tei:titleStmt.tei:title: pod 24 gsung 'bum/_tA ra nA tha/ （dpe bsdur ma/）

tei:div.tei:p: — — sto — ba tshe rī —ci —

〈mes po'i shul bzhag〉 ces pa'i dpe tshogs 'di ni dpal brtsegs bod yig dpe rnying zhib 'jug khang gis bsgrigs shing 'di ga dpe skrun khang dang mnyam 'brel gyis bskrun pa'i dpe rnying dpe tshogs shig yin la/ de yang mkhas dbang gzan dkar rin po che thub bstan nyi ma mchog gis spyi'i gtso skyong gnang ste/ dpal brtsegs bod yig dpe rnying zhib 'jug khang gis nye ba'i lo bcu tsam gyi ring la 'bad brtson chen pos bod kyi sa gnas gang sar bzhugs pa'i bod yig dpe rnying po ti khrir longs pa rang byung dang mi'i gnod 'tshes 'jig la nye ba'i nyen kha las bskyabs te legs par bsgrigs shing dkar chag tu btab/ dpe thum gsol/ dpe sgrom bzhengs te srung skyob mdzad gnang ba dang gnang mus su yod pa ni/rang re'i mes po'i shul nor srung skyob rgyun 'dzin dang bod rig pa'i gal che'i dpyad gzhi mkho 'don gyi dgos pa che ba ma zad/ rang rgyal mi rigs rig gnas nor mdzod dar rgyas dang srung skyob bgyi ba'i 'phrin las gal chen zhig red/nye char dpal brtsegs bod yig dpe rnying zhib 'jug khang dang 'di ga dpe skrun khang gnyis zhib gros byas mthar/ srol rgyun rig gnas srung skyob dang bod rig pa'i dpyad yig myur skyob dang cha tshang du gtong ba'i dmigs yul ngos 'dzin gcig gyur thog 〈bka' gdams dpe dkon gces btus/〉 zhes pa'i dpe rnying dpe dkon gyi dpe tshogs chen mo zhig mu mthud nas legs sgrig dang dpe skrun byed bzhin yod pa dang / da char yang dmigs yul dgos pa gcig gyur thog 〈mes po'i shul bzhag〉 ces pa'i dpe rnying dpe dkon gal chen gyi dpe tshogs chen mo 'di nyid par skrun bya rgyu yin la/ de yang sngon byon mes po mkhas dbang dam pa du mas shul du bzhag pa'i gsung 'bum dpe dkon gal chen rnams dang / 'thar 'thor du bzhugs pa'i dpe dkon gal chen dag phyogs gcig tu bsdus te bsgrigs pa 'di'i nang don thad la/ nang don rig pa dang / gso ba rig pa/ tshad ma rig pa/ sgra rig pa/ bzo rig pa/ lo rgyus/ rtsis rig sogs bcu phrag rig pa'i gnas kun 'dus pa'i dpe dkon nor bu dgos 'dod kun 'byung lta bu zhig yin/ —1—

'ad 'dra' dpe skrun mnyam las kya go skabs legs ngo nged cag dpe skrun khang la thob pa na shan tu skal ba bzang zhing gzi brjid kyi 'os 'gan zhig tu brtsis te lo 'ga'i dpe skrun 'char gzhi gtso bo'i nang du bkod zin cing / las gzhi 'di la krung go'i bod rig pa zhib 'jug nye gnas kyi dbu khrid dang rgyal khab phyi nang gi bod rig pa'i mkhas dbang du mas gdeng 'jog dang mthong chen gyis skul ma yang thob/〈mes po'i shul bzhag〉 gi ma phyi phal cher ni dbu med bris rnying sha stag yi na pas/ ma dnge/ gsal mi gsal dang skung yig mang zhing bris tshugs 'dra min gyi dbang gis klog dka' ba'ang shin tu mang po 'dug 'on kyang dpal brtsegs bod yig dpe rnying zhib 'jug khang gis lo mang ring nyams myong bsdu len dang mkhas dbang du mar bka' 'dri zhus par brten yig gzugs gsar rgyag dang phyogs sgrig thub pa byung / par shing du 'khod yod pa rnams kyang dpe rnying gzhan pa dang bsdur te gtan la phab yod pa bcas te zhib cha deb so so'i bsdu sgrig gsal bshad du gzigs par zhu/dpe rnying srung skyob dang phyogs sgrig dpe skrun gyi las ka 'di la rgyab skyor dang thugs khur gnang mkhan gyi mkhas dbang rnams dang / lhag par du krung go'i bod rig pa zhib 'jug lte gnas kyi dbu khrid lhan rgyas dang / mkhas dbang thub bstan nyi ma rin po che mchog sogs kyis rgyab skyor dang mdzub ston gyi bka' drin bskyangs pa la snying thag pa nas thugs rje che zhu rgyu dang / dpal brtsegs zhib 'jug khang gi 'gan 'dzin pa lhan rgyas dang / zhu dag pa/ yig rgyag pa sogs mdor na las gzhi 'di la lhag bsam dang 'bad brtson chen pos zhabs phyi zhu mkhan rnams la snying thag pa nas bka' drin che zhes zhu rgyu dang /dpe tshogs 'di'i dpe sgrig dang zhu dag thad la ha cang nan tan dang zhib tshags bgyi khul byas mod/'on kyang nga tshor shes tshad dman pa'i dbang gis nor 'chug mi nyung ba yod srid pas dpyod ldan dag gis nor bcos yo bsrang gi dgongs 'char lhug stsol gnang bar zhu zhu/zhes krung go'i bod rig pa dpe skrun khang nas/spyi lo 2007lo'i zla ba dang po'i tshes 10la/—2—

de la 'dir rang cag kha ba can gyi zhing 'dir chos rgyal 'o paṇa rnams dang / sa dge bka' rnying sogs kyi mkhas shing grub pa brnyes pa'i dam pa'i skyes bu rnams kyis/ bshad sgrub kyi shing rta chen po bco brgyad rjes 'brang dang bcas pa'i chos brgyud dang bka' srol ma/tha ri dag dang / de dang rjes su 'brel ba'i thun mong gi rig gnas sum rtags snyan ngag mngon brjod sdeb sbyor/ skar rtsis 'byung rtsis / sgra tshad bzo gso sogs mdo sngags rig gnas dang bcas pa 'i ka/nyung lugs zab cing rgya che ba tshang la ma nor ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa zhig spru chang 'an 'gyur gsum dang / bshad sgrub las gsum gyi sgo nas thog mar sro' sa tod/bar du gtan la phab/ rim bzhin dar rgyas btang ba sogs 'dzin skyong spel bar mdzad pa'i bka' drin bdag rkyen la brten nas/ dbus gtsang khams gsum du bzhugs so cog gi glegs bam thams cad gcig tu sbungs na ri rab lhun po'i gtos dang mnyam zhing / chos tshan gyi rnam dbye ji snyed yod pa grangs su bgrangs na nam mkha'i gza' skar tshogs kyang skyengs par byed pa zhig mchis pa tsam du ma zad / rgya bal hor sogs kyi yul gru kun tu'ang dar khyab che/da lta'i char bod rig pa'am bod kyi shes rig ces su grags pa 'di nyid 'dzam gling shar nub kyi yul gru dag tu'ang mched de/ dper na/ o ka si phor dhi dang / har wid lta bu yo rob dang / a— rdo digs su grags r+ṣa gyi slob grwa ḍā mo

rnams su bod yig gi dpe mdzod chen po yod par ma zad/ bod kyi chos dang rig gzhung slob gnyer byed sa'i sde tshan dang slob ma yang mi nyung ba yod/da ni gong du smras pa'i bshad sgrub shing rta wo po bco brgyad ces pa de gang dang gang yin pa'i ngo sprod mdo tsam zhu na/ de yang ji skad du/ 'jam mgon kong sprul rin po che'i zhal nas/ chos blon thon mi be+e ro ska cog zhus / /gnubs chen rin bzang rngog lo sa skya pa/ /bu ston bshad rgyun 'degs pa'i ka chen bcu// zhes dang / bod yul sgrub brgyud shing rta chen po brgyad/ /rnying ma bka' gdams lam 'bras bka' brgyud pa/ khangs pa zhi byed sbyor drug bsnyen sgrub bo/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ shes bya'i gzhung lugs sna tshogs kyi 'gyur khyad dang 'chad tshul gyi da/bye bas bshad rgyun 'degs pa'i ka chen bcu dang / sgrub pa nyams su len tshul la brgyud pa'i khyad par dang man ngag gi dbye bas sgrub brgyud 'dren pa'i shing rta brgyad de/ pond sgrub shing rta chen po bco brgyad rjes 'brang dang bcas pa'i gsung rab rgya mtsho lta bu zhig bdag cag gi yab mes gong ma rnams kyis gces pa'i lus srog longs spyod thams cad phangs pa med par btang ste/ phyi rabs rang re'i brgyud 'dzin rnams la 'phran yun phan bde'i dpal la dmigs nas bzhag pa'i nor bu rin po che yid bzhin dbang gi rgyal po mtha' yas pa zhig mchis/de dag las mang che ba rig gsar lo bcu'i god chag chen po sogs dus kyi rgud pa'i dbang gis sems med 'byung bzhi'i 'jig pa dang / sems ldan mi dang mi min gyi gnod pas nyams nyes chen por gyur pa ni rgya bod yongs grags ltar lags/—2—

rig gnas gsar brje'i mjug sgril ba dang rbangs cig tang gi yang dag pa'i srid jus kyi nyi 'od slar yang 'phros te/ tang dang rgyal khab kyis 'go khrid dang rtsa 'dzugs gnang nas/ dpe rnying 'thor bsdu dang / legs sgrig dpe skrun/ sgyur spel sogs kyi sgo nas rang rigs kyi rig gnas nyams pa sor chud dang / mi nyams gong 'phel gyi bya bar so so'i 'khos bstun gyi sri zhu sgrub pa'i skal ba bzang po'i dpal la longs su spyad du yod pa'i skabs 'dir/ rang re'i yab mes rnams kyis bzhag pa'i pha nor mang po zhig da dung yang nged cag gi bsod nams kyi bgo skal du lhag yod nga/ rnams la gces spras chen pos srung skyob dang dar spel byed rgyu ni mes rgyal gyis gnang ba'i las 'gan yin par ma zad/ 'u cag bod kyi rig gnas slob gso'i bya bar legs skyes 'bul mkhan gyi rgan dar 'bring gsum gyi shes yon can la mtshon na/ rang re'i phrag par bab pa'i gzhan dring mi 'jog pa'i gzi 'od bla na 'bar ba'i 'os 'gan mchog tu gyur pa zhig kyang yin par sems/der brten/ phyogs dang ris su ma chad pa'i skyes bu dam pa rnams kyis ljags rtsom gnang ba'i gsung rab/ bshad sgrub shing rta bco brgyad las grub nga/'i mdo sngags kyi gzhung bshad dang / chos 'byung dang gdan rabs/ rnam thar dang gsan yig brda sprod dang snyan ngag /rtsis dang gso rig sogs dpe dkon 'thor ba rnams bsdus/ chad pa rnams bsab/ nyams pa rnams gsos/ 'khru/gas pa rnams bsgrigs te dpe tshogs 'ga' rim pa bstar chags su par du bskrun pa dang bskrun rtsis las/—3 —

da lan 'dir jo nang rje bcun tā ra nā tha'i gsung 'bum nga pe bsdur ma 'di rgya che'i gzigs pa po rnams kyi spyan lam du phul ba yin/'byung char nga tsho'i/ dpe tshogs dpar skrun zhu rgyu'i skor la lhag bsam ldan 'ing mkhyen spyan yangs pa'i mkhas nga/bang rnams kyis dgongs 'char gyi bka' sgrub stsol gnang dang / nga/pe dkon gyi ma phyi g.yar gnang gi skyabs 'jug yong ba mkhra/na mche/na/ /zhor 'phros gsi la 'debs zhu ba/ lhag par du da lta lus kyi lang tsho rgyas shing / sems kyi blo gros bkra ba'i gzhon skyes rnam/sa la mtshon na/ snying pos dben pa'i la pho 'don nga / las// zol med kyi lha ga bsam dkar po snying la 'chang / don ྅ na gyi rngam/ dkar bya ba dang du le na/ lhad med kyi chos dang rig gzhung slob gnyer byed/ 'khos bstun gyi sri zhus las ka cung zad re sgrub nus na/mes rgya'/ 'a ⑫pas hog 'grub/ rang rigs la legs skyes 'bul/ rang nyid kyi 'a rgya ma sngon thub pa 'is/ kya/ nga 'ong ba ni mthong chos mngon gyur lags pas/ de bzhan dbongs dbyings su chub par zhu'o/ /phran 'brog rgan 'khyams po thub bstan nyi mas/spyi ro/ 2007pa'i zla tshes la gus phul/—4—

bsdu sgras gsal bshad/bsdu sgrig gsal nga gond/da lam nga tsho'i jo nang rje btsun tā ra nā tha'i gsung 'bum phyogs gcig tu bsgrigs te par skrun zhus pa 'di ni/ gzan dkar mchog sprul thub bstan nyi ma'i bka' slob dang bdag rkyen 'og byung ba zhig yin/de yang spyir khong la gsung 'bum pod ba'i bcu tsam zhig yod tshul phyis su bris pa'i rnam thar 'ga' skolas gsal yang / dngos su pod bzhi bcu'i dkar chag kha gsal zhig da sngon nga tsho'i mjal rgyu ma byung / da lam dngos su mjal rgyu byung ba'i pod bco lnga ni/ deng sang yongs grags su rtag brtan par ma zhes 'bod pa 'di ni/ bod rab byung bcu pa'i me 'brug (spyi lo1616) la/ mnga' ris smad kyi gung thang gi rgyal rabs nyi shu rtsa gsum pa'am/ yang lugs gcig la dmar po sde bsgrangs na nyi shu rtsa bzhi pa bsod nams dbang phyug sdes yon bdag byas/ tā ra nā tha'i dngos slob gnya' yi ban+di dkon mchog legs pas/ thog ma'i mtshams sbyor dang par byang 'bri ba sogs byas te/ dus 'khor sngags phreng dang skad gnyis shan sbyar sogs chos tshan bcu bzhi shing par du bkos pa/ rtag brtan dam chos gling du spyan drangs te bzhugs su gsol/ de'i steng du rtag brtan rang nas brkos pa bcas ngo/da — 1 —

bco lnga tsam zhig yod pa de'i bu dpe par ma tshar gcig /rgyal dbang lnga pa chen pos 'bras sbungs dpe mdzod khang du gdan drangs ba/ phyis dus 'gyur skabs su pe cing mi rigs pho brang du bzhugs kyang / deng seng bod ljongs dpe mdzod khang du spyan drangs te bzhugs pa de yin/yang gangs can mkhas grub rim byon gyi ming mdzod las/ khong la gsung rtsom shin tu mang po yod par grags kyang rgyal dbang lnga pa chen pos/gsung 'bum shing par rnams bka' rgya btab ste par mi chog pa mdzad pas da lta khong gi gsung rtsom rnams kha tshang ba ha cang dka'/ rgyal dbang lnga pa zhing du gshegs rjes/ blo gros brtan pas khong gi gsung 'bum la dkar chag bsdus pa zhig mdzad 'dug /de'i rjes zha lu ri phug sprul skus mdzad pa'i tā ra nā tha'i gsung 'bum dkar chag dwangs gsal me long zhes pa'i nang du/ pod ka nas tsa bar bcu bdun la chos tshan nyis brgya don gnyis dang / ldeb grangs bdun stong brgyad brgya lnga bcu bzhugs/da lta pe cing mi rigs pho brang du pod bcu bdun la chos tshan nyis brgya don brgyad dang / ldeb grangs bdun stong dgu brgya lnga bcu rtsa brgyad bzhugs zhes gsal yang nga tsho'i gong gi dkar chag gnyis po da sngon mjal rgyu ma rnyed/ de yang zha lu ri phug sprul skus dkar chag dwangs gsal me long zhes pa ljags rtsom gnang ste/ sngar rtag brtan gyi shing par dus zing dbang —2—

gis nyams chag shor ba rnams/ kha gso mdzad tshul thos kyang zhib phra'i lo rgyus kha gsal mjal rgyu ma byung / da lta dgen 'jam dbyangs rnams rgyal gyi dpe mdzod du bzhugs pa'i par rnying pod bcu bdun 'di/ zha lu ri phug sprul skus nyams gso mdzad pa de yin nam snyams ste/ da lta rtag brtan gyi par rnying bod ljongs dpe mdzod khang du bzhugs pa pod bco lnga dang / pod grangs dang chos tshan mang nyung tshig mtshams sogs cung mi 'dra ba yod pa'i phyir/da lam nga tshos khong gi gsung 'bum glog klad nang du bcug skabs kyi thog ma'i ma dpe ni/ nye char bla ma yon tan bzang pos 'dzam thang du shing par la brkos pa'i glegs bam nyer bzhi can de la byas te zhu dag thengs gsum byas/ de rjes sngar jo nang rtag brtan du bzhugs pa rtsom pa po tā ra nā tha rang nyid kyi phyag dpe skabs 'gar phyag mchan yod pa/ da lta 'bras sbungs gnas bcu lha khang nang bzhugs bris ma pod chung bcu la chos tshan43la bsdur gzhi dang / jo nang rtag brtan gyi par rnying pod bco lnga bod ljongs dpe mdzod khang du bzhugs pa dang / a ri ba dgen 'jam dbyangs rnam rgyal gyi dpe mdzod du bzhugs pa par rnying pod bcu bdun yod pa gnyis phyogs bsdoms kyis/ par rnying pod nyi shu tsam la chos tshan 314byung ba la sdur byed byas te dpe bsdur thengs dang po zhus/—3 —

de nas rtag brtan gyi par pod nyi shu la bsdur gzhi dang / 'dzam thang sga par mas sdur byed byas te dpe bsdur theng gnyis pa zhus pa yin/ 'on kyang par ma snga phyi gnyis dang bris ma gcig bcas dpe gsum po rtsa ba'i cha nas gcig mtshungs su bzhugs pa las khyad par chen po mi 'dug /cho ga'i skor la mi 'dra ba cung zad yod pa ni mchan dkyus su shor ba yin 'dug pa rnams kyang / gug rtags nang du bcug te gsal po byas yod/ rtag brtan nga/ra rnying dang 'bras sprungs bris ma gnyis su dpe ma bzhugs nga// 'dzam thang par ma'i nang bzhugs gsung thor bu'i skor wa rtags can dang / zha rtags can gnyis dang / za rtags can dbu ma theg mchog gi zin bris rab byed drug pa yan chad/ tā ra nā tha'i zhal gsung slob ma ye shes rgya mtshos zin bris su bkod pa dang / rab byed bdun pa brgyad pa gnyis dza 'go'i dge bshes mchog grub rgya mtshos gsar du bsnan pa/ 'a rtags can nyang yul gyi lo rgyus tā ra nā thas zhabs btags mdzad par grags pa bcas chos tshan121la 'dzam thang gi par ma'i dpe gcig pu las/ rtag brtan par rnying dang 'bras sbungs bris ma gnyis kyi bsdur gzhi ma rnyed/ rtag brtan par rnying gcig pu las gzhan gnyis la med pa chos tshan4/ yang rtag brtan dang 'dzam thang par ma gnyis char med pa/ 'bras sbungs gnas bcu lha khang du bzhugs pa'i gral nas chos tshan bco brgyad la ldeb193gsar rnyed byung —4 —

ba bcas la/ zhu dag byas te kha skong gi tshul du bzhag yod pa bcas khyon bsdoms deb bzhi bcu zhe lnga la chos tshan903yod/ da lta nga tsho'i ma dpe g.yar rgyu ma rnyed pa sngon rtsom pa po'i phyag dpe'i gral nas yin pa/ 'bras sbungs gnas bcu lha khang / dpe rtags phyi298nang bzhugs gtam du bya ba nor bu'i 'byung gnas ldeb6/ yang phyi508nang bzhugs 'khor lo gsum gyi rnam bzhag chos dbyings rgya mtsho'i rgyan rnam par brkad pa ldeb92/ ste lag bris kyi chos tshan gnyis po ma 'ongs par dpe g.yar thabs bya dgos/da lta nga tshos dpe bsdur dang zhu dag gi skabs su ma dpe rtsa 'dzin byas te/ dpe gsum mi 'dra ba'i tshe rtag brtan la〈〈rta〉〉rtags 'di dang /'dzam thang la rtags〈〈rja 〉〉'di/ dag cha nor bcos la gug rtag 'di( 1dang / mchan rnams gug rtag〈 〉'di'i nang du blug yod/gsal bshad zhu rgyu zhig la deb bzhi pa'i nang du/ kun mkhyen dol po pa'i gsung chos tshan bzhi/ rig 'jin tshe dbang kun khyab kyi gsung lho sgo'i cho ga zhes pa'i chos tshan gcig bcas 'dzam thang par mar bzhag yod pa dang / yang sa bzang ma ti paṇa chen gyi gsung dus 'khor phyag rgya'i skor chos tshan gcig rtag brtan par rnying du yod pa rnams rang 'jag bzhag yod pa dang / khong gi rang rnam gtso bor gyur pa'i lo rgyus zhal gdams rnams su/gtsang gi yul skad yin nam snyam pa'i tha snyad go dka' ba mang po zhig —5—

bed spyad gnang ba dag kyang rang sor bzhag yod/da lam bka' 'bum 'di rtsis 'khor nang du blugs pa'i 'gro song tsā 'dra tshogs pa nas zhus shing / par skrun tshar lnga brgya'i 'gro song bod rig pa dpe skrun khang nas bgyis/ tshar brgyad brgya'i 'gro song hrin krin sogs kyi rgya'i spyin bdag rnams kyis gnang zhing / tshar nyis brgya'i 'gro song tsā 'dra tshogs pa nas bgyis pa bcas kyi mthun rkyen las/ da lam dngos su par du bskrun thub pa byung ste rgya che'i klog pa po rnams kyi spyan lam du phul ba yin/las gzhi 'dir bod ljongs dpe mdzod khang nas ma dpe pod bco lnga g.yar gnang byung ba dang / 'dzam thang bla ma mun sel mchog nas kyang ma dpe btsal rogs dang / go rim sgrig rgyu/ zhu dag bcas la rogs ram gang mang gnang ba dang / khams sprul bsod nams don grub mchog nas nyang yul chos 'byung zhu dag gi rogs ram gnang ba dang / bla ma dpal ldan rgya mtshos zhu dag gi las ka spyi'i thugs 'gan che bzhes gnang ba bcas la thugs rje che zhu rgyu ba'o/ /dpal brtsegs bod yig dpe rnying zhib 'jug khang nas karma bde legs kyis/

khong ni slob dpon chen hūṃ rno wang gnas dang / paṇ+ḍi ta gha ya dha ra/gnyos lo tsā ba/ kha rag sgom chung sogs skyes chen mang pos byin gyis brlabs shing / bod skyong brtan ma bcu gnyis kyi nang tshan kha rag khyung btsun gyi gnas jo mo kha rag ces pa'i 'dabs/ chu bo chen po lo hi ta'i nye 'gram du rwa lo tsā ba chen po'i brgyud pa bar ma chad par byon pa la/ shar nub gnyis su gyes nga 'a sa shar ba kun dga' seng ge'i gdung brgyud/ sngags 'chang tshul khrims rgya mtsho'i sras rnam rgyal phun tshogs dgung lo bzhi bcu zhe dgu pa rje 'di'i yab dang /yum rdo rje bu dga' dgung lo bcu dgu pa gnyis kyi sras su bod rab byung bcu pa'i shing phag (spyi lo1575) la/ ngo mtshar ba'i ltas dang bcas sku 'khrungs te mes pos pad+ma sri gcod rdo rje zhes mtshan gsol/sku bltams te zla ba brgyad song rjes bzhengs nas gom pa spo thub pa dang / dgung lo gcig tsam nas gsung byon te nga bla ma kun dga' grol mchog yin zhes zhal gyis bzhes nga/ dang / gzhan yang sku gong ma'i rten gsum dang spyin bdag / nye gnas sogs kyi lo rgyus gsal bar gsungs pa sogs kyis/jo nang bla ma kun dga' grol mchog gi yang srid 'khrul med du shes te/ dgung lo bzhi par jo nang mkhan chen lung rigs rgya mtsho dang / zhabs drung bkra shis — 1 —

stobs rgyas dbang po sogs rta pa brgya dang drug cu rtsa lnga tsam gdan 'dren du byung nas/ gtsang phyogs su gdan drangs te sku gong ma'i slob ma rdo ring kun dga' rgyal mtshan/ lha dbang grags pa/ mkhan chen lung rigs rgya mtsho/ mkhas dbang byams pa lhun grub/ rje drung kun dga' dpal bzang sogs kyis chos lung byang rtser khri ston mdzad/ rdo ring pa chen po 'jam dbyangs kun dga' rgyal mtshan gyi drung du/ thog ma'i rten 'brel du sgrol dkar gyi rjes gnang dang / gshed dmar lha lnga'i dbang / lam 'bras gtso bor gyur pa'i dbang dang gdams pa myo dzi po gsan/de nas dgung lo drug pa nas yi ge sbyor klog phul du phyin pa mkhyen te/dbang dang rjes gnang sogs yig thog nas gnang ba la dka' tshegs med nga/ byung /dgung lo brgyad par rje rgong ma'i dngos slob mkhas dbang byams pa lhun grub yongs 'jin du bsten nas/ tshad ma rigs gter sbyangs pas gzhung don la go ba rnyed wo blo 'dzin 'a/ zla ba lnga tsam 'gor/ gzhan yang mdo rgyud kyi gzhung lugs mang por gsan bsam mdzad pas mkhyen rtogs rgyas/dgung 'o brgyad la phebs skabs stag lung kun dga' bkra shis rgyal mtshan gdan drangs te thog mar bka' gdams glegs bam gyi lung zhus te/ de nas bod rab byung bcu pa'i chu rta khrums stod zla ba'i tshes lnga (spyi 'o 1582)la/ chos lung byang rtse'i rma chod khang gi yang thog tu/ dpal stag lung pa chen po rje btsun kun dga' bkra shis rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po'i zhal snga nas kyi —2—

mkhan po dang / 'jam dbyangs kun dga' rgyal mtshan dpal bzang ngo/sa slob dpon dang / rje drung kun dga' dpal bzang pos dus go ba/chos rje mchod gnas pas grogs dan bgyis te yongs rdzogs dge bsnyen dang bar ma rab byung sngon du 'gro bas dge tshul gyi sdom pa bzhes te/ mtshan kun dga' snying po bkra shis rgyal mtshan zhes gsol/ dag pa'i gzigs snang du rgya gar gyi paṇa chen dz+wa la nā thas tā ra nā tha zhes pa'i mtshan gsol/chos rje brag stod pa lha dbang grags pa'i drung nas chos drug dang phyag chen sogs/ zab chos mang po gsan pas nang zab lam gyi rtogs pa mngon du gyur/ rje drung kun dga' dpal bzang las dus 'khor gtso bor gyur pa'i zab chos mang po gsan/ mkhan po lung rigs rgya mtsho'i mdun dus kyi 'khor lo'i dbang dang rgyud bshad/ dpal rgyal ba jo nang pa'i lugs kyi sbyor drug gi zab khrid mtha' dag gsan te nyams len mjad/ bu lugs kyi sbyor drug gi khrid kyang rdzogs par gsan/ gzhan yang jo zhal bla ma mang po'i gdams khrid dang bka' bstan sogs rgya gzhung gi man ngag mang po dang / kun mkhyen dol bo pa'i gsung 'bum sogs lung mang po gsan/ mkhas grub sangs rgyas ye shes/rdo rje 'dzin pa ye shes dbang po sogs las/ sa skya jo nang shangs pa zhwa lu 'brug pa kaX tshang / stag lung sogs kyi chos skor bcas rgyud sde bzhi'i dbang khrid man ngag mtha' dag ma lus par gsan/ gzhan yang rgya gar gyi grub chen gu ru lho phyogs pa sangs rgyas sbas pa'i mgon po/ 'jam dbyangs kun dga'i mtshan can sogs bshes gnyen mang po'i zhabs la gshugs te/ zhang tshal pa'i chos —3—

skor dang / yang dgon pa'i bka' 'bum/ dwags po lha rje'i bka' 'bum/ ri chos ma drug gi khrid/ mai tri bcu gsum ma'i dbang / sangs rgyas thod pa'i dbang /o rgyan bsnyen sgrub skor gyi khrid lung yongs rdzogs/ mar pa nas brgyud rngog pa'i bka' babs dgyes rdor yab yum/ gur rigs bsdus/ gdan bzhi yab yum/ ma hā mā ya ste drug smri ti nas brgyud pa 'jam dpal gsang ldan bcas rngog dkyil bdun/ rngog ṭīka rin chen rgyan 'dra'i mdzub khrid/brtag gnyis sa rngog gnyis ka'i bshad srol/ stag lung thang pa'i bka' 'bum/sgrub thabs brgya rtsa'i rjes gnang /ni gu chos drug 'jam dkar gyi rjes gnang /'grel chen dri med 'od dang /rdo rje snying 'grel dang / dgyes pa rdo rje'i rgya gzhung / dgyes rdor skor la gtso che'i chos sna sum cu so dgu dang / gdan bzhi'i khrid tshul rgyas pa/ ār+ya de wa'i chos lnga sogs rgya gzhung bcu/ sa ra he'i chos lnga/ nag po'i gzhung drug pū hi smad lnga/dril bu skor gsum/ gshed dmar bi rū pa'i gzhung brgyad/ ku ku ri pa'i chos bdun/ sgrub thabs mtsho skyes sogs dgyes rdor gyi gzhung shin tu mang po dang / dpe med 'tsho'i sbyor drug rtsa 'grel/dza lan+ta ri'i do ha/ sems kyi phyag rgya sogs mdo sngags spyi dang / khyad par du gsang sngags rgyud sde'i dbang bskyed rdzogs mtha' yas pa gsan/ de nas dgung lo bcu bdun pa rab byung bcu pa'i lcags yos hor zla bcu gcig pa'i tshes bcu bdun (spyi lo1591)la/ 'jam dbyangs kun dga' rgyal mtshan gyis mkhan po/ bla ma byams pa lhun grub kyis las kyi slob dpon/dge ba'i bshes gnyen blo bzang pa dang / rje drung kun dga' bsod nams —4—

sogs kyis kha skong gnang ste bsnyen par rdzogs pa dge slong gi sdom pa bzhes te/ phyi ltar ngur smrig gi rgyal mtshan 'chang ba'i dge slong 'dul ba 'dzin pa/nang ltar gzhan phan snying rje chen pos thugs rgyud yongs su brlan pa'i rgyal sras sems pa chen po/ gsang ba bskyed rdzogs kyi zab gnad la mnga' brnyes pa'i sngags 'chang rdo rje 'dzin pa zhig tu gyur/de nas bsam sdings su dpal ldan bla ma dam pa byams pa'i mtshan can gyi drung du rdo rje phreng ba'i dbang yongs rdzogs dang / dpal mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho'i dbang bcas zhus/ bla ma dpal ldan chos kyi bzang po'i zhal snga nas/ rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor la brten nas dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i dbang yongs su rdzogs pa bdag po chen po'i mthar thug pa dang / gsang bdag 'khor lo chen po/dril bu lha lnga/ gzungs grwa lnga/ dril bu lus dkyil sogs dbang mang po gsan/ gzhan yang dge ba'i bshes gnyen rnams las/ gsang 'dus 'phags lugs dang / zhabs lugs/ gshin rje gshed dgra gdong 'jigs gsum/gshed dmar bram ze dpal 'dzin gyi lugs/ gdan bzhi'i gzhung bdun/sangs rgyas thod pa phyogs kyi rgya gzhung mang po dang / rgyud sde 'og ma ci rigs pa dang / grub pa sde bdun/ snying po skor drug yid la mi byed pa'i chos skor rnams dang / phreng ba skor gsum/ rgyud 'grel grags can phal che ba dang /bslab btus dang / byang sa sogs gzhung mang por thos bsam gnang bas blo gros kyi lus stobs ches cher rgyas te gzhung lugs rab 'byams smra ba'i mkhas pa chen por gyur/—5—

de nas bla ma kun dga'i mchan can dang slob dpon rin po ches bka' bzhin/ rje 'di nyid dgung lo nyer gcig pa rab byung bcu pa'i shing lug hor zla ༵skos ༵ chi lnga ༵ bra pa | rnyi~X rnyi/da ༵ nā da sgi dhi ༵ ji/ rnyi / ༵ ḍi ༵ bye /bas /snri ༵ du~Xdā slob da dhi / ༵kyā~Xsna spya ༵ kyā ༵༵ ༵ ri pa lja ba smra~X rdo rtsi lha rnyi 'dun ga ༵ / las / pa dang/ rdo/ ni la la bod spyo sngi rdo 'i zhal bshes gis 1 two nga dang song de hūm̐ dzhai pa ngo nga yang bye tai slo / bye gli thebs / na mkhye/pa rmis bar 1 4 na chen two// s+ho tī / ༵ / sam chos kyis sa su myong rdo / rnyiX pa rda ru go /de nas rgya gar gyi paṇ+ḍi ta pu khyu nan+da dang pra yā mā nan+da gnyis dang mjal 'phrad mdzad de gsung gleng gnang bas/ khong gnyis grub mtha' nang par 'dug gnyi thamaX rgi kau rdo dug / mkhaX ༷ yang pa cho dug ༷ ngh+ru stsi lha/ ngh+ru ༷/ rgi rdo ༷ nas shing bstan bcos kyang than thun bsgyur/ bha ra ta dang rā ma ya ṇa la sogs pa'i lo rgyus kyang mang du thos/ de skabs rā ma ya ṇa'i srung ma ha nu ma tha'i cho 'phru/la lus —6—

byang chen gyi ri dang mnyam pa'i spre'u dang / bha ra ta'i srung ma rgyal po sgyi ma dngos su mthong bas paṇ+ḍi ta na re/ khyod la 'go bar 'dug mthu dang snyan gras sa longs spyod chen po yong gsungs na yang / chos la mi dad pa'i lha 'dre bsten pas ci bya snyam nas yal bar dor ba yin zhes gsungs/lo dus chag med jo nang du sbyor drug gi khrid gsungs pas ngo ma 'phrod pa gcig kyang ma byung / rgya gar gyi slob dpon su ni khyu ṇa shrī dang puṇ+ḍa badz+ra sogs las zab khrid kyi gdams pa mang po gsan/ jo nang du sgrub mchod 'a dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor bzhengs te/ 'dus pa bdun brgya tsam la dbang bcu gcig pa rdzogs par gnang / dgung grangs nyer drug skor rwa sgreng du phebs te tshogs su chos 'brel tsam dang / rje tsong kha pa'i bzhugs khri'i steng nas lam rim gsungs/dgung lo nyer dgu par jo nang du bzhugs skabs tho rengs shig la rje btsun byams pas zhal gzigs te/ khong rang la thim pa'i gzigs snang byung bas gzhan stong dbu ma'i grub mtha' la nges shes gting nas rnyed/ kun mkhyen dol po pas zhal yang yang gzigs nas lung bstan gnang ba dang /gzim lam du sham+bha lar phyin nas rigs ldan sprul pa'i sku dang mjal te chos gsan pa'i snang ba sogs gzigs snang mang po byung /dgung lo so dgu par chos 'khor lha sar phebs nas dar chen mang po bslangs te jo bo'i mdun thugs smon zab rgyas gnang / de nas kun mkhyen dol po pa'i sku brnyan gsung byon ma dang / thugs rje chen po/ tshe dpag med bcas —7—

byin rlabs can gyi rten gsum po'i mdun du mchod 'bul dang thugs smon rgya chen gnang ste smon lam rgyal ba rgya mtsho yang brtsams/dgung lo zhe gcig pa rab byung bcu pa'i shing yos hor zla gnyis pa'i tshes bcu gcig (spyi lo1615)la/ gtsang pa sde srid phun tshogs rnam rgyal gyis chos gzhis dang / lha 'bangs sogs rgya cher phul nas mthun rkyen sbyar ba las/dpal rtag brtan dam chos gling nges don dga' ba'i tshal gyi gnas gzhi'i las grwa btsugs te/ phyi gtsug lag khang dang grwa khang brgya phrag tsam lcags ri dang bcas pa/ nang gi rten sangs rgyas rabs bdun dang / tshe dpag med/ sgrol ma/yum chen mo/ dzam bha la sogs gser zangs las grub pa mang po dang / dpal 'khor lo sdom pa'i sku zhal phyag yongs rdzogs gser zangs las grub pa dang /bde gshegs mchod rten cha brgyad sogs rten gsum dpag tu med pa bzhengs/jo nang du yang lha khang gsar bzhengs dang nang rten byams chen thog tshad gnyis tsam gser zangs las grub pa sogs mang po bzhengs/ gzhan yang lha bzo sogs lag rtsal pa rnams dang po rgya bal sogs nas gdan drangs/ de nas bris pa dang / spar brko shing bzo sogs lag rtsal pa gso skyong gnang bas/las rigs lag rtsal pa rnams kyang gzhan la re mi dgos pa byung ste/ bka' bstan 'gyur ro cog tshar mang po dang / bka' 'bum skor po ti bzhi bcu shing par du brkos pa sogs rten gsum mang po gsar bzhengs gnang /skabs shig ri bo che nas rgya dpe pod bcu tsam zhig 'byor byung ba'i nang / yar klung lo tsā ba'i phyag dpe ngo ma dus 'khor 'grel chen pod gnyis —8—

'dug dus 'khor rgyud kyi dpe de dbus phyogs nas snga mo zhig tu lag son byung ba dang / 'grel pa 'di skabs su rnyed pa la ya mtshan chen po byung ste thengs mang bklags pas zung sbyor la yang blo skyed chen po byung / gzhan yang dbang mdor bstan gyi 'grel pa don dam bsdus pa'i mdzad byang la nā ro pa'i mtshan yod pa dang / kyai rdo rje'i 'grel pa rdo rje'i tshig bsdus kyi mdzad byang du byang chub bzang po'i skad dod bo dhi bha dra zhes yod pa sogs mang po byung /yang skabs shig gtsang pa sde srid kyis sog po'i steng du dmag dpung chas rtsis la srung 'khor dang sku rim gnang ba'i tshe/ khong ni rje tsong kha pa chen por lhag tu dad pa che ba dang / khyad par du chos sde chen po 'bras sbungs la nye sems kyi bag chags shin tu che ba zhig yod pas/ chos sde chen po de nyid dar zhing rgyas pa dang rtsod pa 'jam po'i sgo nas zhi ba'i smon lam btab kyang / nus pa ma thon pa ni phyogs gnyis ka las ngan gyi dbang gis ded pa la g.yol thabs bral zhes gsungs/ de nas dpal 'khor bde chen/ rtse chen chos sde/'jag bsam gnyis/ thar pa gling / rtag brtan chos 'phel sogs dbus gtsang gi chos sde mang por chos dang longs spyod kyi bsnyen bkur rgya chen gnang ste bskyangs/de nas dgung grangs re gcig bzhes pa rab byung bcu gcig pa'i shing phag (spyi lo1635) la/ rtag brtan dam chos gling nges don dga' ba'i tshal gyi gdan sa 'jam dbyangs sprul sku sangs rgyas rgya mtsho la gtad de/ chos lung rtse dang jo mo nang du dus khrid phyag len rgyas pa gnang nas/ da res ma gtogs —9—

'dir chos mi 'chad gsungs te bu slob rnams la zhal ta mang po gnang ste/ lo de'i nag pa zla ba'i tshes nyer brgyad la zhi bar gshegs so//slob ma/ sprul sku sangs rgyas rgya mtsho/ mkhas dbang ye shes rgya mtsho/mkhan chen rin chen rgya mtsho/ mkhas grub blo gros rnam rgyal rnams dang / sgam po sprul sku/ chos rje ngag dbang pa/ bla ma chu bo chung ba'i sku skye/ mkhan po kun dga' bkra shis rgyal mtshan/ sprul sku ngag gi dbang po/ tre bo sprul sku/chos rje rin stengs pa/ dus 'khor shar chen pa/ chos rje lha bo pa/ dge slong snying po mtha' yas/ byams pa yon tan mgon po/ ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams/ mi pham dkon mchog legs pa/ kun dga' 'phrin las dbang mo/gtsang gi rgyal sras kun dga' bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan sogs mang po byung /gzhan yang bstan pa'i spyin bdag gtsang pa sde srid phun tshogs rnam rgyal/ byang bdag bkra shis stobs rgyal/ yar 'brog bstan 'dzin mi 'gyur dbang gi rgyal po sogs mang ngo/ /dpal brtsegs bod yig dpe rnying zhib 'jug khang nas karma bde legs kyis/— 10—

sgrol ma'i rgyud kyi 'byung khungs gsal bar byed pa'i lo rgyus gser gyi phreng ba zhes bya ba bzhugs/ 1phyag 'tshal nyer gcig gi bstod pa'i rnam par nga khrig da pa bzhugs/ 39rgyud sde lnga'i brgyud 'debs dngos grub rol mtsho bzhugs/ 63rgyud sde lnga'i dkyil 'khor sgrub pa'i thabs zhes bya ba bzhugs/ 67dpal rgyud sde lnga'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga don gsal rgyas byed ces bya ba bzhugs/ 104ni gu lugs kyi bde mchog lha lnga'i mngon rtogs bzhugs/ 176ni gu lugs kyi bde mchog lha lnga'i dbang chog bzhugs/ 186zab lam ni gu chos drug gi khrid yig zab don thang mar brdal ba bzhugs/ 213— 1 —
zab lam ni gu chos drug gi gzhung khrid ma mo'i lhan thabs kha skong bzhugs/ 327ni gu 'khrul 'khore rtsa 'grel bzhugs/ 358

lo rgyus gser gyi phreng ba zhes bya ba bzhugs/oX snyu sti/ na mo gu sa sgrol ma'i rgyud kyi byung khungs gsal bar byed pa'i lo rgyus gser gyi phreng ba zhes bya ba bla ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /chos kun gdod nas spros dang bral la phyag 'tshal lo/ /thugs rje chen pos dngos kun khyab la phyag 'tshal lo/ /mtha' dag 'gro ba mchog tu sgrol la phyag 'tshal lo/ / rgyal ba'i yum gyur sgrol ma khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'dir sgrol ma'i rgyud gsungs pa'i thog mar lo rgyus gsung ba dag bsnyad na/ sngon thog ma med pa'i dus shig na/ 'jig rten gyi khams sna tshogs pa'i 'od ces bya bar/ bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa rnga sgra zhes bya ba byung ste/ de'i bstan pa la mchog tu gus pa'i rgyal po'i bu mo ye shes zla ba zhes bya ba zhig yod de/ des sangs rgyas de 'khor nyan thos dang byang chub sems dpa'i dge 'dun grangs med pa dang bcas pa la lo bye ba brgya stong gi bar du mchod par byas te/ nyi ma re re bzhin du phyogs bcu dpag tshad bcu gnyis thams cad rin po ches go mtshams med par bkang ba'i rin thang gi tshad dang mnyam pa'i mchod rdzas dag bshams so/ / de'i mthar byang chub tu sems bskyed de sems dang po bskyed pa yin no/ /de'i tshe dge slong rnams kyis khyed dge ba'i rtsa ba 'di nyid kyis lus 'di nyid la skyes par gyur te/bstan pa la bya ba byed par smon lam btab na de bzhin du 'gyur ba'i phyir de

—————ltar rigs so zhes bskul ba las/ drin lan mang du yod skad nga 'a// mthar rgyal ba'i bu mos smras pa/ 'di na skyes pa med cing bud med med/ / bdag med gang zag med cing rnam rig med/ /pho mor btags pa 'di ni ya ma brla/ /'jig rten blo ngan rnam par 'khrul bar gyur/ /ces bya ba la sogs pa brjod de/skyes pa'i rten la byang chub 'dod pa ni mang gi /bud med kyi lus kyi 'gro ba'i don spyod pa ni 'ga' yang med do/ /de bas na snyen ra ba ma stong kyi bar du bud med kyi gzugs kyis 'gro ba'i don bya'o/ /zhes dam bcas so/ /de nas lo bye ba brgya stong gi bar du/ de rgyal po'i pho brang du gnas shing 'dod pa'i yon to lnga la thabs mkhas pas spyod bzhin du ting nge 'dzin bsgoms pas/ mi skye ba'i chos la bzod pa thob cing / 'gro ba thams cad sgrol ba zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin bsgrubs so/ /ting nge 'dzin grub pa de'i nus pas/ de nas nyin re bzhin du snga dro'i dus kyi tshe/ sems can bye ba brgya stong re 'jig rten pa'i sems las bsgral te/ bzod pa la ma bkod kyi bar du zas za bar mi byed do/ /nyi ma phyi tsho tshe yang de tsam re 'god par byed do/ /de nas sngar gyi ming de 'gyur nas/sgrol ma zhes bya bar gyur to/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa rnga sgras kyang / ji srid bla na med pa'i byang chub mngon du byas pa de srid du/ ming lha mo sgrol mas mtshan pa 'ba' zhig tu 'gyur bar lung bstan to/ /de nas bskal pa bi ba dha rnam par rgyal ba zhes bya ba la/ de bzhin gshegs pa don yod grub pa'i drung du/ phyogs bcu'i zhing rab 'byams thams cad kyi sems can rnams la nye bar 'tshe ba thams cad bsrung zhing skyob par —2—

dam bcas/ bdud thams cad rnam par 'joms pa'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par bzhugs pas bskal pa dgu bcu rtsa lnga'i bar du nyin re bzhin du 'gro ba'i gtso bo bye ba brgya stong 'bum phrag re bsam gtan la yang dag par bkod/nub re bzhin gzhan 'phrul bdag po ste bdud bye ba brgya stong re btul bas sgrol ma/ gdung ma/ myur ma/ dpa' mo zhes mtshan du btags go /de nas bskal pa thog pa med pa zhes bya ba la/ dge slong dri ma med pa'i 'od kyi snang ba zhes bya ba phyogs bcu'i de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi snying rje chen po'i 'od zer gyis mngon par dbang bskur bas/ de nyid 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs su gyur la/ de'i tshe de bzhin gshegs pa rigs lnga la sogs pa sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyis/ slar yang rma/khyen pa'i ye shes kyi ngo bor gyur pa 'od zer chen po'i dbang bskur bas/ 'od zer snga phyi gnyis yab yum du gyur pa 'dres pa las lha mo sgrol mar gyur te spyan ras gzigs kyi thugs ka nas byung nas sangs rgyas thams cad kyi dgongs pa bskang ba dang /sems can rnams 'jigs pa chen po brgyad dang / bcu drug las skyob par mdzad do/ /de nas bskal ba bzang po chen po zhes bya ba 'a/ mi g.yo dbugs 'byung gi skabs nas 'byung ba ltar bstan rgo /de nas bskal pa a sa ske zhes pa la phyogs bcu'i de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis dbang bskur bas sangs rgyas thams cad bskyed pa'i yum du gyur to /de dag ni sngon thog ma med pa'i dus go /de nas bskal pa 'di nyid la/ ri bo ta lar sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' lha klu gnod sbyin la sogs —3—

pa grangs med cing / tshad med pa'i dbus su 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs kyis sgrol ma'i sngags rgyud 'bum phrag brgya gsungs so/ /rdzogs ldan gyi dus su rigs drug gi sems can gyi don de kas byed skad gsum ldan gyi tshe de nub nas 'bum phrag drug pa byung ngo / /gnyis ldan gyi dus na de yang nub nas stong phrag bcu gnyis pa byung ngo / /de nas rtsod ldan gyi dus na sgrol ma 'dus pa glo ka stong yod pa 'di byung ngo / /'dir bla ma'i zhal nas/ rdzogs ldan la sogs pa de rnams su rgyud kyi glegs bam ni yod pa ma yin mod/ lha dang rig 'dzin rnams kyi sar rgya cher spyod pas 'gro ba gzhan thams cad kyi yang don chen por gyur pa la dgongs pa yin no/ /ces gsung / 'on kyang sngags kyi gdul bya dus de dag tu yang 'byung ba mi 'gal ba'i phyir/ glegs bam yang 'byung du rung la/ mtha' gcig tu de 'dra'i nges bzung mi dgos par mngon no/ khyad par rgyud 'di rnams slar yang 'o skol kyi ston pas bzlos te gsungs pa'ang yin te/ 'di nyid kyi bshad pa'i rgyud mkha' 'gro ma gsang ba'i thig le las/ gru 'dzin ri yi rtse mor ni/ shwakya sernyes gsungs pa'i rgyud/ /ces gsungs pas so/ /'di'i gtam rgyud zhal snga nas 'byung ba ni 'di yin te/ de yang ston pa 'di nyid sangs rgyas pa'i mdzad pa sems can la ston par bzhed nas/ byang chub kyi snying po la zhugs te/smin mtshams kyi 'od zer gyis bdud kyi gnas thams cad khyab par mdzad pa na/ bdud kyi dmag rnams lhags pa'i tshe/ sgrol mas bzhad pa brgyad kyis bzhad pas de thams cad sa la 'gyel zhing brgyal bar gyur skad/ de nas ston pa nyid khro bo mi g.yo bar gyur te/ bdud thams cad ma thag par byed pa'i ting —4—

nge 'dzin gis bdud bcom ste/ slar yang byang chub kyi snying po la mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas nas/ de bzhin gshegs pa mi bskyod pa dang gnyis su med par gyur ba la/ lha mo sgrol mas mchod par byas te/ de'i sngags rgyud rgyas par gsungs so/ /de bzhin du rgyal ba rigs drug gi dkyil 'khor rgyas par bstan nas/ ji skad du bshad pa'i rgyud rnams mi nub par bya ba'i phyir 'gro ba rigs drug gi sems can la ston par bzhed de/ sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs dang bcas nas ri bo ta lar gshegs te/ lha klu gnod sbyin dri za la sogs pa grangs med cing tshad med pa'i 'gro ba la dbang bskur te/ sngags kyi theg pa bshad nas dngos grub la bkod do/ /mthar phyag na rdo rje la rgyud rnams gtad de/ lcang lo can la sogs pa'i rig pa 'dzin pa'i gnas rnams su spyod cing / mi'i 'jig rten du rgyud thams cad mi nub par bya ba'i phyir/ lag na rdo rje rgyal po in+d+ra bhu ti zhes bya bar gyur te/ rgyud mtha' dag glegs bam la bris nas chos kyi mdzod ces bya bar sbas nas/ dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma rnams kyis nyams su len pa yin skad/ spyir sngags kyi theg pa dbugs dbyung drug gi bstan pa la/ da lta he ru ka'i bstan pa yin par gsungs so/ /dbugs dbyung drug gi rnam bzhag rgyud nyid na gsal lo/ khyad par bstan pa 'di nyid la 'dzam bu gling du sgrol ma'i rgyud ji ltar byung ba'i tshul ni/ rgyal ba mya ngan las 'das nas/ lo sum brgya lhag pa tsam nyan thos rnams kyis bka' bsdu ba gsum pa zin pa'i dus gzhan zhig na/ lha dang klu dang gnod sbyin dang dri za dang srin po rnams kyi gnas na bzhugs pa'i theg pa chen po'i mdo sde phal che ba yang —5—

rgya gar gyi yul tha dad pa rnams su byon/ rang byung gi glegs bam rnams kyang byung zhing gcig car dar bar gyur la/ de dag ston pa po sdom brtson chos smra ba/mi skye ba'i chos la bzod pa thob cing/ 'jam dpal dang / spyan ras gzigs dang / byams pa la sogs pa'i zhal mthong ba rnal 'byor spyod pa'i slob dpon lnga brgya dang / ngo bo nyid med smra ba'i bdag nyid chen po brgyad la sogs pa byung ngo / /de dag dang dus mnyam par bya spyod rnal 'byor rgyud gsum dang / theg pa bla na med pa'i thabs dang / shes rab kyi rgyud ci rigs pa dang bcas pa yang dar zhing / rdo rje sems dpa' dang / gsang ba'i bdag po zhal mthong ba rnams kyis skal ba dang ldan pa rnams la bstan pas/ dus de'i tshe sngags kyi theg pa thos pa thams cad dngos grub ma thob pa gcig kyang med skad de shar phyogs bha ga lar/ rgyal po ha ri tsan+t+ra 'khor stong dang bcas pa zung 'jug gi sku 'grub pa dang / o ḍi bi shar rgyal po muñdza zhes bya ba 'khor stong dang bcas pa rig pa 'dzin pa'i gnas thob pa dang / nub phyogs ma la war/ rgyal po sto dza de wa zhes bya ba 'khor stong dang bcas pa mi snang bar gyur nga/ dang / lto phyogs koṅku na ra/rgyal ngo/ he ri bha dra 'khor dpag tu med pa dang bcas te/ ril bu'i dngos grub 'grub pa sogs lo brgya'am nyis brgya tsam gyi bar du skye bo 'bum phrag lhag gcig gis dngos grub thob/ 'on kyang rtag tu gsang ba bsrung ba'i phyir dngos grub ma thob bar du gzhan sus kyang sngags kyi spyad pa spyod pa yin par mi shes skad/ de dag gi tshe/ rje btsun ma 'phags ma sgrol ma nyid kyi thugs rjes ma bsgrubs par yang zhal bstan cing / rjes su gzung ba'i lo rgyus gsung bgros —6—

————las 'byung ba mdo tsam zhig bsnyad na/ dgra'i 'jigs pa las skyabs pa ni/i ḍi bi shar rgyal rigs zhig skyed mos tshal du gnyid kyis log pa na/ dgra'i dmag tshogs go mtshone thogs pa stong tsam gyis bskor bas/ skyabs gzhan med de/ sgrol ma zhes bya ba 'jigs pa bcu drug las skyobs pa zhig yod ces thos te/ de kho na la skyabs su 'gro'o bsam pas/ sgrol ma'i mtshan nas bos shing /skad phyung bas skad cig de nyid la rje btsun ma mdun gyi nam mkhar byon te/zhabs kyi 'og nas rlung drag po g.yos pas dmag rnam/sa phyogs bcur khyer nas rang gi yul du sleb skad/ seng ge'i 'jigs pa las skyabs pa ni/ shing 'thu zhing nags tshal du song ba las/ seng ge mo bkres pa dang phrad nas za bar brtsams te khar thogs nas rang gi tshang dang nye bar song / der 'jigs shing skrag pas sgrol ma la gsol ba btab pas/ mdun du bud med shing lo'i gos can zhig byung nas seng ge mo'i kha nas de blangs te/ grong khyer gyi tshong 'dus su bzhag go /glang po'i 'jigs pa las skyabs pa ni/ yul gyi bu mo lo bcu gnyis lon pa zhig me tog 'thu bar nags gseb tu song ba na/ khu ni zhes bya ba glang po che gtum po dang 'phrad de/ des sna shal gyis bcings/ mche ba bsnun par brtsams pa na/ sgrol ma'i mtshan dran par byas shing / snying thag pa nas gsol ba btab pas glang po che dbang du gyur te/ rdo'i stegs mthon po la bzhag ste sna shal gyis phyag byas shing / yang blangs nas grong khyer gyi tsho lnga 'dus kyi gnas su yang de bzhin du byas so/ /de nas 'dun khang dang / lha khang dang /rgyal po'i pho brang gi sgor yang de ltar du byas pas/ bu mo 'di ni bsod nams —7—

dang ldan pa zhig go zhes rgyal po'i btsun mor gyur to/ /me'i 'jigs pa las bskyabs pa ni/ sha 'khon chags pa'i khyim myong gcig /nub mo khang pa la dgra yis me btang bas 'bros par brtsams pa las ma thar ba'i tshe/ kye sgrol ma kye ma ho sgrol ma zhes mtshan nas brjod pas/ khyim gyi steng du sprin shin tu sngo zhing mdzes pa zhig byung ste/ char gyi rgyun gnya' shing tsam khyim kho na la babs pas me zhi'o/ /dug sbrul gyi 'jigs pa las bskyabs pa ni/ grong khyer gyi smad 'tshong ma zhig /dus lan gcig mu tig gi do shal lnga brgya sbyin pa'i tshong dpon zhig rnyed de/ nam phyed kyi dus na tshong dpon gyi khyim du 'gro ba 'dod pas/ rang gi khyim nas song ste/ lam du shing shi ri sha'i yal ga zhig la 'jus pa na/ shing la 'khril pa'i sprul gdug pas lus la 'khril shing zin pa'i tshe/ rje btsun ma sgrol ma dran par byas pa tsam gyis dug sprul de nyid me tog gi phreng bar gyur nas/zhag bdun gyi bar du lus la gnas par gyur to/ /de nas sprul de nyid dkar po dug dang bral bar gyur nas chu bor zhugs so zhes grags so/ /chom rkun gyi 'jigs pa las bskyabs pa ni/ gu dzi ra tha'i yul gyi nang tshan bha ru kasnro zhes bya bar/ tshong dpon shin tu longs spyod che ba zhig yod pa/ ma waṃ yul du rnga mong stong tsam dang / khyu mchog lnga brgya tsam gyis khal bkal te song ba las/ lam khar chom rkun stong tsam gnas pa'i 'bros dgon par phyin pas/ sngon du song ba'i tshong pa thams cad bsad pa'i sha drag rus pas phyogs thams cad khyab/tshong pa brgya stong ni gsal shing la btsugs/ chom rkun de rnams mi'i sha yang za ba srin po lta bur yod pas/ tshong dpon de shin tu 'jigs nas/ mgon skyabs —8—

gzhan med pas sgrol ma la gsol ba btang pa na/ sgrol ma'i sprul pa dpa' bo go mtshon thogs pa'i dmag dpag tu med pa byung ste/ chom rkun de rnams rgyang ring du bskrad cing shi bsad ni med do/ /de ltar chom rkun rnams byer ba'i shul du tshong pa de nyid bde bar phyin nas slar yang bha ru kasme ra sleb bo/ /btson ra las skyabs pa ni/ rkun po'i dpon zhig gis rgyal po'i bang mdzod kyi khyim phug ste song ba na/ chang gi bum pa zhig rnyed de/ de btung bas de nyid du myos shing gnyid du song ba/ rgyal po'i mi rnams kyis rig ste bzung nas/ btson dong du bcug zhags pas bcings sdug bsngal sna tshogs pa myong ba na/ gzhan mgon skyabs med de/ sgrol ma la gsol ba btab pas 'dab chags kha dog sna lnga pa zhig nam mkha' nas babs te byung nas zhags pa rnams bkrol btson khang gi sgo yang rang bye bar gyur te/ ci bder thar nas rang yul du phyin pa na/ rmi lam du bud med rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa zhig byung ste/ gal te khyed nga'i drin dran na khyed cag 'khor dang bcas pa rkun po'i las spongs shig /ces byung bas rkun po de nyid 'khor lnga brgya dang bcas chom rkun gyi las spangs nas dge ba rgya chen po byed pa byung ngo / /rgya mtsho rlabs kyi 'jigs pa las bskyabs pa ni/ lho phyogs kyi lam du zhugs pa'i tshong pa lnga stong tsam zhig gru po che gsum bzung ste gzings chen por zhugs nas/rin po che'i gling du phyin te/ gru gcig ni rin po tshes khengs par byas so/ /yang de nas song ba na/ tsan dan sa mchog gi gling dang 'phrad de/ gru gnyis pa tsan+dan sa mchog gis gang bar byas so/ /de nas yul du 'ong bar 'dod pa la/ rgya —9—

mtsho'i nor bdag rnams khros te rlung chen po btang bas thag ring du khyer te/ rgya mtsho kha dog mi gcig pa mang po brgal ba'i mthar rba klong drag tu 'khrugs pa zhig tu sleb/ de gong du tshong pa rnams kyis/ myongs pa/ khyab 'jug /dbang phyugazla ba/ nyi ma/ ku be ra la sogs pa rnams la nyin mtshan du gsol ba 'debs kyang ma phan la/ der gru'i thag pa chad de/ rin po che'i dang tsan+dan gyi gru yang stor/ gru bo che yang nub la khad pa na/ de na sangs rgyas pa'i dge bsnyen gcig yod pas/ sgrol ma dran pas yi ge bcu nga/'i sngags skad gsangs mthon pos bzlas pas/ de ma thag tu mthun pa'i rlung byung ste/ gru tshur log nas nub gcig la 'dzam bu gling du sleb pa na/ rin po che dang tsan+dan gyi gru yang rlung gis tshur bdas te/ mnyam du 'dzom mo /sha za'i 'jigs pa las bskyabs pa ni/ shar phyogs kyi gtsug lag khang zhig tu/ nyan thos sen+ta pa kho na gnas pa zhig yin pa las/ der dus lan cig nub mor ris kyi gtsug lag khang gi phyi rol sa la 'chag tu song ba'i dge slong re re shi nas/ gtsug lag khang de nyid kyi tshogs pa 'grib par gyur pa las/nub cig dge tshul zhig 'chag sar song bas sha za mdog ngan nag cing mi sdug pa mche ba gtsigs pa gcig byung nas mgo bo nas bzung ba na/ theg chen pa rnams la sgrol ma zhes bya ba 'jigs pa brgyad las skyob pa cig yod ces zer gyi/ de la skyabs su 'gro'o snyam nas/ sgrol ma zhes mtshan nas bos so/ /der lha mo nag mo ral gri thogs pa zhig byung nas sha za de la sdigs pa na sha za des dge tshul la bzod par gsol te/ sa 'og nas lcags kyi bum pa mu tig gis —10—

sgrol ma'i rgyud kyi 'gyung khungs gsal bar byed pa'i lo rgyus gser gyi phreng ba zhes bya ba bzhugs/gang ba zhig phyung nas byin no/ /de phyin chad gtsug lag khang der gnod pa de rgyun chad do/ /mdze nad kyi 'jigs pa las bskyabs pa ni/ yul ku ma ra snye trar las kyi dbang gis bram ze'i slob dpon zhig la mdze nad kyis thebs nas/der phan tshun gcig la gcig 'gos te/ bram ze lnga brgya mdze nad drag pos zin par gyur/ nye du dang sman pa rnams kyis kyang bor zhing / bram ze gtsang sbra'i chos las nyams te lhag mas 'tsho zhing / slong mor spyod pa las/ lam kar rje btsun ma 'phags ma sgrol ma'i rdo sku gcig mthong bas dad pa skyes te/ bram ze lnga brgya po rnams kyis gsol ba btab pas/ sgrol ma'i phyag nas rtsi sman gyi rgyun byung ba la khrus byas pa tsam gyis mdze nad de nyid du zhi/ lha'i lus ltar mchog tu mdzes pa'i lus su gyur skad/ dbang po'i pho nya ba'i 'tshe ba las bskyabs pa ni/de la dbang po ni shar phyogs kyi phyogs skyong yin la/ de'i pho nya ba ni dri za'i gdon yin/ shin tu rtsub cing rgyug bla pa chos la bar du gcod pa che ba zhig yin no/ /de las bskyabs pa'i gtam ni/ yul bcom brlag gi nags tshal zhig na/nyan thos kyi dge slong bsam gtan pa lnga brgya yod de/ de rnams dge ba'i chos la brtson par gnas pa las/ dus nam zhig na dbang po'i pho nya ba byung ste/ kha cig ni bram ze/ kha cig ni bud med/ kha cig ni dge slong gi gzugs brnyan can dang / res 'ga' gnod sbyin gyi rnam pa drag po seng ge dang glang po dang / sha ra bha la sogs pa 'jigs su rung ba'i gdong can mang po byung ste / res 'ga' ni sdigs pa dang / res 'ga' ni bstod pa la sogs pas 'brid par byed pa na/dge slong kha cig ni dran med du song / kha gcig ni spyo kha cig ni yid gzhan du —11—

'gyur te/ glu dang gar kho nas dus 'da' bar byas so/ /der dge slong zhig gis 'byung po'i bar chad kyis gtses par shes nas/ lha mo sgrol ma zhes bya ba 'jigs pa thams cad las skyob po zhes grags pas/ 'di la phan par 'gyur ro snyam ste/ nags tshal 'di ni lha mo sgrol ma'i yin no zhes bris nas shing la btags so/ /de tsam gyis 'jigs pa de nyid rang zhi bar gyur te/ de thams cad lha mo sgrol ma la mos pas theg pa chen po la zhugs so/ /dbul ba'i 'jigs pa las bskyabs pa ni/ bram ze shin tu dbul ba zhig nyams thag pas/lam srang zhig na sgrol ma'i rdo sku zhig 'dug pa la/ rang gi sdug bsngal byung tshul gyi gtam rnams zhu pas/ mchod rten zhig dang nye ba'i sa phyogs zhig bstan te/'di rkos la gter rnyed par 'gyur ro zhes gsung la/ des kyang brkos pas gser gyi bum pa mu tig gis gang ba dang / dngul gyi bum pa rin po che sna tshogs kyis gang ba la sogs pa mang du rnyed nas/ bdun brgyud kyi bar du dbul ba'i sdug bsngal bsal skad/ yang zhing pa dbul po zhig gis/ rje btsun ma sgrol ma'i mtshan nas brjod cing gsol ba btab pas/ bud med shing lo'i gos can byung nas/ shar phyogs su song shig ces lung bstan/ des kyang shar phyogs su song ste/ bye ma'i steng zhig tu nyal ba na/ dril bu'i sgra grags pas gnyid sad/ der rta ljang khu dril bu'i rgyan can zhig rmig pas bye ma rko zhing 'dug go /de nas rta de yud tsam gyis gzhan du zhig tu song bas/ rta'i rmig pa'i shul des brkos pas dang por dngul gyi sgo/ /de nas gser dang / shel dang / be+e khyu rla la sogs pa rin po che sna bdun gyi sgo rnams byung ba rim pas bye ste sa 'og —12—

gi yul zhig tu klu lha dang lha ma yin mang po'i gtso bor gyur nas 'dod yon gyi dga' ba du mnyams su myong ste/ lan cig sa'i bu ga'i sgo nas rang gi yul du 'ongs pas/ de bar du rgyal po rabs gsum 'das 'dug zer ro/ /gnyen dang bral ba'i 'jigs pa las bskyabs pa ni/ bram ze zhig gnyen mang zhing nor che bar yod pa las/ nam zhig na mi ngas chen po byung bas bu dang chung ma dang / sbun zla skud po zhang po sogs thams cad shi ste/ yid mya ngan gyis non nas wā rā ṇa srir 'ongs so/ /de nas sangs rgyas pa'i dge bsnyen rnams sgrol ma'i dus ston chen po byed pa'i sar phyin pas sgrol ma'i che ba thos pas/ me tog snyim pa gang gtor te gsol ba btab/ phyir 'ongs pa na/ rgyal bo dza ya tsan+t+ra'i bu mo bag mar thob ste sa'i dbang phyug tu gyur/ des sgrol ma'i lha khang brgya rtsa brgyad bzhengs shing / thams cad du sangs rgyas pa'i dus ston chen po re yang btsugs so/ /rgyal po'i chad pa'i 'jigs pa las bskyabs pa ni/yul a yo khyu ces par khyim bdag dbang thang dang longs spyod che ba zhig yod pa/dus lan cig rkyen 'ga' zhig gis/ yul gyi rgyal po/ des khyim bdag de la mi dga' bar gyur te/ bsnyad 'tshol ba la zhugs pa na/ des kyang rgyal po'i mi mang po brid nas khrid de ti rā hu tir song ngo / /dus gzhan zhig na/ des yul rtsa ga rnga ru phyin pas/ a yo khyu yi rgyal pos gyad mi bzhi btang ste/ khyim bdag de bcings nas/ a yo khyu ru khrid do/ /des rje btsun ma sgrol ma dran bzhin du gsol ba btabs pas/ lha'i byin rlabs kyi khyim bdag de'i rkang pa sgo them la bzhag pas gser du gyur pa dang / brtsa ni khang du bcug pa der mu tig gi do —13—

shal gyi char babs pa dang / gsal shing la bskyon par gzas pa na/ gsal shing de a mra'i shing sdong me tog dang 'bras bus brgyan par song bas/ rgyal po la sogs pa thams cad ya mtshan skyes te/ 'di ni ches bsod nams dang ldan pa zhig na/ chad pas bcad par ga la 'os zhes byas nas rgyal po'i blon po'i sa la bzhag go /rdo rje lhung ba'i 'jigs pa las bskyabs pa ni/ bha ga la'i yul na dge bsnyen zhig /zhing las kyi mtha' la blta zhing song ba las lam kha na gnod sbyin gyi lha rten zhig yod pa la/ dge bsnyen gyis 'goms nas phyin pas gnod sbyin de khros par gyur nas/ nub mo dge bsnyen de rang gi khyim du gnas pa na/ nam mkha' nas gnam lcags 'bar ba nyi shu rtsa gcig lhung ste/ der 'phags ma sgrol ma dran pa tsam gyis gnam lcags kyi me lce thams cad me tog tu gyur/ dge bsnyen rang nyid/ bu dang chung ma/ nor rdzas sogs gang la yang gnod pa med/ gnam lcags rnams kyang khyim du lus te/ de thams cad rig sngags 'chang ba lnga brgya tsam la byin pas/ de rnams kyi grub pa'i rdzas la nye bar mkho bar byung skad/ don nyams pa'i 'jigs pa las bskyabs pa ni/ khyim bdag zhig zong thogs te yul gzhan du song / rgyal po las sa gzhi blang bar 'dod de/ rang gi nor rnams grogs la bcol/ rang nyid rgya mtsho gru bo cher zhugs so/ /lo mang por rgya mtsho'i gling rnams su phyin pa la/ longs spyod kyi khyad par gang yang ma 'grub cing / lan cig stes dbang gis gru rlud gis bdas te/ma la kha zhes bya ba'i gling der sleb bo/ /gling de na byu ru dang / tsan dan sa mchog ci bder blang du yod pas mang du blangs gru gang bar byas nas 'ongs —14—

so/ /lam du ma ga ra ma smi zhes bya ba'i chu srin nya'i rigs can gyi sna'i lcags bsnun pas gru zhig /der shing leb la 'jus pas rlabs kyis bdas te 'dzam bu gling du sleb bo/ /slar rang gi grogs po rtsad bcad pa na/ de yang lam du song ba stag gis zas nas shi bar shes/ der don gang yang ma grub pas ngal bas sdug bsngal cing yid me bde ba'i tshe/ grogs zhig gis bskul nas sgrol ma la dad pa bskyed de gsol ba bta/ba pa las/ rmi lam du khyod chu bo si rgyu'i 'gram du song zhig /'dod pa'i don rnams 'grub par 'gyur ro/ /zhes byung bas de bzhin du byas pas/ chu bo sin+t+ra'i nang nas sngar gru nang gi nor rdzas rgya mtshor nub pa thams cad rnyed/ de nas grogs shi ba'i sar phyin nas sa zhig bskos pas las/ rang gi nor rdzas bcol ba rnams thon/ de nas rang yul du phyin te/tsan dan sa mchog gi sdong du ma zhig rgyal po la skyes su phul bas/ rgyal pos kyang grong khyer gyi mchog lnga byin no/ /gzhan yang dus phyis slob dpon klu sgrub sgrub pa la bskul ba dang / tsan+d+ra go mi chu'i 'jigs pa las lan gnyis su bskyabs pa dang / thams cad mkhyen pa'i bshes gnyen me'i 'jigs pa las bskyabs pa dang / dge bsnyen btsun pa ngo bo nyid med pa dug sprul gyi 'jigs pa las bskyabs pa dang / slob dpon blo gros brtan pa la zhal brtan pa sogs ya mtshan can gyi gtam rgyud shin tu mang ngo / /yang rdo rje'i gdan du gnas pa'i nyan thos sen+ta pa zhig /dbyar dus sgyu 'phrul la phyin pas chu klung ne rañdza na'am/phal skad du phal gu zhes yongs su grags pa/ de gsar du 'khru ba la brgal bas rab ma tshugs par chus khyer ro/ /der theg chen pa rnams la sgrol ma zhes 15— —

bya ba chu'i 'jigs pa las skyob pa yod ces grags so snyam nas/ sgrol ma zhes skad phyung bas/ rdo rje gdan gyi phyi'i khyams kyi sgrol ma'i shing sku zhig yod pa de der dngos su byon nas/ khyod nam yang nga mi dran par da ltar nga bos pas ci rung zhes gsungs/ chu nang nas rang thon no/ /sku brnyan de la yang chu klung sgrol ma zhes grags so/ /yang lan cig rdo rje gdan du rgan mo zhig gis sgrol ma'i lha khang zhal phyir bstan zhig bzhengs pa las/ bzhengs zin pa na/ byang chub chen po la rgyab bstan pa 'di ma legs snyams nas rgan mo 'gyod pa las sku brnyan nyid kyis gsung byon te/ khyod mi dga' na byang chub chen po la blta bar bya'o/ /gsungs nas/ lha khang gi sgo dang sku brnyan gnyis ga byang chub chen po la phyogs par gyur pas zhal bsgyur sgrol ma zhes grags so/ /yang rgyal po dharma pā la'i dus rdo rje gdan gyi byang shar dge slong rnams kyi chu len sa'i chu mig cig gi drung na/ sgrol ma'i rdo sku zhig bzhugs la/ de dus sidha la pa'i nyan thos sen+ta pa rnams kyis sngags kyi rgyud mang po me la bsregs/ dngul las bsgrubs pa'i he ru ka'i sku 'dra chen po'ang rnyed pa'i phyir bzhig /slob dpon sangs rgyas dpal ye shes kyi chos 'khor la yang gnod pa cher byas pas siṅga gling pa'i nyan thos rnams la rgyal po'i chad pa byung / sen+ta pa'i dge slong zhig gis sgrol ma'i sku de'i drung du phyin te/ bdag rgyal po'i chad pa'i 'jigs pa las bskyabs tu gsol zhes gsol ba btab pas/ khyod dal ba'i dus nga mi dran par da ltar dran nam gsung ste yang chu khung der zhugs shig gsung / chu 'bab pa'i chu khung shin tu chung ngu der lus yongs su rdzogs par shong ste/ rgyal po'i mi rnams kyis btsal bas —16—

ma rnyed do/ /de nas mtshan mo bros te rgya gar shar phyogs thag ring por sleb pa na/ dus ston gyi tshe rdo rje gdan gyi steng khang bya 'dabs kyi 'og gi sgo ma bye ste/slar yang siṅga la'i dge slong de nyid bkug ste phye bas sgo rang bye/ de la rgyal po yang mgu ste/ yo byad du ma yongs su stabs so/ /de la slob dpon klu sgrub kyi snga rol du/ sgrol ma'i rig sngags la brten nas/ dngos grub thob pa lnga stong tsam byung ste/ klu sgrub kyi ring la yang lnga stong tsam byung ngo skad bye brag tu rgyud 'di nyid dang 'brel ba'i lo rgyus ni/ shar phyogs bha ga lar bram ze'i rigs las rab tu byung ba'i dge slong sde snod gsum pa ha ya pā la zhes bya ba zhig theg pa chen po thog mar dar ba la shin tu mos te/ slob dpon rnams las legs par nyan nas mkhas par shes so/ /de nas phyag na rdo rje zhal mthong ba'i bram ze gu hra shī la te/ gsang ba'i ngang tshul zhes bya ba zhig la sgrol ma 'byung ba'i dbang bskur ba nod cing/ gdams pa dang / rjes su gdams pa mtha' dag thob bo/ /de skabs rig sngags 'chang rnams kyi sa na/ rgyud 'di'i dum bu dum bu snyan brgyud du ston pa zhig las/ rgyud tshig yongs su rdzogs pa'ang med la/ yi ger bkod pa'ang med do/ /de nas slob dpon des rtse gcig tu bsgoms pas rdzu 'phrul thob ste/ o ḍa ya na rdo rje'i gnas su song nas/ mkha' 'gro ma rnams las sgrol ma 'byung ba'i rtsa bshad kyi rgyud dang / gtum po khro bo'i rgyud rtsa bshad dang /lag na rdo rje mchog tu gsang ba'i rgyud dang / he ru ka bskyed pa zhes bya ba'i rgyud spyan drangs te/ yul ti pu rar/ nags gseb tu lha khang byas nas der bzhugs nas/ thun mong gi 'gro ba rnams la shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa bsdus pa dag — 17—

ston cing / sgrol ma'i rigs sngags la brten nas shar phyogs kyi rgyal po lnga dbang du bsdus/ thams cad dkon mchog la dad par byas/ lha mo u ma dang /lha'i rgyal po rab tu dga' ba zhes bya ba dbang du bsdus te/ yon thams cad des sbyor bar byed do/ /mi g.yo ba'i rig sngags la brten nas sgyu 'phrul 'grub ste/ dpag tshad bcu gnyis khor yug tu rin po che'i ljon shing dang / rwa ba dang /khang bzang dang / lha dang / lha mo la sogs pa sprul/ phyag na rdo rje'i rig sngags la brten nas/ bstan pa la sdang ba lnga brgya tsam/ tshar bcad/ lo mang por pha rol tu phyin pa'i chos bstan nas/ he ru ka'i rig sngags kyi mthu las nam mkha' la gya gyur gshegs te/ lcang lo can du lus de nyid kyis bzhud do/ /des gsang sngags bstan pa'i slob ma ni/ slob dpon ha ya sto ṣa gcig pu yin te/'di yang slob dpon snga ma dang mdzad pa 'dra ba las/ 'di ni khro bo'i rgyal po rta mgrin grub ste/ srin po'i 'jig rten du lus ma spangs par bzhud go /slob dpon de gnyis ni bram ze sa ra ha dang dus mnyam pa tsam yin no/ /slob dpon de la rgyud bzhi po de rnams 'phags pa klu sgrub kyis zhus te/ slob dpon 'dis ni rig sngags de thams cad grub pa yin no/ /des urla de wa la bshad/ des sgra gcan 'dzin bzang po chung ba la gdams te/ slob dpon 'di ni dmangs rigs las rab tu byung ba/ rig pa'i gnas lnga la byang zhing / theg pa che chung gi sde snod thams cad mkhyen pa zhig yin la/ 'dis 'phags pa klu sgrub kyi gzhung rnams lam gyi lus gcig tu bsgril nas bstan pa'i bstan bcos asma gar+bha zhes bya ba brtsams gsung / 'dis rtsod pa'i sgo nas mu stegs tsakra warma zhes bya — /8—

ba sun phyung ste/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa la bkod/ nyan thos mang po rtsod pas pham par byas te theg chen la bcug /rang nyid kyis sgrol ma'i rig sngags la brten te/ gnod sbyin mo grub nas sa 'og gi gter phyung zhing / nags nang stong pa rnams su yang dge slong stong phrag re'i 'tsho ba sbyor nus skad/ mthar yul dhi nga ko ṭa ra sku 'das so/ /de yang 'grel pa tshig gsal las/ klu sgrub sgra gcan 'dzin bzang po'i zhal bla nas dang bcas 'phags pa snas kyang rjes su bstan pa dang / zhes gsungs pa'i sgra gcan 'dzin bzang ngo/ de yang 'di kho na yin pas/bram ze chen por 'dod pa ni mun sprul lo/ /de yan chad rgyud de rnams glegs bam yang gcig pu kho na yin la/ brgyud pa'ang gnyis su gyes pa med gsung ngo / /des slob dpon dz+wa la sta la gdams/ des kha che dharma bha dra pā la gdams/ des nā ga mi tra la gdams/ de rnams kyi lo rgyus mi gsung / des nyi ma sbas pa sogs la gdams/ de la nyi ma sbas pa ni/ kha che'i yul du sku 'khrungs skye ba bdun du sgrol ma'i sgrub pa po yin par grags la/ skye ba de nyid la blo rno zhing chung ngu nas rig pa'i gnas mtha' dag la mkhas pa zhig yod pa yul dbus su song ste/ rab tu byung bas klu sgrub kyi ring lugs la brten nas/theg pa chen po'i mdo sde mtha' dag la mkhas par byas so/ /slob dpon nā ga mi tra la sgrol ma'i dbang bskur ba zhus te/ spyir sgrol ma'i rgyud brgya rtsa brgyad mkhyen par grags/ slob dpon 'dis sgrol ma 'byung ba'i rgyud la brten pa'i sgrub thabs dang / dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga la sogs pa gzhung bcu gsum tsam mdzad ces zer ro/ /slob dpon 'di ni slob dpon blo brtan gyi slob ma tsan+t+ra go — 19—

mi dang dus mtshungs pa tsam yin no/ des na da ltar 'jigs pa brgyad skyob kyi bstod pa byin rlabs can du grags pa 'di yang nyi ma sbas pa gzhan zhig gis ni yin du rung mod/ slob dpon 'dis mdzad pa ma yin par shes par bya'o/ /'di'i slob ma'i gtso bo ni thams cad mkhyen pa'i bshes gnyen yin te / gzhan yang sgrol ma'i rig sngags grub pa'i slob dpon dpag tu med pa byung ngo / /thams cad mkhyen pa'i bshes gnyen gyis dha na mi tra la gdams/ des ta thā ga ta mi tra la gdams/ des siṅga la gling pa dharma mi tra la gdams/ des shī la rik+ṣa ta la gdams te/ 'di ni sgeg pa'i rdo rje dang dus mtshungs pa ste/ de yan chad du brgyud pa ma chad par byung zhes sngon gyi slob dpon rnams kyi rabs dang / gtam gyi tshigs bcad las 'byung zhes gsung ngo / /de dag gi skabs su/ slob dpon brgyad la 'jigs pa brgyad las bskyabs pa'i lo rgyus ni/ rgya gar lho phyogs su slob dpon di ka warma zhes bya ba sdom brtson sde snod 'dzin pa chen po/ gshin rje gshed dang / sgrol ma 'byung ba'i rgyud 'di nyid la brten pa'i rig sngags grub pa zhig ste/ des lho phyogs be+e da rta'i yul du mu stegs kyi bram ze'i slob dpon ga pu rī la zhes pa dang rtsod pa byas te/ mu stegs pham pas/ de'i spyod yul thams cad sangs rgyas pas blangs so/ /de nas slob dpon de gtsug lag khang du dge slong rnams dang lhan cig chos ston gsol ba'i tshe/ mu stegs rnams kyis gtsug lag khang la me btang ba na/ slob dpon kyis rje btsun ma la gsol ba btab pas/ rje btsun ma nam mkha'i dbyings su byon te/ nam mkha' las chu bo'i rgyun dngos su babs nas me zhi bar gyur to/ /yang slob dpon a ma ra sing ha bya ba/—20—

rgyal po'i yig mkhan rab tu byung ba theg pa che chung gi mngon pa smra ba zhig /sgrol ma 'byung ba'i rgyud la brten te/ 'phags ma sgrol ma la thugs dam du mdzad pa zhig yin no/ /des nub phyogs ma la wa'i yul du gnas gzhi byas nas bzhugs te/ mngon pa slob pa lnga brgya tsam la chos mngon par ston cing /lo nyi shu rtsa bzhi'i bar du gnas de nyid du bzhugs skad/ de dag thams cad du mngon pa la blo sbyong ba lnga brgya tsam gyi 'khor gyi bskor nas yod pa las/ dus lan cig phyogs de na nag phyogs kyi klu'i rgyal po la li ta zhes bya ba yod de/des glo bur du char drag po mi bzad pa phab ste/ char chu las chu bo'i rgyun chu klung ya mu na tsam byung ste/ slob dpon gyi gnas gzhi dang / grong khyer mang po khyer la khad pa na/ slob dpon gyi rje btsun ma sgrol ma la gsol ba btab pas/ gnas gzhi grong khyer u ta dza ya na dang bcas pa la chu de nyid g.yas bskor ba mang du byas nas/ mthar chu bo chen po gzhan zhig la babs pa na/ klu de nyid rang gi gnas dang / tu ru ka'i grong khyer chung ngu zhig khyer ro/ /slob dpon de la sgrol mas mngon brjod kyi bstan bcos gyis shig ces lung bstan pas 'chi med mdzod brtsams/ 'di da lta'i bar du yang rgya gar na phyi nang gnyis ka la shin tu dar bar yod do/ /'di rgyal po'i yig mkhan yin ces pa'i rgyal po ni bi pra karma de ta yin par grags/ yang slob dpon lha'i seng ge zhes bya ba/ rten dge bsnyen du bzhugs pa/ theg pa che chung gi mdo sde dang / mngon pa la cher mkhas pa kha che'i yul gyi rgyal po hri har+sha de ba zhes bya ba'i bla mar gyur ba/ chos smra ba zhig yin te/ de kha che/ la shweng/ ma ru rnams su rgyal po dang / khyim bdag dang bram —21 —

ze sna tshogs pa dad par byas nas/ sangs rgyas pa'i lha khang lnga brgya tsam bzhengs so/ kha che dang nye ba'i yul ga dza ni la sogs par chos mang du bshad pas/ tu ru ka stag gzig gi lugs phal cher nub/ stag gzig gi rgyal po zhig gi /slob dpon btson du bzung ste/ khyod dkon mchog la skyabs su 'gro ba btang ste/ kla klo'i lugs byed na legs/ mi byed na gsod do zhes pa las/slob dpon gyis srog la bab kyang dkon mchog las gzhan du skyabs gnas med do zhes brjong/ pas/ lcags sgrog bcug ste btson dong mi bzad par bor ba tra ri / slob dpon gyis rang gi thugs dam gyi lha sgrol ma la gsol ba btab pas lcags sgrog de me tog gi lu gu brgyud du song / lha mo rnams kyis btson khang du me tog dang / tsan+dan gyi phye ma'i char chen po phab/ rol mo'i sgra chen po bsgrags pas/ tu ru ka'i rgyal pos lta ru 'ongs pa na lcags sgrog med par mthong ste/ yang lcags sgrog gzhan zhig bcug pas de yang me tog gi phreng bar gyur/ de ltar lcags sgrog bdun me tog gi phreng bar song bas/ rgyal po ya mtshan skyes te mchod gnas su bzung ngo / /'on kyang der dam pa'i chos dar bar ma nus pas/ thugs 'byung nas kha cher byon no/ /yang sa ṅgha mi tra zhes bya ba bye brag tu smra ba'i slob dpon chen po zhig la mnal lam du/ thub pa chen po 'khor bcas kyi drung na lha mo sngon mo/ zhig 'dug ste/ de na re khyod theg pa chen po 'a/ legs par slob shig gsung / des kha cher byon te/ theg chen mdo sngags kyi chos lugs mang du nyan/ rje btsun ma sgrol ma la yi dam du mdzad pas/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa nyan pa'i yul ma rnyed nas yul dbus na slob dpon —22—

grol sde zhes bya ba shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'chad pa yod ces thos te/yul dbus su chas pa las lam du chom rku/na gyis bzung ste/ lha mo du rga la mi bsad pa'i khrag dron mos mchod dgos pas/ de'i phyir bzung ngo zhes zer ro/ /der lha mo 'du rga' gnas dur khrod lta bu der sleb pa na/ rje btsun ma sgrol ma la gsol ba btab pas lha mo'i rten de dum bu mang po rang gas so/ /der chom rkun rnams kyang skrag cing bros/ slob dpon thar ro/ /yang slob dpon su bha ṣa kirti zhes bya ba/ 'dul ba 'dzin pa chen go nang du sgrol ma 'byung ba'i rgyud la brten te thugs dam du mdzad pa zhig yin pa/ lan cig yul dbus nas nub phyogs kyi rgyud ltar song ba las/ mthar ri bor zhig tu gtsug lag khang byas te/ chos bstan pas dge slong gi sde yang mang du tshugs te/ de na gar log gi dpon mang du yod pas mgo breg gos dmar can de rnams kyis bdag cag la gnod par 'ong gi /'di thams cad brlag par bya'o zhes glang po che sum brgya tsam gyi dmag 'ongs so/ /der sgrol ma la sogs ba btab pas/ dmag 'ong ba'i phyogs su chu gtor cig gsung / de ltar byas pas glang po che thams cad shin tu 'jigs shing skrag pas sus kyang kha lo ma nus par rang gnas su khyer ro/ /yang slob dpon ba dha dwa sa zhes bya ba dha na pu ri'i mkhan po mdzad pa zhig yod pa/ rgyu 'grul zhig la byon pas grong stong zhig na stag gi tshang mang du yod de/ slob dpon gyis gtam dris pa na/ stag rnams kyis nyin re bzhin grong khyer gyi mi mang po yang za bar byed na/ srogs chags phra mo gzhan lta ci smos/ zhes thos pas/ snying rje chen po skyes te/ lam du song ba las stag rnams thams cad slob —23—

dpon gyi thog tu byung ba/ sgrol ma la gsol ba btab nas/ sngags bzlas pa'i chu gtor bas stag de rnams zhi ba'i sems dang ldan par gyur te/ phyin chad srog chags la gnod pa mi byed par la zas bcad de dus las 'das pas lhar skyes pa'i rtags su me tog gi char chen po babs so/ /yang slob dpon dkon mchog gsum gyi 'bangs zhes bya ba/ slob dpon phyogs kyi glang po'i slob mar gyur pa zhig yin te/ des shar phyogs o ḍi bi sha'i yul du chos ston cing bzhugs pa'i tshe lan cig rgya mtsho chen po nas dug sbrul sbram chen zhig byung nas mi dang glang po che mang du zos/ u ta ka la'i grong khyer dang nye bar byung ba na/ skye bo grangs med pa la gnod pa 'byung bar gzigs te/ sgrol ma la gsol ba drag tu btab cing /sgrol ma'i sngags bzlas pa'i yungs kar gtor te/ sa 'di gdengs can dbang lags kyang / /gang la phan pa'i thugs mnga' ba/ /de yi tshig 'di khyod long la/ /sa 'og nyams dgar song zhig kye/ /ces brjod pa'i mod la sbrul de nyid phyir ldog ste/ ga ga'i lam la zhugs nas rgya mtshor song ngo / /yang slob dpon ye shes lha zhes bya ba/ zhi ba lha'i slob ma zhig ste/ rgya gar lho phyogs tri ma la'i yul du nyan bshad kyi bya ba yun ring du mdzad de/ mthar nga ni ri kha ba can du bsgom par bya'o/ /zhes byang phyogs su byon nas/ ti rā hu ti'i yul du 'gro ba'i don ci rigs pa mdzad/ de'i tshe yul de'i phyogs zhig na/ tha dra'i rigs kyi grong khyer chung ngu zhig tshangs pa'i srin po'i gdon byung ste/ yul gyi grong dpon nas/zhing las kyi bla ma'i bar thams cad dus gcig tu shi'o/ /de'i nyin mo slob dpon der byon pas/ ro langs mi bzad pa cig rgyug cing byung bas/ sgrol ma'i —24—

sngags bzlas pa'i phur bu 'phangs pas/ ro langs kyi spyi bor thim gyi song zhing 'byel/ grong khyer gyi nang du byon te/ sgrol ma la gsol ba btab pas 'chi ba gso bar nus pa'i bdud rtsi'i char chen po babs te/ grong khyer gyi mi shi ba phal che ba gsos so/ /yang grub pa brgyad ma bsgrubs par yang 'grub pa'i gtam rgyud ni/ sgrol ma la yi dam du byed pa'i dge slong zhig gis/ gtsug lag khang bzheng ba'i don du slong mo la phyin no/ /bram ze zhig gis/ gi ha bre gang byin pa blangs nas sgrol ma'i lha khang zhig tu de ril bur byas so/ /de'i lhag ma zhig nyi ma la bzhag pas/ rlud gis gser tsag dang / sbang ma la sogs pa ril bu'i rdzas rnams kyi rdul khyer te de la btab bo/ /de la yang ril bu zhig byas nas/sngags thun bzla yin yod pa'i tshe/ ril bu'i dbus nas me 'bar ro/ /de lus la bcangs nas yod pa las/ lan cig sum cu rtsa gsum lha'i grong khyer yid la bsams pa na/ sum cu rtsa gsum du phyin te/ mi'i lo bcu gnyis kyi bar du der 'dug go /yang sgrol ma la yi dam du byed pa'i zhing pa zhig gis/ phu phu zhes sa brkos pas sa 'og gi sgo bye ste/ klu'i gnas su sleb nas bdud rtsi btungs pas lus 'ja' lus su gyur skad/ rnal 'byor ma zhig gis/ dur khrod du nyi shu dgu'i nub mo mi ro mang po bsreg cing sgrol ma'i sngags bzlas pas me dreg chags pa'i dbus nas 'od 'phro zhing 'dug go /de mig la byugs pas/ grogs po rnams kyi dbus de nyid du mi snang bar gyur to/ /yang sgrol ma la yi dam du byed pa'i dge bsnyen zhig grogs dang bcas te dur khrod du song bas/ ro langs 'jigs su rung ba kha nas me 'bar ba zhig byung nas/ grogs rnams 'jigs shing bros pa —25—

la/ dge bsnyen des sgrol ma dran par byas shing de'i gnya' bar bzhon pas de nyid lag gsum rkang gsum mgo gsum par gyur te/ rkang pa dang lag pa gcig gis rgya mtshor nyul/ gcig ni ri dang sa'i khongs su nyul/ gcig ni nam mkha'i khongs su nyul ba'i cho 'phrul bstan te/ gdong gsum po re re dpa' bo chen po bdag gis ci bgyid/ nam mkha'i lam nas lha'i gnas su 'gro bar bgyi'o/ /sa 'og gi lam nas lha min gyi gnas su 'gro bar bgyi'o/ /rgya mtsho'i lam nas klu'i gnas su 'gro bar bgyi'o/ /zhes zer ba la/ de dag las gang 'dod pa zhig smras na 'grub par 'gyur ba las/ sgrub pa po blo rtul te/ de dag mi 'tshal gyis bdag la rin po che'i gter byin cig byas pas/ de na re/ 'o na ri bo sngon por gshegs 'tshal zer nas skad cig gis der sleb ste/ rin po che'i gter chen po bstan no/ /de ji srid 'tsho'i bar du rgyal po chen po las kyang longs spyod che bar gyur skad/ yang sgrol ma'i sgrub pa po zhig /shing bim pa la'i rtsa ba zhig tu sngags bzla zhing 'dug pa/ lan cig tho rangs kyi dus na/ rang gi mdun du sngon med pa'i lam srang zhig mthong ngo / /der zhugs te phyin pa las/nam zhig na nags tshal yid du 'ong ba'i dbus su/ gser gyi khang pa zhig mthong / der zhugs pas gnod spyin na ḍa ku ba ra'i g.yog mo gnod sbyin mo nag mo zhes bya ba/ rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/ lus kha dog ma nges pa zhig 'dug ste/ de na re/ sgrub pa po tshur byon bcud len 'di gsol zhig zhes bum pa bcud kyis gang ba zhig byin no/ /zla ba gcig tu de btungs pas skye 'chi med nga/'i lus su gyur to/ /yang dge bsnyen dad pa can/ sgrol ma la yi dam du byed rnga —26—

zhig lam du phyin pas khab len gyi ral gri zhig rnyed de/ sgrol ma'i sngags bzla bzhin du phyin pas ral gri las du ba 'thul lo/ /yang bzlas pas me 'bar ro/ /de nas de yid la ji ltar 'dod pa'i gnas su 'gro nus par gyur te/ nyin re bzhin du lha klu mi ma yin tha dad pa'i gnas su song ste/ de dag gi longs spyod kyi khyad par sna re blangs nas dge 'dun la 'bul ba zhig yo da la/ lo mang po zhig na de nyid kyang rig pa 'dzin pa'i gnas su song ngo / /yang dge slong zhig gis sgrol ma'i lha khang zhig la lo gsum bskor ba byas pas/ phyag gi mchog sbyin las bcud len 'o ma'i rgyun lta bu babs so/ /de btungs pas rgas pa med par gyur te/ lo sum brgya'i bar du 'tsho zhing lo bcu drug tsam gyi na tshod la gnas skad/ yang dge bsnyen zhig gis/ sgrol ma'i lha khang zhig tu gsol ba 'debs kyin bsdad pas/ nang gcig sgrol ma'i sku brnyan gyi zhabs la phyag btsal bas zhabs 'og nas rdo'i bum pa zhig byung ngo / bum pa de'i nang nas ji ltar 'dod pa'i longs spyod zad med du byung nas/ dge slong lnga brgya re'i 'tsho ba spyor ba lo sum cu'i bar du byas so/ /'phags pa klu sgrub sku 'das nas/ rgyal bo dharma pā la byung gi bar du yang sgrol ma la brten te dngos grub thob pa lnga stong tsam byung ste/ 'di skabs kyi mi rnams sgrol ma 'gyung ba'i rgyud la brten te/ grub pa thob pa kho na mang gsung ngo / /de dag sgrol ma'i rgyud 'di sngon ji ltar dar ba'i tshul lo/ /bar skabs su cung zad cung zad nub pa'i tshul ni/ rgyal po dharma pā la'i sku che'i smad/ dge slong sde snod 'dzin pa 'ga' zhig gis bskul nas yin yang zer/ rgyal sar 'khod ma thag pa'i skabs yin yang zer te/ sangs —27—

rgyas ye shes sku 'das nas yin par gsal bas snga ma dag go /gang ltar yang nyi 'og gi rgyal khams na gsang sngags kyi glegs bam dang / nyan bshad yod pa'i sa thams cad du byon te/ shin tu zhib mor dpyad nas rgyud nas man ngag so ldu'i bzhugs tshul thams cad mkhyen pa na/ dus kyi khyad par gyis sngon bzhin du gsang sngags gsang ste spyod pa mi 'byung zhing / rnal 'byor chen po'i rgyud rnams nyan bshad sgom gsum 'jig rten gyi mngon du shin tu dar bar gyur pas/'dus pa la sogs pa rdo rje'i tshig gis rgyas btab pa 'di rnams rgya cher shod la/ shin tu gsang ba 'gal ba'i tshig yod pa 'di rnams phyin chad ma shod cig ces dril bsgrags te/ dpal he ru ka'i rgyud 'ga' shes dang / nag po chen po dang / sgrol ma 'byung ba dang / gtum po khro bo dang / gdan bzhi las kyi phreng ba la sogs pa rgyud sde chen po 'ga' shas dang / grub thob rnams kyis spyan drangs pa'i rgyud kyi dum bu chung ngu lnga brgya tsam mam yang zer/ stong tsam mam yang zer te/ shin tu mang po yod pa de thams cad kyi dpe rnams bsdus nas gser gyi sgrom chen po brgyad du bcug /de rnams dngul gyi snod du bcug pa sogs rin po che sna bdun gyi snod du bcug ste/ dur khrod bsil ba tshal du sbas so/ /de'i tshe re zhig rgyud 'di'i nyan bshad kyang rgyun chad skad/ phyis dar ba'i tshul ni slob da/pon ti l+li pa grub pa ma brnyes pa'i sngon rol zhig na/ shar phyogs kyi gtsug lag khang zhig tu bzhugs pa'i tshe/ thub pa'i dbang po'i sku brnyan zhig yod pa'i khri'i 'og nas yang dang yang du 'od 'byung zhing / dus dus su rol mo'i sgra 'byung ba gsan no/ /des sa drus te gzigs pas sgrol ma'i rgyud 'di byung nas/ dus —28—

de'i tshe zhu ba'i yul ma rnyed do/ /phyis dngos grub brnyes nas nub phyogs o rgyan gyi yul du gshegs pa na/ bud med sngo sangs mkha' 'gro'i rtags dang ldan pa zhig 'dug pa la/ rgyud nas bshad pa'i brda bstan te des kyang brda'i lan byas so/ /der gsol ba btab pas/ de nyid lha mo sgrol mar gyur te rgyud byin gyis bsas shing dbang bskur ro/ /des ni slob dpon nā ro pa la spund/ des ḍom+bhi pa dang / ka na ka shrī dang / da pa dang / tha k+ki na sna pa rnams la bshad/ḍom+bhi pa la ku sa la chung bas zhus/ de la a si ta gha nas zhus/ de la dzñā na mi tras gsan/ de la grub chen zhi ba sbas pas gsan/ de la bdag gi bla ma gsum gyis gsan no/ /yang ti snyi pa la/ lī la badz+ra sa zhus/ de la ra hu la gugs zhus/de la dī paX kā ra shrī dzñā nas zhus/ de la ma ju ma sidha sa zhus/ de la tā ra shrī mi tras zhus/ de nas rim pas sa ṅgha shrī/ rat+na bhā dza/ na ya ka shrī/ dha rma shrī/ shākya rak+ṣi ta/ su dzā ta/ bud+dhā shrī bha dra/ dzñā na rat+na/ dzñā na gya na/ rā te gup+ta/ des slob dpon chen po zhi ba spas pa la'o/ /yang kan+ta ba/ bṛ ka pa/ dhu pi rā dza/ ha re bhañdza pa/a se ta gha na rnams las rgyud kyang chog /yang ka na ka shrī/ lo ka pra dha/ chos 'byung zhi ba sogs nas rgyud pa'ang yod gsung / pak+ki nasna pas/ slob dpon mni ra pā la bshad/ de ltar na bar skabs brgyud pa tha dad pa mang po dar la/phyis ni grub chen zhi ba kho na la bzhugs pas da lta de las rgya cher 'phel ba'o/ /de dag gi nang nas lo rgyud gzhan du bkod zin pa rnams de dang de dag tu shes par bya la/ der ma 'khod pa dag bshad na/ ka na ka shrī 'di ni bal bo ka shrī mi na ma ga dha nyid du sku 'khrungs shing / ku ru ku le'i sde pa las rab tu byung ba/ rnam —29—

gnon tshul gyi dgon par mdo sngags rig gnas thams cad la mkhas par sbyangs te/ dha ga lar paṇ+ḍi ta dharma mi tra zhes bya ba zhig la gsang ba 'dus pa'i dbang nos te lo bdun du sgom bzlas byas kyang mtshan ma bzang ba tsam yang ma byung ste/ sgom 'phro bcad nas ci bder bzhugs pas/ nub cig rmi lam du bu med cig gis dpal nā ro pa'i drung du song zhes lung bstan/ de nas nā ro pa la 'khor lo sdom pa'i dbang bskur zhus pa tsam gyis ting nge 'dzin bzang por rang shugs su skyes/ zla ba drug tu bsgom pa'i 'khor lo sdom pa'i zhal gzigs/slar yang nā ro pa chen po lo bdun gyi bar du bsten te/ rgyud sde dpag tu med pa gsan/ khyad par 'khor lo bde mchog dang / gdan bzhi dang / sgrol ma 'byung ba'i rgyud rnams la mkhas par grags/ ma ga dhar rgyal po ni ya pā la'i skabs dbang phyug gi rjes su 'brang ba kha sa ma de ba zhes pa dang nus pa 'gran par mu stegs kyis 'dom gang tsam gyi nam mkha' la dkyil 'khor bris shing bum pa bzhag pa la/ slob dpon gyis yungs kar gtor bas dkyil 'khor zhig cing bum pa lhung / slob dpon gyis sgrol ma'i sku zhig ta la gcig tsam gyi nam mkha' la bzhag pa/ slob dpon nyid kyis ma bsdus bar du mu stegs rnams kyi sngags dang me mda' la sogs pa thabs gang gis kyang lhung bar ma nus pas/ slob dpon rgyal/ rgyal pos bi ka ma la shi lar ma rgyud 'chad pa po'i slob dpon du spyan drangs so/ /'dis sgrol ma'i zhal gzigs shing / sgrol ma'i rig sngags la brten nas phan tshun dbang du bsdu ba'i las sbyor mdzad de/ 'khrug pa chen po lan brgyad sdum skad/ kan+ta pa ni/ sangs rgyas pa'i rnal 'byor pa blo shin tu rtul —30—

ba ltar snang ba zhig gam/ /ngo bo nā ro pa 'a// sgrol ma 'byung ba'i dbang dang byin rlabs rnams zhus/ rgyud 'di las 'byung ba'i he ru ka lha dgu bsgom zhing lo bcu gnyis bsgrubs pas/ he ru ka dang / sgrol ma zhal mthong / dngos grub thob ste/dpag tshad brgya'i lam yang yud tsam gyis chod par byed de skabs grong khyer ḍi lir sog po'i rgyal po zhig yod pa des pho brang chen po gsar du bcos pa na/slob dpon des kyang bem po zhib 'tshom gyin de dang nye bar bzhugs so/ /pho brang zin pa na/ bem po de dum bur dra'/ zhing bshags pa na/ pho brang de yang rmangs nas zhig go /de ltar lan gsum song bas/ rgyal po des kyang gtam de thos te/ slob dpon spyan drangs/ zhabs la phyag btsal slob dpon gyi gsung las byung ba'i dam bca' bzhi byed par byas la/ bzhi ni/ sangs rgyas pa'i lha khang la gnod pa mi byed pa dang / pho brang nang na gnas pa rnams kyi srog gcod spong ba dang / rab tu byung ba rnams la mchod pa byed pa dang / nyin re bzhin du sangs rgyas kyi mtshan nas brjod cing phyag 'tshal ba rnams yi na skad/ kan+ta ri bem po'i ming ste/ de phyin chad grub thob kan+ta par grags/ yun ring du 'gro don mdzad/ mthar sku lus de nyid kyis mkha' spyod du gshegs go /yang ṭha ka ki na ga na pa ni/ ṭha ka ki zhes pa g.yo sgyu'i bya ba sna tshogs pas 'tsho ba bsgrub pa'i don te/ mtha' 'khob kyi rigs ngan gcig yin gsung / na ka na ni tshan che ba'am/ stobs che ba'i don sgo /ṭha ka ka'i rigs su lus stobs shin tu che bas mtshan yang de bzhin du thogs pa yin sgo / 'di yang rnal 'byor pa byas te/ mi thub zla ba'i slob ma zhig la dgyes rdor zhus nas/ lho phyogs nī la bya ba'i ri la —31 —
