lo bco lnga'i bar du rtse gcig tu bsgoms kyang rtags gang yang ma byung bas/ skye ba gzhan du 'grub par smon lam btang ste/ g.yang sa chen po zhig la mchongs so/ /der lus kyang ma snad/ nam mkha' las kyang sgra byung ste/ khyod nā ro pas rjes su 'dzin par 'gyur ro/ /zhes so/ /de nas nā ro pas zhabs bsten te/dgyes pa rdo rje'i dbang bskur bar gsol ba btab pas/ khyod kyi dgyes pa rdo rje mi 'grub/ bde mchog 'khor lo sgom dgos pas bde mchog gi dbang bskur dgos gsung / jo bo nā ro pa la ni/ bde mchog 'khor lo zhu ba ni shin tu dka' ste/ dkyil 'khor gzhan rnams las brgyad 'gyur gyi lhag pa'i yo byad dgos pas/ de skabs bdag la yo byad kyang med cing / blo gros rtul bas rgyud rgya chen po gsar du nyan pa'i nus pa med zhus pas/ sgrol ma'i dbang bskur zhing rgyud kyang gnang la/ bde mchog yab yum go ldog gi gdams ngag thams cad rdzogs par gnang ba rtse gcig tu bsgoms pas mchog gi dngos grub thob ste/nā ro pa tshogs kyi mchod pa rgya chen po'i gral dbu la bzhugs pa'i drung du/ phyag 'tshal du 'ongs te/ lus las me 'bar ba dang / sa g.yo ba la sogs pa'i cho 'phrul du ma bstan te mi snang bar gyur to/ /de skabs 'gro don mdzad pa ma byung bas/ nā ro pa'i slob ma grub thob bzhi'i grangs su ma bgrangs la/ phyis a bha yā ka ra'i slob ma mni ra pā la zhes bya ba rnal 'byor pa shin tu bzang ba zhig yod pa la/ zla gcig tsam du sku dngos su bstan nas/ sgrol ma'i dbang bskur ba dang / rgyud bshad man ngag rnams kyang gnang nas/ des kyang brtson par bsgoms pas zla ba drug na dngos grub thob ste mthar klu'i gnas su song skad/—32—

de la yang slob ma bzhi tsam yod cing / brgyud pa'ang gnyis gsum du rgyud 'di nyan bshad sogs byung 'dug kyang / lo rgyus rgyas par ma thos gsung ngo / /li la badz+ra ni rgyal rigs zhig yin la/ bya ba zhig la ma ga dhar phyin nas/ lam du shing drung zhig na rnal 'byor pa zhig 'dug pa mthong bas mchog tu dad de/zhabs la phyag byas so/ /rang yang yul du ldog pa'i tshe/ rang gi bud med de mi gzhan dang 'dre ba sogs kyis sems la gnod par gyur nas yang ma ga dhar chos la 'ongs pas/ shing drung der sngar gyi grub thob de nyid dang mjal ba/ grub thob de ni ti snyi pa chen po'o/ /der ti snyi pas rgyud byin gyis brlabs nas dbang bskur zhing gdams ngag bstan pas ring por mi thogs par grub pa brnyes te/gling bu 'bud cing smyon pa'i spyod pas sems can gyi don byed pa zhig yod skad 'di'i lo rgyus rgyas pa mi gsung ngo / / dī pusko ra'i lo rgyus ni grags che bas gzhan du shes so/ /ma dha ma sidha ni/ jo bo rje'i slob ma zhig ste/ sgra tshad dang mdo lugs la mkhas/ 'dis gsang sngags gzhan mi mkhyen/ sgrol ma'i rgyud 'di kho na la mkhas/ nus pa'ang thob te/ rgya gar shar phyogs kyi chu bo ga ṅga la gshegs kyang thang la 'gro ba bzhin thogs pa med pa/ dug sbrul dang stag la sogs pa la bka' bsgo bar nus pa zhig go /tā ra shrī ni/ rtsod pa smra ba'i khyu mchog ste/ ma ga dhar mu stegs kyi rtsod pa las lan gsum du rgyal/ lto phyogs kyi yul du nyan thos rnams kyi rtsod pa bzlog pa dang / kha che'i yul du phyi nang gi paṇ+ḍi ta thams cad rtsod pas zil gyis mnan skad/ kha che'i rgyal po'i bla mar gyur/ yul ga rdza na'i rgyal po sgrol ma'i rig sngags kyis dbang du bsdus te/—33—

sangs rgyas pa la bcug go /sa ṅgha shrī nas/ dharma shrī'i bar gyi lo rgyus mi gsung /shākya rak+ṣi ta ni/ siṅga la'i yul du 'khrungs shing / dang po nyan thos sen+ta pa yin cing / de'i ring lugs la shin tu mkhas pa zhig ste/ ra khang gi yul gru'i char gtogs pa ha ri puñtsa gser gyi grong ste der slob dpon dharmā shī la/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang / sngags kyi chos mang du gsan/ khyad par du dgyes pa rdo rje/ bde mchog 'khor lo/ sgrol ma 'byung ba/ nag po chen po'i rgyud de/ bzhi po de dag phal cher la mkhas pa/ he ru ka'i zhal gzigs shing / sgrol ma'i rig sngags la brten nas nag po chen po dbang du bsdus te/ dge bsnyen nag po'i gzugs kyis ji ltar bzhed pa'i dngos po rnams dpag tshad brgya'i pha rol nas 'gugs pa zhig yod skad/ rtsa ga la rā dza zhes bya ba rgyal po zhig gis ha ri punyur grong khyer dang lha khang rnams 'joms pa'i phyir dmag 'dren par brtsams pa na/ nag po chen po'i phyag mtshan rtse gsum 'phangs pa zla ba tsam gyis bgrod dgos pa'i pha rol yin na'ang / rgyal po pho brang gi steng du tri shu la sleb te pho brang zhig go /de ltar nus mthu dang ldan par grags/ su dza ta ni yul ko lnga dza'i gtsug lag khang daṇ+ḍa pu ri'i mkhan po ste/ rgyal rigs las rab tu byung ba yin no/ /kyā shrī bha dra dang / dzñā na rat+na gnyis kyang yul de nyid du byon pa'o/ /dzñā na phya na ni yul der 'khrungs shing / mkhan po dzñā na rat+na las rab tu byung ba/gsang sngags phyi nang gi rgyud mang du mkhyen pa/ khyad par sgrol ma'i rgyud la mkhas shing nus pa brnyes pa/ sku tshe'i smad la bal mo'i yul du bzhugs shing /rnal 'byor pa'i spyod pa mdzad de/ phyag rgya pad+ma can las dngos grub thob pa/—34—

'bras bre gang dang chang bum pa gcig gis sngags btsun stong phrag gnyis tsam la 'khor lo'i mchod pa shin tu rgyas par ldang ba sogs ngo mtshar ba'i rtags mang po can zhig go /slob dpon rā ti gugs/ sgrol ma'i rgyud dang / nag po ka po'i rgyud dang / bde mchog sdom pa 'byung ba dang / ku ru ku lce'i rtog pa la sogs pa sngags kyi rgyud sde 'ga' shas kyi dbang rgyud 'tshol bar bal bo'i yul du phebs te/ dzñā na gya na dang / dzī ba phya na dang / shrī ta nu pā la/ gi nyi pā la rnams las rgyud sde mang du gsan pa las/ rgyud 'di ni slob dpon dzñā na gya na la gsan pa yin no/ /yang grub thob pri ka pa ni/ grub thob rdo pa las dbang dang man ngag thams cad thob nas/ yun ring du sgrub pa mdzad cing / mthar pri ka'i me tog gi tshal zhig tu dkyil 'khor bzhengs nas/ sgrub pa byas pas me tog gcig zla ba bcu gnyis kyi bar du mi rnyings shing / de'i mthar nub gcig me tog la me 'bar ro/ /de gsol ba tsam gyis thun mong gi dngos grub thob ste/sa 'og la thogs med du bgrod pa zhig go /dhu pi ra dza ni/ khrus mkhan gyi rigs las grub pa thob pa zhig yin gsungs/ ha ri bhañdza ba'i lo rgyus mi gsung lo ka pra dwa pa ni/ rgyal rigs kyi paṇ+ḍi ta zhig ste/ ka na ka shrī la rtsa ba'i bla mar mdzad/gsang sngags kyi chos ni sgrol ma 'byung ba'i chos skor kho na la legs par sbyangs pa zhig yin la/ yul gu dzi ra thar skyed tshal stong pa zhig tu gnas gzhi byas nas/ lo drug tsam du sngags 'chang mo zhig gis sgrub grogs byas te/ sgrol ma'i bskyed rdzogs kho na bsgoms pas/ mkha' 'gro mas lung bstan pa thob nas/rig ma bcu gnyis la brten nas rig pa'i brtul zhugs zla ba drug byas pas —35

'dod pa'i dngos grub brnyes te/ gnas de nyid du bzhugs pa las/ lan gcig yul de'i rgyal po gar log gis rang gi yul ljongs bltar 'ongs pa'i tshe/slob dpon gyi gnas de nyams dga' bar mthong nas/ 'di na su zhig gnas zhes dris pa na/ 'di nas sangs rgyas pa'i khyim btsun zhig yod do zhes rgyal po'i g.yog rnams kyis smras so/ /de nas rgyal po'i gnas de 'phrog par brtsams pa na/ skad cig la de'i phyi nang thams cad mer 'bar te/ rgyal po 'khor bcas kyang tshig la khad par song ngo / /der slob dpon grub pa thob par shes nas/ gsol ba btab pas me zhi'o/ /de nas slob dpon na re/ rgyal po khyod kyis sangs rgyas pa mchod par byed na legs/ mi byed na da lta nyid du brlag par bya'o gsung / rigs brgyud dang bcas pa sangs rgyas pa mchod par mna' bor ro/ /de phyin nas da lta'i bar du yang yul 'di'i rgyal po ni rus gar log yin yang sangs rgyas pa la gtso bor mchod par byed pa yin no/ /de gong yul de na sangs rgyas pa nyung ngu las med pa la/ rgyal po de nyid kyis kyang gtsug lag khang brgyad bzhengs so/ /de nas brtsams te rim pas da lta'i bar du yang sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dar bar yod do/ /der rgyal po des sangs rgyas la dad par gyur pa'i tshe/ kla kle'i ston pa kā dzi rnams kyis slob dpon gyi gnas la me btang bas/ slob dpon gyis kyang de rnams nyid la lta stangs mdzad pas thams cad rengs shing dran med du gyur/ zhug gsum gyi bar du ma gsos pa las/ de rnams kyi nye dus gsol ba btab pa las/ dril bu 'khrol ba'i sgras slar gsos/de rnams rgyal po'i chad pas 'jigs pas rang gi yul nub phyogs thag ring —36—

por bros te song ngo / /kla klo'i gnas gzhi ma si ta thams cad slob dpon gyis yungs kar gtor ba kho nas zhig ste/ de dag gi shul du yang sangs rgyas kyi mchod rten re bzhengs/ sgrol ma'i lha khang brgya rtsa bzhengs so/ /rgyal po la pad+ma gar dbang dbugs dbyung ba'i dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur te/ gsang sngags kyi lha khang zhig kyang bzhengs/ sngon rgyal po de'i mnga' 'og na bram ze dang mu stegs mang zhing rgyal po'i mchod gnas kyi gtso bo gar log kā dzi rnams kyi byed pas kla klo'i grub mtha' 'dzin pa stong tsam yod/ sangs rgyas pa'i rab tu byung ba nyi shu tsam las med pa la slob dpon de nyid kyi sku ring nyid la kla klo thams cad nub cing rgyal pos sangs rgyas pa'i slob dpon mang po spyan drangs pa la brten nas dge slong rang yang stong phrag gnyis tsam 'phel skad/ lan gcig yul der mu ge chen po byung ba la slob dpon gyis sa 'og nas 'bru'i gter chen po phyung nas/ yul gyi mi thams cad la 'bru khal brgya brgya byin cing / klu dang gnod spyin rnams las blangs te dbul 'phongs thams cad la mu tig gi do shal re re dang / nyin re bzhin du to la re'i rin thang gi kha zas sbyin pa lo gsum gyi bar du mdzad/ mthar 'gro lding dang nye ba'i gling zhig na/ khye'u shi ba'i lus mtshan dang ldan pa zhig yod pas de la grong 'jug mdzad de/ sku lus snga ma de byin gyis brlabs nas mi rul bar mchod rten sgo can zhig gi nang du bzhugs so/ /'gro lding du yang spros bcas kyi spyod pa mdzad pa zhig byung la/ slob ma bud med brgyad rga shi med pa'i lus su gyur te/ sku lus snga ma de la mchod pa byed cing yod pa las/ lo drug cu nas de nyid slar yang sku lus snga ma nyid la zhugs te/—37—

der yang lo bcu tsam du skal ldan gyi sems can 'ga' zhig gi don mdzad do/ /slar yang mi lo gsum gsum du sku lus phan tshun du 'pho ba lan drug tsam mdzad nas/ sku lus gnyis rig ma'i 'khor tshogs dang bcas pa mi snang bar gyur to/ /slob dpon 'di la tā ra shrī mi tra dang / chos 'byung zhi ba gnyis kyis rgyud 'di gsan/ chos 'byung zhi ba ni/ rtsod dus kyi thams cad mkhyen par grags zhes nyi ma dpal gyis bshad kyang / lo rgyus mi gsung / de la sa ṅgha shis zhus par byas kyang chog gsung / grub pa'i slob dpon lo ka pra dha sa sgrub thabs dang / rgyud kyi bsdus pa'i don dang / rdzogs rim dang / dbang gi cho ga dang /sbyin bsreg rnams mdzad cing / mi'i nyi ma'i 'grel pa yang 'di'i rjes 'brang ngo / / phyis rgyud 'di'i nyan bshad shin tu dkon pa la/ grub chen zhi ba'i zhabs kyis rgya cher dar bar mdzad de/ kho bos kyang / zhi ba'i zhabs kyi man ngag phyin ci ma log pa bla ma'i zhal gyi gdams pa kho nar gyur pa dang / 'grel pa gnyis gzhung phran brgyad dang bcas legs par mnos pas/ kha ba can gyi phyogs 'dir sngon chad bdag kho na'i bsod nams kyi skal bar thob bo/ ma rgyud rgyal po zab mo'i mthar thug pa sgrol ma 'byung ba'i rgyud kyi byung khungs rnams/ bla ma'i gsung bzhin bkod 'di rgyal khams pa/ /tā ra nā tha zhes byas sbyar ba yin/ /zhes pa rang lo sum cu pa la chos grwa gser mdog can du smras pa'o// //dge legs 'phel// bkra shis// zhus dag/—38—

batsha/da pa bzhugs/na mo lo ke shwa ra ya/ sgrol ma 'khor ba kun sgrol ba/ /de la gus pas phyag 'tshal nas/ /bstod pa'i rgyud don cung zad bshad/ /bgegs rnams ma lus zhi bar mdzod/ /de la rgyud 'di ni rnal 'byor bla na med pa yin la/ de las kyang rnal 'byor ma'i rgyud do/ /de la rigs drug las/ rdo rje rta mchog ste rta'i rgyal po'i rigs so/ /de las kyang rigs kyi 'khor lo'i dbang phyug ma bcom ldan 'das ma sgrol ma'i rgyud de/ bstod pa 'di yang rgyud cha tshang ba kho nar bzhed do/ /de la tshigs bcad dang po phyag 'tshal sgrol ma myur ma dpa' mo zhes pa la sogs pa la/ phyag 'tshal lo zhes pa dang por 'byung ba ni brjod pa gleng slang ba'i gzhir bzhag pa ste 'og ma rnams la'ang shes par bya'o/ /gang la phyag 'tshal na bcom ldan 'das ma sgrol ma la'o/ /de nyid kyi khyad par ji lta bu ce na/thugs dmigs pa med pa'i snying rje chen pos myur du sems can gyi don mdzad pas me dang 'jigs pa thams cad las skyob par dpa' ba mo ni nus mthu thogs pa med pa'i 'phrin las dang / skad cig gcig la ye shes kyi spyan glog dang 'dra ba myur du skyod pas/ shes bya mtha' dag gzigs pa'i mkhyen pa po'o/ /de'i phyir sgrol ma ste sems can thams cad 'khor ba las sgrol ba'i 'phrin las can no/ /de ltar na mkhyen pa dang / brtse ba dang nus pa dang 'phrin las te/ de —39—

tsam bstan pas mtha' yas pa'i yon tan thams cad mtshon nus pa yin la/ de lta bas na tshig gnyis po de ni thams cad kyi mdor bstan yin par shes par bya'o/ /de lta bu'i yon tan mnga' ba'i lha mo 'di ni/ 'jig rten gsum gyi mgon po spyan ras gzigs kyi zhal ras kyi chu skyes te pad+ma ge sar bye ba las sprul zhing byung ba'o/ /'di la lo tsā ba nam mkha' bzang pos/ 'jig rten gsum mgon zhal gyi chu skyes/ /bye ba'i ge sar las ni byung ma/ /zhes pa 'gyur bcos pa go bde'o/ /sgra ji bzhin pa ma yin pa ni/ 'jig rten gsum mgon chos kyi sku/ de las byung ba ni gzugs kyi sku'o/ /tshig bcad gnyis pa phyag 'tshal ston ka'i sogs la/ ston ka'i zla ba kun tu gang ba ste/ nya gang ba brgya phrag ni brtsegs pa'am sbungs pa'i 'od zer dang mtshungs pa'i zhal ras rab tu dwangs pa mdzes pa ma dang / skar ma stong phrag mang po tshogs pa rnams kyi ste lta bu'am du mar gyes pas rab tu phye zhing 'phro ba'i 'od zer rab tu 'bar ba'i sku can ma ste/sku mdog dkar zhing dwangs la yid 'phrog cing 'od zer dkar po 'phro ba'o/ /sbas don ni ston zla lta bu'i byang chub kyi sems nor bu nas spyi bo'i bar 'pho med du brtsegs pa dang / phran thams cad kun das gang ba ni skar tshogs lta bu'o/ /tshigs bcad gsum pa phyag 'tshal gser sngo sogs la/ gser gyi yu ba can me tog sngo ba chu las skyes pa'i pad+mas phyag rnam par brgyan pa ste phyag na bsnams pa'i lha mo khyod ni sbyin pa dang brtson 'grus dang / dka' thub ste tshul khrims dang / zhi ba ste shes rab dang / bzod pa dang bsam gtan te pha rol tu phyin pa drug la mnga' mnyes pas/ phar phyin ni khyod ni khyod kyi spyod yul nyin yin la/—40—

lha mo khyod ni de la spyod pa mo'o/ /sbas don ni chu skyes gsang ba'i pad+ma dang /phyag gi sgras rdo rje te mnyam par sbyar ba las 'pho ba med pa'i tshul khrims dka' thub dang / bde ba'i bsam gto dang / stong nyid rtogs pas rnam rtog zhi ba'i shes rab dang de las mi 'da' ba'i brtson 'grus dang / bde sdug thams cad de'i ngang du snyoms pa'i bzod pa dang / bdag 'dzin btang ba'i sbyin pa ste/sngags kyi spyod pa bstan pa'o/ /tshigs bcad bzhi pa phyag 'tshal de bzhin sogs la/ de bzhin gshegs pa rnam par snang mdzad kyi gtsug tor las/ phan yon mtha' yas pa dang ldan zhing mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad las rnam par rgyal bar byed pa'i rig sngags kyi ye shes sprul pa de/ dge ma khyed kyis bdag gir mdzad nas longs spyod de/ sems can dpag tu med pa'i rig sngags des mdzad la pha rol tu phyin pa bcu ma lus par thob pa'i/ rgyal ba'i sras po sa bcu'i dbang phyug rnams kyis kyang nyid la gus pas brten zhing mchod pa'o/ /zab don la lugs 'byung lugs ldog gi dga' ba'i sa ni/ dpal ldan de bzhin nyid gshegs shing / /de bzhin slar yang gshegs pa nyid/ /ces pa ltar de bzhin gshegs pa'o/ khams dang rlud gi tshogs pa gtsug tor du thim pas spangs bya mtha' yas pa las rnam par rgyal zhing / phar phyin bcu ste rlud bcu gnas gyur pas/ rgyal sras byang chub sems dpa' ste mig sogs skye mched rnams kyang ye shes su gnas gyur pa'o/ /'di dang gong gi ston zla sogs sbyar sogs ༵ rdo~X rdo /pa hū dhi rlo/ ༵sa/ tshig 1 sa sgra ba / bcwa smad 'ji 1 na rten ༵sna ldod khams bye —41—

gnas thams cad dang / nam mkha' ste gzugs khams gzugs med kyi gnas dang / phyogs ces pas phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten gyi khams gzhan thams cad kyang / khyab cing gang bar mdzad la 'jig rten bdun po zhabs kyi 'og tu mnan pa ltar dbang du mdzad cing / khyed kyis byin gyis brlabs pa'i rig sngags kyi mthus dbang phyug chen po la sogs pa'i lha chen po rnams kyang bran du 'gugs pa'i nus mthu yod na/ phra mo gzhan lta smos kyang ci dgos/ de la 'jig rten bdun zhes pa snod bdun dang / bcud kyi bdun dang / snod bcud bsdoms pa'i bdun la sogs pa'i 'chad tshul mi gcig pa mang yang / 'dir ni mthu dang ldan pa'i 'jig rten bdun te/ klu dang yi dwags dang lha ma yin dang / mi dang rig pa 'dzin pa dang mi'am ci dang lha'i 'jig rten no/ /sbas don ni tu stu ra ni gdung ba ste/ gtum mo'i mes gdung pa'o/ /huX gi yi ge ni mi shigs pa'i sgra ste gtum mo las byung ba'o/ /'dod pa ni gsang ba'i 'khor lo dang / phyogs ni dbu ma'i nang ste sgra des gang ba dang / nam mkha' gang ma ni brjod bral lo/ /'jig rten bdun ni rtsa 'khor lo lnga dang / me rlung gi 'khor lo gnyis te bdun gtum mo 'bar ba zhu ba'i kun das gang ba dang / kun da de nyid ma lus par slar yang gsang ba nas spyi bo'i bar du 'gugs pa'o/ /tshigs bcad drug pa phyag 'tshal brgya byin sogs la/ brgya byin ni lha'i 'gro ba rnams kyi rgyal po'o/ /me lha ni drang srong gi gtso bo'o/ /chas pa ni 'jig rten gyi byed por 'dod pa'o / /rma lha ni 'jig rten bzo'i gnas dang bkod pa'i khyad par byed pa'o/ /drag po dang gtogs 'dod dang / drang srong nyi ma'i mdog dang / phywa la sogs pa byed pa'am/—42—

dbang phyug tu grags pa sna tshogs pa ni/ sna tshogs dbang phyug ste/ 'jig rten na ches che bar grags pa de rnams kyis kyang / mchod pa'i gnas su gyur cing /'byung po ni tshogs kyi bdag po la sogs pa bgegs dang log par 'dren pa rnams so/ /ro langs ni ro langs kyi las byed pas las kyi ming byed pa ba la btags pa ste/ lha'i srin po rig sngags kyi mthu grub pa/ rdzu 'phrul chen po dang ldan pa'i 'jigs byed dgu la sogs pa'o/ /dri za ni sna tshogs shing rta la sogs pa rnams dang / gnod sbyin ni rnam thos bu la sogs pa gter gyi bdag po rnams dang / mdangs 'phrog pa'i lha ma srin rnams te/ gdul bar dka' ba'i tshogs de rnams kyis kyang / khyod kyi mdun nas bstod par byed pa ste 'gro ba thams cad kyis bla mar bsngags so/ /sbas don ni brgya byin sogs lnga ni 'byung ba lnga ste/ brgya byin ni sa/ me lha ni me/ myongs pa ni chu/ rlud lha ni rlud /sna tshogs dbang phyug nam mkha'o/ /de ltar khams lnga'i rlung thig ler thim pa ni mchod pa'o/ /'byung po rtsa/ ro langs thig le/ dri za rlung / gnod sbyin rnam rtog ste/ de dag kyang thig ler thim/ pa ni mdun nas bstod pa'o/ /'dis ni 'dzin pa'i yan lag bstan no/ /tshigs bcad bdun pa phyag 'tshal thog ces sogs la traṭa dang phaṭa kyi gsang sngags la sogs pa/ 'phags ma sgrol mas gsungs pa'i rig sngags/ drag shul spyod pa rnams kyi mthu las/ drag po'i las sna tshogs par byed par 'gyur la/ de yang gzhan la phan pa'i phyir gdul dka' 'dul ba yin gyi/ gnod pa'i sbyor ba ni ma yin no/ /rigs sngags de lta bu'i khyad par 'ga' zhig las/ pha rol pa'i byad ma rnams kyi 'khrul 'khor dang spre —43—

sngags kyi stobs bzlog cing 'joms pa dang / khro mo'i skur bstan te/ g.yas bskum g.yon brkyang la sogs pa'i zhabs kyis/ gdug pa can rnams mnan pa'i tshul gyis/ rims dang nad yams la sogs pa zhi bar mdzad cing khro bas 'khrugs pa'i sku lus me 'bar zhing shin tu 'bar ba ston pas/ gshin rje la sogs pa'i gdon rnams byer pa dang / 'gro ba rnams la bsrung ba chen po mdzad pa yin no/ /sbas don ni thog ces pa ni dral ba / phaṭa ni 'gas pa ste rnam rtog 'joms pa'o/ /pha rol las dang nyon mongs pa'i 'khrul 'khor dus sbyor bcu gnyis kyi rlung sogs 'gag pa dang / g.yas kyi rtsa ro ma ni skum pa ste kha steng du lta ba dang / g.yon gyi rtsa rkyang ma ni brkyang ba ste kha 'og tu blta ba yin la/ de gnyis dbu ma'i zhabs gyis yongs su mnan pa ni/ de gnyis kyi rlung dbu mar 'gags pa'o/ /de las gtum mo'i me 'bar ba dang / ha yig zhu ba'i chu 'khrugs pa dang / slar yang shin tu 'bar zhing ches zhu ba la sogs pa ste/ srog rtsol gyi yan lag go /tshigs bcad brgyad pa phyag 'tshal tu re sogs la oṃ tu re sogs kyi rigs sngags bzlas pa'i mthus/ rang bzhin zhi ba'i dbyings las sgrol ma nyid 'jigs pa chen po'i skur ston par 'gyur la/ des ni bdud kyi dpa' bo ste dmag dpon rnams 'joms shing / zhal ras chu skyes khro gnyer dang ldan par mdzad pas/ bstan pa la sdang ba dang / sems can mang po la 'tshe ba dang / sgrub pa po la bar du gcod pa'i dgra rnams gsod pa ma ste/ 'chi ba'am gnod pa'i bsam sbyor med par 'gyur ba'o/ /de'i nang gi don la/ bdud kyi dpa' bo 'joms pa ni phyogs las rnam par rgyal ba'i spyod pa'o/ khro gnyer ni —44—

lha'i chas su zhugs par mtshon te/ des kyang ye shes kyi sku grub pa mtshon pa yin la/ bde stong gnyis su med pa'i ye shes ni skal dman rnams skrag par mdzad pa'i phyir 'jigs pa chen po'o/ /ye shes dang ye shes kyi sku de gnyis kyis dgra bo ste sgrib pa ma lus pa bcom nas/ tu re ste myur bar lam gong ma rnams bsgrod nas rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas thob pa'o/ /'di ni ting nge 'dzin gyi yan la ga gi 'bras bu kun tu 'od la sogs pa'i sa bcu gnyis so/ /tshigs bcad dgu pa phyag 'tshal dkon mchog sogs la/ dkon mchog gsum mtshon par byed pa ut+pa la'i phyag rgya ni sgrol ma'i dam tshig gi phyag rgya ste/ snyim pa kha sbyar gyi gung mo sbyar zhing 'dzub mos brten nas mthe bong gzhibs te rtsa bar bkod pa thugs kar gtod pas rnam par brgyan pa ni/ rjes 'jug rnams kyis kyang dam tshig gi phyag rgya de lta bu cho ga bzhin tu bcings na/ rig sngags kyi lhas byin gyis rlob pa'i don sngon byung la bcom ldan 'das ma nyid phyag rgya de lta bu 'ching ba'i sku'i rnam 'gyur dang / phyogs kyi 'khor lo ste phyogs bcu'i zhing khams ma lus pa/rang gi sku las byung ba'i 'od zer gyi tshogs rab tu 'khrugs shing 'phro bas khyab cing brgyan par mdzad pa'o/ /de nyid rjes 'jug la ni/ phyag rgya des spyan drangs na phyogs bcu'i zhing nas 'od zer 'phro zhing dngos su 'byon pa'o/ /sbas don ni/dkon mchog gsum mtshon ni khu rdul rlung gsum ste/ gcig tu 'dus pa sor mo gsum gyi phyag rgya lta bu de rnams rtsa 'khor lo so rbe'i thugs ka ste dbus kyi lte ba'i thig ler yongs su bcings pas ye shes kyi sku gtum mo'i 'od zer las grub pa phyogs kun tu khyab pa/ thim par 'gyur ba'i don te/ 'dzin pa'i stobs —45—

las rjes dran 'byung ba'o/ /tshigs bcad bcu pa phyag 'tshal rab tu sogs la/'gro ba rnams rab tu dga' ba bskyed pa'i sku dang / brjid cing mdzes pa'i dbu rgyan gyi nor bu las 'od zer gyi phreng ba spel zhing 'phro ba ma dang / bzhad pa dang rab tu cher bzhad pa dang / oṃ tu stu re la sogs pa'i sngags kyi sgras 'jig rten gzhan rnams dbang du byed pa'i bdud kyang khyod kyis dbang du mdzad la/ 'jig rten gzhan thams cad kyang nus pas dbang du bsdus nas/ thar pa dang thams cad mkhyen pa la 'god do/ /sbas don ni/ rab tu dga' ba lhan cig skyes pa'i gzi brjid kyi 'od zer gyis dbu la brgyan pa ni/ spyi bor mas brtan pa'i lhan skyes te/ bzhad pa rab bzhad kyang sgra dang bcas pa'i gtum mo'i me'i don no/ /tu stu ra ni gdung ba ma ste gtum mo'i me'i gdung bas/ bdud chags rtog dang /'jig rten lus ngag yid gsum bde ba chen po'i ye shes kyi byin gyis rlob cing dbang du byed pa ste/ rjes dran gyis yan lag go /tshigs bcad bcu gcig pa phyag 'chal sa gzhi sogs la lha mo gang gi rig sngags kyis sa gzhi skyong ba'i rgyal po'i tshogs sam/ sa'i lha mo la sogs pa/ sa 'og gi klu dang / lha ma yin dang rig pa 'dzin pa dang / mkha' 'gro ma'i tshogs rnams thams cad 'gugs shing dbang du byed pa'i nus pa dang ldan pa nyid ma'o/ khro gnyer g.yo ba ste khro mo'i rig sngags hūX gi yi ge dang bcas pa'i mthu las/ 'gro ba 'phongs pa rnams thams cad dbul zhing 'phongs pa'i sdug bsngal ma lus pa las sgrol zhing zhi bar mdzad pa dang / longs spyod phun sum tshogs pa dang / gter chen po'i dngos grub la sogs pa rgyas par byed pa'o/ /sbas don ni/ sa gzhi skyong —46—

bas 'og gi bdag po'i sgras/ rdul gyi dwangs ma/ gcur tor nas nor bu'i bar du brtan pa'i tshul gyis 'gugs pa dang / khro gnyer g.yo ba dang hu gi sgras/ ri bong can gyi dwangs ma khro gnyer te/ smin mtshams kyi thig le brgyud de/ gtsug tor gyi bar du brtan pa ni/ nam mkha' mdzod la sogs pa'i ting nge 'dzin sgrub pa'i phyir 'phongs pa las sgrol ba'o/ /'di ni ting nge 'dzin gyi yan lag gi khyad chos dkar dmar gyi sgrod pa steng 'og tu 'gag tshul lo/ /tshigs bcad bcu gnyis pa phyag 'tshal zla ba'i sogs la/ zla ba'i dum bu ni zla ba phyed pas dbu rgyan la brgyan pa las dang / gzhan yang rgyan gyis brgyan pa thams cad las 'od zer rab tu 'bar bas/ phyugs bdag chen po bye ba phrag brgya'i dregs pa 'joms pa mo/ lan 'ga' dka' thub can gyi skur bstan nas/ ral pa'i thor tshugs 'chang ba'i khrod na de bzhin gshegs pa 'od dpag tu med pa bzhugs shing gnas pa'i sku las/ rtag tu rgyun mi 'chad par shin tu 'od rab byed ma ste/'od kyi snang bas gsal bar byed pa'o/ /sbas don ni/ gong snga ma'i 'phros de nyid la sbyar te/ zla ba'i dum bu'i dbu rgyan ni byang chub kyi sems spyi bor brtan pa'o/ /ral pa'i khrod gnas ni grib ma'i tshul du spyi bor brtan pa/ 'od dpag med ni dmar cha'i dwangs ma/ de gnyis kar la 'od zer rab tu 'phro ba ni/dkar dmar de rnams stong gzugs phyag rgya chen po'i dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo mtha' yas par gyur pa'o/ /tshigs bcad bcu gsum pa phyag 'tshal bskal pa sogs la/ bskal pa tha ma ste/ 'jig dus kyi me ltar 'bar ba'i phreng ba me dpung gi dbus na bzhugs shing / nang zag med kyi dga' ba las ma g.yos —47—

bzhin du/ g.yas brkyang g.yon bskum sogs drag po'i stangs stabs kun nas bskor ba ste rol pa sna tshogs pas dga' ba dang / dgra bo ste mi dang mi ma yin pa'i gnod byed kyi dpung gi tshogs rnams ni rab tu 'joms pa'o/ /sbas don ni/ gtum mo ye shes kyi me dus mtha'i me 'bar ba lha bu ste/ lus dang snang ba thams cad la khyab par 'byung ba'i rgyu ni g.yas brkyang g.yon bskum ste/ g.yas g.yon ro rkyang ngam steng 'og srog thur gyi rlung ni kun nas bskor ba ste/ rtsa 'khor lo so sor re re bzhin 'byung ba lnga'i thim tshul sogs/ rnam par rol pa'i rnam 'gyur du ma kun nas 'byung ba ste/ dga' ba ces pas rlud rnams bde ba'i thig ler gyur pas bdud dang nyon mongs pa'i dgra dpung 'joms pa'o/ /tshigs bcad bcu bzhi pa phyag 'tshal sa gzhi sogs la/ ri rab gling dang bcas pa'i sa gzhi chen po'i ngos la/ thal mo brdabs pa'i phyag gi mthil gyis bsnun pa'o/ /zhabs kyi brdungs pa las dang / zhal ras khro gnyer can du mdzad cing khro ba'i shugs kyis/ hū ཾ zhes shangs nas 'jigs pa'i sgra bsgrags pas/ sa 'og rim pa bdun na gnas pa'i klu dang lha min dang srin po dang yi dwags gdug pa can rnams thams cad 'gems pa mo ste dum bur 'thor bar mdzad pa'o/ /de las 'og bdun ni/ sa gzhi chen po 'di nyid la/ 'og tu thog phugs rim pa bdun bzhin du mi ma yin gyi yul chen po dag gnas pa'o/ kha cig ni ri rab kyi rtse mo'i khong seng nas 'thur du gzhal pa yin zer yang mi legs par mngon no/ /de yang gzhi dang / lhag pa'i gzhi dang / gzhi med pa dang / gzhi nyid dang bcud kyi gzhi dang / gzhi bzang po dang / dag pa'i gzhi —48—

zhes bya'o/ /sa 'og gi 'jig rten chen po rnams so/ /sbas don ni/ sa gzhi'i ngos ni lte ba'i dkyil 'khor te/ de la ga tshu mo ye shes kyi me nges pa'i don gyi lha mo'i zhabs kyis brdungs pa dang me lce'i phyag gis bsnun pa'o/ /de yang sa 'og bdun te/ dbu ma'i mas sna na tshangs pa'i me sprul ltar 'khyil ba lan bdun pa/ rab tu 'bar ba gnas pa der/ gtum mo 'bar ba'i byang chub kyi sems 'ongs pa na me'i gdung ba rab tu zhi ba dang / de'i rtsa mdud rnams 'gems shing 'jig pa'o/ / tshigs bcad bco lnga pa phyag 'tshal bde ma sogs la/ bcom ldan 'das ma nyid rtag tu bde ba dang / dge ba dang / zhi ba'i ngang tshul can ma/ mya ngan las 'das pa mchog tu zhi ba/ 'gog bden gyi dbyings la mnyam par 'jog pas zhi ba'i spyod yul can ma ste/ de'i phyir 'gro ba rnams la/tshe 'di'i bde ba dang / pha rol gyi don du dge ba bskyed par mdzad pa ma/ skal ba dang ldan pa rnams la/ zhi ba'i lam ston par mdzad cing / 'bras bu mi gnas pa'i myang 'das zhi ba dam pa'i spyod yul la 'god par mdzad pa ste/gzhan yang lha mo nyid kyi gsungs pa'i rig sngags swāhā dang o dang yang dag par ldan pa dag bzlas pas/ sdig pa chen po dang de'i 'bras bu sdug bsngal chen po rnams kyang 'joms par mdzad pa nyid do/ /'dis zhi ba'i las kyi mtha' bsgyur ba'i sngags swāhā bshad cing / gong du bzlog pa la trog dang /bsad pa la phaṭa du gsungs pas/ las gzhan rnams kyi sngags kyi mtha' bsgyur ba yang zhor la 'phangs pa yin no/ /'di'i nges pa'i don mthar thug pa ni/ bde ma ni sor rtog ye shes/ dge ma ni me long ye shes/ zhi ma ni mnyam —49—

nyid ye shes/ mya ngan 'das zhi ni chos dbyings ye shes/ sdig pa chen po 'joms pa ni bya sgrub ye shes so/ /gsung gzhom med kyi sgra/ rig sngags o dang swahwas mtshon pa mtha' yas par shar bas/ sdig pa zhi ba sogs sems can gyi don mdzad pa ste 'bras bu la sbyar ba'o/ /tshigs bcad bcu drug pa phyag 'tshal kun nas sogs la/ grub pa rig pa 'dzin pa dang / byang chub sems dpa' ting nge 'dzin dang rab tu dga' ba'i thugs dang ldan pa rnams kyis kun nas bskor zhing / gzhan 'phrul dbang byed kyi bdag po sdig to can la sogs pa sems can rnams la nye bar 'tshe ba'i dgra'i lus rab tu 'gems pa ste 'thor bar mdzad pa/ yi ge bcu pa'i ngag ste sngags kyi bkod pa las byung ba'i lha mo khyod/rig pa ste rig sngags hū yig las byung ba'i sgron ma 'od zer 'bar ba'i sku can nyid ma'o/ /'dis ni sgrol ma khro mo la sa bon hu dang bsnyen pa'i sngags yi ge bcu par bstan no/ /nges don rni/ stong gzugs phyag rgya chen po 'od zer gyis bskor ba'i rab dga' ste g.yo med bde bas/ dgra ste ma dag pa'i snang ba'i lus 'joms par byed do/ /zhes pa bsam gtan gyis yan lag dang / yi ge bcu ni g.yas g.yon gyi dkyil 'khor bcu'i cha shas 'gag pa las thob pa'i rtags bcu'o/ /de yang yi ge rlung mtshon zhing / yi ge'i skad dod ak+ta ra 'gyur ba med pa ste/ chos dbyings 'gyur ba med pa'i snang ba bcu'am/ de mthong ba las byung ba'i bde ba mi 'gyur pa'i cha shas bcu'o/ /rig pa hu gi brdas ni/ hū cha lnga pa'i ye shes lnga mtshon te ye shes lnga'i ra pa bzhin gyi thig le khams gsum gyi gzugs brnyan dang bcas pa'o/ /de yang rtags bcu po de dag gi chos su —50—

'jog ste rlung dbu mar bkag pa las byung bas so/ /de la mnyam par 'jog pa ni don dam pa'i rig sngags chen po ste sgron ma ni stong gzugs kyi gsal snang ngo / /'di ni so sor bsdud pa'i rnal 'byor ro/ /tshigs bcad bcu bdun pa phyag 'tshal tu re sogs kyi don ni/ tu re zhes pa myur ma ste/ 'gro ba'i don myur du spyod pa'i lha mos khro bo'i tshul gyis zhabs gnyis ni brdabs pas/ ri'i rgyal po ri rab dang / man dar/ zhes bya ba'i ri dang / ri bo gangs can zhes bya ba dbang phyug chen po gnas pa'i ri rnams dang bcas nga/'i 'jig rten gsum ste sa 'og sa steng sa bla rnams kyang g.yo bar byed do/ //bod dpe phal cher las/'bigs byed ces 'byung ba ltar na/ ri'i rgyal po 'bigs byed de/ gzhung 'di'i rgya skad mthong ba rnams na/ ke la sha zhes par snang ste/ de ltar na gangs ri zhes 'don pa dang mthun mod/ dpe sna tshogs pa snang ba'i phyir/ gcig tu nges bzung dka' bas gnyis ka ltar mi 'gal bar bya'o/ /hū gi rnam pas zhes pa hu ka ra te hu gi yi ge'o/ /'jig rten gsum na zhes pa gnyis pa'i don la bdun pa'i tshig ste gsum ngo la g.yo ba'i byed pa 'jug pa'o/ /'jig rten gsum skyod par 'gyur na/ ri rab sogs smos pas ci zhig bya ce na/ spyir 'jig rten gsum skyod par gyur yang / lha mthu bo che dag gnas pa'i gnas kyi khyad par de rnams g.yo bar mi 'gyur ba yang srid pas/ 'phags ma nyid mthu che ba'i don du smos so/ /sbas don ni/ ri rab ni tshangs pa'i rus pa/ ri gzhan gnyis ni yid bzang ma dang dung can ma/ g.yo ba ni byang chub kyi sems kyi yongs su gang ba/ 'jig rten gsum ni steng 'og gi dbye bas rtsa gsum gsum drug go /hu gi brngas ni/—51 —

thugs rdo rje'i rtsa a wa dhu ti ste rtsa thams cad kyi sa bon nus pa der thim pa'o/ /tshigs bcad bco brgyad pa phyag 'tshal lha'i sogs la/ lha'i mtsho ste/yid kyi mtsho'am rdzing bu dal gyi 'bab pa dang 'dra ba'i rnam pa can ni/ dkar zhing zlum pa'i ri dwags rtags can te zla ba phyag na bsnams pa dang / de'i rig sngags ha ra zhes pa lan gnyis brjod cing / mthar brtan phaṭa kyi yi ge dang bcas pa'i sngags kyis brtan pa dang g.yo ba'i dug ma lus pa sel bar byed do/ /'dis ni zla ba 'dzin pa'i sku bsgoms te/ sngags kyi khyad par de bzlas pas sbrul la sogs pa'i dug gso ba dang / sel bar byed do/ /ha ra lan gnyis brjod pa'i sngags ni/ oṃ na ma tā re na mo ha re hu ha re swāhā/ zhes pa yin la de'i mthar sarba bi dza sharnyi du ru phaṭa ces btags pa ni dug sel ba ste sgrol ma khro mo'i las sngags so/ /ces pa ni rjes 'jug gi don no/ /nges pa'i don du ni/ lha ni lus las byung ba ste/ de'i mtsho ni lhan cig skyes pa'i bde ba rten kun+da dang bcas pa yin la/ de dang dbyer med pa'i stong pa nyid kyi ye shes zla ba ltar dri ma med pa/ gang la mnga' ba ni de'i phyag na bsnams pa'i don no/ /de 'dra ba'i bde stong gnyis su med pa des ni/ ha ra te 'phrog pa/lan gnyis brjod pa'i brdas sgrib pa gnyis kyi nyes skyon 'phrog cing / ma dag pa'i lus kyi dug 'joms par byed do/ /tshigs bcad bcu dgu pa phyag 'tshal lha'i tshogs rnams sogs la/ lha'i tshogs pa ste 'dod pa'i khams kyi lha rigs drug po rnams yin la/ de bzhin du rgyal po ni 'jig rten 'di na dbang bsgyur ba po 'khor lo'i bsgyur ba la sogs pa'i rgyal po rnams so/ /'jig rten du phan —52—

gnod byed pa ri'i lha dang shing gi lha dang / mtsho'i lha mo la sogs pa ni lha'i khyad par te/ de rnams dang mi'am ci dbang che ba rnams kyis khyod kyi zhabs kyi pad+mo la gus pas brten pa yin la/ lha mo khyod kyis byin gyis brlabs pa'i sngags dang phyag— rgya'i go cha dga' ba dang bde ba'i rgyu de kun nas bcings pa'i sgrub pa pos/ lus ngag yid kyi gzi brjid kyi pha rol pa'i rtsod pa dang / rmi lam ngan pa la sogs pa mi 'cham pa thams cad sel bar byed ma'o/ /'dir go cha ni bsrung ba'i don no/ /nges pa'i don du/ lha ni de ba'i spre las de ha bha ba ste lus las byung ba/ ye shes kyi sku'o/ /tshogs ces smos pas ye shes kyi sku de yang / phung khams bcu la sogs pa rnam dag du ma dang ldan pa'i don no/ /de nyid rig pa 'dzin pa'i rgyal po yang yin la/ 'jig rten gsum gyi mchod 'os yin pa'i phyir/ lha dang mi'am ci la sogs pas bsten pa'o/ /de'i rgyu ni thig le'i tshogs pa 'pho med du bcangs pa'i 'pho cha'i gzi brjid kyis/ 'gyur nga/'i chags bral rtsod pa dang / tha mal gyi snang ba rmi lam ngan pa bcom pa'o/ /tshigs bcad nyi shu pa phyag 'tshal nyi ma sogs la/ nyi ma dang zla ba 'od zer rab tu rgyas pa lta bu'i spyan gnyis pha rol 'od zer 'bar ba rab tu gsal ba'i gzigs pas 'gro ba rnams la yongs su gzigs pa na/ngan 'gro la sogs pa sdug bsngal can gyi 'gro ba mtha' dag bde ba la 'god par mdzad pa ste/ tā re'i sngags lan gnyis su brjod pa/ tu stu ra'i sngags dang bcas la bzlas pa yis shin tu drag po ste gso bar dka' ba'i rims nad ma lus pa yang sel bar mdzad pa'o/ /gnas skabs su ye ge bcu pa'i sngags kyi —53—

rims nad zhi ba dang / nad yams gcod pa dang / nad 'go ba rnams bsrung bar ston la/ don gyi gtso bo ni yi ge bcu pa bzlas pas/ drag po'i rims nad dang 'dra ba'i nyon mongs pa ma lus pa zhi bar byed pa'o/ /skabs 'dir spyan gnyis nyi zla 'dra bar sbyar ba ni/ spyan g.yas pa'i 'od kyis nye bar 'tshe ba rnams skrag par byed cing / sdig pa dang sdug bsngal bsreg par byed pas nyi ma lta bu'i 'od dang / g.yon pa'i 'od zer gyis tshe dang longs spyod dang bde ba rtsol ba'i phyir/ bdud rtsi spro bar byed pa zla ba'i 'od do/ /tā ra gnyis brjod ces pa 'das/ ni tā re gnyis dang tu stu re ste gong du yi ge bcu pa'i ngag ces gsungs pa de nyid ngos 'dzin pa'o/ /des na oṃ tā re tu stu re tu re swāhā ces yongs su grags pa lte/ sgrol ma zhi ba'i bsnyen sgrub las gsum ga'i sngags so/ /sbas pa'i don ni/ nyi zla'i brdas nang gi khu rdul gnyis yin la/ de yis yongs su gang ba'i spyan ni dbu ma'i steng 'og gi sna gnyis yin zhing / de las ye shes 'byung ba'i phyir 'od gsal ba'o/ /tā ra gnyis ni sgrol ba ces pa ste/ bde stong gis srid zhi gnyis kyi mtha' las sgrol ba'o/ /tu stu ra ni gdung ba ste dka' thub yin la/ nyi ma mthur du gnon pa dang / zla ba gtsug tor du drangs te 'gyur med kyi dka' thub 'dis ni thig le 'pho ba'i rims nad sel ba'o/ /tshigs bcad nyer gcig pa phyag 'tshal de nyid gsum rnams sogs la/ yi ge'i don dang / spyi'i don dang / sbas pa'i don dang / mthar thug gi don te bzhi'o/ /dang po ni/ stong pa nyid dang / mashaṃ ma med pa dang / smon pa med pa'i de kho na nyid gsum la/ gdul bya'i sems nyid yang dag par bkod pas/ de'i mthu las/—54—

sgrib pa thams cad spangs te/ zhi ba la 'god pa ste/ gdul bya smin grol du byed pa'i mthu dang yang dag par ldan ma'o/ /gdon ni nam gru'i gdon la sogs pa gdon bco brgyad rnams so/ /ro langs ni ro langs kyi las te rbod gtong la sogs pa'i ngan sngags rnams so/ /gnod sbyin ni mdangs 'phrog pa rnams kyi gnod pa ste/ de lta bu'i gnod pa thams cad kyang / rnam par thar pa'i sgo gsum gyis 'joms pa nyid du byed cing / rab mchog tu re zhes pa'i sngags kyi mthu las kyang de ltar byed pa nyid do/ /yang na tu re ni myur ma ste/ rab mchog lha mo khyod kyi gnod pa thams cad myur du 'joms pa nyid do/ /ces pa'i don du'ang 'gyur bas/ myur du 'joms pa'i mchog rab nyid ma zhes bcos na bde'o/ /gnyis pa spyi'i don ni/ sgrol ma'i skur bskyed pa'i bsam gtan la/ gnas gsum du yi ge 'khru gsum gyi de nyid bkod pas/ zhi ba ste bar chad bsrung ba'i mchog tu 'gyur ba dang / gdon gyi gnod pa la sogs pa bsrung ba'i man ngag kyang ston no/ /gsum pa sbas don ni/ de nyid gsum snang ba dang mched pa dang / nye bar thob pa'o/ /de dag bkod pa de rim gyi shar nas/ zhi ba ste skad cig bzhi pa thams cad stong pa 'od gsal ba nye bar 'gro'o/ /gdon te rtsa dang / ro langs te thig le dang / gnod sbyin te rnam par rtog pa rnams 'od gsal gyi dbyings su bcom pa las/ rab mchog ste lha'i skur myur du bzhengs pa'o/ /'di lta bu'i rigs ni sgron gsal las/ 'od gsal ba ni rab ston dang / /zung du 'jug pa rab rtogs byed/ /rnam pa gnyis su mtha' bshad de/ mtha' na mur thug pa yi —55—

tshig /ces gsang 'dus 'phags skor ba rnams kyi rang lugs la/ mthar thug gi bshad pa 'dod kyang / spyir nas sbas don yang yod par shes pa bya'o/ /bzhi pa mthar thug ni/ sku dang gsung dang thugs rdo rje'i de nyid gsum ni/ chos thams cad kyi rang bzhin du gdod ma nas bkod pa yin la/ rang bzhin gdod ma nas rnam par dag pa de'i phyir/ lam bsgoms pas kyang zhi ba thob pa'i mthu dang yang dag par ldan pa dang / rdo rje gsum dbyer med pa'i dbyings de nyid la mnyam par bzhag pas/ gdon gyi gnod pa dang mtshungs pa'i sdug bsngal dang /ro langs kyi las dang mtshungs pa'i las dang / gnod spyin dang mtshungs pa'o/ /nyon mongs pa rnams myur du bcom nas/ rab mchog ste bde chen lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes gcig pur byed do/ /ces pa'i don no/ / de ltar na rgyas bshad sgra ji bzhin pa'i tshig 'di rnams kyis/ bcom ldan 'das ma sbrul pa'i sku/ sangs rgyas rnams kyi 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor du ston par mdzad pa/ lha'i rgyal po rnams kyi gnas dang / ri bo tā la la sogs par mngon sum du bzhugs par grags pa'i 'di'i dbang du byas pa'i bstod pa yin la/ don gyi na longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku dang chos kyi sku la yang bstod pa'o/ /nges don 'di rnams ni/zab lam mthar thug rdo rje'i rnal 'byor yan lag drug pa dang bstun nas bshad pa ste/ de yang sgrol ma 'byung ba'i rgyud kyi mtshan nges pa'i sgos kyi 'grel ba rgya gar mkhas pas sbyar ba gnyis dang / mar me mdzad dpal gyi rgyud 'grel chen mo'i nang nas byung ba rnams dang mthun par phal cher bshad pa yin la/ de dag las rdo rje'i rnal 'byor gyi man ngag dang mi mthun pa cung zad yod pa rnams ni/—56—

rgyud kyi zab don mthar thug las brtsams nas/ rgyud ni rgyud gzhan gyis rtogs dgos par gsungs pa ltar/ bdag gis rdo rje'i rnal 'byor dang mthun par bkral lo/ /gzhan yang nye bar mkho ba'i rnam grangs 'di lta bu dag kyang yod de/ston ka'i zla ba sogs kyis zla ba dang sa bon las bskyed pa dang / nyi ma zla ba rgyas pa sogs kyi mngon byang lnga las bskyed pa dang / de bzhin gshegs pa'i gtsug tor zhes pas lha dbang bskur ba dang / 'jig rten gsum mgon sogs kyi cho ga gsum bskyed dang / de nyid gsum sogs kyis rdo rje gsum byin gyis rlob pa dang / kun nas go cha sogs kyis skye mched rnams byin gyis rlob pa dang /kun nas skor rab dga' ba dang / g.yas brkyang g.yon bskum kun nas skor dga'i zhes pas 'khor gyi lha tshogs te/ bskyed rim gyi phyogs dang / nyi ma zla ba rgyas pa'i sogs kyis sa chog dang / rdul tshon sogs la mig gi blta ba byin gyis rlob pa dang / dbu rgyan 'od kyi 'phreng ba spel ma zhes pas/ cod pan gyi dbang bskur ba la sogs pa dang / yi ge hū gis ces pas sngags kyi dbang bskur ba dang / zla ba'i rtse mos dbu brgyan gyis gsang dbang dang / ral pa'i khrod las 'od dpag med kyis sher dbang dang / bde ma dge ma sogs kyis dbang bzhi pa yang bstan te/ dbang gi don no/ /me 'bar 'khrugs ma zhes pa dang / 'bar ba'i 'phreng ba ces pa dang / 'od rab 'bar ma zhes pa dang / sgron ma nyid ma zhes pa rnams kyis las bzhi dang dngos grub sgrub pa'i bsreg blugs kyang bstan zhing / dbang bskur bas ni rab tu gnas pa'ang bstan pa yin no/ /gzhan yang sgrol ma nyin zhi mtshan khror grags pa'i sgrub thabs kyang gzhung na—57—

'dis shin tu gsal bar bstan zhing / sgrub thabs nyer gcig dang las tshogs nyer gcig bstan par shin tu grags che ba rnams kyang yin te/ ha cang mangs par 'gyur bas 'dir ma spros so/ /mjug gi don la/ de'i 'og tu bstod pa'i phan yon bstan pa yin te/de la dang po rtsa ba'i sngags kyi sogs sho lo ka gnyis la/ rtsa sngags yi ge bcu pa'i sgo nas bstod pa ni 'di nyid yin pa dang / phyag 'tshal lo zhes pa nyi shu rtsa gcig dang ldan pa'i bstod pa yang 'di yin no zhes pa des na dang zhes pa bsdud pa'i tshig go /de la rtsa ba'i sngags kyi don ni/ oṃ zhes bya ba mchog gi tshangs pa/chos kyi dbyings chos kyi sku/ yon tan mtha' dag gi nor bu 'dzin pa/ bde bar gshegs pa'i snying po chos kyi mchog go /chos kyi sku las byung ba'i ye shes ni tā re/ gdod ma'i chos las byung ba'i sku ni tu stu re/ brjod du med pa'i chos las byung ba snying rje chen po ni tu re te sprul pa dang mdzad pa'o/ /spru ni rang byin gyis brlabs pa/ hā ni ha las a ra li ste/ e ma ho rol pa ste/ sgyu ma lta bu'i sku dang zhing khams dang mdzad pa mtha' yas pa'o/ /don de rnams kyi sgo nas bstod pa'i phyir rtsa ba'i sngags kyi bstod pa'o/ /las su bya ba bstod pa'i yul lha mo ste bcom ldan 'das ma la'o/ /byed pa ni gus pa yang dag par ldan pas so/ /byed pa po blo ldan gang gis so/ /tshul ji ltar na/ 'dir rab tu dad cing brtson 'grus dang ldan pas te/ bstod pa 'di brjod pa dang / srod dang tho rangs langs pa ste ldang ba yang bar byas nas/ phyag 'tshal ba dang mchod pa sngon du 'gro bas/ 'phags ma'i yon tan yid la dran pas so/ /de'i phan yon ni pyi / —58—

'jigs pa thams cad rab tu ster ba ste/ 'jigs pa chen po brgyad dang bcu drug la sogs pa 'jigs pa thams cad las skyob pa dang / mi 'jigs pa'i gnas dbang phyug phun sum tshogs pa rtsol bar mdzad pa'o/ /'dir rab dang brjod cing ces pa la/ rgya skad du pa ces pa yod pas brtson pas klog cing zhes brjod na bde'o/ /de bas na blo ldan gang gis srod sogs thun drug tu lha mo la gus shing yon tan dran pa'i sgo nas/ brtson pas bstod pa 'di bklags na/phan yon 'di dag yod do ces pa ste gong 'og thams cad du de ltar go bar bya'o/ /sdig pa ni sdig pa'i 'bras bu te nad dang gdon dang / byur chags skal ba ngan pa sngar yod rnams thams cad rab tu zhi zhing slar 'byung bar 'gyur ba rnams bzlog pa'o/ /de bzhin du sngar sdig pa'i las kyi mthus ngan 'gror skye nges pa'i las can yin yang / bstod pa bklags pa'i gzi brjid kyis sdig pa'i las zad de ngan 'gro'i skye ba thams cad 'joms pa'i gnas skabs thob pa nyid de/ ngan 'gror skye bar mi 'gyur ro/ /de'i ldog don du bde 'gro'i skye ba phun sum tshogs pa 'grub pa yang bstan te/ des ni 'khor ba nyid du yang tshe 'di dang phyi ma'i phan yon gnyis kar bstan no/ /rgyal ba bye ba sogs la bstod pa bzlas pa dang de'i sgrub pa la gnas pas/ bcom ldan 'das ma 'di nyid dang lhan cig tu gshegs shing bzhugs pa'i rgyal ba sangs rgyas sprul pa'i sku bye ba phrag bdun rnams kyis/ zhal yang sgrub pa po des myur du mthong bar 'gyur la/mthong nas kyang dngos sam rmi lam du de rnams kyis 'od zer ram phyag las bdud rtsi'i rgyun 'bab pas dbang bskur bar 'gyur ro/ /'dis ni slob ma smin —59—

byed kyi tshe/ chu dbang bskur ba yang bstan no/ /de ltar dbang bskur ba de'i rkyen gyis/ sgrib pa mang po ni byang / ting nge 'dzin dang gzungs kyi khyad par mang po thob ste 'khor phun sum tshogs pa 'di las ches che ba'i yon tan du ma nyid dang ldan pa'i phyag rgya chen po'i dngos grub rim gyis thob par 'gyur zhing de thob nas kyang 'phags pa'i sa rnams bsgrod de/ mthar thug rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phangs der 'gro bar 'gyur ro/ /zhes thar pa dang thams cad mkhyen pa thob pa'i phan yon bstan no/ /sa nas skabs sngags kyi mthus phan yon gzhan yang bstan pa'i phyir/tshigs bcad gsum gsungs pa las/ de yi dug ni sogs la brtan pa nag po brtsegs pa la sogs pa'i dug dang / g.yo ba sdig sprul dang lhog pa dang shu ba la sogs pa'i dug ste/ gnas pa zhes pa ni brtan pa dang ming gi rnam grangs su 'gyur ba go bde ba'i phyir gnyis ka brjod pa ste/ gnyan los brtan pa'am ni g.yo ba yang rung zhes pa'am/ nam mkha' bzang pos/ brtan g.yo gang yang rung ba dag ni/ zhes bcos pa go bde'o/ /de lta bu'i dug ste drag po chen po ste/ srog 'phrog pa dang sdug bsngal tshabs chen bskyed pa'o/ /de lta bu'i dug de yang sgrol ma'i rigs sngags dran pa tsam gyis/ rab tu 'jigs pa ste de'i gnod pa rnams sel zhing / bdud rtsi la sogs par 'gyur ba'o/ /zos pa dang ni 'thung ba nyid kyang zhes pa ltar na/ dran pas rab tu sel zhes pa'i snga rol du sbyar te/ dug de lta bu zos pa dang 'thung ba nyid kyang / reg pa dug can gyi byug pa sogs kyang rig sngags dran pas skad cig la sel zhes pa'i don yin la/ 'gyur gzhan —60—

las zos pa dang ni zhes pa 'di dran pas ces pa'i tshig gi 'og tu 'don pa ltar na/ sho lo ka 'og ma dang sgrel bar 'gro mod / 'on kyang kha di ta bī pa ta me wa bā ces 'gyung ba ltar na/ dkyus nyid bde'o/ / gdon dang sogs la gdon rnam pa sna tshogs kyi gnod pa dang / rims la sogs pa'i nad dang / dug gis gzir ba la sogs pa'i sdug bsngal gyi tshogs rang la gnas pa rnams kyang sgrol ma'i rigs sngags 'di'i mthus rnam par spangs te/ thar pa thob par ma zad/ rig sngags mkhan po des yid kyi bsam pa tsam mam/ zhi ba'i las kyi sbyor ba byas pa tsam gyis/ sems can gzhan pa rnams la yang sdug bsngal de spong bar byed do/ /de bzhin du kun gyi tha ma'i tshig rkang yar blangs te bgegs rnams med cing bdud la sogs pa rnams so sor 'joms par 'gyur ro/ /gnyis gsum bdun du sogs la gnyis ni nyin dang mtshan mor brjod pa'o/ /gsum ni nyin dang mtshan la yang rung ste thun gsum mo/ /de re rer yang sgrub pa dang 'brel bar bstod pa lan bdun bdun du brjod pa ste/ bla ma'i man ngag las 'byung ba ltar ro/ /de ltar brjod na bu ste khyim pa'i phyogs la rigs brgyud dam/ rab tu byung ba'i phyogs la ni chos kyi bu slob ma 'dod pas bu'am slob ma mang po dag thob par 'gyur zhing / /nor 'dod pas ni nor dang longs spyod rnams nyid thob par 'gyur la/ gzhan yang zhi ba la sogs pa'i las dang /ril bu dang mig sman dang / ral gri dang gnod sbyin mo dang gter chen po la sogs pa/ dngos grub rnam pa sna tshogs pa thams cad thob par 'gyur ro/'phags ma sgrol ma la bstod pa/ yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnam —61—

par snang mdzad kyis gsungs pa zhes pa la 'di sgrol ma'i rgyud kyi rgyal po rtog pa bdun brgya pa las 'byung ba'o/ /zhes grags so/ /las sna tshogs pa/'i rgyud du grags pa/ deng sang phyogs 'dir yod pa 'di na'ang snang mod/ 'di ni mkhas pa rnams brtsams rgyud yin par bzhed pa don la gnas pas 'di nas min no/ /rgyud rgyas pa'i dum bu dang / bsdus rgyud la sogs pa yin pa'ang mi 'gal lo/ /rdzogs po ni sa ma sta ste yang dag par thob pa'o/ / dus gsum rgyal ba'i yum gyur la/ /bstod pa'i rgyud 'di rab bshad las/ / dge ba gang zhig thob pa des/ /'phags ma'i go 'phang 'grub par shog/ //ces pa phyag 'tshal nyer gcig gi bstod pa'i rnam par bshad pa 'di yang tā ra nā thas smras pa'o/ / zhus dag / maṅgal/ /—62—

rol ma‘ bzhugs/rgyal ba kun gyi bdag po rdo rje 'chang / /dkyil 'khor 'khor lo'i yum gcig bdag med ma/ /grub pa'i dbang phyug shom bhi he ru ka /de yi rjes bzung ngo mtshar rdo rje dang / /gsang spyod mthar phyin ga rba ri pa'i khas/ / rigs pa'i gnas lnga mkhyen pa rgyal ba dpal/ /mkha' 'gro ma mgon rgyal dka' zla ba'i zhabs/ /rtsod dus kun mkhyen rat+na a kā ra/ /blo gros mi zad rdo rje gdan pa ste/ /dgyes mdzad brgyud pa rnams la gsol ba 'debs/ /gsang ba'i bdag po phyag na rdo rje dang / u rgyan gnas kyi klu'i rnal 'byor ma/ /rgyal rigs skal ldan bi su kalpa'i zhabs/ /rtogs pa don gyi mnga' bdag sa ra ha/ / rab dga' sa grub slob dpon klu grub zhabs/ /'od gsal sgyu ma'i gar mdzad 'phags pa lha/ /bcud len grub pa'i dbang phyug bkra shis ma/ /gdol pa'i rigs las grub brnyes ma ti ṅga/ /mkha' 'gros byin rlabs shar phyogs ti snyi pa/ /bla mas byin rlabs mchog brnyes nā ro pa/ /slob dpon ta thā ga ta rak+ṣi ta/ /gsang 'dus bla ma rnams la gsol ba 'debs/ /rgyal ba'i yum gcig rdo rje rnal 'byor ma/ /dka' ba spyad pas grub brnyes lha hi pa/ /chang tshong mkha' 'gros rjes bzung zhi lha pa/ /bud med gsum bcas grub brnyes dril bu pa/ /sgyu ma'i don gzugs gā ya la pa'i zhabs/ /ye shes mchog gis rnam rol 'bar —63—

ba 'dzin/ /rigs pa'i brtul zhugs spyod mdzad nag po pa/ /mngon shes drug ldan dge ba'i mgon po dang / /grub chen te lo pa dang nā ro pa/ /mkhas pa blo gros bzang po'i zhal snga nas/ /bde mchog bla ma rnams la: zag med bde ster rnam lnga'i mkha' 'gro ma/ /'byung po 'dul mdzad ku ku ri pa'i zhabs/ /'od gsal rdo rje'i rnam rol pad+ma pa/ /ma rgyud rgya mtsho'i mthar son zhi ba bzang / /shan+ti pa dang rdo rje gdan pa ste/ /sgyu 'phrul bla ma rnams la /rnal 'byor ma dpal skal pa bzang mo'i zhabs/ /mngon spyod drag po'i las mdzad la lī ta/ /mi bdag in+da bhu ti chung ba dang / /sgyu 'phrul ma he'i zhal can dpal 'dzin dang / /bde chen rang bzhin rnam snang srung ba'i zhabs/ /nus mthus bstan pa skyong mdzad pad+ma srung / /'jigs byed bla ma rnams la: /rdo rje 'chang chen rdo rje snying po'i zhabs/ /ye shes mkha' 'gro in+t+ra bhu ti dang / /lha lcam dpal mo sa man+ta badz+ra/ /dza ya de wa rdo rje gdan pa dang / /rdo rje 'chang chen blo gros rin chen dang / kha ba ri pa mnga' bdag me tri'i zhabs/ /man ngag rgya mtsho'i mthar son rda chen po/ /rdo rje 'chang chen grub pa'i dpa' bo dang / /rat+na ka ra a ta ya badz+ra/ /sgra gcan 'dzin sbas rdo rje'i zhal snga nas/ /nye brgyud bla ma rnams la gsol ba 'debs/ /rgyud sde lnga'i brgyud pa'i bla ma rgya gar ba rnams la gsol ba 'debs te/brgyud pa'i khyad par gzhan man ngag gtso bor gyur pa la kho bo'i bka' babs brgyud 'debs su sbyar zin/ 'di ni gzhung gi brgyud pa gtso che ba yin te tā ra nā thas so/ /—64—

de yang / mthar thug ston pa rnam lnga'i dkyil 'khor dang / /dbyer med mkhas grub khyung po rnal 'byor zhabs/ /rin chen brtson 'grus dpon ston skyer rgang pa/ /gnyen ston chos rje sangs rgyas ston pa mchog /rin chen brgyud pa lnga la: /mkhas grub khyung po rne ston yon tshul dang / /rdo rje tshul khrims steng ba tshul khrims bstan/ /bla ma bsod mdzes yon tan rgyal ba'i mtshan/ /'dren mchog rin chen bstan pa rgyas pa sogs/ /bka' babs rim brgyud rnams la:/ /mkhas btsun sangs rgyas 'jig chen byams pa dpal/ /chos dpal bzang po 'khrul zhig tshul rgyan dang / /mkhyen par mchog grub kun bzang chos nyid sogs/ /bstan pa'i srol 'dzin rnams la: /gtsang ma shing ston khyung po tshul khrims mgon/ /ri khrod ras chen shing dkar rin rgyal ba/ /sangs rgyas dpal bzang nam mkha' rgyal mtshan dang / /rgya sgom legs rgyal sems kyi mdud grol mchog /lha dbang grags pa kun dga' rgyal mtshan dang / khyad 'phags rtsa ba'i brgyud par: /brgyud srol kun 'dus gsang bdag sgrol ba'i mgon/ /rin chen rgya mtsho blo gros rnam par rgyal/ /ngag dbang 'phrin las ngag dbang rnam par rgyal/ /mnyam med dam pa rnams la: /dgyes rdor gsang 'dus bde mchog sgyu ma che/ /'jigs mdzad ye shes rnam lnga'i dkyil 'khor pa/ /mkha' 'gro sde lnga myur mdzad mgon po sogs/ /zung 'jug snying po'i lha la: /smin byed dbang bzhi'i rigs kyi gsos theb nas/ /dam tshig rnam dag mthu chen gegs med tshogs/ /bskyed rim brtan thob rdzogs rim mtha' ru phyin/ /mi slob zung 'jug tshe 'dir mngon byed shog /de ma thob pa'i tshe rabs thams cad du/ /bla ma lhag —65—

pa'i lha dang mi 'bral zhing / /dka' ba med par rdo rje sa lam bsgrod/ /dngos grub rnam gnyis bde rlag 'grub gyur cig /rtsa brgyud bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro yi/ /byin rlabs bdag gi rgyud la rab zhugs te/ /ma/kha' mnyam 'gro kun sku gsung thugs yon tan/ /'phrin las 'khor lo myur du 'god nus shog/ //ces shangs lugs rgyud sde lnga'i brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs kha skong 'di blo gros mtha' yas kyis bgyis pa dge legs su gyur cig/

zhes bya ba bsdo/gas/oṃ na mo gu ru he badz+ra gu hu sa ma dzaX tsakra saX bha ra mahā ma ya badz+ra bhe ra ba mahā kā la maṇ+ḍa le khyuX mthar thug ston pa rnam pa lnga'i dkyil 'khor lha la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de yi sgrub thabs man ngag bzhin gsal por 'god la spro ba skyes/ dgyes mdzad rdo rje drag po gdan can gyi bskyed pa'i rim pa la gzhi byas nas rgyud sde lnga'i dkyil 'khor gyi sgrub thabs nyams su len pa'i tshul ni 'di yin te/ skyabs 'gro sems bskyed/ rdo rje sems dpa'i sgom bzlas spyi dang mthun par byas la/ oṃ hūṃ n+ya tā dzñā na badz+ra swa bhā wa ut+pa ko3haX/ stong pa'i ngang las huX las rdo rje hūX gis mtshan pa/ de las 'od zer sna lnga 'phros 'gro ba'i sdig sgrib sbyangs/tshur 'dus rang gi snying gar thim nas zhu ba'i thig le las/ bdag nyid dgyes mdzad rdo rje phyag gnyis pa shes rab ma dang bcas pa tshangs pa dang dbang phyug gi gdan la gnas pa'i snying gar nyi ma la huX de las khro bo bcu spros phyogs bcur 'khod pa ni/ shar du gshin rje gshed nag po tho ba 'dzin pa/ lhor shes rab mthar byed dkar po be con 'dzin pa/ nub tu pad+ma mthar byed dmar po pad+ma 'dzin pa/ byang du bgegs mthar byed nag po rdo rje gdengs pa 'dzin pa/shar lhor gtum mo nag po ral gri 'dzin pa/ lho nub tu 'dod rgyal sngo dmar lcags kyu 'dzin pa/ nub byang du be con sngon po dbyug pa 'dzin pa/ byang shar du stobs po che nag po tri shu la 'dzin pa/ steng du gtsug tor 'khor los bsgyur ba —67—

ser po snyen ra lo 'dzin pa/ 'og tu gnod mdzes nag po gas shing 'dzin pa/mi g.yo 'dod rgyal gnod mdzes rnams rol pa'i khro bo/ gas rnams shin tu khros pa/ thams cad kyang stag lpags kyi sham thabs dang rin po che'i rgyan dang ldan pa/ khro bo'i mtshan nyid thams cad rdzogs pa me dpung dang bcas pa'o khro bo bcu las khro bo bcu lcags kyu dang zhags pa thogs pa phyogs bcur spros/phyogs bcu'i bgegs rnams kyi yan lag lnga zhags pas bcings/ lcags kyus snying gar btab ste bkug par gyur/ oṃ ya mun+ta krita hūX/ oṃ pra rnyen+ta krita huX/ oṃ pad+man+ta krita huX/ oṃ birtswan+ta krita hūX/ oṃ ur+sā tsa la hūX/ oṃ ṭak+ki rā dza hūX/ oṃ nī la daṇ+ḍa hāX/ oX mahā ba la hūX/ oṃ tsakra nywa rto hūX/ oṃ za rā dza hūX/ oṃ nga ni ra huX/gro hā gro hā huX/ gro hā pā ya gro hā pā ya huX/ ā na ya ho bha ga wān bi rgyu rā dza hūX phaṭa swāhā/ yang huX las phur bu dang tho ba bcu spros/ yang sbul khro bo rnams kyi lag pa g.yas g.yon du gtod/ bgegs rnams kyi spyi bor phur bus btab cing tho bas brdungs pas/ lus g.yo 'gul med/ ngag rlud rgyu ba med/ sems 'od gsal du thim zhing / lhag ma rnams rdo rje'i me 'od dang sngags kyi sgras khor yug chen po'i phyi rol du bskrad par gyur/ oṃ gha gha ghā ta ya ghā ta ya/ sarba dunaX na phaṭa/ gī la ya gī la ya sarba pā paX phaṭa/ hūX hūX huX badz+ra gī la badz+ra dha ro adzñā pa ya ti sarba bis+thān kā ya lha ka tsit+ta badz+ra gī la ya hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra mu ṅga ra badz+ra gī la ā ko ṭa ya huX huX phaṭa/ rang nyid mi bskyod pa sngon po rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pas mā ma gī la 'byud pa/ rma kha spyor bya/ rtsa gsum gsal bto nas/ a wa dh+ra tī rab tu rgyas pa'i nang gi snying gar hūX mthing nag /oṃ badz+ra rak+ṣa rak+ṣa huX huX huX phaṭa swāhā/ snying ga'i huX —68—

las ra chad de 'og tu nyi mar gyur/ yang hū gcig chad de/ de'i steng du sna tshogs rdo rjer gyur pa ni/ shar gyi rwa gsum dkar po/ lho'i rwa gsum ser po/nub kyi rwa gsum dmar po/ byang gi rwa gsum ljang khu/ lte ba mthing nag la hū gis mtshan pa/ sna tshogs rdo rje de nyid rgya che zhing rngams 'thug par gyur pas rdo rje'i sa gzhi/ khor yug tu 'phros pa dpangs mtho pas rā ba/ rtse mo rnams steng du 'dus pa gur dang bla bre/ oṃ badz+ra rak+ṣa rak+ṣa hū hu hū phaṭa swāhā/ phyogs bzhir dmigs nas hū bzhi pa lan gcig brjod/ snying ga'i hu gi 'od zer gyi sne la rdo rje rtse gcig pa nas rtse dgu pa'i bar gyi rdo rje rnams 'phros te go mtshams med par gtams/ yang rak+ta'i sngags brjod pas/ 'og gi nyi ma las ye shes lnga'i rang bzhin gyi me 'bar bas/ phyi ngos kyi rdo rje rnams khro chu ltar zhu nas/ me long gi ngos bzhin du gyur pas bskal pa'i rlung gis kyang mi thar zhing bar du gcod pa gang gis kyang mi tshugs pa'i bsrung 'khor ye shes kyi me 'bar bas dpag tshad bye ba tsam du khyab par gyur/ badz+ra rak+ta'i sngags lan gsum brjod/ bsrung ba'i 'khor lo'i nang du bla ma yi dam sangs rgyas byang sems dpa' bo mkha' 'gro sprin dpung 'khrigs pa bzhin bzhugs par gyur/ bla med dkon mchog rnam pa gsum/ /bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro'i tshogs/ khro bo chos skyong bcas pa la/ /rtag tu gus pas skyabs su mchi/ /lan gsum/ bla ma yi dam 'khore bcas kyis/ /rigs kyi bu khyod kyis sems can gyi don du rgyud sde lnga'i lha tshogs sgrub pa ni shin tu legs so/ /rigs kyi bu khyod kyi bar chad nga yis bsrung zhing byin gyis rlabs par bya'o/ /zhes gsungs nas bum pa'i chus dbang bskur bas sdig sgrib mi mthun —69—

pa'i phyogs thams cad bkrus par gyur/ mdun gyi nam mkha' la bcom ldan 'das dgyes mdzad rdo rje la sogs pa byon nas rang dang dbyer med du gyur/ rtsa sngags/ kha bkrus la bdud rtsi myang / nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad bdag gis pha ma yin/ pha ma 'di rnams sdug bsngal ba snying re rje/ da ni bdag gis bde ba dang bde ba'i rgyu dang ldan par bya/ sdug bsngal dang sdug bsngal gyi rgyu dang bral bar bya/ rgyud sde lnga'i dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs rnams kyi go 'phang la bzhag par bya/ de'i phyir du bdag gis rgyud sde lnga'i dkyil 'khor sgrub par bgyi'o/ /de nas/ rang skad cig gis dgyes mdzad rdo rje phyag gnyis pa shes rab ma dang bcas par gsal ba'i snying gar ra las nyi ma'i steng du hu/ de las 'od zer sna lnga 'phros pas rang gi lus kyi nad thams cad sbyangs/ ye shes lnga'i rang bzhin du gyur/ yang 'phros pas sha khrag la sogs pa bar gyi dngos po rnams kyang sbyangs te ye shes lnga'i ngo bor gyur/ yang 'phros pa ba skru'i bu ga nas phyir song ste rang bzhin gyi gnas nas dkyil 'khor lnga'i lha tshogs bla mas dbu rgyan pa sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs dang bcas pa mdun gyi nam mkhar spyan drangs/ bla ma rnams dang yi dam lha/ /sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' dang / /dpa' bo mkha' 'gro chos skyong sogs/ /bdag gi gnas 'dir gshe/gas su gsol/ /oṃ bha ga wān mahā kā ru ṇi ka he badz+ra gu phya sa ma dza tsakra sam+bha ra mahā ma ya badz+ra bhe ra ba maṇ+ḍal sa pa ri bā ra badz+ra sa mā dza rang gi lus zhing gi rdul snyed du sprul/ sangs rgyas thams cad 'dus pa'i sku sogs sho lo ka gcig dang /bcom ldan dgyes mdzad dkyil 'khor dang / /gsang 'dus mahā ma ya dang / /—70—

bde mchog 'khor lo 'jigs byed de/ /yi dam lha la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun dang / /dpa' bo dpa' mo mkha' 'gro dang / /chos skyong tshogs dang bcas pa la/ /bdag sogs gus pas phyag 'tshal lo/ /ar+gha pu du ste chu gnyis phul/ oṃ badz+ra purdze ā hū nas/ sha lta'i bar phul/ dkar mo ri dwags mtshan ma 'dzin/ /chom rkun bdud las rgyal ba'i snod/ /ro langs ma ni chu lag ma/ /lha sma ri ni sman 'dzin cing / /puska si ni rdo rje'i lag/de bzhin ri khrod ma ro 'dzin/ /gdol pa mo ni cang te'u brdung / /'di rnams kyis ni gtso bo mchod/ /'dod chags chen po rjes chags pas/ /g.yung mos sku la 'byud pa nyid/ /de nas rgyun bshags ni/ bdag gis sdig pa bgyis pa dang / /bgyid du stsal dang yi rang ba/ /sangs rgyas spyan sngar mchis nas su/ /ma lus so sor bshags par bgyi/ /sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' dang / /rang rgyal dgra bcom 'gro rnams kyi/ /bsgom dang bzlas brjod bsod nams kyi/ /tshogs la bdag ni yi rang ngo / /bla ma rgyud sde'i0lha rnams kyi/ /sems can rgyud la gang 'tsham pa'i/ /gang 'dul de la der bstan nas/ /chos kyi 'khor lo bskor du gsol/ /bla ma yi dam lha tshogs kyis/ /mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can rnams/ /sangs rgyas dag la ma 'khod par/ /de srid du ni bzhugs su gsol/ /sems bskyed mngon par sangs rgyas nas/ /chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba dang / /chub sems dpa'i tshogs kyi mchog /de la bdag ni skyabs su mchi/ /sangs rgyas 'byung ba ji lta bar/ /skal ldan byang chub sems dpa' yi/ /byang chub sems ni bskyed pa ltar/ /de bzhin bdag gis sems bskyed do/ /bdag gi dge ba'i las ni 'di —71—

dag gis/ /'jig rten 'dir ni myur du sangs rgyas shog /'gro la phan phyir chos kyang ston bgyid cing / /sems can sdug bsngal gzir las sgrol bar shog /bla ma yi dam sangs rgyas la/ /bdag gi lus ngag yid gsum ni/ /ltos med sems can don du 'bul/ /khyod kyi sku gsum 'grub par shog /de nas/sras bcas sangs rgyas thams cad dang la sogs pas rigs lnga'i sdom pa bzung ba yang bya'o/ /sems can thams cad bde ba dang sogs tshad med bzhi bsgom/oṃ su bhā wa shudha sarba dharma spyo bhā wa shu khro3haX/ oṃ shā n+ya tā dzñā na badz+ra su bhā wa ut+pa ko3haX/ stong pa'i ngang las raX las nyi ma la huX las sna tshogs rdo rje/ de las rdo rje'i sa gzhi rwa ba dra ba gur bla bre me ri dang bcas pa'i dbus su/ e las chos 'byung gru gsum phyi dkar la nang dmar ba gdengs ka che ba gyen du phyogs shing / rtsa ba phra ba thur du zug pa'i nang du/ yaX las rlung gi dkyil 'khor sngon po zla gam yaX dang ba dan gyis mtshan pa/ de'i steng du raX las me'i dkyil 'khor dmar po gru gsum raX dang 'bar bas mtshan pa/ de'i steng du baX las chu'i dkyil 'khor dkar po zlum po baX dang bum pas mawo pa/ de'i steng du laX las sa'i dkyil 'khor ser po gru bzhi laX dang rdo rjes mtshan pa/ de'i steng du bhuX las 'khor lo ser po rtsibs bcu drug pa nye ba la bhuX gyis mtshan pa/ de rnams gcig tu 'dres pa las pad nyi sna tshogs rdo rje dang bcas pa'i steng du/ rin po che sna tshogs las grub pa'i gzhal yas khang gru bzhi sgo bzhi pa/ phyi nas rim pa bzhin du dkar ser dmar ljang sngo ba'i rtsig pa rim pa lnga dang ldan pa/ de'i steng du rin po che pha gu las dra ba dang dra ba phyed pa la sogs pa du ma dpyangs pa/ de'i —72—

steng du bya 'dabs las thur du 'phyang ba'i shar bu'i phreng ba dang / steng du mda' yab mchod rten gyi dbyibs can gyis bskor ba'i bar bar na gdugs dang rgyal mtshan dang ba dan la sogs pas brgyan pa/ nang ka ba brgyad dang ldan pa/ steng rdo rje'i gdung bzhi mig mangs ris su bris shing mdzes par phub pa/ dbus phyur bur gyur pa'i rtse mor rdo rje rin po che'i tog gis spras pa/ rtsig pa'i phyi rol 'gram stegs mchod pa'i snam bu dmar po la bud med sgyu ma'i mdzes sdug gis sgeg pa'i gzungs ma rnams kyis mchod rdzas du ma thogs nas dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs rnams la mchod pa/ zur bzhir zla phyed nor bu dang / sgo 'byud kyi mtshams su zla phyed rdo rjes brgyan pa/ sgo bzhi'i mdun du rgyan dang bcas pa'i ka bas btegs pa'i rta babs mchod rten gyi rnam pa can rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/ rta babs kyi rtse mor pad+ma la gnas pa'i chos 'khor/ steng du gdugs dkar po/ g.yas g.yon du ri dwags pho mo dang bcas pa/ gzhan yang rgyan sna tshogs kyis spras pa'i gzhal yas khang glang rgyab kyi nang de bzhin gshegs pa lngas mdzes pa/ sgo bzhi'i phyi rol du rin po che'i them skas dang / de'i pha rol du babs zhon gyi rta babs dang bcas pa'o/ /de'i phyi rol du dur khrod chen po brgyad ni/ shar du gtum drag lhor 'jigs byed thod pa can/ nub tu 'ur 'ur 'bar ba/ byang du tshang tshing 'khrigs pa/ shar lhor dbang phyug nags tshal/ lho nub tu mun pa mi zad pa/ nub byang du ca co sgrog pa/ byang shar du ha ha rgod pa'o/ khreng chen po brgyad ni/ ha ra tsu ta a sho ka a shwad tha dang ka ra lja dza la ti dang par ti pa/ bhe ta dang ni bha ṭa'o/ /rtsa bar phyogs skyong brgyad gnas pa/ /—73—

tshoshar du brgya byin lhor gshin rje/ /chu lha nub dang gnod spyin byang / /byang shar 'byung po shar sto me/ /lho nub srin po nub byang rlung / /mkha' la lha chen brgyad gnas pa/ khar du dbang po lhor tshangs pa/ /khyab 'jug nub dang dbang phyug byang / /byang shar la sogs mtshams bzhi sa /gdong drug tshogs kyi bdag po dang / /sgro gi ri ti legs ldan nag/chu la klu chen brgyad gnas pa/ /'jog po dung skyong rigs ldan dang / /mtha' yas pad chen dga' bo dang / /nor rgyas bu dang pad+ma 'o/ /shang bi yo la ga la gnas pa'i zhing skyong rnams phyogs skyong so so'i mdog dang rma chungs shing so so'i bzhon pa'i gdong pa can gri gug dang thod pa gtor mas gang ba ri rin pa'o/ /sprin chen po brgyad ni/ sgrog byed ser po/ ldog byed sngon po/ 'jigs byed dkar po/ 'khor byed ser po/ 'thug po dkar po/'gengs byed dmar po/ char 'bebs nag po/ gtum po ljang khu'o/ /gzhan yang ri brgyad/ mchod rten brgyad/ chu brgyad/ drag tu 'bar ba'i me brgyad dang bcas pa/ gzhan yang ro dang ro langs dang sha za dang 'byung po dang srin po dang /bya dang gcan gzan dang / dpa' bo dang / rnal 'byor ma grub pa thob pa dang /grub pa'i rdzas dang mchod rdzas thams cad kyis gang ba dngos grub 'byung ba'i dur khrod/ de rnams kyis yongs su bskor ba'i gzhal yas khang gi lha snam shar dkar/ lho ser/ nub dmar/ byang ljang / dbus sngo ba'i lte bar sna tshogs pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa/ phyogs bzhi dmar ba me dang rlud ser ba/ bden bral ljang pa/ dbang ldan sngo ba/ mtha' ma rdo rje nag po'i mu khyud kyis bskor ba/ lte bar nyi ma'i gdan la bdud bzhi'i ngo bo tshangs pa ser po/ dbang po kham ser/ nye —74—

dbang ljang khu/ drag po thal dkar rnams kan rkyal du bkram pa/ 'dab ma brgyad la/ shar du tshangs pa/ sto ru brgya byin/ nub tu nye dbang / byang du drag po/byang shar du skyon rje sngon po/ shar lhor gnod spyin ser po/ lho nub tu srin po smug na gnub byang du lha min thags bzang ris ljang khu rnams kan rkyal du gnas pa'i snying gar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor re re/ sgo bzhir nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor la yi dwags kyi gdan re re'o/ /dbus su rang sems hu dang a nag po/ de'i 'og tu mtshan bzang po sum cu rtsa gnyis kyi ngo bo/ a ā/ i yī/ u mū/ ṛ grwa/ '-i lī/e i/ o au/ a a phrag gnyis zhu ba las byung ba'i zla ba'i dkyil 'khor me long lta bu'i ye shes/ de'i steng du dpe byad bzang po brgyad cu'i ngo bo/ ka /spa ga gha nga / tsa tsha dza dzha nya/ ṭa ṭha ḍa khyu ṇa/ ta tha da dha na/ pa pha ba bha ma/ ya ra la wa/sha ṣa sa ha k+ṣa/ ḍa khyu da dha la ya/ phrag gnyis zhu ba las byung ba'i nyi ma'i nga/kyil 'khor mnyam pa nyid kyi ye shes/ de gnyis kyi bar du yi ge gnyis zhugs te/ hū las rdo rje hū gis mtshan pa dang a las gri gug a gis mtshan par gyur pa ni so sor kun tu rtog pa'i ye shes/ de las 'od 'phros sems can gyi don byas/tshur 'dus thams cad gcig tu 'dres pa bya ba nan tan gyi ye shes de las sku yongs su rdzogs pa chos kyi dbyings kyi ye shes kyi ngo bo bcom ldan 'das dgyes mdzad rgyu rdo rje 'dzin pa sku mdog mthing nag zhal brgyad pa/ spyan nyi shu rtsa bzhi phye ba/ phyag bcu drug pa/ 6khas bzhi pa/ zhal nas hū spro ba/ lha dang lha min thams cad sdigs par mdzad pa/ 'jigs pa'ang 'jigs pa/ drag po chen po rtsa ba'i zhal nag po/ g.yas dkar ba g.yon dmar ba steng zhal du ba'i —75

mdog can/ lhag ma zhal bzhin nag la/ dbu skra ser po 'bar zhing 'khyil ba/spyi bor sna tshogs rdo rjes mtshan pa/ thod skam lnga lnga'i dbu rgyan can smin ma yon po dang bcas shing / khro gnyer dang ldan pa/ mche ba gtsigs pa/ brgyu ltar dmar ba'i spyan gsum gsum dang ldan pa/ phyag bcu drug gi dang po gnyis kyis rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pas yum la 'byud cing / g.yas kyi gnyis pa na ral gri/gsum pa na mda' dang / bzhi pa na 'khor lo/ lnga pa na bgor/ drug pa na dbyug pa/ bdun pa na rtse gsum/ brgyad pa na lcags kyu/ g.yon gyi gnyis pa na pad+ma/ gsum pa na gzhu/ bzhi pa na kha ṭāX ga /lnga pa na thod pa/ drug pa na rin po che/ bdun pa na sdigs mdzub/ brgyad pa na zhags pa bsnams pa/ sku la dras pa'i phyag rgya drug dang ldan pa/ khrag 'dzag mi mgo lnga bcu'i do shal can/ gcer bu zhabs mdun ma gnyis g.yas brkyang gi stabs dang / rgyab ma gnyis skyil krung phyed pa'i stabs kyis tshangs pa dang / dbang po dang / drag po dang / nye dbang rnams mnyam par mnan pa/ sgeg pa dpa' ba mi sdug pa/ /rgod dang drag shul 'jigs su rung / /snying rje rngam dang zhi ba ste/ /gar dgu'i ro dang ldan pa nyid/ /de la 'byud pa'i bdag med ma nag mo drag mo chen mo lha mo'i cha byad rdzogs pa/ phyag bzhi'i dang po gnyis gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pa/ 'og ma gnyis kyis mda' dang gzhu bsnams pa/ gcer bu phyag rgya lnga dang mgo bo skam po lnga'i phreng ba can/ g.yon brkyang gi stabs kyis rjes su chags pa/ lhag ma bcom ldan 'das dang mtshungs pa/ gnyis ka'ang me dpung 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs shing / nam mkha'i mtha' klas pa 'od kyi khyab par mdzad pa 'bar ba'i —76—

phreng ba 'khrugs pa'o/ /yab kyi gsang gnas mi dmigs pa'i ngang las huX las rdo rje sngon po rtse lnga pa la lte ba la huX gis ma/tshan pa/ oṃ badz+ra mahā dī ṣa ca tun ā nan+ta dā ya ka kha kha mu kha a ka ra so nā tha huX hūX huX kwarlaX ku ru ṣa me/ yum gyi mkha' a las pad+ma dmar po 'dab ma brgyad pa lte bar aX gis mtshan pa/ oX pad+ma su kha dha ra mahā rā ga su khaX dang tsa tun ā nan+ta bhā ga bi shwa huX hūX huX kaṅkaX ku ru ṣa me/yab yum snyoms par zhugs pa'i dga' ba'i sgras phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas sras dang bcas pa spyan drangs yab kyi zhal nas zhugs nas thugs kar rjes su chags pa'i mes zhu/ rdo rje'i lam nas yum gyi pad+ma ra babs pa'i thig le cha bcu gnyis su gyur/ mkha' nang nas phyir spros te so so'i gdan la 'khod pa nyi zla ༈ba sbyor bcu gnyis su gyur/ de rnams kyi bar du gaX rtsa baX ghaX paX shaX laX ḍaX dzaXhuX baX hoXrnams su gyur/ de rnams yongs su gyur pa las gri gug dang cang te'u ral gri dang thod pa rin po che dang rdo rje rlung ras dang thod pa lcags kyu dang zhags pa lcags sgrog dang dril bu rnams sa bon de rnams kyis mtshan pa/ zla nyi so so dang gcig tu 'dres pa yongs su gyur pa las/ shar du go ri nag mo g.yas gnyis gri gug dang mda'/ g.yon gnyis kyi thod pa dang gzhu 'dzin pa/ lhor tso rī dmar mo g.yas gnyis ḍā ma ru dang 'khor lo/ g.yon gnyis thod pa dang lcags kyu 'dzin pa/ nub tu be+e tā li ser mo g.yas gnyis ral gri dang chang bum/g.yon gnyis su dung chos dang thod pa 'dzin pa/ byang du spyi sma rī ljang khu g.yas gnyis thod zhags dang skyabs sbyin/ g.yon gnyis dgra sta dang me thab 'dzin pa/byang shar du puska sī sngon mo g.yas gnyis rdo rje dang mchog sbyin/ g.yon gnyis —77—

mes po ri shul ba chag las/ tā ra nā tha'i gsung 'bum/dpag bsam shing gi lcug ma dang thod pa 'dzin pa/ shar lhor shā bā ri dkar mo g.yas gnyis rdo rje dang kha ṭāX ga /g.yon gnyis thod pa dang zhags pa 'dzin pa/sto nub tu tsaṇ+ḍa li sngon mo g.yas gnyis rlung ras dang thod pa/ g.yon gnyis ba dan dang pad+ma 'dzin pa/ nub byang du zloX bi nī sna tshogs mdog g.yas gnyis thod pa da/nga bshor/ g.yon gnyis mdung rtse gsum dang sa'i dkyil 'khor 'dzin pa/shar sgor rta gdong ma nag mo zhal bzhi nag ser dmar ba'i steng na rta gdong ljang khu rtsa phyag gnyis kyis gling bu/ tha ma gnyis kyis rdo rje dang lcags kyu 'dzin pa/ lho sgor phag gdong ma ser po zhal bzhi ser sngo dkar ba'i steng na phag gdong dmar mo rtsa phyag sa/nyis kyis pi waX/ tha ma gnyis kyis rin po che dang zhags pa 'dzin pa/ nub sgor khyi gdong ma dmar mo zhal bzhi dmar sngo dkar ba'i steng na khyi gdong ser mo rtsa phyag gnyis kyis rnga bo che/ tha ma gnyis kyis pad+ma dang lcags sgrog 'dzin pa/ byang sgor seng gdong ma ljang khu zhal bzhi/ ljang nag dmar ba'i steng na seng gdong dkar mo rtsa phyas gnyis kyis rdza rnga/ tha ma gnyis kyi ral gri dang dril bu 'dzin pa/ lha mo thams cad kyang spyan gsum gsum dang ldan zhing / dbu skra dmar ser gyen tu brdzes pa/ thod skam lnga lngas dbu brgyan cing / skam po lnga bcu'i phreng ba dang / rus pa'i phyag rgya lngas brgyan pa/ g.yon brkyang pa'i stabs kyis ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa/ sgo ma rnams ni sbom thung cher khros shing stag gi lpags pa'i sham thabs can no/ /de nas/ gtso bo'i dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āX thugs kar hūX/ gtsug rkeng dang lte bar hoXdamar po res mtshan par gyur/ yab yum snyoms par zhugs rjes su —78—

chags nga/'i mes 'od du zhu nas bdud bzhi'i steng du/ bde ba chen po'i ngo bo rdo rje sems dpa'i rang bzhin thig le gnyis su gyur/ de nas tshad med pa bzhi'i ngo bor gyur pa'i lha mo bzhi'i snyan pa'i dbyangs kyis 'gro ba'i don la bskul ba ni/ puska sris/ rje btsun snying rje'i yid bzhengs shig /puska swe nī bdag la skyobs/ /stong pa'i rang bzhin nyid spongs la/ /bdag la bde chen sbyor bzhed mdzod/ ta bā ris/ khyod med na ni bdag 'gum pas/ /dgyes mdzad rdo rje khyod bzhengs shig /stong pa'i rang bzhin nyid spongs la/ /ri khrod ma 'bras grub par mdzod/ /tsaṇ+ḍa lis/ dga' gtso 'jig rten don gnyer ba/ /stong pa nyid la bzhugs sam ci/ /khyod med phyogs ni mi 'tshal bas/ /gdol pa mo bdag zhu ba bgyid/ to bi nis/ bdag gis nyid kyi thugs 'tshal gyi/ /mig 'phrul mnga' ba khyod bzhengs shig /g.yung mo bdag nyid dran nyams pas/ /snying rje rgyun chad ma mdzad cig ces bskul bas/ thig le gnyis po gcig tu 'dres te nyi zla kha sbyor gyi dbus su hu dang a las rdo rje dang gri gug hū ཾ dang a bis mtshan pa/ de yo/ngas su gyur pa las 'bras bu rdo rje 'dzin pa dgyes mdzad rdo rje sku mdog mthing nag sogs rgyu rdo rje 'dzin pa yum bcas ltar gsal bto po/ /de ltar bdag nyid dgyes mdzad du gyur pa'i sku la rtsa gsum 'khor lo bzhi yongs su rdzogs pa/ snying ga chos kyi 'khor lo sngon po rtsibs brgyad pa'i steng du dgyes mdzad rdo rje'i thugs kyi snang cha gzhal yas khang mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa/ pad+ma 'dab brgyad dang bcas pa'i lte ba la nyi ma'i steng du bdud bzhi'i gdan/ 'dab ma rnams la shar du tshangs pa/ ltor dbang po/ nub tu nye dbang /—79—

byang du drag po/ byang shar du gshin rje/ shar lhor nor bdag /lho nub tu srin po/nub byang du thags bzang ris/ dbus kyi gdan gyi steng du bcom ldan 'das dgyes mdzad rdo rje sku mdog mthing na gzhal brgyad pa nas/ phyag bcu drug gis thod pa bcu drug bzung ba'i g.yas pa brgyad na/ glang po che/ rta/ bong bu/ glang /rnga mo/ mi/ sha ra bha/ byi la rnams so/ /g.yon pa brgyad na/ sa'i lha mo/ chu lha/me lha/ rlud lha/ zla ba/ nyi ma/ gshin rje/ gnod spyin rnams so/ /sku la phyag rgya drug dang ldan pa sgronas/ nye dbang rnams mnyam par mnan pa/ gar dgu'i nyams kyis rol pa/ de la 'byud pa'i bdag med ma nag mo drag mo chen mo lha mo'i cha byad rdzogs pa/ phyag gnyis gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pa/ gcer bu phyag rgya lnga dang / mgo bo skam po'i phreng ba can/ g.yon brkyang gi stabs kyis rjes su chags pa/ lhag ma bcom ldan 'das dang mtshungs shing / gnyis ka'ang me dpung 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'o/ shar du go ri nag mo g.yas gri gug g.yon nya ro hi ta 'dzin pa/ lhor chom rkun ma dmar mo g.yas shā ma ru g.yon phag pa 'dzin pa/ nub tu ro langs ma ser mo g.yas ru sbal g.yon thod pa 'dzin pa/byang du nus ma ljang khu g.yas sprul g.yon thod pa 'dzin pa/ byang shar du sbos mo sngon po g.yas seng ge g.yon dgra sta 'dzin pa/ shar lhor ri khrod ma dkar mo g.yas dge slong g.yon sil byed 'dzin pa/ lho nub tu gdol ba mo sngon mo g.yas 'khor lo g.yon thod pa 'dzin pa/ nub byang du g.yung mo kha dog sna tshogs pa g.yas rdo rje g.yon sdigs mdzub mdzad pa/ thams cad kyang dbu skra ser po gyen tu brdzes pa/ spyan dmar po gsum dang ldan pa/ gcer bu phyag rgya —80—

lnga ldan g.yon brkyang ba'i skyil krung phyed pa'i gar gyis me dpung 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'o/ /spyi bor bde ba chen po'i 'khor lo dkar po 'dab ma so gnyis pa'i steng du dgyes mdzad kyi sku'i snang cha gzhal yas khang mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa/ dbus la che dgu pa snam bu rim pa gnyis dang bcas pa/ dbus dang khro bcu'i gnas su nyi gdan dkar po/ shar phyogs pa rnams la zla ba/ mā ma gī la rdo rje/ gzhan lho phyogs pa rnams la rin po che/nub phyogs pa rnams la pad+ma dmar po/ byang phyogs pa rnams la sna tshogs rdo rje'i gdan/ dbus su mi bskyod pa sngon po sngo dkar dmar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi g.yas pa rnams kyis rdo rje 'khor lo pad+ma/ g.yon pa rnams kyi dril bu rin chen ral gri 'dzin pa/ rdo rje skyil krung gis bzhugs pa/ dar dang rin po ches brgyan pa/ phyag dang po gnyis 'phyud rgyas yum reg bya rdo rje ma rang dang 'dra ba pad+ma'i skyil krung gis bzhugs pa dang mnyam par spyor ba/ re mig rnams la shar du rnam snang dkar po dkar nag dmar ba'i zhal gsum/ phyag drug gi g.yas pa rnams kyis 'khor lo rdo rje pad dkar/ g.yon pa rnams kyis dril bu nor bu ral spi 'dzin pa/ lhor rin 'byung ser po ser nag dkar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi g.yas pa rnams kyis nor bu rdo rje 'khor lo/ g.yon pa rnams kyis dril bu pad ser ral gri 'dzin pa/ nub tu 'od dpag med dmar po dmar nag dkar ba'i zhal gsum/ phyag drug gi g.yon gyi dang po dril bu dkur bsten pas pad+ma dmar po'i sdong bu 'dzin pa g.yas kyi dang pos kha 'byed pa/lhag ma g.yas gnyis kyis rdo rje dang 'khor lo/ g.yon gnyis kyis rin po che —81—

dang ral gri 'dzin pa/ byang du don grub ljang khu ljang nag dkar ba'i zhal gsum/ phyag drug gi g.yas pa rnams kyis ral gri sna tshogs rdo rje 'khor lo/g.yon pa rnams kyis dril bu pad ljang nor bu 'dzin pa/ shar lhor spyan ma dkar mo dkar nag dmar ba'i zhal gsum/ phyag drug gi g.yas pa rnams kyis 'khor lo rdo rje ut+pal dkar po/ g.yon pa rnams kyis dril bu rin chen ral gri 'dzin pa/ lho nub tu mā ma gī sngon mo sngo dkar dmar ba'i zhal gsum/ phyag drug gis g.yas pa rnams kyis rdo rje 'khor lo ut+pal sngo dmar/ g.yon pa rnams kyis dril bu rin chen ral gri 'dzin pa/ nub byang du gos dkar mo dmar mo dmar nag dkar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi g.yon gyi dang po dril bu dkur bsten pas ut+pal dmar po'i sdong bu 'dzin pa g.yas kyi dang pos kha 'byed pa/ lhag ma g.yas gnyis kyis rdo rje dang 'khor lo/ g.yon gnyis kyis rin po che dang ral gri 'dzin pa/ byang shar du sgrol ma ljang khu ljang nag dkar ba'i zhal gsum/ phyag drug gi g.yas pa rnams kyis sna tshogs rdo rje ut+pal sngon po rdo rje mtshan pa/ g.yon pa rnams kyis dril bu rin chen ral gri 'dzin pa/rim pa gnyis pa'i shar lhor gzugs rdo rje ma dkar mo sangs rgyas spyan ma dang 'dra ba las/ phyag dang po gnyis kyis me long dmar po 'dzin pa/ lho nub tu sgra rdo rje ma sngon mo mā ma gī dang 'dra ba las/ phyag dang po gnyis kyis pi wa sngon po 'dzin pa/ nub byang du dri rdo rje ma dmar mo 'od dpag med dang 'dra ba las/phyag dang po gnyis kyis dri'i dung chos 'dzin pa/ byang shar du ro rdo rje ma ljang khu sgrol ma dang 'dra ba las/ phyag dang po gnyis kyis ro drug gi gang ba'i snod —82—

'dzin pa/ rim pa gsum pa'i lha snam la/ shar sgo'i g.yas su byams pa rnam snang dang 'dra ba las/ g.yas kyi dang pos klu shing gi yal ga me tog dang bcas pa 'khor los mtshan pa 'dzin pa/ shar sgo'i g.yon du sa'i snying po rnam snang dang 'dra ba/ lho sgo'i g.yas su phyag na rdo rje dang g.yon du nam mkha'i snying po gnyis ka'ang rin chen 'byung ldan lta bu/ nub sgo'i g.yas su 'jig rten dbang phyug dang / g.yon du 'jam dpal 'od dpag med dang 'dra ba/ byang sgo'i g.yas su sgrib pa rnam sel dang / g.yon du kun tu bzang po don grub lta bu/ lha yab rnams thams cad ral pa'i thor tshugs dang mtshan dang dpe byad rdzogs pa/yum rnams dbu skra phyed bcings su byas pa/ sgeg cing 'dzum bag dang ldan pa/zur gyi lta ba la sogs pa'i rnam 'gyur gyis mdzes pa/ 'dod pa'i yon tan lnga'i dga' bas rol pa/ de bzhin gshegs pa rnams rdo rje'i skyil krung dang /gzhan rnams sems dpa'i skyil krung gis bzhugs pa/ thams cad dar gyi na bza' dang rin po ches brgyan pa'o/ khar sgor gshin rje mthar byed nag po nag dkar dmar ba'i zhal gsum/ phyag drug gi g.yas pa rnams kyis tho ba 'khor lo rdo rje/ g.yon thugs kar zhags pa dang bcas pa'i sdigs mdzub dril bu dgra sta 'dzin pa/ sto sgor shes rab mthar byed dkar po dkar nag dmar ba'i zhal gsum/ phyag drug gi g.yas pa rnams kyis rdo rje dbyug pa ral gri/g.yon thugs kar zhags pa dang bcas pa'i sdigs mdzub dril bu dgra sta 'dzin pa/ nub sgor rta mgrin dmar po dmar nag dkar ba'i zhal gsum/ phyag drug gi g.yas pa rnams kyi pad+ma ral gri gtun shing / g.yon snyems pa dang bcas —83—

pas dril bu dgra sta zhags pa 'dzin pa/ byang sgor bgegs mthar byed ljang khu ljang nag dkar ba'i zhal gsum/ phyag drug gi g.yas pa rnams kyis sna tshogs rdo rje 'khor lo gtun shing / g.yon thugs kar zhags pa dang bcas pas sdigs mdzub dril bu dgra sta 'dzin pa/ shar lho'i grwar mi g.yo ba nag po nag dkar dmar ba'i zhal gsum/ phyag drug gi g.yas pa rnams kyis ral gri rdo rje 'khor lo/ g.yon sdigs mdzub dgra sta zhugs pa/ lho nub kyi grwar 'dod rgyal sngon po rin 'byung gi dbu rgyan can sngo dkar dmar ba'i zhal gsum/ phyag drug gi dang po gnyis kyi hū mjad kyi phyag rgya can/ lhag ma g.yas rdo rje dang ral gri/ g.yon zhags pa dang lcags kyu/ nub byang gi grwar dbyug sngon can sngon po 'od dpag med kyi dbu rgyan can/ sngo dkar dmar ba'i zhal gsum/ phyag drug gi g.yas pa rnams kyis rdo rjes mtshan pa'i dbyug pa sngon po ral gri 'khor lo/ g.yon thugs kar zhags pa dang bcas pa'i sdigs mdzub pad+ma dgra sta/ byang shar gyi grwar stobs po che sngon po don grub kyi dbu rgyan can/ nag dkar dmar ba'i zhal gsum/ phyag drug gi g.yas pa rnams kyis rdo rjes mtshan pa'i dbyug pa nag po ral gri 'khor lo/ g.yon thugs kar sdigs mdzub dang bcas pa zhags pa rtse gsum dgra sta/ steng gi ya phugs kyi nang du gtsug tor 'khor los sgyur ba sngon po mi bskyod pa'i dbu rgyan can/ sngo dkar dmar pa'i zhal gsum/ phyag drug gi dang po gnyis gtsug tor gyi phyag rgya/ lhag ma g.yas rdo rje pad+ma/ g.yon sdigs mdzub dang ral gri/ 'og tu sa gzhi'i nang du gnod mdzes nag po mi bskyod pa'i dbu rgyan can/ nag dkar dmar ba'i zhal gsum/ phyag drug gi g.yas pa —84—
