rnams kyis rdo rje'i 'khor lo rin chen/ sa yon thugs kar zhags pa dang bcas pa'i sdigs mdzub pad+ma ral gri/ khro bo thams cad kyang stobs chen pha rol gnon pa spyan gsum gsum dang ldan zhing mche ba gtsigs pa/ stag gi lpags pa'i sham thabs can klu chen po brgyad kyis brgyan pa/ g.yon brkyang gi stabs kyis pad nyi la bzhugs pa/ dus mtha'i me lta bu'i me stag 'bar ba dang bcas pas gdug pa can tshar gcod pa'o/ /mgrin pa longs spyod kyi 'khor lo dmar po 'dab ma bcu drug pa'i steng du/ dgyes mdzad rdo rje gsung gi snang cha gzhal yas khang mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa/ dbus su pad+ma dam ra po 'dab ma brgyad pa la sgyu 'phrul chen mo lha lngar gyur pa ni/ dbus kyi gdan gyi steng du dpal he ru ka sngon po sngo ser dmar ljang ba'i zhal phyag dang po gnyis thod pa dang kha ṭāX ka bsnams pas/ rang dang 'dra ba'i yum sangs rgyas mkha' 'gro ma dmar mo dmar ser dkar ljang ba'i zhal can la 'byud pa/ 'og ma gnyis kyis mda' gzhu/ khro chags sgegs la 'jigs pa'ang 'jigs par mdzad pa/ spyan gsum gsum dmar zhing g.yo ba/ skra ser gyen brdzes thod skam lnga'i dbu rgyan dang / rlon pa lnga bcu'i do shal/ phyag rgya lnga dang gar dgu'i rol pa/ thal chen gyis byugs shing mi lpags kyi stod g.yogs can g.yon brkyang ba'i gar stabs kyis/ nyi ma'i steng du mi ro'i snying gar mnan pa me dpung gi dbus na bzhugs pa'o/ shar du mkha' 'gro ma sngon mo sngo ser dkar ljang ba'i zhal/ phyag bzhis rdo rje dril bu kha ṭāX ga thod pa bsnams pa/ lhor rin chen mkha' 'gro ma ser mo ser sngo dkar ljang ba'i zhal/ phyag bzhis rin chen ce —85—

spyang ba dan mdung rtse gsum pa bsnams pa/ nub tu pad+ma mkha' 'gro ma dkar dmar dkar ser ljang ba'i zhal/ phyag bzhis pad+ma thod pa gzhu dang mda' bsnams pa/ byang du sna tshogs mkha' 'gro ma ljang khu ljang ser dkar sngo ba'i zhal/ phyag bzhis ral gri zhags pa ka pā la ḍā ma ru bsnams pa/ lha mo lnga ni thal ba dang bral ba/ lhag ma gtso mo dang mtshungs pa/ mtshams kyi 'dab ma bzhi la bdud rtsis gang ba'i bum pa bzhi'o/ /lte bar sprul pa'i 'khor lo ser po rtsa 'dab drug cu rtsa bzhi'i steng du/ dgyes mdzad rdo rje'i yon to gyi snang cha gzhan pa yas khang mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa/ nang gi lha snam shar dkar/ byang ljang / nub dmar/ lho se ra/ dbus sngo ba'i steng du/ sku'i 'khor lo dkar po 'khor los mu 'khyud can/ de'i lte bar gsung gi 'khor lo dmar po pad+ma'i mu khyud can/ de'i lte bar thugs kyi 'khor lo sngon po rdo rje'i mu khyud can/ gsum ka'ang rtsibs brgyad dang ldan pa/ dbus su bde chen 'khor lo pad+ma 'dab brgyad mu 'khyud la gri gug gi phreng ba can/ sgo mtshams brgyad du ro'i gdan sna tshogs pad+ma'i lte bar nyi ma la 'jigs byed dang dus mtshan ma'i gdan/ dbus kyi gdan gyi steng du 'khor lo bde mchog sku mdog mthing nag zhal bzhi phyag bcu gnyis pa/ rtsa ba'i zhal mthing ga /g.yon ljang / rgyab dmar/g.yas ser ba/ zhal re re la dmar zhing g.yo ba'i spyan gsum gsum dang ldan zhing / mche ba gtsigs pa/ phyag dang po gnyis kyis rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pas yum la 'byud pa/ de'i 'og ma gnyis kyis glang po che'i lpags rlon stod g.yogs su gyon pa/ lhag ma g.yas rnams kyis ḍā ma ru dgra sta rtse gsum/ gri —86—

gug g.yon pa rnams kyis kha ṭā ga thod pa zhags pa tshangs pa'i mgo bo bsnams pa/ zhabs g.yas brkyang bas dus mtshan ma dmar mo dang / g.yon bskum pas 'jigs byed nag po mnan pa/ ral pa'i thor tshugs la sna tshogs rdo rje dang / zla ba phyed pa dang / thod skam lnga lngas dbu rgyan can/ mi mgo rlon pa lnga bcu'i do shal can/ stag lpags kyi sham thabs grol zhing phyag rgya drug gis brgyan pa gar gyi nyams dgu dang ldan pa/ yum rdo rje phag mo dmar mo phyag g.yas rdo rje gri gug dang bcas pa'i sdigs mdzub/ g.yon khrag chen gyis gang ba'i thod pa yab la stob pa'i tshul gyis 'byud pa/ spyan gsum drag mo bskal pa'i me ltar gzi brjid 'bar ba gcer bu skra grol zhing phyag rgya lnga dang mgo phreng gis brgyan pa/ byin pa gnyis kyis yab la 'khyud pa/ khrag la dgyes zhing zla mtshan dang bcas pa me dpung 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa/ 'dab ma rnams la shar du mkha' 'gro ma nag mo/ byang du lā ma ljang gu/ nub tu dum skyes ma dmar mo/ lhor gzugs can ma ser mo/ dam tshig gi 'khor lo'i shar sgor khwa gdong ma sngon mo/ byang sgor 'ug gdong ma ljang khu/ nub sgor khyi gdong ma dmar mo/ lho sgor phag gdong ma ser mo/ shar lhor gshin rje brtan ma g.yas sngo g.yon ser ba/ lho nub tu gshin rje pho nya mo g.yas ser g.yon dmar ba/ nub byang du skyon rje mche ba ma g.yas dmar g.yon ljang ba/ byang shar du gshin rje 'joms ma g.yas ljang g.yon sngo ba/ thams cad kyang phyag bzhi'i dang po gnyis sgi~X sa brkyang gi pyi sa/ ṭā ba ga pho ste sa zhugs pa ste /ḍā sgo ma ༵༵ sa / ba rgyad ni ro'i / —87—

gdan dang bcas pa/ bde chen 'khor lo'i mtshams kyi 'dab ma la bum pa bdud rtsi lngas gang ba'i steng du thod pa bdud rtsi lngas gang ba'o/ /thugs kyi 'khor lo'i shar phyogs pu zhi ra ma la yar khaṇ+ḍa ka pā la dang rab tu gtum mo/byang phyogs dzā lan+ta rar mahā ka ka la dang gtum pa'i mig can ma/ nub phyogs o ṭi ya nar ka ka la dang 'od ldan ma/ lho phyogs arbu tar mche ba rnam par gtsigs pa dang sna chen ma/ shar lhor go da wa ri su ra be+e ri dang brtan pa'i blo can ma/ lho nub ri smi shwa rar 'od dpag med dang mi'u thung ma/ nub byang de bī ko ṭar rdo rje'i 'od dang ling ga'i dbang phyug ma/ byang shar ma la bā ra rdo rje sku dang shing grib ma ste thugs kyi gsang ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i ngo bo kha dog nag po'o/ /gsung gi 'khor lo'i shar phyogs kā ma ru par a ku ri dang e ra bā ti/byang phyogs o drer rdo rje ral pa can dang 'jigs byed chen mo/ nub phyogs tri sha ku ner dpa' bo chen po dang rlung gi shugs can ma/ lho phyogs ko sa lar rdo rje hu mdzad dang chang 'thung ma/ shar lhor ka ling kar rab tu bzang po dang bye ma de bī/ lho nub lam pā kar rdo rje bzang po dang shin tu bzang mo/ nub byang ka zhin 'jigs byed chen po dang rta rna ma/ byang shar hi ma lar mig mi bzang dang 'a gā na ste gsung gi gsang ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i ngo bo kha dog dmar po'o/ /sku'i 'khor lo'i shar phyogs pre ta pu rir stobs po che dang 'khor lo'i shugs can ma/ byang phyogs kṛ ha de war rin chen rdo rje dang khaṇ+ḍa ro hi/ nub phyogs so ra spyir rta mgrin dang wo nī/ lho phyogs su waṇ+ḍa dī par nam mkha'i snying po dang 'khor lo'i go cha ma/ shar lhor na ga rar dpal he ru ka dang shin tu dpa' mo/—88—

lho nub si rgyu ra pad+ma gar gyi dbang phyug dang stobs chen ma/ nub byang ma rur rnam par snang mdzad dang 'khor lo'i bsgyur ma/ byang shar ku lu tso rdo rje sems dpa' dang brtson 'grus chen mo ste/ sku'i gsang ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i ngo bo kha dog dkar po'o/ /dpa' bo nyi shu rtsa bzhi po rnams dpal he ru ka'i rigs las byung ba he ru ka dang rnam pa mtshungs pa ste/ zhal gcig phyag dang po gnyis rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pas rang rang gi yum la 'khrud pa/ 'og ma gnyis kyis ḍā ma ru dang kha ṭāX ga 'dzin pa/ rnal 'byor ma nyi shu rtsa bzhi ni rdo rje phag mo'i rigs las byung ba phag mo dang rnam pa mtshungs pa ste/ phyag g.yas gri gug dang g.yon thod pa bsnams pa'o/ /gsang gnas bde skyong gi 'khor lo ljang khu rtsa 'dab sum cu rtsa gnyis kyi steng du dgyes mdzad rdo rje'i phrin las kyi snang cha gzhal yas khang mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa/ dbus kyi lte ba la sna tshogs rdo rje/ steng thog re'u mig dgur phub pa dbus kyi gdan gyi steng du bcom ldan 'das dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed chen po sku mdog mthing nag zhal dgu phyag sum cu so bzhi/ zhabs bcu drug pa/ rtsa zhal nag po ma he'i gdong can shin tu khros pa/ phe ka ra'i sgra chen po 'brug ltar sgrog pa/ de'i steng na srin po'i zhal dmar po bzhad cing mche ba gtsigs pa/ de'i steng na 'jam dpal gyi zhal ser po 'dzum zhing cung zad khros pa/ gzhon nu'i rgyan can/ rwa'i g.yas phyogs kyi zhal dang po sngon po/ gnyis pa dmar po/ gsum pa ser po ste mnga' bdag gi zhal gsum shin tu khros pa/ nā'i g.yon phyogs kyi zhal dang po dkar po/ gnyis pa dud kha/ gsum pa nag po ste zhal gsum ka'ang gtsigs pa'o/ khro —89—

zhal rnams smin ma dang sma ra dbu skra dmar ser gyen du brdzes pa/ g.yas pa'i phyag bcu drug gis rim pa bzhin du/ gri gug 'phang mdung gshun shing chu gri rdo rje rtse gcig pa dgra stu mdung mda' lcags kyu dbyug pa kha ṭāX ga 'khor lo rdo rje rtse lnga pa rdo rje tho ba ral gri rnge'u chung bsnams pa/ g.yon pa'i phyag bcu drug gis rim pa bzhin du/ thod khrag tshangs pa'i mgo bo phub zlum rkang pa rdo rje'i zhags pa gzhu rgyu ma rdo rje dril bu lag pa ro ras skyes bu gsal shing la btsugs pa me thab thod tshal/ sdigs mdzub 'phan rtse gsum pa rlung ras bsnams pa/ phyag tha ma gnyis kyi sa glang po che'i lpags pa rlon pa khrag dang bcas pa 'dzin pa/ phyag dang bo gnyis phyag mtshan thugs kar steng 'og tu 'dzin cing 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i lha la sdigs mdzub mdzad pa'o/ /zhabs bcu drug gi g.yas brgyad bskum pas rim pa bzhin du mi dang ma he dang glang dang bong bu dang rnga mong dang khyi dang lug dang wa rnams mnan pa/ g.yon brgyad brkyang bas rim pa bzhin du bya rgod dang 'ug pa dang khra dang bya rog dang ne tso dang khyung dang ri skeg dang bzhad rnams mnan pa/ de rnams kyi 'og tu tshangs pa ser po/ dbang po dkar po/ nye dbang sngon po/ drag po nag po rnams bskyel zhing kha sbub tu mnan pa/ dbu re re la thod pa skam po lnga lngas dbu rgyan cing rlon pa khrag 'dzag pa lnga bcu'i do shal dang / rus pa'i rgyan drug dang sbrul gyis brgyan pa/ thal chen gyi tshom bu rak+ta'i thig le/ zhag gi zo ris rnams kyis mtshan pa/ gar dgu'i ro dang ldan pa de'i pang na yum rdo rje phag mo sku mdog dmar mo phyag g.yas rdo rje dang bcas pas sdigs mdzub bsgreng ba/ g.yon khrag chen gyis rdu/nga —90—

ba'i thod pa yan la stob pa'i tshul gyis 'khyud pa/ spyan gsum drag mo bskal pa'i me ltar gzi brdzid 'bar ba/ gcer bu skra ser 'khyil ba/ phyag rgya lnga dang brlan bral gyi mgo phreng gis cod pan dang / do shal du brgyan pa/ g.yas brkyang ba'i stabs kyis yab la 'khril pa/ khro mo'i cha lugs rdzogs pa'i 'od/ kyi nam mkha'i mtha' khyab pa'i ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na yab yum snyoms par zhugs pa'i tshul gyis gnas pa'o/ khar du gti mug gshin rje gshed dkar po dkar nag dmar ba'i zhal gsum/ phyag drug gi dang po gnyis kyis gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pas rang 'od kyi yum la 'khyud cing / lhag ma g.yas gnyis 'khor lo dang ral gri/ g.yon gnyis rin po che dang pad+ma 'dzin pa/ lhor ser sna gshin rje gshed ser po ser nag dkar pa'i zhal gsum/ phyag drug gi dang po gnyis kyis gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pas rang 'od kyi yum la 'khyud pa/ lhag ma g.yas gnyis rin po che dang ral gri/ g.yon gnyis 'khor lo dang pad+ma 'dzin pa/ nub tu 'dod chags gshin rje gshed dmar po dmar nag dkar ba'i zhal gsum/ phyag drug gi dang po gnyis kyis gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pas rang 'od kyi yum la 'khyud pa/ lhag ma g.yas gnyis pad+ma dang ral gri/ g.yon gnyis rin po che dang 'khor lo 'dzin pa/ byang du phrag dog gshin rje gshed ljang khu ljang nag dkar ba'i zhal gsum/ phyag drug gi dang po gnyis kyi gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pas rang 'od kyi yum la 'khyud pa/ lhag ma g.yas gnyis ral gri dang 'khor lo/ g.yon gnyis rin po che dang pad+ma 'dzin pa/ shar lhor tsar ci ka dkar mo gti mug gshin rje gshed lta bu/ lho nub tu phag mo ser mo dbu'i steng —91 —

du phag zhal gyen du lta ba dang bcas pa ser sna gshin rje gshed lta bu/ nub byang du dbyangs can ma dmar mo 'dod chags gshin rje gshed lta bu/ byang shar du go ri ljang khu phrag dog gshin rje gshed lta bu/ de ltar lha mo bzhi po rang snang gi thabs la 'khyud pa'o/ khar sgor tho ba gshin rje gshed nag po nag dkar dmar ba'i zhal gsum/ phyag drug gi dang po gnyis kyis gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pas rang 'od kyi yum la 'byud pa/ lhag ma g.yas gnyis tho ba dang ral gri/ g.yon gnyis 'khor lo dang pad+ma 'dzin pa/ lho sgor dgrag pa gshin rje gshed dkar po dkar nag dmar pa'i zhal gsum/ phyag drug gi dang po gnyis kyis gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pas rang 'od kyi yum la 'khyud pa/ lhag ma g.yas gnyis dbyug pa dang ral gri/ g.yon gnyis pad+ma dang 'khor lo 'dzin pa/nub sgor pad+ma gzhin rje gshed dmar po dmar nag dkar ba'i zhal gsum/phyag drug gi dang po gnyis kyis gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pas rang 'od kyi yum la 'khyud pa/ lhag ma g.yas gnyis pad+ma dang ral gri/ g.yon gnyis 'khor lo rin po che 'dzin pa/ byang sgor ral gri gshin rje gshed ljang khu ljang nag dkar ba'i zhal gsum/ phyag drug gi dang po gnyis kyis gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pas rang 'od kyi yum la 'khrud pa/ lhag ma g.yas gnyis ral gri dang 'khor lo/g.yon gnyis rin po che dang pad+ma 'dzin pa/ 'khor rnams thams cad rgyan dang cha lugs bcom ldan 'das dang mtshungs pa ste/ 'on kyang lha mo bzhi ni bud med sgyu ma'i nga rgyal gyis 'gying ba/ bcom ldan 'das ma dang mtshungs pa las g.yon brkyang gi stabs can no/ /phyi'i grwa bzhir ka pā la bdud rtsis gang ba bzhi dang —92—

bcas pa'o/ /rang dgyes mdzad rdo rje mtshon cha can gyi thugs kar pad nyid la hu lha mo bcu gsum gyi thugs kar pad zla la/ a ga rtsa ba gha pa sha la ḍa dza : ba ho rnams 'khor par gyur/ snying ga'i sa bon gyi 'od zer gyis dgyes mdzad mtshon cha can lha bcu gsum rgyud sde lnga'i dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs dang bcas pa oṃ badz+ra sa mā dza shar phyogs kyi dur khrod chen po'i thad kyi steng gi nam mkhar bzhugs/ tshogs zhing gi skabs ltar chu gnyis sngon du 'gro ba'i nyer spyod kyis yang dag par mchod/ phyi mchod mchod do/ /spro na 'og nas 'gyung ba ltar nang mchod byin gyis rlabs la 'bul/ bsdu na/ dgyes mdzad snying po lan gnyis dang / gtso bo gzhan bzhi'i snying po lan re brjod la/ mthar 'bru gsum btags pas nang mchod 'bul/ tso ( sarba ta thā ga ta a nu ra ga ṇa badz+ra snya bha wa ut+pa ko3ha/ zhes gsang ba'i mchod pa 'bul/ de thams cad kyang sgyu ma ltar rang bzhin med par shes par byas nas cung zad mnyam par bzhag /oṃ badz+ra go rī a karnya ya dza oṃ badz+ra tso rī pra be sha ya hu/ oṃ badz+ra be ta lī ban+ta ba/ oṃ badz+ra lha sma rī wā sha ku ru ho/ dza : ba holan lnga/ ye shes sems dpa' dang dam tshig sems dpa' ro gcig tu gyur/dgyes mdzad rdo rje'i lha thams cad kyi mig tu mo las gti mug rdo rje ma dkar mo/ rna bar de las zhe sdang rdo rje dmar mo/ sna la ma las ser sna rdo rje ma ser mo/kha la ra las 'dod chags rdo rje ma dmar mo dpral bar i las phrag dog rdo rje ma ljang khu/ lte bar no las bdag med rnal 'byor ma nag mo/ de rnams las 'od zer 'phros/ sems can thams cad kyi sdig sgrib sbyangs/ rdo rje ma drug gi go 'phang la bkod/ slar 'dus te skye mched kyi lha rnams la thim/ lha thams cad kyi dpral bar oṃ dkar po de las 'od zer 'phros/ sems can rnams kyi —93—

lus kyi sdig sgrib sbyangs/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyi sku'i byin rlabs bskul zhing bsdus te/ oṃ la thim pa las sku rdo rje ma dkar mo/ mgrin par āXdamar po de las 'od ze 'phros/ sems can rnams kyi ngag gi sdig sgrib sbyangs/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyi gsung gi byin rlabs bskul zhing bsdus te/ āXl thim pa las gsung rdo rje ma dmar mo/ thugs kar hūX sngon po de las 'od zer 'phros/sems can rnams kyi yid kyi sdig sgrib sbyangs/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyi thugs kyi byin rlabs bskul zhing bsdus te huX la thim pa las thugs rdo rje ma sngon mo/ lha mo de thams cad zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan gsum ma/ gri gug dang thod pa kha ṭāX ga bsnams pa/ rus pa dang mi mgo'i phreng bas brgyan pa'o/ /rang gi thugs ka nas 'od zer sna lnga pa 'phros/ dbang gi lha rgyal ba yab yum byang chub sems dpa' yab yum/ khro bo rig ma dang bcas pa oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaXgong bzhi mar pa gsum rgyas ma rdzo/ zhe sdang rdo rjer phyag 'tshal bstod/ /gti mug rdo rjer phyag 'tshal bstod/ /ser sna rdo rje bdag la gsol/ /'dod chags rdo rje bdag la skyobs/ /phrag dog rdo rje nga rgyal te/ /sgyu 'phrul rdo rje mgon po khyod/ /las rnams thams cad sgrub byed pa/ /thams cad rdo rje bdag mgur 'gyur/ /bcom ldan de bzhin gshegs pa kun/ /bcom ldan bdag nyid chen po rnams/ /thugs rjes bdag nyid can rnams kyis/ khyed kyis bdag la dbang bskur stsole/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga a bhi khri lto tu maX/ zhes gsol ba btang pas/sangs rgyas rnams kyis thugs ka nas phyung ba'i spyan ma dang / mā ma ki dang /gos dkar mo dang / sgrol ma rnams kyi byang chub kyi sems kyi gang ba'i bum pas —94—

dbang bskur/ khro bo rnams kyis bsrung ba'i las mdzad byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyis rdo rje'i glu blang / rdo rje ma rnams kyis mchod de/ dbang bskur rdo rje chen po ni/ khams gsum kun gyis phyag byas pa/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi gsang gsum gyi/ /gnas las byung ba spyin par bya/ /oX sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shrī ye huX/ zhes gsung zhing dkyil 'khor gyi lha thams cad la dbang bskur/ chu'i lhag ma spyi bor 'khyil ba las gtso bo yab yum dang / go ri dang /puska si la mi bskyod pa/ tso rī dang shā bā ri la rnam par snang mdzad/ be+e tā li dang tsan+da lī la rin chen 'byung ldan/ lha sma rī dang ḍi bi ni la 'od dpag med rnams kyis dbu rgyan/ sgo ma bzhi la don grub kyis dbu rgyan/de nas bdud rtsi byin gyis brlab pa ni/ tseX( āXbikūn+ta krita huX gis bsangs swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las yaX las rlung gi dkyil 'khor zla gam yaX dang ba dan gyis mtshan pa'i steng du/ raX las me'i dkyil 'khor gru gsum raX gyis mtshan pa/ de'i steng du kaX gsum las mi mgo'i skyed pu gsum gyi steng du a las thod par dkar po stong gsum gyi khyon tsam gyi nang du/ pad+ma 'dab brgyad kyi lte bar hūX las snabs dang mchil ma/ shar du bhuX las dri chen/ lhor aX las rak+ta/ nub tu dzi las byang chub kyi sems/ byang du khaX las dri chu/ dbus su na las ma'i sha /byang shar du go las ba glang gi sha khar lhor naX las glang po che'i sha /lho nub tu haX las rta'i sha /nub byang du ṣaX las ce sbyang gi sha rnams kyis gang ba/ steng du oṃ āXhuX thugs ka'i hūX las 'od 'phros sna bug nas thon/ rlud gi ba dan la phog /yaX las rlung g.yos/ raX las me sbar/ thod pa'i rdzas rnams —95—

bskol/ zhu zhing gyen du lud pa'i mi gtsang ba rnams phyir phyung / steng gi āXzla ba'i dkyil 'khor hūX rdo rjer gyur pa oṃ dang bcas te thod par lhung bas rdzas rnams lan bdun du dkrugs shing sbyangs/ yang rdo rje 'greng bur gnas pa'i lte bar khyu las byung ba'i zla ba la huX dang rtse mo la oṃ gyis mtshan pa/ de las 'od 'phros sangs rgyas thams cad kyi thugs ka nas ye shes kyi bdud rtsi dpag tu med pa spyan drangs/ dam tshig gi bdud rtsi dang 'dres/ oṃ āXhūX/ lan gsum dang /ha ho hiX kha dog dri ro nus pa phun sum tshogs par gyur/ lha thams cad kyi ljags hūX las byung ba'i rdo rje'i sbu gus bdud rtsi drangs shing gsol bas tshims zhing mnyes par gyur/ oX sarba ta thā ga ta a mṛ ta badz+ra swa bhā wa ut+pa ko3haX/ de nas yang sngar bzhin ar+ghaX la sogs pas mchod/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta pū dza badz+ra swa bhā wa ut+pa ko3haX/ lha mo'i 'khor gyis bcom ldan bskor/ rgyu dang mi rgyu khyod kyi thugs/ /sems can kun gyi don mdzad rnams/ /bcom ldan mchog tu dgyes rdo rje/ /zhal mdzes thugs kyi dgongs pa 'grub/ /thugs dgyes mdzod cing dgyes rdo rje/ /oX sarba ta tha ga ta stu ti ra badz+ra swabha wa ut+pa ko3haX/ hūX mi bskyod rdo rje ye shes che/ /rdo rje dbyings ni mkha' wo po/ /rdo rje gsum mchog dkyil 'khor gsum/ /rdo rje dbyings la phyag 'tshal lo/ /thams cad dngos po rang bzhin mchog /gdod nas thams cad rang bzhin gnas/ /thabs dang shes rab gnyis med pa'i/ /kyai rdo rjer bdag phyag 'tshal/ /mche ba gtsigs shing 'jigs pa che/ /sngags kyi me tog 'phreng bas brgyan/ kha chen rab tu gsol mdzad pa/ /he ru ka dpal bdag phyag 'tshal/ / bcom ldan mgon po dpa' —96—

bo'i dbang phyug ni/ /bskal pa'i me dpung lta bur rab tu 'bar/ /ral pa'i cod pan dbu yi rgyan du bcings/ /mche ba rab ga rtsigs drag shul 'jigs pa'i zhal/ sku la gzi brjid phyag stong ldan pa po/ / dgra stu zhags pa kha ṭāX mdung bsnams shing / /rab 'jigs stag gi pags pa sku la gsol/ /sku chen dud kha bgegs mthar mdzad la 'dud/ dus gsum rgyal ba thams cad kyi/ /bka' yi 'bor lo rab tu bskor/ /bdud dang mu stegs lha min bcom/ /skyon rje 'joms la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de nas bzlas pa'i dmigs pa gsal btab la sngags 'di rnams bzla bar bya ste/ oṃ ag na nā ya/ skra go rta ke sha wartu ne/ tsa sa tu rba sha ti ne t+yā ya/kho ṭa sha bhu dzā ya/ kriṣ+ṭha dzi mū ta wa pu ṣe/ (〈ram̐〉 rtse ka pā la ) mā la a ne kan+ta la ri ṇi/ adhe ta kru ra tsit+ta ya/ a lha skye daXsgyi ṇi/ lkoX mā rā ya mā rā ya/ ka rā ya ka rā ya/ ga rdza ya ga rdzu ya/ tardza ya ta rdzu ya/ sho khri ya sho khri ya/ sa sta sā ga rā na/ban dha ban dha nā ga a gi kā naX/ grihā gro hā/ sha truX/ ha hā/ hihi/ hu hū/ he hai/ho ho/ haX haXphaṭa swāhā/ rtsa ba'i sngags so/ /oṃ de ba pi tsu badz+ra huX huX hūX phaṭa swāhā/ oṃ badz+ra ka rta ri he badz+ra ya huX hūX hūX phaṭa swāhā/ oṃ aX swāhā/ de ni mtshon cha can gyi'o/ /oṃ āXbadz+ra dhika huX hūX phaṭa swāhā/ oṃ āX'ar+sha badz+ra huX/ oṃ āXdzi na dzika huX/ oṃ āX rat+na dhika huX/ oṃ āX.a ro snyika huX/ oṃ āXpradzñā dhika hūX/ oX āXmo ha rā ti hūX/ oṃ āX dī ṣa ra ti huX/ oṃ āXrā ga rā ti huX/ oṃ āXbadz+ra rā ti hūX/ oX āXrū pa badzā huX/oṃ āXtshan p+ta badz+ra hūX/ oṃ āXgan+ta badzā hūX/ oṃ āXrā sa badz+ra huX/ oṃ āXmo skyoX/ oṃ āXsh+lauhuX/ tseX( āXhuX huX/ tsho( āX.āX hūX/ skye( āXhri huX/ skye( āXglu( huX/ tso rna āXmaX huX/ glu( āXsaX huX/ tsho rna āXya mun+ta〈sku ta huX/ oṃ āXpratswan+ta krita hūX/ oṃ āX pad+man+ta krita hūX/ skye( —97—

āXdu krita hūX/ oṃ āX ār+ya a tsa la skyoX/ oṃ āXṭak+ki rā ba / huX/—oX āXni la daṇ+ḍa hūX/ oX āXmahā bā la huX/ oṃ āXtsakra nywa rta huX/ oX āXsu bha rā dza hūX/de ni gsang ba 'dus pa'i 'o/ /oX āXhri hūX phaṭa swāhā/ oX brnya ḍā ki nī āXhri hūX/ oX badz+ra ḍā ki nī āXhri huX/ oX rat+na ḍā ki nī āXhri hūX/ oṃ pad+ma ḍā ki nī āXhri huX/ oṃ bi shwa ḍā ki nī āXhri hūX/ de ni mahā ma ya'i 'o/ /oṃ de ba pi tsu badz+ra huX huX huX phaṭa swāhā/ oṃ āX.aX hūX swāhā/ tseX( āXgaX huX swāhā/ tsho ( āXtsaX huX swāhā/ skye( āXbaX hūX swāhā/ tsho( āXghaX huX swāhā/tseX( āXbaX huX swāhā/ tseX( āXtshanaX huX swāhā/ tseX( āXlaX hūX swāhā/ tseXr+sha āXḍaX huX swāhā/ de ni mtsho skyes lha dgu'i yin no/ /oX shrī badz+ra he he ru ru kaX hūX hūX phaṭa ḍā ki nī dzā la saX bha raX swāhā/oṃ badz+ra be+e ro tsa ni ye hūX hūX phaṭa/ lkoX hriXha ha huX hūX phaṭa/ lkoX sarba bud+dhā ḍā ki ni ye badz+ra waṇi nī ye hūX hūX swāhā/ maX laX paX tāX pu dza oṃ go ra de ma/ ka o tri ko ka la ka hi/pre kṛ so so su na si ma ku/ huX hūX hūX huX hūX huX huX hūX/ zhes bde mchog gi sngags 'phreng bsdus pa'o/ /rgyas par na gzhan du shes par bya'o/ /oṃ āXdhi swāhā/ oṃ ya man+ta ka huX phaṭa/ lkoX hruXsgyiXbi kri ta na nā hūX phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra be+e ro tsa nī ye huX hūX phaṭa/ oX āXdzi na dzika huX/oṃ āXrat+na dhika huX/ oX āX.ā ro lika hūX/ oṃ āXpradzñā dhika hūX/ oX āXmo hā rā ti hūX/oṃ āXdī ṣa rā ti hūX/ oṃ āXrā ga rā ti huX/ oṃ āXbadz+ra rā ti hūX/ oX ā mu rgo ra dhika huX/ oṃ āXdaṇ+ḍa lha ka huX/ oṃ āXpad+ma rnyika huX/ oṃ āXkhas lha ka huX/ oṃ unaX huX/ oX āXyo huX/ oṃ āXni hūX/ oṃ āXr huX/ zhes pa rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi lha tshogs kyi yin no/ /rgyas par mtshon cha can la/ 'phreng ba'i sngags 'di dag bzla bar bya'o/ /oṃ hriXswāhā/ oṃ badz+ra gu hre sirnyi pa ra ma yo ge shwa ri ka pā la mā dha ri ṇi ru dhi ra pri ya shā shā na bā si nī huX phaṭa swāhā/ oṃ badz+ra tsaṇ+ḍi shwa ri/ kha ṭa rmi mahā badz+re ṇi ka pā la mā la/ mu ku ṭo —98—

ā ka lha/ sarba dun da pa mā kaṭa/ ru lu ru lu blo hūX phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra pa ra dzi te pa ra ma gu phya ka pā la mā lwa ni bhu te sarba du ni mo ha ni pri ye e phya hi bha ga ba ti badz+ra gu hre shwa rī/ ba hu bidha bi sha dha ra ṇi/ sarba sgyu rtse ni bā ra ṇi hūX phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra be rta li kha kha ji hi ji hi/ sarba du ni bi kra ta be ṣa dha ra ṇi/ bi kri ta laṅga ra bhā ṣe te ha na ha na/da ha da ha/ pa ca pa tsa/ ma bi la spa/ mi bi la spa/ sa ma ya ma nu sma ra pra be sha ya maṇ+ḍa la ma bye/ ut+pa pa ya sarba huX huX phaṭa/ oṃ e hre bha ga ba ti badz+ra gu hre shwa ri ba hu bidha be sha dha ri ṇi/ sarba ta thā ga ta ge 〉 sa ma ya ma na sma ra ha na ha na/ ra sgo ra sgo/ ra rgo pā ya ra rgo pā ya/ pū ra ya pū ra ya ā bi sha ā bi sha /sarba dh+wa ta na rta narta/ na rta pa ya na rta pa ya/ haXha ha ha ha huX huX huX phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra shā la rmi gri bhin+da bhin+da sarba dun hri da yaX/ ā kar+ṣa ya/ a kar+ṣa ya/ ha na ha na/ da ha da ha/ ni rma tha ni rma tha/ mā ra ya mā ra ya/ ma bi la sba ma bi la sba/ sa ma ya ma nu sma ra hūX phaṭa/oX badz+ra ma he shwa ri/ haX haX haX haX haXru lu ru lu rtso hūX phaṭa/ bhak+ṣa ya sarba du༅/ ni rma tha hri da yaX huX phaṭa swāhā/ oṃ nga ni tibha sa ma ya badz+ra huX phaṭa/ oX badz+ra ha ra bā mu khi yo ge shwa rī hiXhi hi hi hi huX dzaX oṃ badz+ra bā rā hi mu khri hi baX ba huX/ oṃ tsan+d+ra su rgyu hu rā sha ni sidha ni rna de sing ha bsnye sing ha ni ṭāX ṭāX rbaX/ oṃ badz+ra dh+wa ru dzī pra ni yak+ṣi ni shwa ni rū pi ni mahā pru la ya ni rna dī kā ma rū pi ṇi truX tra ṭa ṭa ho/ thun ma kles su gtor ma 'bul bar 'dod na/ gtor ma nang mchod lhar byin gyis brlabs la/ rgyud sde lnga'i dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs 'khor dang bcas pa thams cad mdun gyi nam mkhar skad cig tsam gyis grub par gyur/ bzlas pa'i skabs su bstan pa ltar sngags re re'i mthar/ a kā ro sbyar ba gtso bo rnams la lan bdun bdun/ 'khor rnams la re re phul la/ gong —99—

du ye shes pa la mchod pa 'bul ba ltar phyi nang gsang bas mchod/ rang rang gi bstod pas kyang bdag bskyed ltar bstod/ mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bzhes la/ /zhes sogs kyis 'dod don gsol ba bto/ myur mdzad ye shes mgon po la bar 'dir gtor ma 'bul/de nas spyi gtor ni/ gzhal yas khang thad chos 'byung la/ /pa las pad+ma 'dab brgyad sngo/ /lte bar bcom ldan thugs rdo rje/ /a ya bā ya bha ra na bā rnams las/ shar du brgya byin lhor gshin rje/ /chu lha nub dang gnod spyin byang / /byang shar 'byung po shar lho me/ /lto nub srin po nub byang rlung / /mi dang gnod spyin sogs kyis bskor/ /gzhal yas khang steng chos 'byung la/ /pa las pad+ma 'dab brgyad dkar/ /lte bar bcom ldan sku rdo rje/ sha oṃ bi hū ka ga ra ka rnams las/ khar du dbang po lhor tshangs pa/ khyab 'jug nub dang dbang phyug byang / /byang shar la sogs mtshams bzhi sa /gdong drug tshogs kyi bdag po dang / /rngo gi ri ti legs ldan nag /'dod pa'i lha la sogs pas bskor/ /gzhal yas khang 'og chos 'byung la/ /pa las pad+ma 'dab brgyad dmar/ /lte bar bcom ldan gsung rdo rje/ /pha phi phu pho pho phyu phi h+pha rnams las/ khar du dga' bo dung skyong lho/ /nub tu mtha' yas byang rigs ldan/ /byang shar pad chen 'jog po me/ /srin por nor rgyas pad+ma rlung / /dmyal ba yi dwags dud 'gros bskor/ /'byung po'i gtso bo nyer bzhi po/ /rang rang bu smad g.yog 'khor bcas/ /mkha' dbyings gang ba'i 'byung po rnams/ /dza : ba ho gnyis med thim/ /thams cad rang mdog thig ler zhu/ /dbus ma'i thams cad mi —bskyod pa/ /steng gi thams cad rnam snang mdzad/ /'og ma'i thams cad 'od —100—

dpag med/ /rang snang shes rab dam pas 'byud/ /rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pa dang / /g.yas brkyang bzhugs shing dur khrod brgyad/ /snying kha'i sa bon 'od zer gyis/ /ye shes 'khor lo spyan drangs gyur/ go ri dzaX tso ri hūX be+e ta li baX/ lha sma ri hoXmig tu moX las gti mug rdo rje ma: zhes pa nas/ shrī ye huX/ dbang bskur/chu'i lhag ma spyi bor 'khyil ba las/ sa spyod kyi rigs la mi bskyod pa/ mkha' spyod kyi rigs la rnam snang / sa 'og spyod pa'i rigs la 'od dpag med pas dbu rgyan te thams cad kyang chags bral kyi cha byad can no/ /oṃ i da/ dza ma dza la/ dzak+ṣa bhu ta/ pa sni bā u/ rak+ṣa/ tsan+ta/ su tho mā ha bab ba ta la/ pa tā la/at+pa sa spa swāhā/ e daX ba kla bhuX dza dzi gha phul+la dhu pa maX sa bi gha aX pa/ sa skra/ kadz+dza mā ta khaṇ+ḍi khu ṇi phe ḍa ga ta oṃ a kā ro mu khaX sarba dharma ṇaX u du shud+ma sno tā ta oṃ āXhūX swāhā/ zhes lan gsum gyis 'bul/ ar+ghaX la sogs pas mchod/ glu rdzo āXhuX gis nang mchod phul/ mi bskyod pa ni ye shes che/ /rdo rje dbyings ni mkha' chen po/ /rdo rje gsum mchog dkyil 'khor gsum/ /rdo rje mkha' 'gro phyag 'tshal bstod/ /rnam par snang mdzad rab tu dag /rdo rje zhi ba dga' chen po/ /rang bzhin gyis ni 'od gsal mchog /sangs rgyas mkha' 'gro1 /rin chen rgyal po rab tu zab/ /mi rtog nam mkha' dri ma med/ /dngos 'dzin dag pas gos pa med/ /rin chen mkha' 'gro /rdo rje mi 'chi 'dod chags che/ /mi rtog nam mkha' rdo rje 'dzin/ /'dod chags pha rol phyin pa brnyes/ /pad+ma mkha' 'gro /rdo rje dag pa gdon mi za/ /bsam pa thams cad rdzogs mdzad pa/ /sangs rgyas ngo bo nyid las byung / /sna tshogs mkha' 'gror phyag 'tshal bstod/ /bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro dang / /—101— rī

sangs rgyas byang sems chos skyong la/ /bdud rtsi 'bar ba'i gtor ma dang / /phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod pa 'bul/ /rnal 'byor bdag cag 'khor bcas dang / /mtha' yas sems can ma lus la/ /mchog dang thun mong dngos grub gsol/ /yon tan 'phrin las rgyas par shog /kol+la e ri ṭa ṭha a bol+la/ /mu skru ṇi ri kak+ko la/ /gha ṇa i ki ba ṭa ho badz+dza i/ /ka ru ṇi ka a i ṇa ro lwa/ /ta hi ba la khadz+dza i/ /gā ḍi ma a ṇa bidz+dza a i/ /ha le kwa liñdza ra pa ṇi a i/ /du zhu ra badz+dza a i/ /tsa u sa ma ka spru ri si khyu/ /ka sbu ra lwa i a i/ /ma lwa i in+ta ṇa spyo li dza a i/ /ta ho bha ru sku i a i/ /phre'i ṇa khe ṭa ka ra rnye/ khris dha a hwa khri spu ṇa ma ṇa a i/ /ni ra du e ṅga tsa ḍā bi a i/ /ta hi dza sa ra ba a spa pa ṇi a i/ /ma la a dze ku skye ru bā ḍā i/ /ni ṇ+ḍi ma ta ho ṇa badz+dza a i/ /zhes rdo rje'i glu blangs/ oṃ phun sum tshogs pa mnga' ba gser gyi ri bo 'dra sogs sho lo ka gsum gyi bkra shis brjod/skye zhing skye bar rigs mchog tu/ /skye zhing /wengs med dam tshig ldan/ /dgyes mdzad rdo rje ston pa dang / /brtse ldan bla mar gus 'gyur shog /skye zhing skye ba thams cad du/ /lag pa rdo rje dril bu 'khrol/ /zab mo'i chos ni klog pa dang / /btsun mo'i khu ba len par shog/sems can thams cad bde gyur cig /sems can thams cad skyon med par/ /gang gi lam nas 'gro ba yi/ /lam de myur du 'grub gyur cig/ma bsgral ba rnams bdag gis bsgral/ /ma sgrol pa rnams bdag gis sgrol/ /rnal 'byor gtsug lag bstan bcos la/ /da lta nyid du gnas par shog /ces smon lam btab/ yi ge brgya pas nyams chags bskang / ma 'byor pa dang nyams pa dang / /gang yang bdag rmongs blo yis ni/ /bgyis pa dang ni —102—

bgyid stsal ba/ de yang mgon pos bzod par mdzod/ /lhag pa dang ni chad pa dang / /cho ga'i yan lag nyams pa dang / /bdag gis brjed ngas ci mchis pa/ /de yang mgon pos bzod par mdzod/ /bag med spyod pa ma dag pas/rgyud las gsungs pa'i cho ga bzhin/ /ma lcogs 'khrul pa ci mchis pa/ /de yang mgon pos bzod par mdzod/ /ces bzod par gsol la/ o khyod kyis sems can don kun mdzad/ /rjes su mthun pa'i dngos grub stsol/ /sangs rgyas yul du gshe/gas nas kyang / /slar yang 'byor na par mdzad du gsol/ /ces snyan mnan/'jig rten las 'das pa'i dkyil 'khor rnams bdag nyid la thim/ skyed mu ga smo ga tsā swa bhā wa na/ zhes 'jig rten pa rnams rang bzhin gyis gnas su gshegs/ bdag nyid lus kyi dkyil 'khor dang bsgom pa'i dkyil 'khor yang skad cig gis mi snang bar gyur te 'od gsal ba'i ngo bo'o/ /stong pa'i ngang las bdag nyid dgyes mdzad rdo rje phyag gnyis par gyur/ dpral bar o/ mgrin par ā thugs kar hū/ snang ba thams cad kyang lha'i 'khor lor gyur/ slar yang smon lam bto ste thun mtshams la 'jug go /de ltar dgyes mdzad lha bcu gsum ma la brten nas rgyud sde lnga'i dkyil 'khor rdzogs pa'i rnal 'byor gyis chabs gcig tu bsgom pa'i tshul la lugs gzhan gyi bsre bslad med par bshad zin to/ /grub chen bye ba'i thugs kyis bcud/ /rdo rje 'chang gi lam bzang mchog khyung po'i mtshan 'chang grub brnyes de'i/ /dgongs pa ji bzhin gsal bar bkod/ /ces pa dpal rgyud sde lnga'i sgrub thabs ngag 'don 'di yang tā ra nā thas sbyar ba'o// /khubha ma stu sarba dza ga snya// dge'o// //— 103—

gsal rgyas byed ces bya ba bzhu/gas/oṃ khyu sti/ dpal rgyud sde lnga'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga don gsal rgyas byed ces bya ba/ bla ma dang lhag pa'i lha la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dpal ldan rdo rje 'dzin pa'i zhabs la gus bstud nas/ /dngos grub 'bras bu yang dag byin pa dang / /mtha' dag bgegs kyi tshogs rnams nyer bcom nas/ /'gro la lhag par dge ba nyid du mdzod/ /rdo rje'i gsung gi byin gyis rlabs nas kyang / /bdag gi ngag tshig shin tu dri med pa/ /gzhan la phan pa'i bdud rtsis nyer bsgrubs nas/ /mtha' yas skye bo'i don chen 'grub par mdzod/ /'dir rgyud sde lnga'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga ni/ slob ma rjes bzung dang / bsnyen pa dang / sa chog dang / lhag gnas dang / dkyil 'khor zhug gi cho ga dang / sgrub cing mchod pa dang / bdag nyid 'jug cing dbang blang ba dang / slob ma dkyil 'khor du 'jug pa dang / slob ma la dbang bskur ba dang / slob dpon gyis dbang bskur ba dang / dbang gong ma rnams sbyin pa dang / dkyil 'khor nyer bsdu'i cho ga te don bcu gnyis kyis rtogs par bya'o/ /de'i dang po ni/ deng sang lag len mdzad pa ma mthong la/ gnyis pa ni spyi dang mthun te/ de dag gi rnam par bzhag pa shes par 'dod na/ rdo rje gdan pa'i dkyil chog mna' mchan dang bcas par blta'o/ /gsum pa la sa brtag pa dang / mngon pa las bslang pa yang spyi dang 'dra mod kyi/ de ltar mi byed par snang ngo / /mi snang ba las bslang ba la gsum las/ dang po phyogs skyong las bslang ba ni/ gtor ma dang mchod pa bshams/ a mri tas bsangs/ swabha was sbyangs/stong pa'i ngang las a las byung ba'i rin po che'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba rnams — 104—

kyi nang du/ oṃ āX hūX zhu ba las byung ba'i lha rdzas las grub pa'i/ mchod yon/zhabs bsil/ me tog/bdug spos/ mar me/ dri rmang/ zhal zas/ rol mo la sogs pas mchod rdzas rnams dwangs shing thogs pa med pa nam mkha'i mthas klas par gyur/ oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaX swāhā/ pā duX/ oṃ badz+ra pukhye āXhuX/ dh+wa pe/ a lo keg rnye/ ni wi rkye/ shabha aXjiX/ gtor ma bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las a las ka pā la yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du/ huX zhu ba las byung ba'i gtor ma ye shes kyi rang bzhin bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ oṃ āXhuX ha ho hriX lan gsum gyi byin gyis bsas/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros/ phyogs skyong ba bcu srid pa gsum gyi 'byung po'i tshogs dang bcas pa badz+ra sa mā dzaX oṃ in+d+ra sogs sbyar te/thog mar mchod yon dang / zhabs bsil phul/ de nas nam mkha' mdzod kyi sngags sbyar ba lan gsum gyis gtor ma phul/ de nas purdze sogs kyis nyer spyod lngas ma rdzo/ dbang po rdo rje 'chang ba'i lha sogs kyis bstod/shar phyogs rdo rje can gyi sogs kyis 'phrin las bcol/ mthar sa'i phyogs 'dir bdag dkyil 'khor gyi las rtsom na/ sa'i phyogs 'di bdag la stsol zhing phan pa dang bde ba'i sems kyi stong grogs khyad par can mdzad du gsol/ gang dag sdang ba dang gdug pa'i sems dang ldan pa log par blta ba'i bgegs dang / log par 'dren pa thams cad sa'i phyogs 'dir ma gnas par gzhan du song zhig /ces brjod la tshams rngam dang rol mo'i sgra dang bcas gtor ma phyir dor ro/ /gnyis pa ni/ gtor ma gnyis pa zhig bshams la/ gong bzhin byin gyis rlabs nas/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros/ gnas bdag gzhi bdag grong bdag gnyug mar gnas pa lha klu gnod sbyin srin po 'byung po'i tshogs dang —105—

bcas pa badz+ra sa mā dza a kā ro lan bdun gyis phul/ ar+gha nas shasta'i bar gyis ma rdzo/ gang dag 'dir gnas lha dang klu/ / gnod sbyin srin po gzhan dag la/ /sa 'di bdag gis blang bar gyis/ / dkyil 'khor don du khyod kyis stsol/ lko lan gsum gsol ba btab pas gnang ba byin par bsam/ ga smo ca su bhā wa na/ zhes rang gnas su gshegs par bsam la/ gtor ma btang ngo / /gsum pa sa'i lha mo la blang ba ni/ dkyil 'khor gyi sa gzhi de nyid du lci ba'i maṇ+ḍal gyi dbus su dri bzang gi thig le byas la/ mdun du mchod gtor gsum spun mas/ gong bzhi byin gyis wos/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros/sa 'og nas sa'i lha mo 'khor dang bcas pa badz+ra sa mā dza hu bde chen gser gyi sa gzhi la gnas pa'i/ / sangs rgyas rnams kyis tshogs gnyis dbang bskur ba/ /gser mdog gser gyi bum pa phyag na bsnams/ /sa 'dir bdag cag tshogs gnyis rdzogs pa'i phyir/ /dbang mdzod thugs rjes bdag nyid sa yi lha/ /byang chub shing drung shākya thub pa yi/ /spyan sngar thugs dam gang bzhes de dgongs te/ /'dir byon bdag la brtser dgongs mchod pa bzhes/ /o bṛ shrī wi de wi a kar+ṣa ya dza dri'i thig le'i steng du byon par gyur/ hū lha mo chen mo 'dir byon legs/ / bdag cag bsod nams skal bar ldan/ /bdag gi mchod yon bzhes nas kyang / /'di nyid du ni bzhugs su gsol/ /oṃ bṛ shrī wi khyu ga ga na sa ma ye hu/ zhes mchod yon phul/ ji ltar bltams pa sogs kyis khrus gsol/ bdag dang 'gro la thugs brtse'i phyir/ /nyid kyi rdzu 'phrul mthu yis ni//ji srid mchod pa bdag bgyid na/ /de srid lha mo bzhugs su gsol/ /oṃ bṛ shrī wi khyu pad+ma ka ma la ya stu/ zhes gdan phul/ skye( bṛ shrī wi khyo zhes pa thams cad la sbyar rī—106—

nas/ ar+gha nas shasta'i bar gyis mchod / gtor ma/ a kā ro dang nam mkha' mdzod kyi sngags rgyas rgya cher spel/ oṃ bṛ shrī wi khyu na ma sarba nas/ ga ga na kha gro hā da bā ling ta ye swāhā/ lan gsum gyis phul/ khyod ni sa 'dzin lha mo ste/ /sku phyed thon pa gser gyi mdog /rin chen sna tshogs rgyan gyis brgyan/ /sa 'og lha mo khyod la bstod/ /hū sa la rgyu ba'i lha kun dang / /gang yang sa la brten pa rnams/ /sems can kun la dge don du/ /byams pa'i sems kyi gnang bar mdzod/ /ces bstod cing gsol ba bto/ oṃ ma ma rin chen sna tshogs 'dzin/ /dpal ldan he ru ka mchod ma/ /lha mo khyod ni dpang mdzod cig /sa 'dir dkyil 'khor bri bar bya/ /lan gsum gsol ba btab pa gnang ba byin par mos la/ sa'i lha mo slar yang sa de nyid la thim/ sa sbyang ba ni/ lag pa g.yas pa sa la reg la/ ma rdzo bhu kha nam mkha'i rang bzhin du gyur/ hu la hū/ rdo rje'i rang bzhin du gyur/ yungs chu dang thal ba gtor la/oṃ ha na ha na badz+ra krodha hu phaṭa/ ces lan mang du brjod/ oṃ me dhi ni badz+re bha wa bhan+ta hu/ zhes brjod/ sa bzung ba ni/ slob dpon gyi dkyil 'khor gyi sa gzhi'i gnas su 'dug la/ rdo rje 'chang chen po'i nga rgyal la gnas par bya/ phyogs bzhir rnam snang la sogs pa'i nga rgyal 'dzin pa'i slob ma bzhi gnas te/ nam mkha' mdzod kyi sngags rgyas mchod pa dpag tu med pa sprul/ar+gha nas shasta'i bar gyis slob dpon la mchod/ mi bskyod rdo rje ye shes che sogs kyis bstod/ shar mas/ de bzhin gshegs pa kun zhi ba/ /de bzhin gshegs pa kun gyi gnas/ chos kun bdag med pa yi mchog /dkyil 'khor dam pa bshad du gsol/ /lho mas/ mtshan rnams thams cad yang dag rdzogs/ /mtshan min thams cad yang dag spangs/ / kun tu bzang po sku yi mchog /dkyil 'khor —107—

dam pa/ nub mas/ zhi ba'i chos ni mchog las byung / /ye shes spyod pa rnams sbyong ba/ /kun tu bzang po gsung gi mchog /dkyil 'khor dam pa/ byang mas/ sems can kun gyi sems chen po/ /rang bzhin dag cing dri ma med/ /kun bzang thugs mchog kha lo bsgyur/ /dkyil 'khor dam pa: zhes gsol ba bto/ de nas slob dpon gyis sems can rnams la snying rje chen po'i sems bskyed de/ skyabs 'gro nas brtsams bzlas pa'i mthar thug pa sgrub thabs su ji skad bshad pa bzhin bsgom par bya'o/ /bdag nyid kyi lus kyi dkyil 'khor dang nas/ lha'i 'khor lor gyur/ bgegs gtor gong bzhi byin gyis rlabs nas/ a kā ro lan gsum gyis bsngos te phyir dor/ hu dkyil 'khor chen po'i sa gzhi la gnas pa'i/ /lha la sogs pa'i bgegs tshogs kun nyon cig /gnas 'dir bde gshegs pho brang bdag 'dri yi/ /bgegs kyi tshogs rigs gang yin byer bar gyis/ /de yang sa phyogs bzang po dri ma med pa nam mkha' ltar yangs pa 'dir/ bdag rdo rje 'dzin pa ming 'di zhes bgyi bas sems can thams cad kyi don du/ dpal rgyud sde chen po lnga'i dkyil 'khor 'bri bar byed na/ khyed cag 'di na gnas pa'i lha dang / klu dang / gnod sbyin dang / dri za dang /'byung po dang / sha za dang / srin po la sogs pa'i gdon bgegs gang dag gnas pa de thams cad myur du dengs shig /gang dag mi 'gro bar gyur pa de thams cad dpal he ru ka'i ye shes kyi rdo rje rab tu 'bar bas mgo bo ardza ka'i dog pa bzhin du tshal pa brgyar 'gas par gyur ta re/ zhes lan gsum brjod pha/sna/la ༵kau sna gro sna huhu rjo/ dkar skyo yi tsho gi spre |pyi ༵ ༵ gro je kau kā/ / su hu : tsa ṭa/ ༵ ༵ / ༵ —108—

ho bha ga wan ru rā dza hūX hūX phaṭa/ ces pa dang hūX glur len zhing dkyil 'khor la g.yas bskor du lan gsum bskor/ oṃ ya mun+ta kri ta hūX huX/ zhes sogs khro bo bcu'i sngags brjod cing / phur bu bcu khro bo bcu'i rang bzhin rnams gnas 'di nyid du gdod nas grub pa'i khro bo bcu skad cig gis byon par gyur pa rnams kyi phyag g.yon pa rnams su phur bu re re gtad / skye( gha gha ghā ta ya gha ta ya sarba ྅niX phaṭa/ gī la ya gī la ya sarba pā paX phaṭa/ hūX hūX hūX/ badz+ra gī la ya/ badz+ra dha ro adzñā pa ya ti/ sarba bisnan kā ya wā ka tsit+ta badz+ra gī la ya huX phaṭa/ ces lan bcu bzlas shing phur bu btab la/phyogs bcu'i bgegs thams cad tshar bcad par bsam/ oṃ badz+ra na zhi ra badz+ra ki la ya a ko ṭa ya hūX phaṭa/ ces phur bu brdung bar bya'o/ /phur bu rnams la so sor mchong/ gtor re re bshams pa'am/ thun mong du gcig bshams/ gong bzhin byin rlabs nas/ tseX( ya mun+ta kri ta sogs kyi mthar/ ar+ghaX nas sha lta'i bar sbyar bas mchod/ yang gong gi sngags rnams kyi mthar/ i daX bā ling grit+na grit+na huX hūX phaṭa kha kha ji hi 'a hi/ zhes pas gtor ma phul/dkyil 'khor chen po'i bya ba mthar ma phyin gyi bar du bar chad thams cad bsrung du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab/ mchod gtor de bsdus la bdug spos la sogs pa'i mchod pa rgyun mi 'chad par bya'o/ /rdo rje gdan pa'i dkyil chog ltar na sa chog phal che ba phreng ba sogs dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga spyi dang mthun shas che na'ang / grub chen khyung po'i man ngag thun mong ma yin pa dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga dngul gdong ma yin pas 'dir de'i lugs bzhin du bshad pa yin no/ /gnyis pa la lhag gnas kyi sngon 'gro dang / lhag gnas dngos so/ dang po ni bshad pa ltar/ phyogs skyong gi gtor ma btang zhing bgegs bskrad/ mchod pa bsangs sbyangs byin rlabs kyang gong bzhin las/ shak+ta'i mthar/ oṃ badz+ra ga rnyer ṇi ta la sogs pas rol mo byin dbab/ sgrub thabs — 109—

bzhin bdud rtsi byin rlabs thog mar bya/ de nas skyabs 'gro nas bzlas pa'i bar mngon rtogs bzhin las/ bdud rtsi myang ba'i skabs byin rlabs bsdus pa des chog /gong bzhin bdag bskyed kyi dkyil 'khor bsdus nas/ thun mtshams kyi lha skur langs so / /gnyis pa la/ sa'i lha mo lhag gnas/ lha lhag gnas/ bum pa lhag gnas/ slob ma lha ga gnas te bzhi las/ dang po ni/ dkyil 'khor gyi gzhir/ dri'i maṇ+ḍal dri bzang gi tshom bu can mchod gtor dang bcas pa 4zhams/ mchod gtor gong bzhin byin gyis rlabs/ a mṛ tas sangs/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las/ pad+ma dang zla ba'i gdan la paX las sa'i lha mo gser gyi mdog can zhi ba'i nyams dang ldan pa bdud rtsis gang ba'i gser gyi bum pa thugs kar bsnams pa/ dar dang rin po ches brgyan pa/ dpral bar oX/ mgrin par āX thugs kar hūX/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros/ sa 'og nas sa'i lha mo 'khor dang bcas pa badz+ra sa mā dzaX dzaXhuX baX hoX gnyis su med par thim rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros/ dbang gi lha rigs lnga 'khor bcas badz+ra sa mā dzaX.ar+ghaX nas/sha lta'i bar gyi ma sto/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis 'di la mngon par dbang bskur du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ oX badzir bha wa a bhi khiñtsa hūX/ zhes dbang bskur/ sku gang dri ma dag chu lhag ma yar lud pa las/ rin chen 'byung ldan gyi dbu rgyan/ gong bzhi gtor ma phul la mchod bstod bya/ mthar/skyobs pa sangs rgyas tham/sa cad kyi/ /spyod pa'i tshul dang khyad par gyi/ /sa dang pha rol phyin pa la/ /lha mo khyod ni dpang du gyur/ shwakya seng ge skyob pa yis ji ltar bdud kyi sde bcom pa/ /de bzhin bdag gis bdud sde las/ /rgyal bar byas te dkyil 'khor 'dri/ /lan gsum gsol bto la/ sa'i lha mo slar yang sa de —110—

nyid la thim/ gnyis pa ni/ gang du dkyil 'khor bya ba'i sa gzhir/ skya thig tsam bto la/ lha so so'i gnas su dri bzang gi thig le'i tshom bu bkod/ lha grangs dang mnyam pa'i mchod pa bshams pa'am/ bsdu na lha thams cad gshegs pa gshegs ma sems dpa' sems ma khro bo khro mo rnams su 'du bas/ mchod pa thams cad sum cu rtsa bdun bshams pa'i lag len yod pas yul dus kyi spyod pas deng sang de ltar bya mod kyi/ mchod pa ni lhag par mang ba nyid mchog go /'jig rten las 'das pa dang / 'jig rten pa'i gtor ma gnyis bshams/myur mdzad ye shes kyi mgon po las 'bul rgyu'i gtor ma che ba nyid logs su bshams/ de thams cad bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las/ ra las nyi ma la hu las sna tshogs rdo rje zhes pa nas/ ba dan la sogs pas brgyan pa/ rtsig pa'i phyi rol 'gram stegs zhes pa nas/ de rnams kyis yongs su bskor ba'i gzhal yas khang / shar dkar/ lho ser/ nub dmar/ byang ljang/ dbus sngo ba'i steng du/mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa'i gzhal med khang dbus gtsang khang phyur bu dang bcas pa lnga tshoms su gnas pa/ rta babs dang bral ba rnams so/ /de rnams kyi steng gi nam mkha' la/ sna tshogs pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa nas/ zla ba'i dkyil 'khor re re'i/ dbus kyi gdan gyi steng du/ bcom ldan 'das dgyes mdzad rdo rje sku mdog mthing nag nas/ 'od kyis khyab par mdzad pa'o/ /zhes pa'i bar gtso bo mtshon cha can sgrub thabs bzhin bskyed/ 'dab ma brgyad la shar du/go rī nag mo/ nas/ sa'i dkyil 'khor 'dzin pa/ lha mo thams cad kyang spyan gsum nas dbus na bzhugs pa'o/ /nang gi gzhal yas khang dbus ma'i lha — 111 —

snam shar dkar/ lho ser/ nub dmar / byang ljang / dbus sngo ba'i steng du/ sna tshogs pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad dang bcas pa'i lhe ba la nas/ gar gyi me dpung 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'o/ /gzhal yas khang shar ma'i nang le'u tshe dgu pa nas/ gdug pa can tshar gcod pa'o/ /gzhal yas khang lha mo'i nang gi lha snam nas/ gri gug dang thod pa bsnams pa'o bar/ gzhal yas khang nub ma'i dbus su/ pad+ma dmar po nas/ gang ba'i bum pa bzhi'o/ /gzhal yas khang byang ma'i dbus kyi lte ba la sna tshogs rdo rje nas/ gang ba bzhi dang bcas pa'o/ /phyi'i gzhal yas khang gi shar sgor rta gdong ma nas/ dril bu 'dzin pa/ sgo skyong ma bzhi char yang spyan gsum dang ldan zhing / stag gi pags pa'i shams thabs can/dbu skra dmar ser nas/ dbus na bzhugs pa'o/ /zhes dam tshig pa bskyed/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer gyi tshogs dpag tu med pa spros/ sprul gzhi bla ma dang dbyer med pa'i gzhi'i dkyil 'khor dgyes mdzad lha bcu gsum gyi bdag nyid can dang / rgyud sde lnga'i dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs thams cad oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzashar phyogs kyi nas/ at+pa ko3ha/ mi bskyod rdo rje ye shes sogs kyis bstod/ o badz+ra go rī nas/ gcig tu gyur/ ma rdzo pa rnams gong bzhi byin gyis brlabs/ so so'i phyag rgya dang cas te/ dri med yid du 'ong ba yi/ /lha rdzas dam pa'i mchod yon 'di/ /bcom ldan 'khor dang bcas la 'bul/ /bzhes nas bdag la dgyes par mdzod/ /o shrī he badz+ra gu phya sa mā dza tsakra sam+bha ra mahā mā ya badz+ra ste ra wa sa pa ri wa re khyo gu ru bzhi bo dhi satwa maṇ+ḍal la de bī khyu mahā shā sha na wa si ni sarba wi re ne sa pā ri wa re khyo ar+gha pra ru swahā/ de bzhi du sbyar te/ mchod yon zhes pa'i —112—

gnas su/ zhabs bsil/ ar+ghaX zhes pa'i gnas su pā rkye zhes pa sbyar/ chu gnyis 'bul ba'am/ chu bzhi 'bul ba ltar na/ thog mar zhabs bsil 'di/ gong gi mtshan sngags kyi mthar/oṃ ni ri ti hūX khaX swāhā/ de bzhi du/ zhabs bsil dang / oṃ ni wi te hūX khaX swāhā/'thor 'thung 'di/ sarba saX shodha ni swāhā/ mchod yon 'di/ dzaX huX baX hoX kha raX mahā ar+ghaX prati ts+tsha swāhā/ wo wol/ me tog bzang po mdzes shing gtsang / /gtsang ma'i gnas skyes 'di rnams ni/ bdag gis gus pas 'bul lags kyi/ /so sor bzhes te rab dgyes mdzod/ /gong gi mawo sngags kyi mthar/ oX badz+ra pur+sha aXhuX/ de bzhi du/ yid dga' snying po ro mchog ldan/ /bdug pa bla med dri mchog 'di/ /bdag gis gus pas 'bul lags kyi/ /so sor bzhes te dges par mdzod/ /ga pe srin po 'joms shing dag byed la/ /dges shing mun sel mar me 'di/ tho/ dag gis /so sor: /ā lo ke /gtsang zhing bzang la dge ba'i dri/ /skye gnas gtsang mar ldan dri rnams/ /bdag gis: ga rnye/ /sman rnams bcud gtsang yid gar 'ong / /sngags kyi zhal zas mchog 'di dag /bdag gis nai rlu tshu/ pa ṭa ha dang cang te'u sogs/ /dung dang rnga sogs sgra dbyangs rnams/ /yid 'phrog sil snyan sna tshogs pa/ /'bul gyi yang dag bzhes su gsol/ khas/ gos zung bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las/ bhāX las byung ba'i lha rdzas kyi na bza' bzang zhing rgya che ba nam mkha'i mthas klas par gyur/ kha dog bzang zhing dri zhim reg na bde/ /srab 'jam yang mdzes lha las byung ba yi/ /na bza' mchog 'di rdo rje'i sku la 'bul/ /bgres pa med pa rdo rje'i sku thob shog /gong gi mtshan sngags kyi mthar/ badz+ra wasta ye āXhuX/ rang gi snying ga —113—

nas/ a ā/ i sī/ u ྅/ ṛ grwa/ le lī/ e i/ tse( e(/ aX aX zhes pa rnams yongs su gyur pa las/ mchod pa'i lha mo bcu drug nam mkha' gang ba spros/ oṃ wi ni badzi huX hūX phaṭa/ de bzhi du/ waX phya/ mṛ taX gi /mu ra dze/ ha gya/ lwa su/ girti/ nirti/ puṅge dhū pe/ ā lo ke /ga rnye/ rū pa/ rwa sa/ sparnye/ oṃ dharma dh+wa tu badzi huX huX phaṭa/ de bzhin du rgyal srid sna bdun dang / 'dod yon rnam lnga sogs kyang spyi dang mthun par 'bul/ slar yang nang mchod byin gyis brlabs te/ phyogs bcu dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi ngo bo gyur pa dpal ldan bla ma dam pa'i zhal du oṃ āXhuX/ spros pa la dga' na/ khos bos brgyud 'debs logs su sbyar ba ltar/ rgyud sde lnga so so'i bla ma brgyud pa rnams la 'bul lo/ /bsdu na/ rdo rje 'chang / blo gros rin chen/ 'phags pa klu sgrub/ grub pa'i dpa' bo/ shā bā ri/ gu ṇa sa ka ra rnams kyi zhal du mchod pa dam pa 'bul lo/ /oṃ āXhuX/ mai tri pa/ mi mnyam rdo rje/ mnyam pa'i rdo rje/ rin chen lha mo/ /dha byang chub sems dpa' rdo rje gdan pa/ mtshungs med rgyal mtshan 'bum/ 'jag chen byams pa dpal/ 'jam dbyangs chos dpal bzang po/ 'khrul zhig tshul khrims rgyal mtshan/ rin chen mkhyen rab mchog grub/ kun bzang chos kyi nyi ma rnams kyi zhal du oṃ āXhūX/ ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma/ a ta ya badz+ra rā hu la gup+ta badz+ra rnams kyi zhal du oṃ āXhuX/ grub chen khyung po rnal 'byor/ mnyam med rin chen brtson 'grus/dbon ston skyer sgang pa r+sā po/ gnyan ston sbas pa'i rnal 'byor/ 'gro mgon sangs rgyas ston pa rnams kyi zhal du oṃ āXhuX/ grub chen khyung po rnal 'byor/sne'u ston pa yon tan tshulu khrims/ brag nag pa rdo rje tshul khrims/ bla ma steng pa — 114—

ba tshul khrims bstan pa/ bla ma bsod nams mdzes/ bla ma yon tan rgyal mtshan/ rin po che bstan pa rgyas pa rnams kyi zhal du oṃ āXhuX/ mkhas grub shangs ston chos rje/ khyung po tshul khrims mgon po/ bya bral ri khrod ras wo/shangs dkar pa rin chen rgyal mtshan/ mnyam med sangs rgyas dpal bzang /grub chen nam mkha' rgyal mtshan/ rgya sgom legs pa rgyal mtshan/ rje btsun kun dga' grol mchog /rdo rje 'chang lha dbang grags pa dang / 'jam dbyangs kun dga' rgyal mtshan rnams kyi zhal du/ oṃ āXhūX/ oṃ sde/ ba pi tsu badz+ra huX huX phaṭa/ oṃ aXhūX/ de bzhin du sbyar te/ oṃ hriXswāhā/ oX āXbadz+ra khyu ka huX phaṭa swāhā/ oṃ khyiXha ha hūX hāX phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra be+e ro tsa ni ye hūṃ hūX phaṭa/ oṃ āXhriXhuX huX phaṭa swāhā/ oṃ ya mun ka huX phaṭa/ ces pa rnams la 'bru gsum btags/ gaX rtsa baX ghaX paX shaX laX ḍaX oṃ āXhūX/bhuX swa a ha laX maX paX taX thi li oṃ dzi khaX gaX oṃ skaX saX dzaX hūX baX hoX huX huX huX hūX huX hūX hūX huX huX hūṃ oṃ u.āXskyoX/ maX taX paX laX/ pu dza o a go ra de ma/ ka o tri ko/ka la ka hi/pra gro so pu/ na si mā ku oṃ āXhūX/ oṃ huX traX hri a oṃ āXspyoX/ yak+ṣi ma me da/ dza sa do sa ru ni ra/ ṇa ya ni ra oṃ āXhuX/ gaX tsaX paṃ ghaX paX shaX laX ḍaX dzaXhūṃ baX hoX.oṃ āXhuX/oṃ gu ru bud+dhā bodhi sa twa sa pā ri wa ra oṃ āXhūX/ oṃ khyi snyi tra cha bi nā ya ka hūX huX phaṭa/ nag po chen po'i 'khor dang bcas pa'i zhal du oṃ āX hūX/ oṃ huX traX hri a/mkha' 'gro sde lnga'i tshogs kye zhal du oṃ āXhūX/ gzhan yang gnas gsum gyi dpa' bo mkha' 'gro ma rnams dang / phyogs skyong ba bcu/ lha wo po brgyad/ klu r+ṣa po brgyad/ gza' r+ṣa po brgyad/ 'jigs byed wo po dgu/ rgyu skar nyi shu rtsa brgyad/ rgyal po chen po sde bzhi/ lha srin sde brgyad srid pa gsum gyi 'byung —1/5—

po'i tshogs dang bcas pa'i zhal du oṃ āXhūX/ gnas bdag bzhi bdag grong bdag gnyug mar gnas pa 'gro ba rigs drug dang bcas pa la mchod par 'bul lo/ /oṃ āXhuX/ rang gis kyang 'bru gsum gyi bdud rtsi myang / oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a nu rā ga na badz+ra su bhā wa ut+pa ko3haX/ zhes lha thams cad bde stong gis mnyes par bsam/ de thams cad kyang 'khore gsum mi dmigs pas rgyas thebs pa de kho na nyid kyis mchod pas mchod bstod pa bsdus pa la spro na mngon rtogs bzhin bya/ long yod cing shes na be+e ro tsa na rak+ṣi tas phyogs gcig tu bsdus pa'i rgyas pa 'di nyid bya ste/ de yang 'di ltar/ huX khyod ni rnal 'byor ma sogs yongs su bskor/ /nyid kyi thugs kyi dgongs pa yongs su bsgrub/ khyod ni rgyu dang mi rgyu 'khor ba kun sgrub pa/ /snying rje'i thugs kyi sems can byang chub tu/ /kun rdzob sgyu mas byang chub sgrub pa'i yid/ /dges mdzad rdo rje dpal chen he ru ka la bstod/ /huX dges mdzad rdo rje bcom ldan 'das/ / bdag med ma dang yang dag rol/ /thabs dang shes rab gnyis med pa'i/ /he ru ka la bdag phyag 'tshal/ /go rī tso rī be+e ta lī/ /lha sma rī la phyag 'tshal lo/ / puska sha ri tsaṇ+ḍasnyi/ḍom+bhi ni la bdag phyag 'chal/ khar sgor rta gdong lho sgo yi/ /phag gdong can la phyag 'tshal lo/ /nub sgor khyi gdong byang sgo yi/ /seng gdong can la phyag 'chal lo/ /de ltar gtso bo lha mor bcas/ /dkyil 'khor lha tshogs thams cad la/ /bdag gis gus pas bstod byas pas/ /he ru ka dpal myur thob shog /hūX thams cad dngos po'i rang bzhin mchog /gdod nas thams can rang bzhin gnas/ /thabs dang shes rab gnyis med pa'i/ /dgyes mdzad rdo rje bdag —116—

phyag 'tshal/ /bdag med ma yis mgul nas 'byud/ /dbu skra ser po gyen du 'bar/ /zhal brgyad po la spyan gsum po/ /mgon po de la gus phyag 'tshal/ /spyi bo dang steng nag po mdzes/ /dkar dang dmar ba g.yas dang g.yon/ /gang gi lhag pa'i zhal rnams ni/ /nag po de la bdag phyag 'tshal/ /glang po rta bong glang rnga mong / /skyes pa khyi dang ma he can/ /g.yas pa'i phyag brgyad la gnas pa'i/ /thod pa 'dzin la bdag phyag 'tshal/ /sa dang chu dang rlung dang me/ /zla nyi gshin rje gsang ba la/ /g.yon pa'i phyag brgyad la gnas pa'i/ /thod pa 'dzin la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhabs bzhi yis ni bdud bzhi po/ /mnyam par mnan cing gcer bu nyid/ /nyi mar zhabs g.yas brkyangs dang sngo/ /gar mdzad de la bdag phyag 'tshal/ /'khor lo bzhi yi bdag nyid mdzes/ /'dzag pa'i mgo bos rnam par brgyan/ /de bzhin gshegs pa rnam dag pa'i/ /phyag rgya lnga yis rnam par brgyan/ /sna tshogs rdo rje spyi bor 'dzin/ /dpral bar rigs kyi bdag po nyid/ /dam pa'i dga' ba yang dag thob/ /bde chen de la bdag phyag 'tshal/ /bud med skyes 'dul 'gro gzigs nas/ / bdag med rnal 'byor ma nyid gyur/ /phyag 'os thub pa'i pha rol phyin/ /sgyu ma'i rgya la phyag 'tshal lo/ /ga las skyes pa'i go ri shar/ /yan lag nag cing g.yon na nya/ /g.yas pa na ni gri gug 'dzin/ /tshangs pa mnan la bdag phyag 'chal/ /tsa las byung ba'i cho me rkun ma/ /btsod kyi kha dog lho phyogs su/ /phyag na phag dang cang te'u bsnams/ /dbang po mnan la bdag: /pa las skyes pa'i ser mo nub/ /ro langs ma ni nye dbang mnan/ /phyag g.yon lhung bzed g.yas pa na/ /rus sbal 'dzin la bdag —117—

phyag 'tshal/ /lha sma ri ni byang gi sgor/ /ljang khu gha las byung ba yi/ /phyag gnyis sbrul dang thod pas brel/ /drag po mnan la bdag: /gshin rje mnan cing pa las byung/ /g.yon na dgra sta seṅge g.yas/ / dbang ldan du ni 'jigs gzugs mo/ /phyag 'tshal puska si sngo la/ /ri khrod ma dkar sha las byung/ /me ru gnod sbyin steng du gnas/ /g.yon na bsil byed g.yas pa na/ /dge slong 'dzin la bdag phyag 'tshal/ /gtum mo nam mkha'i sngo bsangs ma/ /srin por la las byung ba yi/ /g.yon na thod pa 'khor lo g.yas/ /phyag 'tshal srin po mnan pa la'o/ /ḍa las 'khrungs pa'i g.yung mo ni/ /rlung mtshams thag bzang ris steng gshegs/ /phyag g.yon sdig mdzub g.yas rdo rje/ /sna tshogs mdog la bdag phyag 'tshal/ /skyil krungs phyed pa'i gar gyis bzhugs/ /phyag rgya lnga yi rnam par brgyan/ /gcer bu spyan gsum thams cad la/ /bdag ni gus par phyag 'tshal lo/ /phung ngo/ khams ni rnam da/ga pa/ /byang chub sems las byung ba yi/ /bde rab bstir 'di thams cad la/ /dngos po kun gyis phyag 'tshal lo/ /nyid kyi g.yas pa'i phyag bzung ba'i/ /phyag mtshan sa bon las byung ba/ /bde chen 'dod pa thams cad la/ /rtag tu yang dag phyag 'tshal lo/ /gang zhig nyi zla sa bon gnas/ /gnyis las skyes pa'i gtso bo rig mar bcas/ /nyid kyi nyid kyis dkyil 'khor 'di la ni/ /'jig rten gsum po sprul par mdzad dang ldan/ /nyid la 'di dag thams cad ma lus pa/ /zhi ba'i bde stsol rig ma sdud mdzad pa/ /shes rab chags pa'i bdud rtsi'i ro nyid kyi/ /gnas su zhi ba de la phyag 'tshal lo/ /mkha' 'gro ma gtso kyai rdo rje/ /lha mo 'khor lor bcas bstod —118—

pas/ /bdag gis bsod nams gang thob pa/ /des ni 'jig rten bde mtshungs shog /skyo mi bskyod rdo rje ye shes che/ /rdo rje dbyings ni mkha' wo po/ /rdo rje gsum mchog dkyil 'khor gsum/ /rdo rje dbyings la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rnam par snang mdzad dag pa che/ /rdo rje zhi ba dga' ba che/ /rang bzhin 'od gsal mchog gi mchog /ston pa rdo rje phyag 'tshal lo/ / rin chen rgyal po rab tu zab/ /rdo rje nam mkha' dri ma med/ /rang bzhin dag pa gos pa med/ /rdo rje sku la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rdo rje dpag med rgyal po che/ /mi rtog nam mkha' rdo rje 'dzin/ /'dod chags pha rol phyin pa brnyes/ /rdo rje gsung la: /don yod rdo rje rdzogs sangs rgyas/ /bsam pa thams cad rdzogs mdzad pa/ /dag pa ngo bo nyid las byung / /rdo rje sems dpa' : /bcom ldan mgon po dpa' bo'i dbang phyug ni/ /sogs sgrub thabs bzhi/ bcom ldan rnam kun rdo rje phag mo chen mo ni/ /'jig rten gsum sogs phyogs gzhan rgol bas mi thub cing / /'byung po'i 'jigs pa ma lus rdo rje chen pos 'joms/ /rdo rje'i gdan bzhugs tshangs sogs dbang byed las rgyal zhing / /rdo rje phag mo khro mo'i gzugs can drag snyems pas/ /rmugs byed rengs byed rmongs byed las ni rnam rgyal zhing / /bdud kyi 'jigs pa la sogs skem zhing pham par mdzad pa mo/ / rnal 'byor chen mo 'dod pa'i dbang phyug ma la 'dud/ /skye med ngang las thugs rje chen po yi/ /keng rus 'jigs su rung ba'i ri steng du/ /bdud 'dul hū las khro bo'i skur sprul pa/ /bcom ldan bde ba'i mchog la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dag pa chos sku'i sprul pa ni/ /dmigs pa med pa'i thugs rje yi/ /gzugs sku sgyu ma ltar —119—

ston pa/ /phag mo'i sku la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'byung ba bzhi po rnam dag cing / /ye shes bzhi yi ngo bo nyid/ /mkha' 'gro ma dang lwa ma dang / /dum skyes ma dang gzugs can ma/ /'gro ba'i don du sku sprul pa/ /mkha' 'gro bzhi la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rab gtum ma dang gtum mig ma/ /'od ldan sna chen brtan pa'i blo/ /mi thung la ske'i dbang phyug ma/ khreng grib ma la phyag /sa bsrung ma dang 'jigs byed che/ /rlung shugs chang 'thung ljang lha mo/ khren tu bzang dang rta sna mo/ /bya gdong ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'khor shugs khaṇ+ḍa ro ha dang / /chang 'thung go cha rab dpa' mo/ /stobs chen 'khor lo bsgyur ma dang / /brtson chen ma la: /thod pa'i dum bu keng rus can/ /keng rus mche ba gtsigs pa'i sgra/ /'od dpag med dang rdo rje'i 'od/ /rdo rje'i sku la /myu gu can dang ral pa can/ /dpal chen hū mdzad rab bzang dang / /rdo rje bzang dang 'jigs byed dang / /mig mi bzang la phyag 'tshal lo/ /stobs chen rdo rje rin chen dang / /rta mgrin mkha' snying he ru ka /pad+ma gar dbang rnam snang dang / /rdo rje sems dpar phyag 'tshal lo/ /phyogs bzhi'i sgo rnams skyong mdzad ma/ kha gdong ma dang 'ug gdong ma/ /de bzhin khyi yi gdong ma dang / /phag gdong rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gzugs gnyis kyis ni yid 'phrog ma/ /brtan ma mo dang pho nya mo/ /mche ba gtsigs dang 'joms ma dang / /gshin rje bzhi la phyag 'tshal lo/ /hu sgyu 'phrul chen po he ru ka /yang dag sprul pa ston 'dzin cing / /sku gsum ye shes ro gcig pa/ /sgyu 'phrul rgyal po la phyag 'tshal/ /mche ba gtsigs shing 'jigs pa che/ /sngags kyi me tog 'phreng bas brgyan/ kha chen rab tu gsol —120—

mdzad pa/ /he ru ka dpal bdag phyag 'tshal/ /dpal ldan rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma/ /mkha' 'gro ma yi 'khor lor sgyur/ /ye shes lnga dang sku gsung thugs/ /'gro ba skyob la phyag 'tshal lo/ /ji snyed rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma/ /kun tu rtog pa'i 'ching gcod cing / /'jig rten bya ba rab 'jug ma/ /de snyed rnams la bdag phyag 'tshal/ /༈ dus gsum rgyal ba thams cad kyis/ /bka' yi 'khor lo rab tu bskor/ /bdud dang mu stegs lha min bcom/ /gshin rje 'joms la phyag 'tshal lo/ /chos nyid las bzhengs ye shes sku/ /dang po'i sangs rgyas 'jam pa'i dpal/ /mngon byang ye shes longs spyod rdzogs/ /ya man+ta ka phyag 'tshal bstod/ /sangs rgyas thams cad gcig bsdus pa/ /rdo rje sems dpa' rigs kyi gtso/ /zhe sdang 'joms mdzad gshin rje gshed/ khro rgyal khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /tshon rje gshed po rab 'jigs pa/ /gti mug rdo rje'i ngo bo khyod/ /ston pa sangs rgyas kun rang bzhin/ /rdo rje'i sku la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /gzhin rje tshige da po rab 'jigs pa/ /phra ma rdo rje'i ngo bo nyid/ /rdo rje'i thugs dang rab mtshungs pa/ /rdo rje rin chen phyag 'tshal bstod/ /gshin rje gshed po rab 'jigs pa/ /'dod chags rdo rje'i ngo bo khyod/ /rdo rje'i gsung dang rab tu mtshungs/ /rdo rje'i gsung la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /phrag dog rdo rje'i rang bzhin khyod/ /gshin rje gshed po las kun byed/ /rdo rje'i sku dang rab tu mtshungs/ /phyag na ral gri phyag 'tshal bstod/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi ngo bo khyod/ /sangs rgyas thams cad gcig bsdus pa/ /sangs rgyas kun mchog gtso bo'i gtso/ /dkyil —121—

'khor gtso la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /gtor ma gnyis nang mchod ltar byin gyis brlabs te/so so'i sngags mthar gtor ma 'bul nas brtsams/ ga smo su bha wa na zhes pa'i bar sgrub thabs bzhi gtor ma lkol/ mthar spos dang bcas pa'i rdo dril 'dzin pas/ rdo rje slob dpon blo gros che/ /sems can don rnams bya ba dang / /sangs rgyas thugs dam bskul ba'i phyir/ /dkyil 'khor gtso bo rig mar bcas/ /gang yang phyogs bcu'i dpa' bo dang / /rig pa'i lha mo rdzu 'phrul can/ /byang chub sems dpa' la sogs kun/ /ma lus bdag la dgongs su gsol/ /bdag la brtse bar dgongs nas kyang / /slob ma rnams la phan pa dang / khyed rnams la yang phan pa'i phyir/ /sang ni dkyil 'khor 'bri bar 'tshal/ /bcom ldan bdag ni gus pa la/ /de bas gnang ba mdzad par rigs/ /sangs rgyas 'jig rten mgon brtse dang / /byang chub sems dpa' dgra bcom dang / /gsang sngags lha gzhan gang lags dang / /'jig rten skyong ba'i lha rnams ni/ /gang yang 'byung po mthu chen dang / /gang dag lha yi spyan mnga' ba/ /sems can bstan la dga' ba rnams/ /bdag la dgongs par mdzad du gsol/ /rdo rje 'dzin pa 'di zhes pas/ /sang ni dkyil 'khor bzang po'i ming / /rgyud sde lnga yi dkyil 'khor ni/ /cho ga bzhin du dril lags na/ /bdag dang slob mar bcas pa la/ /thugs ni brtse bar dgongs nas su/ /tshogs pa thams cad dkyil 'khor du/ /byin gyis rlabs par mdzad du gsol/ /zhes lan gsum gsol btab/ rab tu lha grangs dang mnyam pa'i bum pa dgos pa yin mod kyang / de tsam 'grub dka' bas/ da ltar phyag bzhes la lha bum lnga/dbus kyi bum pa'i steng du rnam rgyal chen po thod pa'am dung chos/ las thams cad pa'i bum/ pa je /— 122—

bum pa lhag gnas kyi gzhi mdun du bsdu ba kho na phyag len du mdzad/ de yang tshom bu'am dkyil 'khor so so'i dbus kyi steng du mañdzi sogs la bum pa lnga bkod/ las bum gzhi dkyil gyi byang sgo'i tshom bu'i steng du bkod/ mchod pa dang gtor ma bum pa re re bzhin du bshams pa'am bsdu na thun mong du bshams kyang rung / bum pa bskyed chog gi tshul/ sa bon gyi dkyil 'khor bskyed nas/ gtso bo'i snying po brjod pa tsam gyi lha rnams skad cig gis bskyed pa rdo rje gdan pa'i lugs dang /bsrung 'khor chos 'byung 'gyung bzhi gzhal yas khang du mngon byang lnga las gtso bo lnga bskyed nas/ 'khor rnams mkha' spro byed pa brda byang chub sems dpa'i lugs/ lha thams cad rdo rje cho ga gsum bskyed pa be+e ro tsa na rak+ṣi ta'i lugs/skad cig gis bskyed pa rā hu la dang / su ma ti chen po'i lugs yin par bshad pa las/ deng sang lag len bde ba'i phyir phyi ma mdzad la/ thams cad kyang bum pa gzhal yas khang du bskyed par ni mthun no/ /de yang 'di ltar bum pa rnams bsangs sbyangs stong pa'i ngang las/ pad zla'i gdan la bhu las bum pa bhu gyis mtshan pa las 'od 'phros/ sangs rgyas rnams mchod cing thugs rgyud bskul/ sems can thams cad kyi don byas/ slar 'dus te thim pa yongs su gyur pa las/ thams cad gzhal yas khang gru bzhi sgo bzhi rta babs bzhis brgyan pa/ mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs par gyur/ rnam rgyal chen po dang dbus kyi bum pa'i gzhal yas khang nang gi lha snam shar da/kar/ lho ser nas/ ljang khu rnams gan rkyal du mnan pa'i snying gar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor re re/rnam rgyal wo po'i sgo bzhir nyi ma'i gdan/ dbus kyi gdan gyi steng du/ bcom ldan 'das dgyes mdzad nas/ sa'i dkyil 'khor 'dzin pa'i bar lha sta gon — 123—

bzhin/ shar sgor rta gdong ma nas/ sham thabs can no'i bar masto cha can gyi bar sgrub thabs bzhi/ gzhal yas khang dbus ma'i nas/ gang ba bzhi dang bcas pa so so'i bar dkyil 'khor lnga po lha sta gon gyi skabs bzhin ji lta ba bzhin du bskyed/ las thams cad pa'i gzhal yas khang par pad+ma dang zla ba nyi ma brtsegs pa'i gdan la/ bdud rtsi 'khyil ba sku mdog ljang nag dkar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug pa/ dang po gnyis kyis rang snang gi yum la 'khyud pa/ lhag ma g.yas gnyis kyis rdo rje nag po rwa gdengs pa dang ral gri g.yon gnyis kyis rin po che dang pad+ma 'dzin pa/ stag lpags kyi sham thabs dang sprul gyi brgyan pa/khro bo'i mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa'o/ /snying ga'i sa bon gyi 'od zer gyis dgyes mdzad mtshon cha can lha bcu gsum rgyu sde lnga'i dkyil sde bor gyi lha tshogs/ bdud rtsi 'khyil ba dang bcas pa oṃ badz+ra sa mā dza shar phyogs kyi nas/ spyi bor khyil ba las/ gtso bo drug la mi bskyod pa dang / 'khor rnams la gtso bo dang / bdud rtsi 'khyil ba la don yod grub pa rnams kyis dbu rgyan/de nas bum bzlas bya ste/ gzungs thag nas bzung la/ gtso bo drug gi sngags brgya rtsa re dang / lha gzhan rnams la'ang nyer gcig tsam re bzla bar bshad na'ang / bdun bdun nam gsum gsum tsam ci rigs par bzlas/ las bum la dmigs te/ tso rna ā bighān+ta kṛ ta hu phaṭa/ ces pa brgya rtsa dang / na ma sa man+ta kā ya wā ka tsit+ta badz+ra na/ na mo mahā badz+ra kro dha ya/ mahā da sgo t+pa ṭa bhi ṣa ṇa hai ra wa ra ya/ a si mu sa la/ pa ra shu/ pā sha ha sta ya/ o ā mṛ ta kuṇ+ḍa li kha kha/ sku hi 'a hi/ hu lu hu lu/ tiṣ+ṭha la ban+ta ban+ta/ ha na ha na/da ha da ha/ ga rdza ga rdza/ bi spro ṭa ya bi spro ṭa ya/ sarba bisnin bi na ya ka /mahā ga — 124—

ṇa pa ti/ dzi wi twan+ta kā ra ya/ hu hū phaṭa swāhā/ zhes pa'ang nyer gcig sogs bzla'o/ /thams cad kyi thun mong du/ skye( sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shrī hu zhes pa dang /gtsug gtor rnam rgyal gyi gzungs yang ci rigs su bzlas te gzungs thag bsdu'o/ /de nas mchod pa gong bzhin byin gyis rlabs/ mchod bstod dang / 'jig rten 'das pa'i gtor ma 'bul tshul lha sta gon gyi skabs bzhin la 'jig rten pa'i gtor chog mi dgos/ bdag dang slob mar bcas pa'i sems can thams cad la gegs med cing dngos grub stsal du gsol/ yig brgya lan bdun gyi mthar ma 'byor pa dang sogs kyis bzod par gsol/ rdo rje pang du bzhag pa'am g.yas par me tog dang lhan cig bzung yang rung / g.yon pas dri chab kyis gang ba'i dung chos blangs/ pad skor re sngon du 'gro bas/ bum pa re re bzhin g.yas su bskor te/a kha wi ra hu/ lan bdun gyis bum pa re rer dri bzang gi chu thigs re dang / me tog re 'bul/rab tu dges pa'i thugs can gyis ye shes pa rnams steng gi nam mkha' la bzhugs par gyur/ ar+gha nas shasta'i bar gyis phyi mchod dang / 'bru gsum lan bdun gyis nang mchod/ a nu rā ga ṇa sa gsang mchod phul/ de nyid lnga pa dang / khro bo zhe sdang gnas las skyes/ /gsod gcod don du gnyer mdzad nas/ / dngos grub thams cad thob ster ba/ /bdud rtsi 'khyil ba la phyag 'tshal/ /zhes pas bstod/ slar yang dung chos kyi dri chab bum pa so sor blug /nam mkhar bzhugs pa'i ye shes pa'i lha tshogs shin tu dgyes pa'i thugs ka nas/ bdud rtsis chu rgyun byung ste/ bum nang gi lha rnams kyi spyi bo nas zhugs shing thim pas/ gzhal yas khang rnams bum pa rnams su gyur/ dam tshig pa de rnams 'od du zhu ba las/ rnam rgyal chen po dang rnam rgyal rnams su sngags kyi rnam pa'i bdud rtsis yongs su gang ba dang / las — 125—

thams cad par chu'i rdul phra rab re re nas lha sku phra mo re rer gyur/ de nas bum pa rnams rol mo dang bcas stegs bur spyan drang ngo / /yang dam ye ma phye bar mchod yon phul bas lha rnams yab yum snyoms par zhugs pas/ byang chub kyi sems kyis bum pa gang / ye shes pa gshegs nas/ dam tshig pa zhu bar byed pa'i lugs kyang yod la/ yang dam ye dbyer med kyi lha rnams byang chub kyi sems su zhu ba ste/ gsum po 'di bum dbang dang / gsang dbang dang / shes rab ye shes kyi dbang gsum dang rjes su 'brel ba'i bum pa'i sgrub lugs yin pas/ dngos gzhi nub gsum la dbang bzhi rdzogs par byed na/ sta gon gyi skabs dkyus bzhin dang / gsang dbang gi nyin mo gnyis pa dang / sher dbang gi nyin gsum pa ltar sgrub/ dbang rdzogs par byed na gsum pa ltar sgrub dgos zhes gsungs pa'i dgongs don yang de yin la/ deng sang dbang bzhi nub gcig la bskur ba dang len pa ltar na/ bum dbang ma gtogs pa la bum pa'i bya ba med pa'i phyir/ dkyusaltar bya'o/ /bzhi pa ni/ thun mongs bslab bya spro ba bskyed/ /gsol btab gnang ba sbyin pa dang / /rtog pa bsdu zhing sdom gsum brtan/ /rgyun bshags dris lan sdom pa bsgrags/ /sdom sgyin sgo gsum byin gyis brlabs/ /so shing dor la bsrung skud gdags/ khyod chu ku sha gzengs stong dang / /rmi lam bstan pa zhes bya ba/ /bcu bdun slob ma sta gon chos / /zhes so/ /de yang dang po ni/ slob ma rnams khrus byas gral la 'khod/ me tog bkye bsdu byas pa la/ sems bskyed gsal btab/ chos 'di'i byung tshul dang / che ba ci rigs par brjod nas/ sdom pa gsum la gnas par bya/ /so sor thar dang byang chub sems/ /rig 'dzin rang gi sdom pa'o/ /zhes bya ba yin pas/ so so thar pa'i sdom pa dang /byang chub sems dpa'i sdom pa la yang dag par gnas pa la dbang bskur bar bshad pa yin pas/so so'i cho gas legs par blangs shing ma nyams pa yin na legs/ de ltar ma yin kyang dkon — 126—

mchog gsum la yang dag par skyabs su song / mi dge ba bcu'i las lam spangs pa'i chos dge ba bcu la gnas pas so thar sdom pa'i dgos pa tshang / sems can thams cad 'khor ba las sgral ba'i phyir sangs rgyas thob 'dod thun mong ma yin pa dang / de thob phyir phar phyin drug sogs byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa khyad par can slob pa'i bsam pa rnam dag bskyed pas sems bskyed blangs pa'i dgos nus kyang 'grub pa yin pa'i phyir/ de rnams kyi bsam pa rnam dag bskyed dgos so zhes gdams/ sngar sdom pa gnyis po phog zin pa yin na/ 'di ma brjod kyang chog go /gnyis pa ni/sngags kyi dngos grub don gnyer gang / /dkyil 'khor 'di 'drar gzhug bya ste/ /bsod nams 'dod pas de las gzhan/ /'jig rten 'di yis bsam pa spangs/ /dad pa chen po ldan pa dag /'jig rten pha rol la dmigs nas/ /blo ldan dkyil 'khor gzhug bya ste/ /bdag don 'di 'dras gnyer mi bya/ /gal te 'di 'dras don gnyer na/ /gzhan don sangs rgyas 'grub mi 'gyur/ /gzhan don pha rol la dmigs na/ /'bad pa med par 'di 'bras 'grub/ /ces brjod la don mug da gsum pa ni/ 'di'i rjes bzlos bya ste/ dga' chen khyod bdag ston pa ste/ /slob dpon khyod ni dgongs su gsol/ /byang chub chen po'i tshul bstan pa/ /mgon po chen po bdag 'tshal lo/ /sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun te/ /skyabs gsum dag kyang bdag la stsole// /byang chub sems kyang bdag la stso'i// /dam tshig de nyid bdag la stsol/ /thar pa chen po'i grong mchog tu/ /mgon pos bdag ni gzhug tu gsol/ /zhes lan gsum/ bzhi pa ni/ bu rlung theg pa chen po yi/khyod ni tshul chen snod yin te/ /gsang sngags spyod tshul cho ga mchog /khyod la yang dag bstan par bya/ /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas gang 'das dang / /de — 127—

bzhin gang dag ma byon pa/ /da ltar byung ba'i rdzogs sangs rgyas/ /'gro la phan phyir bzhugs pa kun/ /de dag kun gyi gsang sngags kyi/ /cho ga bzang po 'di mkhyen te/ /dpa' bo byang chub shing drung du/ /thams cad mkhyen pa tshad med brnyes/ /gsang sngags spyod pa mnyam med de'i/ /ye shes mnyam med thob pas na/ /skyob pa dpal ldan he ru kas/ /bdud sde shin tu mi bzad pa'i/ /dpung chen dag kyang de yis bcom/ /de bas kun mkhyen thob bya'i phyin/ /bu yis blo gros 'di gyis shig /ces brjod la don spyod/ lnga pa ni/rtog pa thams cad legs par bsdus nas ni/ khren tu bsam pa bzang dang ldan pas nyon/ /brjed ngas blo la rdo rje sems dpa' sogs/ /bde bar gshegs pa rnams kyis byin mi rlob/ /ces brjod/ drug pa ni/ bcom ldan dkyil 'khor des gsungs chos/ /de sgrub lha mor bcas pa yi/ /sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun te/ /mchog gsum de la skyabs su mchi/ /dpa' bo dpa' mo dbang lha mo/ /byang chub sems dpa' bdag nyid che/ khyad par du yang slob dpon la/ /rtag par bdag ni skyabs su mchi/ /bdag ni dus 'di nas gzung ste/ sdom gsum ldan pas rang nyid sgrub/ /gzhan la smon pas chos kyang ston/ /'khor dang ldan pa ston par bgyi/ /wo lan gsum rjes bzlos bya'o/ /bdun pa ni/ sgrub thabs bstan rgyas dang / dkyil chog dngul gdong ma'i dngos gzhi'i skabs na rgyun bshags mi 'dra ba re yod cing / rdo rje gdan pas/ dbang med bdag gis sogs kun snying gi gzhung ltar mdzad pas/ rgyun bshags kyi rigs rnams 'dam ga yin kyang /dngul gdong ma'i 'di skabs su/ yan lag lnga/ bdun gang rung byed par gsungs pa nyid 'jug pa bde ba'i phyir snga phyi thams cad du sbyar na legs pas yan lag bdun pa ltar na sgrub thabs kyi —128—

tshogs zhing skabs ltar bya zhing lnga pa la'ang bskul ba gsol 'debs/ bdag 'bul gsum gyi tshigs bcad dor ba nyid do/ /brgyad pa ni/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi/ /gsang ba chen po'i rigs dag pa'i/ /gsang ba yongs su 'dzin par ni/ /bdag nyid chen po khyod 'dod dam/ /lko dris pa la/ bdag nyid chen po bdag 'tshal lags/ /zhes 'don pa spos te lan btab/ dgu pa ni/ sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun te/ /dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su song / /'di ni sangs rgyas rigs dag pa'i/ /sdom pa brtan por gyur pa'o/ /rdo rje dril bu'i phyag rgya ni/ /blo chen khyod kyis bzung bar bya/ /byang chub sems gang de rdo rje/ khres rab dril bu zhes bsgrags so/ /slob dpon khyod kyis bzung bya ste/ /bla ma sangs rgyas kun dang mnyam/ /'di ni rdo rje'i rigs dag pa'i/ /dam tshig sdom pa yin par bshad/ /rin chen rigs mchog chen po yi/ /dam tshig yid du 'ong ba la/ /nyin dang mtshan mo lan gsum du/ /zang zing mi 'jigs chos dang byams/ /sbyin pa rnam bzhi rtag tu byin/ /phyi nang gsang ba theg pa gsum/ /dam chos khyod kyis bzung bar bya / /'di ni pad+ma'i rigs dag pa'i/ /dam tshig yid du 'ong ba'o las kyi rigs mchog chen po la/ /sdom pa thams cad ldan par ni/ /yang dag nyid du bzung bar bgyi/ /mchod pa'i las kyang ci nus bgyi/ /de las gzhan yang bcu bzhi ni/ /phas pham par ni rab tu bshad/ /spangs shing dor bar mi bya ste/ /rtsa ba'i lhung ba zhes bshad do/ /nyin dang mtshan mo lan gsum du/ /nyin re bzhin yang bzlas par bya/ /gang tshe nyams gyur rnal 'byor pa/ kha na ma tho sbom por 'gyur/ khyod kyi srog chags bsad mi bya/ /ma byin par yang blang mi bya/ /'dod —129—

pa log par mi spyad cing / /brdzun du smra bar mi bya'o/ /phung khrol kun gyi rtsa ba yi/ /chang ni rnam par spang bar bya/ /sems can 'dul phyir ma gtogs pa/ /bya ba ma yin thams cad spangs/ /dam pa nye bar bsten bya zhing / /rnal 'byor pa rnams bsnyen bkur bya/ lus kyi las ni rnam gsum dang / /ngag gi rnam pa bzhi dag dang / /yid kyi rnam pa gsum dag ni/ /ci nus par ni rjes su bsrung / /theg pa dman la 'dod mi bya/ /sems can don la rgyab mi phyogs/ /'khor ba dag kyang yongs mi spangs/ /rtag tu mya ngan yongs mi 'da'/ /lha dang lha min gsang ba pa/ khyod kyis brnyas par mi bya ste/ /phyag rgya bzhon pa mtshon cha dang / /mtshan ma 'god par mi bya'o/ /'di dag dam tshig yin par ni/ khyod kyi rtag tu bsrung bar bya/ /rjes mthun sdom pa rgya cher ni/ /gsang ba'i rgyud las yang dag bshad/ /ces lan gsum/ ya pa ni/ slob dpon 'dir ni bdag la gson/ /gtso bos ji ltar bka' stsal pa/ de ltar bdag gis bgyid par 'tshal/ /zhes lan gsum brjod pas khas blangs la/ slar yang sdom pa bzung pa ni/ ji ltar dus gsum mgon po rnams/ /byang chub tu ni nges mdzad pa'i/ /byang chub sems ni bla na med/ /zhes pa nas/ sems can mya ngan las 'das la 'god/ /ces lan gsum/ bcu gcig pa ni/ slob ma skad cig gis rdo rje sems dpa'i skur gyur pa'i dpral bar zla ba la lko las/ 'khor lo oṃ gyis mtshan pa las sku rdo rje sku mdog dkar po 'khor lo dang dril bu 'dzin pa/ mgrin par sna tshogs pad+ma la a las pad+ma dmar po us mtshan pa las gsung rdo rje sku mdog dmar po pad+ma dang dril bu 'dzin pa/snying gar nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor la hu las rdo rje hū gis mtshan pa las thugs rdo —130—

rje sku mdog mthing ga rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pa rnams su gyur/ slob ma'i gnas gsum du bdud rtsi lnga dang dri bzang sbyar ba'i thig le bya/ slob dpon gyi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ sangs rgyas byang sems thams cad sku gsung thugs rdo rje'i rnam par spyan drangs/ slob ma'i gnas gsum du bstim/ mchod pa rnam lnga byin gyis brlabs te/ so so'i sngags dang phyag rgyas phul ba'i mthar/ dus 'di nas ni gzung nas su/'khor ba'i nyes pas ma gos par/ /mchod pa kun dang ldan pa yi/ /dus kun tu ni dge bar mnos/ /zhes brjod yang slob ma rnams kyis rang gi gnas gsum gyi rdo rje gsum la gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos byed du 'jug ste/ oṃ sku yi rdo rje sku yi mchog /ye shes dang ldan gti mug sel/ /bcom ldan gtso bo sku rdo rje/ /sku yi rdo rje phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes gsol ba btab pas/ sku rdo rje slob ma'i lus la thim pas/lus sku rdo rje'i ngo bor gyur par mos la/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta kwa ya badz+ra swa bha wa ud+ma ko3haX/ zhes nga rgyal 'dzin du 'jug de bzhin du/gsung gi rdo rje gsung gi mchog /so sor rtog pas 'dod chags 'joms/ /bcom ldan gtso bo gsung rdo rje/ /gsung gi rdo rje: zhes gsol ba btab pas gsung rdo rje slob ma'i ngag la thim pas/ ngag gsung rdo rje'i ngo bor gyur par mos la/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta wā ka badz+ra swa bhā wa ut+pa ko3haX/ de bzhin du/ thugs kyi rdo rje thugs dam bskul/ /dag pa'i rang bzhin zhe sdang sbyong / /bcom ldan gtso bo thugs rdo rje/ /thugs kyi rdo rje phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes gsol ba btab pas/ thugs rdo rje slob ma'i yid la thim pas/ yid thugs rdo rje'i ngo bor gyur/ oX sarba ta thā ga ta tsit+ta badz+ra swa bhā wa ut+pa ko3haX/tsasti/ oṃ su pra tiṣ+ṭha badz+re swāhā/ zhes me tog 'thor zhing brtan par yang bya'o/ /bcu —131—

gnyis pa ni/ ba lci'i maṇ+ḍal thig bzhis le'u tshe dgur bgos pa zhig byas la/ byang chub kyi shing du mos pa'i so shing ā khaX lī ra huX zhes brjod pas slob ma'i lag tu btang la/ 'chal ba'i tshul bgyis pas sdig sgrib thams cad skyugs par bsam zhing / oṃ ā khaX ldi ra hūX zhes so shing gi rwa bar 'dor du gzhug go/ltas brtag pa spyi dang 'dra/ bcu gsum pa ni/ huX las byung ba'i bsrung skud mdud pa gsum la oṃ āXhūX yongs su gyur pa las/ sku gsung thugs rdo rje'i lha gsum/ slob dpon gyi snying ga'i huX las 'od 'phros/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyi thugs ka nas/ ye shes kyi sras bu rdo rje gsum dang bcas pa badz+ra sa mā dzaX dzaXhūX baX hoX lha gsum zhu ba las mdud pa'i rnam par gyur/ skyes pa'i dpung pa g.yon dang / bud med kyi g.yas dang / byis pa'i mgul du gdags so/ /bcu bzhi pa ni/oṃ hi bi shurnya dharma sarba pā paX ni tsa a spya re(dha ya sarba bi kalpa na a pā ya huX/ zhes lan gsum gyis khyor chu byin/ bco lnga pa ni/ dhī las byung ba'i ku sha /oṃ āXbadz+ra lha ka hūX/zhes lag pa g.yas su byin te sngas kyi don dang / ha las byung ba'i ku sha oṃ āXkhaX wi ra huX/ lko/ lag pa g.yon du sbyin te stan gyi don to/ / ༅ drug pa ni/'jig rten du ni kun mkhyen rnams/ /u dum ba ra'i me tog bzhin/ /rgya lam na ni res 'ga' zhig /'byung 'gyur yang ni mi 'byung ngo / /gsang sngags spyod pa'i tshul 'byung ba/ /de bas kyang ni dkon pa ste/ /gnyis med zab mo'i spyod tshul ni/ /sems can thams cad sangs rgyas byed/ /gang gis bskal pa grangs med du/ /mtshams med sdig pa byas pa yang / /de kun gyis ni dkyil 'khor 'di/ /mthong bas sdig pa byang 'gyur na/ /grags pa mtha' yas sngags spyod pa'i/ /tshul la gnas na smos ci dgos/ /gang gis bskal pa bye ba sa /bsod —132—

nams ye shes tsho gis bsags kyang / /'di ni mthong ba shin tu dka'/ /lam mchog 'di ni dpal dang ldan/ /thams cad de bzhin gshegs nyid 'gyur/ /theg mchog 'di la dga' bar gyis/ /zhes brjod la don 4zhad/ bcu bdun pa ni/nangs par dkyil 'khor chen po mthong bar 'gyur bas dga' ba rgya chen po gyis la/ ku sha'i gdan la sesgo'i nyal stabs dang dge ba'i sems kyis nyol cig /rmi lam ci mthong ba de yang nangs par nga la legs par smos shig /ces brjod la slob ma rnams rang gnas su btang ngo / /gsum pa ni sta gon gyi dkyil 'khor nam mkhar btegs par mos la/ gtso bo rnams kyi snying po'i mthar/ oṃ badz+ra be ga a kra ma ho zhes pa'i sngags dang phyag rgya lha grangs dang mnyam pa sbyar bas nam mkhar bzhugs par bsam la las thams cad pa'i sngags dang bum chus mtha' nas bskor te phyogs bcings par bsam/ ar+gha nas sha lta'i bar gyi mchod/ thun mong du 'bru gsum gyis nang mchod phul/ a nu rā ga'i sngags kyis gsang mchod kyang phul/ mngon rtogs ltar bstod pas bstod/ skabs 'dir rdo rje gdan pa'i dkyil chog dang / dngul gdong ma gnyis car na/ gsol gdan rgyas par byed par bshad na'ang /sngar gong du snyan mnan pa byas zin na lan gnyis su mi dgos pas/ gong du byed pa dang / 'dir byed par 'dam gar dgongs pa yin no/ /'on kyang dngul gdong ma las byung ba'i gsol btab bsdus pa 'di bya ste/ bdug spos 'thul bzhin du spos phor thogs nas/ ma lus phyogs bcur bzhugs pa yi/ /sangs rgyas bdag la dgongs su gsol/ / bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi ba yis/ /rdo rje can gyi dkyil 'khor 'bri/ /sangs rgyas la sogs kun 'byon 'tshal/ /dngos grub 'dir ni yang dag stsol/ /zhes lan gsum/ 'di mchod pa rgyun mi 'chad par 'bul na/ lhag gnas kyi nangs par bya ba yin na'ang / mchod pa de — 133—
