bzhin mi 'grub na lhag gnas kyi mjug nyid du byed pa deng sang gi lag len nyid legs so/ /lnga pa la/ thig gdab pa/ tsho ni gyi 'bri ba/ rgyan dgod pa'o/ /dang po la las thig gdab pa dang / ye shes kyi thig gis byin gyis brlabs pa'i lugs kyang yod mod kyi/ dkyil chog gnyisacar gyi dgongs pa ye shes kyi thig gdab pa'i rjes su las thig gi cha 'byed pa nyid yin no/ /de yang 'di ltar thig skud bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las/ thig skud kyi gnas dang nam mkha'i lha tshogs rnams kyi thugs kar bhu a dzi kha hu las 'od 'phros/'phags pa mchod/ sems can gyi don byas te thim/ hu las thig skud nag po mi bskyod pa sku mdog nag po rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pa la yum mā ma kis 'byud pa/ bhu las thig skud dkar po rnam snang dkar po 'khor lo dang dril bu 'dzin pa la/ yum sangs rgyas spyan mas 'khyud pa/ a las thig skud ser po rin chen 'byung ldan ser po nor bu dang dril bu 'dzin pa la yum rin chen sgrol mas 'byud pa/ dzi las thig skud dmar po 'od dpag med dmar po pad+ma dang dril bu 'dzin pa la/ yum gos dkar mos 'khyud pa/ kha las thig skud ljang khu don yod grub pa ljang khu ral gri dang dril bu 'dzin pa la/ yum dam tshig sgrol mas 'khyud pa/ yab lnga rdo rje'i skyil krung gyis bzhugs shing / yum lnga yab dang mtshungs pa las pad+ma'i skyil krung can/ thams cad kyang dar dang rin po che'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa'o/ /dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par ā thugs kar hu/ ar+gha nas shasta'i bar lan gnyis kyis mchod/ de nyid lnga pa tshar gcig gis bstod/ lha lnga zhu ba las byung ba'i thig skud du gyur/ thig skud sgril bzhi du/ oṃ a rgyo n+ya/ a nu ga ta/sarba dharma pa ra spa ra/ a nu pra khrus sarba dharma urun+ta/ a nu pra pri sna sarba dharma hū/—134—

zhes lan ma/nga du bzlas la/ dza zhes brje shod pas nam mkha'i lha rnams kyi thugs ka nas ye shes kyi thig skud spyan drangs te thig skud la thim/ dza hū ba ho zhes lan lnga brjod/ slob dpon nub dang slob ma shar du gnas/ rdzi hū ཾ tho zhes thig skud gtad cing thig sna drangs/ myos badz+ra sa ma ya phi//tra ma ti kra ma hu/ zhes lan mang du bzlas la/ slob dpon gyi rdo rje dang bcas pa'i lag g.yas kyis steng dang 'og tu thig btab pas/ sems can dom na du khyed rnams kyis/ dus yin de ring 'dir spyon cig /ces pa'i sgra byung nas sangs rgyas thams cad spyan drangs nas thig la thim/ zhes pa thig chen brgyad ka la sbyar la/ shar nub kha bltas tshangs thig dang po btab/ /lho byang kha bltas gnyis pa btab par bya/ /me dang dbang ldan nas ni shar thig btab/ /rlung dang srin po nas ni nub thig btab/ /rlung dang dbang ldan nas ni byang thig btab/ /mer gnas srin po nas ni lho thig btab/ /me rlung gnyis nas log thig dang po btang/srin dbang gnas pa'i log thig gnyis pa btab/ /gnyis gnyis sbyar ba'i dang po slob dpon gnas/ /phyi ma slob ma'i gnas su shes par bya/ /g.yas skor dang ni rgyab 'gros byed pa dang /phyogs rnams ma 'khrul ba ni nges par bya/ /de ma thig / ye (le ka thig la gong bzhin mchod bstod bya ste/ ye shes pa gshe/gas/ thig skud de nyid kyi las thig gdab par bya ste/ dbus su phur bu btab la/ de nyid du phyung ste phur khung bya'o/ /bya rjes btsal las thig gi thig chen brgyad rlon thig tu btab/ de nas skam thig thig ring du btab na les sa shing / min na'ang cha bcu drug tu bgo ba'i bar skam thig tu btab/ de phyin chad thig thung du btab pas drang ngo / /de yang / lte ba nas rtsa thig gi bar nyis 'gyur du bya rjes byas la/ rta babs kyi rtse mo'i logs thig bya'o/ /de nyid logs gtub gsum byas la cha bcu drug tu bgo'o/ /de la thog mar gzhi dkyil gyi thig byas la/ de'i 'og tu dbus kyi pho brang lnga po'i thig gdab bo/ /'di la rta babs ni snam bu bcu gcig sgo tshad gsum/ — 135 —

ma'am/ yang na sgo tshad gnyis ma rta babs rgyan ldan du grags pa bya yi sgo tshad gcig ma dang / snam bu bzhi ma ni brgyud pa 'di'i lugs la nam yang med do/ /snam bu bcu gcig ma la yang gnyis mnyam dgu mnyam kho na mdzad kyin snang la/ slob dpon gzhan rnams kyi ba ched pa rta babs rgyan can yin cing / rdo rje gdan pa'i bzhed pa ni bcu gcig ma'o zhes gsung la/ a bha yā ka ras bzhed pa snam bu bcu gcig ma yang rdo rje gdan pa che chung nas brgyud pa'i man ngag yin par phreng ba nyid nas bshad pa sogs gung mthun no/ /gzhi dkyil gyi nang du rdo rje'i rwa ba zlum po le'u tshe dgu dang bcas pa byed pa rdo rje gdan pa'i dkyil chog gis bsal zhing / dngul gdong ma las ni/ rdo rje'i rwa ba dang / dur khrod brgyad me ri dang bcas pa yang 'bri bar mdzad pa ni/ gzhi dkyil med par khyams le tshe dgu pa'i nang du dkyil 'khor lnga po rta babs can re mdzad pa'i lugs su mngon no/ /'on kyang deng sang lag len la/ gzhi dkyil gyi nang du/ rdo rje'i phreng ba'ang mi byed pa shas che ba lag len gdam nga yin par shes par bya'o/ /gang na'ang gzhi dkyil gyi rtsa thig nang du cha chung gnyis de'i lha snam kyi sar 'jog pa rdo rje'i rwa ba yod pa'i lugs dang / lha snam stong zad yod kyang nang gi dkyil 'khor gyi pha gu drwa phyed shar bu mda' yab rnams kyis sgrib pa'i phyir/ nang ma'i mda' yab dang bcas rtsa thig gi bar tu ma 'brel tsam gyi bar snang ma gtogs med par byed pa rdo rje'i 'phreng ba mi byed pa'i lugs gnyis shes par byas nas/ thig bzhis dbus kyi le'u tshe dgu bgos la/ dbus dang phyogs bzhir dkyil 'khor lnga so so'i thig rnams btab bo/ /de yang 'di ltar/dbus su mtshan ma legs btab nas/ shar nub tshangs thig drang por btab/ /rim pas bya rjes btsal nas ni/ /tshangs thig gnyis la zur thig gnyis/ /logs gtub gsum gyis cha bcu drug /rta babs sgo tshad gsum ma la/ /phyi ru cha chen re re mnan/ /'dir ni thun mong min pa'i phyir/ /sgo tshad gnyis ma'i dbang du bya/ /dang po gnyis pa cha chen bzhin bgo /gsum pa'i nang du cha — 136—

chung gcig /bzhi pa rang sar ba theg par bya/ /lnga pa dbus dor mtha' gnyis gdab/ /drug pa phyed gdab phyi ma gdab/ bdun pa brgyad pa cha bzhir bgo /gsum pa'i phyed du gdab bya ba/ /'di ni bdun pa brgyad pa la/ /thig thung gdab par bya ba nyid/ /bcu bcu gcig rtsa ba'i thig yin te/ /thig chen brgyad kyi logs thig go /bcu bdun pa ni mda' yab thig /de gnyis zur nas zur du'o/ /rtsa ba'i thig las phyi rol du/ /zur nas ngos su thig lnga las/ /dang po gsum par reg par bya/ /lhag ma bzhi ni dgu par reg /tshangs thig ngos las thig gnyis pa/ /rtsa thig nas ni bcu bzhi'i bar/ /de nas ngos su bzhi pa'i bar/ /steng du bco lnga pa la reg /rtse nas rtse ru bco lnga pa/ /tshangs las gsum pa bcu gnyis nas/ /bcu gsum pa yi bar du'o/ /de nas ngos su lnga pa'i bar/ /steng du bcu drug pa la reg /rtse nas rtse ru bcu drug pa/ /tshangs las drug bdun brgyad dgu rnams/ /bcu gnyis bcu bdun bar du'o/ /rta babs brgyan ldan zhes bya ba/ /sgo tshad gnyis ma yin par brjod/ /pad+ma zla ba gdung snam dang / /nyi ma pad+ma bre gdan dang / /bre dang pad+ma zhes bya brgyad/ /rta babs snam bu'i grangs su 'dod/ /tshangs las g.yas g.yon dang po'i thig /bcu dgu pa dang 'dzom sa nas/ /cha chung gnyis gnyis g.yas g.yon bskor/ /de yi sne nas cha chung re/ /bskor te mda' yab la reg bya/ /de snang cha chung phyed kyis bskor/ /glang rgyab dbus bsnol mig gsum 'grub/ /snam bu dang po'i 'og gi ni/ /gdung sna dgu pa'i g.yas g.yon du/ /cha chung re res ring ba'o/ /tshangs las brgyad nas dgu pa'i bar/ /pad snam dang po bcad par bya/ /snam bu gnyis pa drug steng bcad/ /snam bu gsum pa brgyad pa la'o/ /'di la steng dang 'og dag tu/ /cung zad bzhug nas dbus su gcod/ /bzhi pa bzhi nas bcad par bya/ /lnga pa drug nas lnga yi bar/ /drug pa gnyis nas gsum gyi bar/ /steng du rgyas pa'i tshul gyi bcad/ /bdun pa gnyis pa'i steng nas bcad/ /brgyad pa gsum nas gnyis su bcad/ /dang po lnga pa brgyad pa gsum/ /pad+ma yin no thams cad la/ /'og tu — 137—

cha chung gsum cha'i gdung / /steng du'ang pad kheb de dang mnyam/ /nang du bskor thig la reg gdab/ /gsum pa la yang steng 'og tu/ /gdung khebs gdung gdan gnyis kyi thig /gdab bo zhing du thig gnyis so/ /so gsum gnyis nas gnyis kyi bar/ /sum cu gsum nas gsum gyi bar/ /nyer dgu'ang gsum nas gsum bar ro/ /nyer brgyad lnga nas lnga yi bar/ /nyer lnga drug nas drug gi bar/ /nyer bzhi nyer gcig gnyis po ni/ /bdun dang brgyad kyi dbus su bzung / /nyi shu pa ni brgyad par reg /de rjes pad+ma phyi ma ni/ /gnyis kyi bar khebs rtse mo la/ kha bad ze'u 'khru'i rnam pa 'dri/ /gdung gdan gyi ni nang thig dang / /tshangs las gnyis pa 'dzom sa nas/ /cha chung drug gi nang rwa bskor/ /gdung khebs kyi ni nang thig dang / /tshangs phyir bzhi pa 'dzom pa nas/ /snga ma'i tshad kyi phyi rwa bskor/ /sbags rwa la sogs 'dir mi bzhed/ /dbus kyi rdo rje'i rwa rtse ni/ /dkyus su cha chen gcig yin la/ /tshangs las g.yas g.yon cha chung ni/ /phyed dang gnyis gnyis rtsa ba'i zhing / /rtse mo'i tshang la nges pa med/ /'on kyang snon por bya'o gsung / /dbus kyi rwa rtse'i phyi rol du/ khyams thig pad thig dur khrod thig /rdo rje'i thig dang 'og thig ste/ /skor thig lnga po rim bzhin bskor/ /de rnams tshad ni spyi dang 'dra/ /rtsa ba'i thig gi nang ngos su/ /cha chung re re yongs bor ba/ /nang gi thig tu 'gyur ba ste/ /tshangs las g.yas g.yon cha chung lnga/ /bor bar thig dang drug par thig /bsnol mar btab pas nang gi ni/ /dkyil 'khor lnga yis sa cha 'byung / /phyogs bzhi'i dkyil chi bzhi po la/ /cha chung phyed re g.yas g.yon phri/ /nang gi dkyil 'khor lnga po ni/ /re re la yang tshangs zur gyi/ /thig bzhi btab nas de rjes la/ /zur thig steng nas gsum gtubs kyi/ /cha ni gsum gsum bgo bar bya/ /de la'ang gnyis gnyis phye nas ni/ /lnga pa dbus dor mtha' gnyis gdab/ /drug pa phyed gdab phyi ma gdab/ /dang po phyed gdab phyi ma gdab/ /gnyis pa'i nang du cha chung gcig /btab pas sgo khang 'grub par 'gyur/ /ka ba ka rgyan mun snam rnams/ /dkyil 'khor — 138—

nang ma rnams la med/ /de dag med phyir rta babs med/ /de rnams spyi'i mtshan nyid do/ /dbus ma dang ni nub ma la/ /lha snam mi 'jog zlum thig bskor/ /'dab brgyad pad+ma'i gcus thig btab/ /nub ma la ni 'od zer gyi/ /pa ṭa'i nang du rdo rje'i phreng / /de gnyis cha chung re re'o/ /pad+ma 'ang mnyam gsum bya ba yin/ /dbus kyi ji du 'dab brgyad ni/ /lte ba g.yas g.yon cha chen ni/ /phyed dang gnyis kyi mtshams nas bskor/ /de nas ze'u 'bru cha chung gcig /de yi phyi rol g.yas g.yon du/ /cha chung brgyad kyi 'dab ma bskor/ /phyi ru cha chung gcig 'byung ba/ /rdo rje'i phreng ba'i thig yin no/ /'di ni nye ba cha chen gsum/ /'dab ma cha chen gnyis pa'i lugs/ /gzhan la yongs su ma grags na'ang / /'di nyid kyi ni rang lus so/ /dkyil 'khor shar dang byang ma la/ /rtsig pa'i nang du cha chen re/ /lha snam tshul du bzhag nas ni/ /dbus su zlum bskor re mig dgu /spyi dang mthun par gdab pa yin/ /de yang bzhi pa la reg par/ /rdo rje'i phyi thig bskor nas ni/ /de nang cha chung gcig kyang bskor/ /tshangs las g.yas g.yon gsum pa dang / /bzhi pa'i gdung thig bsnol mar gdab/ /des ni re mig dgu par gyur/ khar ma la ni 'od zer gyi/ /'phreng ba'i don du rdo rje'i thig /cha chung gcig pa gnyis su bgo /byang ma'i phyogs bzhi'i re mig tu/ /rdo rje'i rwa thig spyi dang 'dra/ /lho ma'i nang du gdab bya ba/ /lte ba nas bzung rtsa thig bar/ /cha chung bcu drug legs bgos nas/ /gnyis pa'i steng nas bskor ba dang / /lnga drug bar dang dgu pa dang / /bcu gnyis bcu gsum par dang ni/ /bcu drug pa nas bskor te lnga/ /gtso gnas dang ni 'khor lo bzhi'i/ /phyi thig yin par shes bya ste/ /tshangs thig steng nas bskor bar bya/ /dang po phyi dang gzhan rnams kyi/ /nang du cha chung phyed re bskor/ /ge sar dang ni phreng ba'i thig /skor thig lnga yi bar dag tu/ /dang por 'dab brgyad gcus thig gdab/ /phyi rol gyi ni bar stong gsum/ /'khor lo'i rtsibs kyi sa yin te/ /de yang rtsibs dang rtsibs can gnyis/ /gsum gnyis gsum che'i rtse mo ni/ /rtsa ba'i zhing las g.yas g.yon du/ /cha — 139—

chung re res phra bar bya/ /lte ba'i phyogs ni rtsibs can te/ /mu khyud phyogs ni rtse mo'o/ /rtsibs rnams kyi ni bar bar du/ /zhing ni cha chung re re yi/ /ka ba'i thig ni gdab bya ste/ /mu khyud nas ni mu khyud bar/ /skor thig rnams la rim pa bzhin/ /lte ba 'dab ma 'dab shun dang / /mu khyud rtsibs dang mu khyud dang / /slar yang rtsibs dang mu khyud ni/ /lan gnyis su ni brjod pa yin/ /'dir ni de tsam gyis chog la/ /nang gi cha shas dbye ba zhib mo dag ni/ rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor la bri bar dka' zhing / de bzhin du thig gdab par dka'o/ /de'i phyir mi mkho bas ma bris so/ /gang dag bri bas las shin tu mkhas pa'am/ dkyil 'khor gyi tshad chen por 'bri ba dang / ras bris la sogs pa dag la ni/ nang gi cha dbye ba shin tu phra ba dag kyang shes dgos te/ 'on kyang so so'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga 'a sa 'byung ba rnams kyis rigs 'gre ba'i phyir 'dir ma smos so/ /dgyes mdzad dang sdom pa'i dbus kyi pad+ma'i cha tshad ni lugs 'di'i thun mong ma yin pa yin cing / ka ba ka rgyan rtsig pa'i thig la reg pa ni/ rgya bal bod gsum gyi sngags pa rnying pa gzhan mang po zhig la yang yod do/ /de bzhin du rta babs rgyan ldan yang ste/ 'di ni phyis kyi rgya gar ba mang po la yang snang ngo / /gzhan yang rta babs tshad can dang / tshad med du 'dod pa sngon dus kyi rdo rje 'dzin pa rnams la'ang ci rigs su yod cing / 'phags pa'i yul du ni/ sngon ni tshad med du 'dod pa mang zhing / phyis ni tshad can du 'dod pa mang ste/ de yang sgo tshad gsum mar 'dod pa mang ngo / /'dir rta babs snam bu bcu gcig mar byed pa'i tshe yang / ka ba cha chung bdun pa dang / mun snam 'khor mo dang / zla phyed rdo rje yang mun snam la gnas pa dang / 'dod snam ka ba la thug pa tsam byed pa sogs gong dang 'dra bar bya'o/ /zhor la 'ongs pa ste spros pas chog go /gnyis pa ni/ rdul tshon rnams bsangs sbyangs thig skud zhes pa'i gnas su rdul tsho ni zhes pa ma gtogs/ mchod bstod/ rigs lnga zhu bas rdul tshone du bsgyur ba'i bar thig — 140—

skud skabs dang 'dra/ yi ge 'bru gsum lan mang du brjod cing mnyes/ dza zhes pa nas/ dza hū ba ho : zhes pa'i bar yang gong bzhin las 'don pa spo/ oṃ badz+ra tsi tra sa ma ya hū/ zhes lan mang du bzlas/ phur khung bkang / dbang ldan gyi rtsig pa mdzub gang tsam du bris te/'di ni chos dbyings dag pa ste/ /sems can khams ni rab sgrol byed/ /dpal ldan khrag 'thung rgyal po nyid/ /de bzhin gshegs pa kun gyi gnas/ /nyes pa kun las rnam grol ba/ /tshon gyi las ni yang dag brtsam/ /zhes brjod/ thod pa sogs kyi bkab ste/ rdo rjes mnan/ phyis sbrel ran pa na sbrel te sna'i bkra rtag go /rdul tsho ni rnams g.yas skor du dgye'o/ /de la tshon gyis mtshan nyid ni/ rtsig pa kha dog lnga phyi nang mthun par nang nas rim pa bzhin sngo ljang dmar ser dkar ba'o/ /gzhal yas khang gi lha snam rnams thams cad mthun par/ shar dkar/ lho ser/ nub dmar/ byang ljang ba mngon rtogs ltar dgyes mdzad thod pa can la lho dmar nub ser ba/ ma hā mā ya la shar sngo nub dkar bar mdzad pa'i lugs kyang yod pa shin tu legs par yang mngon no/ /'dod snam dmar po pha gu ser po/ drwa phyed kyi gzhi nag po/ dra phyed dkar po de yang kha phyir bstan pa dang / me tog 'phreng ba dang / dar dpyangs sogs mdzes tshon/shar bu sngon po/ mda' yab dkar po/ mun snam nag po/ ka ba nang ma ser po/ phyi ma dkar po/ ka rgyan glang po che mnan pa'i seng ge dang / de'i phyi sa gdung sna las dpyangs pa'i dar dpyangs rma/dzes tsho ni/ glang rgyab phyogs mdog /rta babs snam bu bcu gcig ltar na/ gser snam ser po/ shar bu sngon po/ rin chen dmar po/ rmig pa ljang khu/ mun pa nag po/ wa ra na mdzes tshon/ rdo rje'i rwa phyogs mdog /khyams ljang ser/ pad+ma rnams sna tshogs kyi mdog dur khrod kyi gzhi nag po la me ri rnams kha dog rnam lnga'i rim pas 'bri'o/ /nang gi gzhal yas khang rnams la rta babs med pas ka ba ka rgyan mun snam yang med pa'i de'i phyir 'dod snam sgom khyud kyi rtsig pa la reg pa dang / pha gu drwa — 141 —

phyed shar bu mda' yab rnams kyang sgo logs kyi rtsig pa la reg pa'o/ /de nas dgyes mdzad thod pa can la/ rtsig pa la reg pa'i rdo rje'i phreng ba dang gong ras nag po/ pad 'dab phyogs bzhi dmar la me rlung ser/ bden bral ljang la dbang ldan sngo/ ze'u 'bru khra bo lhe ba mthing ga /lha snam gyi gru chad phyogs mdog /gsang ba 'dus pa la/ lha snam dang / rim pa gnyis pa'i gru bcad rnams phyogs mdog /de gnyis kyi bar re kha nag pos bcad/ de la ma reg tsam rdo rje nag po'i phreng ba zlum po nang le'u tshe dgu lte ba mthing ga /re mig phyogs mdog /ka ba'i mtshan ma phyogs mdog /gdung phyi nang rnams nag po la rdo rje dmar po'i phreng ba rnams so/ /'khor lo bde mchog la/ sgo'i rtsig pa la ma reg tsam nas sku 'khor gyi mu khyud bri ste/ sku 'khor dkar po/ rtsibs bar gyi ka ba dang mu khyud la 'khor lo'i phreng ba/ gsung 'bor dmar po ka ba dang mu khyud la pad+mas mtshan pa/ thugs 'khor lo sngon po ka ba dang mu khyud la rdo rjes mtshan pa/ bde chen 'khor lo'i mu khyud ser po la gri gug ljang khus mtshan pa/ sna tshogs pad+ma gong dang 'dra/ lha snam gyi gru bcad dang sku 'khor gyi rtsibs bar phyogs mdog /gsung 'khor gyi rtsibs bar dkar po/ thugs 'khor gyi rtsibs bar dmar po/ bde chen 'khor lo'i gong ras mthing ga /mahā mā ya yang dgyes mdzad dang 'dra ba las/ lha snam bzhag pa dang / rdo rje'i phreng ba med pa'o/ /rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi dkyil 'khor la/ sgo'i rtsig pa la ma reg tsam du rdo rje'i zlum po dang / dbus su'ang rdo rje'i gdung zlum po/ bar bar du gdung thung brgyad kyis re mig brgyad du byas pa/ lte ba mthing ga gzhan rnams phyogs mdog /phyogs kyi re mig gi nang du/sna tshogs rdo rje'i rwa rnams kyang phyogs mdog /gdung thams cad nag po la rdo rje sngo skya'i mtshan pa 'bri'o/ /da ni lha'i mtshan ma la sogs pa rnams bshad par bya ste/ dkyil 'khor dbus ma'i lte ba la nyi gdan gyi steng du/ sna tshogs rdo rjes mtshan pa'i thod pa dang gri gug go /'dab ma brgyad la nyi ma'am zla ba'i gdan la/ byang shar nas g.yas skor gyis/ seṅge/ gri gug /dge slong / shā ma sa— 142—

'khor lo/ rus sbal/ rdo rje sbrul rnams lha'i sku mdog dang mthun par bri/ dkyil 'khor shar ma'i re mig dgu'i dbus su/ nyi gdan la rdo rje sngon po/ lha gnas gzhan rnams su nus shing spro na mngon rtogs bzhin lha'i gdan 'bri ba yin na'ang/ bsdu myo sgo skyong bzhi ma gtogs pa la mtshan ma kho na bris kyang chog ste/ re'u mig brgyad la g.yas skor gyi 'khor lo dang mig 'bras dang / rin po che dang / rdo rje sngon po dang / pad+ma dang / yang pad+ma dang / sna tshogs rdo rje dang / ut+pal sngon po rnam/sa 'bri/ rim pa gnyis pa'i grwa bzhir/ me long / pi wa/ dri'i dung chos/ ro mchog gis gang ba'i snod rnams bri/ de bzhin du shar sgo'i g.yas nas brtsams te rim pas/ 'khor los mtshan pa'i klu shing gi me tog dang / rin po che dang / yang rin po che dang / pad+ma dang yang pad+ma dang / sna tshogs rdo rje dang /yang sna tshogs rdo rje rnams 'dri/ shar sgo'i tho ba/ lho sgor dbyug pa dkar po/ nub sgor pad+ma dmar po/ byang sgor rdo rje nag po rwa gdengs pa/ shar lhor ral gri/ lho nub tu lcags kyu/ nub byang du be con nag po/ byang shar du rdo rje rtse gsum/ shar gyi glang rgyab kyi nang du 'khor lo/ nub kyi glang rgyab kyi nang du/ gtun shing rnams kha dog dmigs gsal med pa rnams sku mdog dang mthun par 'bri'o/ /dkyil 'khor lho ma'i bde chen 'khor lo'i dbus su rdo rje dang gri gug /phyogs kyi 'dab ma bzhi la kha ṭī ga /mtshams kyi 'dab ma bzhi la bum thod/ thugs 'khor gyi rtsibs brgyad la rdo rje/gsung 'khor gyi brgyad la pad+ma/ sku 'khor gyi brgyad la 'khor lo/ sgo mtshams brgyad la gri gug rnams nyi ma'i gdan la lha'i sku mdog dang ma/tshungs pa 'bri'o/ /dkyil 'khor nub ma'i lte ba la thod pa dang kha ṭī ga phyogs kyi 'dab ma bzhi la g.yas bskor gyi rdo rje nor bu/ pad+ma ral gri mtshams bzhir bum thod/ gzhal yas khang byang ma'i lte bar rdo rje'am gri gug gam ral gri gang rung / re mig brgyad la shar nas g.yas skor gyis 'khor lo dang / yang 'khor lo dang nor bu dang / yang nor bu dang / pad+ma dang / yang pad+ma dang / ral gri dang / yang ral gri dang / lha snam ba༈zhe na/ rim pa — 143—

gnyis pa'i grwa bzhir pad+ma la gnas pa thod pa khrag gang shar gyi lha snam la/ gri gug/'phang mdung /gtun shing / chu gri/ rdo rje rtse gcig pa/ lcags kyu lhe'i lha snam la/ stu re/ mda'/ dbyug pa / kha ṭā ga /'khor lo zhags pa/ nub kyi lha snam la/ rdo rje/ cang tes phub/ gzhu/ dril bu/ rlud ras/byang gi lha snam la sdigs mdzub/ 'phan rtse gsum pa/ glang lpags/ tho ba/ mdung ring / me thab rnams 'god pa'i lugs kyang yod/ lha snam ma bton na de dag 'gog mi dgos shing / thod pa bzhi yang gru chad bzhi la bri'o/ khar sgor tho ba/ lho sgor be con/ nub sgor pad+ma / byang sgor ral gri ste/de rnams lha'i sku mdog dang mthun pa re mig brgyad gyi shar dang / shar lho la zla gdan dang / gzhan rnams nyi gdan la bri'o/ /phyi nang gi dkyil 'khor thams cad la bkra shis kyi bum pa brgyad 'bri zhing / gzhi dkyil gyi grwa bzhi po la mchod pa sna tshogs mdzes tshon du 'bri bar bshad pa la/ deng sang lag len ni/ bum pa las thon pa'i me tog zlum 'dzings pad+ma brgyad brgyad yod pa la mtshan ma brgyad brgyad 'khod pa'am/ pad+ma 'dab brgyad kyi lte bar bum pa bzang po re re/ 'dab ma brgyad la 'khor lo rin po che sogs brgyad dam/ sgeg sogs brgyad dam/ dngos grub brgyad la sogs pa ji ltar bde bar 'god do/ /bum pa thams cad dang / rta babs kyi rtse mo'i ri dwags ni ser po'o /gdugs rnams dkar po/ gzhan rgyan rnams mdzes chon du bya/ gzhi dkyil gyi sgo bzhir yang nyi rma 'i gdan la lcags kyu zhags pa lcags sgrog dril bu rnams 'bri bar de kho na nyid rig pa ri dag 'dom par mdzad la/ nam mkhar bzhugs pa'i dgyes mdzad lha dgu'i mtshan ma ni 'god dgos pa ma yin te/ thod pa can lha dgu dang don gcig pa'i phyir ces gsung ngo / /rta babs sgo tshad gnyis ma ltar na/ pad+ma'i snam bu dbus sngon po dang ljang khu spel mar bya zhing / pad+ma phyi ma gnyis kyi kha bad khra bo/ zla ba dkar po/ nyi ma dmar po/ bre gdan dmar po/ bre dkar po/ gdung gdan dang gdung khebs dmar ser/ gdung snam dngos dang / pad+ma gsum gyi 'og gi gdung dang / steng gi bad khebs — 144—

rnams ni gser mdog ste 'di la rta babs kyi rtse mo'i pad+ma 'khor lo gdugs ri dwags rnams la tshad nges pa med do/ /gdung khebs dang / pad+ma'i snam bu gnyis pa'i kha bad kyi steng gi g.yas g.yon du dril bu'i snam pa'i mchod rten gha ṭi ra ser po dang bcas pa re bya/ glang rgyab kyi phyi ngos rtsa bar chu srin dang / rtse mor mkha' lding gi gdong dang / phyi skor du gser gyi pa tras bskor ba/ nang du drwa phyed sogs dpyangs shing / glang rgyab kyi nang gi rtser de bzhin gzhags pa rigs bzhi'i phyag mtshan phra mo re 'bri zhing / rta babs kyi snam bu thams cad la ma nges pa'i rgyan sna tshogs pa'o/ /phyi nang gi gzhal yas khang thams cad kyi snod dang sgo khyud kyi mtshams su zla phyed rdo rje dang / 'dod snam kyi steng du lha mo'i mtshan ma me tog bcu drug bcu drug dang / zur bzhir zla phyed nor bu'o/ /de ltar legs par tshar ba dang / tshon gyi lhag ma rnams mchod bstod ye shes pa gshegs pa rnams bya ste/ ji lta ra bde bar bzhag go /gsum pa ni/ de ma thag tu las thams cad pa'i bum chus dkyil 'khor dang yo byad thams cad bsangs sbyangs la/ sa rgyan gnam rgyan sogs ji ltar mdzes par bsham/sa/ khyad par rgyal mtshan brgyad bshams pa ni/ shar du dkar po/ mer leb rgan/ stor nag po/ lho nub dud kha/ nub tu dmar po/ rlung du khra bo/ /byang du ser po/ byang shar du ljang ser rnams so/ /mchod pa sta gon gyi dus las mi nyung bar bshams shing mang po la ni tshad med do/ /bcud sna tshogs kyis gang ba'i bum pa brgyad kyang / phyogs mtshams brgyad du dgod/ nang gtor yi dam gtor ma lnga dang / chos skyong bsrung ma'i gtor ma bzhi nges par dgos shing / rgyas pa la spros pas lhag por phyogs skyong bcu'i gtor ma bcu dang / rgyal po chen po bzhi la bzhi ste/ gtor ma bcu bzhi byed tshul brgyud pa 'di nyid kyi yig rnying dang / bla ma'i man ngag la〈 ba byung ba rnams de sang lag len la byed pa nyung bas re zhig bzhag go /

drug pa dkyil 'khor sgrub pa'i mngon du bya ba dang / dkyil 'khor sgrub pa dngos dang /mchod cing bstod pa dang / gtor ma 'bul ba ste bzhi las/ dang po ni/ sngon 'gro gtor ma dang / phyi rol gtor ma dang / 'og tu dgos pa'i yo byad thams cad tshogs par byas la/ gong bzhin sngon 'gro gtor ma btang / dkyil 'khor dang yo byad thams cad la bgegs sbyang ba bya ste/zhi bas sbyang ba/ zhi drag phyed mas sbyang ba/ drag pos sbyang ba rnams spyi dang mthun par bya/ 'og slob ma dbang bskur gyi skabs su 'gyung ba ltar til gyis sbyang bas byur bsal/ las thams cad pa'i bum pas khrus gsol rgyas bsdus gang rung zhig bya/ de nas bdud rtsi 'khyil ba'i sngags drag tu bzla zhing / hu zhes brjod pas bsrung ba'i 'khor lo skad cig gis gsal btab/ gong bzhin mchod pa byin rlabs bya/ skyabs 'gro nas bzlas pa'i bar dang / de rjes bdag bskyes/ nyer bsdu rnams bsgrub thabs nas 'byung ba ltar bdag bskyed rdzogs par bsgom mo/ /gnyis pa la/ dkyil 'khor bskyed dang gzengs bstod pa/ gnas lnga sgrub pa lhag pa'i lhar sgrub pa/ ye shes kyi lhar sgrub pa/ ting nge 'dzin gsum sgrub pa ste drug go /dang po ni/ de nas mdun bskyed bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las/ ra las nyi ma nas/ zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi gdan re re zhes pa'i bar lha sta gon bzhin/ lha'i mtshan ma rnams yongs su gyur pa las/ dbus su dgyes mdzad nas/ khyab par mdzad pa'o /de bzhin du/ 'dab ma brgyad la nas/ dbus na bzhugs pa'i bar phyi nang gi dkyil 'khor mtha' dag bskyed tshul yang lha sta gon bzhin no/ /gnyis pa ni/ de nas nam mkhar bzhugs pa'i sta gon gyi lha rnams gsal bar bltas te/ bdug spos 'thul bzhin du/ deng bdag skye ba 'bras bur bcas/ /bdag gi gson pa'ang 'bras bur bcas/ /lha dang dam tshig mnos par ni/ /'gyur ba 'di la the tshom med/ /'di ni bdag nyid dam pa — 146—

ste/ /lha dang skal ba mnyam par 'gyur/ /bdag gis ma snar pa bla med 'dis/ /sangs rgyas thams cad spyan 'dren pas/ /deng bdag 'dus pa'i mchog yin no/ /zhes nye bar snyan gsan phab/ gsum pa ni/ oṃ khyo swāhā dang gtso bo lnga'i snying po brjod/rang gi gnas lngar rgyud sde lnga'i dkyil 'khor skad cig gis slar yang grub par gyur/ slar yang snying po drug tshar gcig brjod/ oṃ a ā i sī u mū ṛ grwa da lī e i tse( oṃ( a ā ka kha ga gha nga / tsa tsha dza dzha nya/ ṭa ṭha /za lha ṇa/ ta tha da dha na/ pa pha ba bha ma/ ya ra la wa/ sha ṣa sa ha k+ṣa hu phaṭa swāhā/ bdag nyid kyi lus kyi dkyil 'khor lnga dang / mdun bskyed rgyud sde lnga'i dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs rang bzhin mnyam pa nyid kyi ngo bos rnam par dag pa'i phyir rnam pa tha dad kyang ngo bo gcig pa yin no/ /rdo rje rtse lnga pa'i phyag rgya gnas lngar ga‘/sa la/ oṃ badz+ra mahā sa ma ya sta/ slar yang gtug/sa la/ tse( sa ma ya satwa a dhi la swa ma/ bzhi pa ni/ ā kha lī ra hū/ lko/ dkyil 'khor gyi shar sgo nas zhugs te/ gtso bo drung du bdag nyid gnas par gyur/ oṃ ā hū/ gzhal yas khang sa gsum rnam par dag pa'i ngo bo gyur/ oṃ ā hu lha tshogs rnams sems can gyi khams thams cad rnam par dag pa'i bdag nyid du gyur/ lnga pa ni/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros pas/ sta gon gyi dkyil 'khor rten dang brten par bcas pa thams cad oṃ badz+ra sa mā ja bdud rtsi 'khyil ba'i sngags lan gsum bzlas shing rdo rje gsor bas/ bgegs bskrad/ sgo nga/bye/mtshams bcings par bsam/ rdo rje'i gur nang gi nam mkha' la dgyes pas bzhugs par gyur / ar+gha sogs dang / gtso bo'i snying po rnams kyi mthar 'bru gsum sbyar ba dang / a nu ra ga rnams kyis mchod/ de nyid lnga pas bstod/ pad+ma ka ma la ya stu gyi gdan phul/ rtsa — 147—

sngags rnams dang / mchon cha can gyi lha mo brgyad po'i sngags bor ba'i sngags thams cad la re re bzhin du a be sha ya dza hu ba ho don zhes btags la rten la phab ste dam ye gnyis med du bsre/snying ga'i sa bon gyi 'od zer gyis dgyes mdzad mtshon cha can lha bcu gsum rgyud sde lnga'i lha tshogs dang bcas pa oṃ badz+ra sa mā dza nas/ 'khor rnams la gtso bos dbu rgyan gyi bar du bum bskyed kyi skabs dang 'dra bar bya/ drug pa ni / slar yang gong bzhin rma chod bstod byas la/ bdag nyid rang snang gi rig ma dang bcas pa dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo yab yum rnams dang gnyis su med par gyur/ yab kyi gsang gnas nas/rdo rje'i lam nas yum gyi pa/blar babs:gyi bar mtshon cha can gyi sgrub thabs bzhin/ byang chub kyi sems kyi 'od zer gyi dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo'i lha tshogs tshad med cing grangs med par gyur/ mkha' nang nas phyir spros nam mkha'i dbyings thams cad yongs su gang / sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad sna tshogs pa'i mchod pas mnyes par byas/ sems can thams cad la byang chub kyi sems kyi 'od zer gyi dbang bskur/ sdig sgrib thams cad sbyangs/ rdo rje 'chang chen po'i go 'phang la bkod/ de rnams dang sngon nas grub pa'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad sprul pa'i lha tshogs rnams dang gcig tu 'dres/ thams cad slar 'dus/ byang chub kyi sems su zhu ba dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs rnams la thim par gyur/ mdun bskyed kyi bzlas pa ci rigs pa bya ste/ gtso bo drug gi snying po brgya rtsa re/ rtsa sngags nye snying sogs tshar re/ 'khor rnams kyi sngags gsum gsum bzla ba'i lag len yod do/ /gsum pa mchod cing bstod pa ni/ de nas mchod pa byin rlabs nas bstod pa'i bar ni gong lha sta gon gyi skabs su bshad pa bzhin bya'o/ /der ma zad mchod pa 'bul ba'i — /48—

tshigs bcad/ sngags dang phyag rgya ji tsam shes pa de thams cad kyis 'tsham par mchod de mchod pa'i khyad par rgyas pa nyid mchog go /bzhi pa gtor ma 'bul ba ni/ de nas gtor ma rnams byin gyis brlabs pa dang / 'jig rten 'das pa'i gtor ma 'bul tshul sgrub thabs bzhin te/ cung zad khyad par yod pa sta gon gyi skabs bzhin no/ /gtor ma gnyis pa myur mdzad ye shes mgon po la gtor chog ltar 'bul/gsum pa mkha' 'gro sde lnga la 'bul ste/ skye rna shrī he 29 ka mahā badz+ra a ka sne a ka sne/ pra be sha ya/ pra be sha ya/ ban+dha ya ban+ta ya/ sarba badz+ra ḍā ki ni na hri da ya hū hū phaṭa ces lan gsum gyis spyan drangs/ oṃ bud+dhā ḍā ki ni pra stusmo i ma bā li o phaṭa/ lko badz+ra shā ki nī pra tismo i ma bā li hu phaṭa/ lko rat+na ḍā ki ni pra tismo i ma bā li tra phaṭa/ o pad+ma ḍā ki nī pra ca i ma bā li hri phaṭa/ oṃ karma ḍā ki ni pra titsā i ma bā li a phaṭa/ oṃ sarba ḍā ki ni pra tismo i ma bā li ho phaṭa/ ces lan lngas phul/ ar+gha nas/shabha'i bar dang 'bru gsum/ gyis mchod/ de nyid lnga pa mkha' 'gro spyi gtor ltar 3don pa spos pas bstod/ gtor ma tha ma 'byung ngo thams cad pa'i gtor ma yang sgrub thabs nas 'byung ba bzhin no/ /'on kyang 'dir gshegs gsol mi bya/ phyogs skyong dang nag ngo chen po dur khrod dang / mkha' 'gro sde lnga khyams la bzhugs par bsam/ phyi rol gtor ma ni/ mdor bsdus pa'i tshe/ mkha' 'gro spyi gtor dang / 'bring la mos pa'i tshe dgyes mdzad rdo rje nas 'byung ba'i 'byung po thams cad pa'i gtor ma dang / rgyas pa la mos pa'i tshe/ phyogs bzhi dang / steng ste lngar gtor ma che ba re mchod pa dang bcas pa de 'bul dgos la thams cad la'ang mchod pa byin rlabs dang / gtor ma byin rlabs rnams grong sa chog gi skabs dang 'dra/ shar du phyogs skyong la gtor ma 'bul ba yang gong sa chog gi skabs bzhi/ lto sa h+pha badz+ra a ra smi ho dza hū ba ho khru khyi ho/ spyo ཿnga po thams — /49—

cad sbyan drangs/ oṃ kha kha ji hi ji hi/ sarba yak+ṣa rak+ṣa sa bhū ta pre ta bī sha tsa/ sprukau/ ta/a pa smu ra/ ḍā ki ḍā ki n+ya da ya/ i daX bā li gri zla skye/ sa ma ya rak+ta skye/ ma ma sarba sirnyi me pra ya :skyo/ ya thi paX/ ya thi gliX bhañdza thā/ pi pa tha dzi gh+ra tha/ ma ti kra ma tha/ ma ma sar+pā kwa rta ya/ sa phyi khaX bi shudha sa hā yi kā bha lha skye huX hūX phaṭa swāhā/ zhes lan gsum gyis phul/ nub tu mkha' 'gro sde lnga'i gtor ma sngar bshad pa ltar 'bul/ byang du/rang gi snying ga'i 'od zer gyis/ phyogs skyong ba bcu srid pa gsum gyi 'byung po'i tshogs dang bcas pa badz+ra sa mā dzaX oṃ bhu dza ra ṇaX ya pa ta la tsa ra ṇaX/ man khe tsa ra khri / ta purba a ti ga ta nāX/ ka dak+ṣi khya a dhi ga ta nāX/ huX rdu ma a dhi ga ta nāX/phaṭa ut+ta ra ṇa a dhi ga ta nāX/ oṃ i hri ya bi khyo kri ta i na ā na de huX phaṭa/ sarba bhu te lco ha ha ha hi hi hi huX huX huX h+pha h+pha h+pha phaṭa swāhā/ zhes lan gsum gyis phul/ so so'i mthar ar+ghaX la sogs pa'i phyi mchod dang 'bru gsum gyis nang mchod dang / dam tshig ldan zhing 'jig rten skyong / /srid pa gsum na gang gnas pa/ /'gro ba'i don kun spyod pa la/ /mchod cing bstod de phyag kyang 'tshal/ /spyo bstong/ mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bzhes la/ /sogs 'dod don gsol ba btab pa rnams thams cad la sbyar ro/ /steng phyogs su sgrub thabs nas 'gyung ba ltar spyi gtor rgyas par 'bul ba las/ thams cad rang mdog thig ler zhu zhes pa nas/ g.yas brkyang bzhugs shing dur khrod brgyan 'es pa'i bar dor/ gtso bo lnga'i rtsa sngags dang / bdud rtsi 'khyil ba'i sngags drag tu bzlas/ yungs dkar gtor zhing bgegs bskrad la mtshams bcad/ slar nang du 'ongs ma thag las bum gyi chus khrus byas la kha bshal/ dkyil 'khor la lan gsum du bskor ba byas te/ oṃ badz+ra ut+na/ ha ṭa ya sa ma ya pra be sha ya hūX zhes huX mdzad kyi phyag rgya dral bas phyogs bzhi'i sgo dbye/ oṃ mchog tu — 150—

bde ba'i sems ni rol par ldan/ /sgeg pa'i phyag gis bcom ldan 'das la 'dud/ /dza : ba hor ba tu grub par mdzod/ /mgon po snyim pa'i me tog bzhes su gsol/ /ho zhes me tog phul/ sa ma ya pra be sha ya hū zhes pas mgo bor me tog bcings la/ bdag gzhan 'khor dang bcas pa la bar chad zhi bar mdzod/ ces gsol ba drag tu btab/ bdun pa ni/ dkyil 'khor du 'jug pa'i don du maṇ+ḍal phul la/ dga' chen khyod bdag ston pa ste/ /zhes lan gsum/ sangs rgyas kun gyi rang bzhin sku/ /slob dpon khyod la skyabs su mchi/ /gtso bo lha mor bcas pa yi/ /lha rnams la yang phyag 'tshal lo/ /thar ba chen po'i grong mchog tu/ /mgon pos bdag ni 'jug par 'tshal/ /rgyal ba mi gnas mya ngan 'das/ /bcom ldan khyod sku bdag la ston/ /zhes lan gsum/ gnang ba sbyin pa ni/ de bzhin gshe/gas pa kun gyi gnas/ /he ru ka dpal grong khyer mchog /snying po'i dkyil 'khor 'di ru ni/ /bdag gis slob ma gzhug par bya/ /lan gsum/ e rna na ma ste hū/ na ma me hū/ na mo na ma hu/ phyogs bzhi nas phyag bya/ bdun rnam dag bya'o/ /rigs kyi bu khyod gang la dga'/ /skal ba bzang la bdag dga'o/ /skal bzang des khyod ci zhig byed/ /sangs rgyas mchog 'dod dam tshig yin/ /oṃ tsak+ṣu ban+ta wa rā ma na ya hu/ oṃ ā kha skyi ra hu/ snying gar kun rdzob byang chub sems kyi ngo bo zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ don dam byang chub sems kyi ngo bo rdo rje dkar po rtse lnga pa 'od zer 'phro ba/ oṃ sarba yo ka tsit+ta ut+pa ta ya mi/ su ra te sa ma ya stu/ badz+ra yo ga bo dhi tsit+ta ya tha su kha/ dza : ba ho/ zhes pa'am/ a kha wi ra hū zhes pas yol ba'i nang du bcug par bsam/ lha'i dam tshig bsgrags pa ni rdo rje mgo bor bzhug la/ 'di ni dam tshig rdo —151 —

rje ste/ /khyod kyis spyi bor bzhag pa yis/ /sangs rgyas sku ru khyod 'grub cing / /mi phyed ye shes mchog tu 'gyur/ /yang snying gar rdo rje bzhag la/ he ru ka dpal deng khyod kyi/ /snying la yang dag zhugs par mdzad/ /gal te tshul 'di smras na ni/ /de ma thag tu dral te gshegs/ /mna' chu blud pa ni/ 'di ni khyod kyi dmyal ba'i chu/ /dam tshig 'das na bsreg par byed/ /dam tshig bsrungs na dngos grub ni/ /rdo rje bdud rtsi'i chu 'dis 'grub/ /o sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta u da ka ṭha ṭha ṭha/slob dpon gyi dam tshig bsgrags pa ni/ rdo rje spyi bor bzhug la/ deng nas bzung ste bu khyod kyi/ /he ru ka dpal nga yin gyi/ /nga yis ji ltar bka' stsal pa/ /gus pa'i tshul gyis nyan par byos/ /gal te nga la brnyas pa na/ /sangs rgyas thams cad brnyas pas na/ /mi bde ma spangs dus byas nas/ /sems can dmyal bar gyur ta re/ /ye shes dbab pa'i don du maṇ+ḍal phul la/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi/ /byin gyis rlabs pa'i ye shes de/ /rdo rje sems dpa' bdag la deng / /slob dpon khyod kyis dbab du gsol/ /lan gsum/ dang po'i rdo rje'i phyag rgya snying gar gtad la/ 'di ni ye shes rdo rje ste/ /rdo rje sems dpa' yin par bsgrags/ /rdo rje ye shes bla med ni/ /de ring nyid du dbab par shog /slob mas lha la gsol ba gdab pa ni/ dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma rnams kyis byin gyis rlobs la/ bdag la he ru ka dbab tu gsol / lan gsum/rang nyid 'od dpag med dmar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pad+ma dang dril bu 'dzin pa/ g.yas brkyang gi stabs kyis bzhugs pa'i rkang mthil du/ dzhai ljang nag rlung gi rang bzhin/ lte bar ram dmar po me drag tu 'bar ba/ snying gar hu yig sngon po 'od zer lnga 'phro ba sa — 152—

khams kyi rang bzhin/ spyi bor ba las bdud rtsi'i dkyil 'khor dkar po zlum po dbus su ma yig dang / 'og tu ha yig dkar po mgo thur du bstan pas mtshan pa/ skabs 'dir spro na/ 'byung bzhi'i dkyil 'khor la yi ge rnams kyis mtshan par bsgom pa dang / shin tu bsdu na/ spyi bor yi ge gsum kho nas chog par bzhed do/ /dzhai las 'od zer gyi tshogs 'phros/ byin pa nas brgyud/ brla'i rtsa bo che nas zhugs/ sum mdor gcig tu 'dres/ lte ba'i ra la phog pas/ me lce drag tu 'bar te/ snying ga'i hu bsregs/ spyi bo'i ha la phog pas/ bdud rtsi'i bde ba chen po'i rgyun/ skya chil chil babs pas/ snying ga dang lte ba'i yi ge la phog cing / lus thams cad du khyab pas/ gzung 'dzin gyi snang ba dbyings su nub cing / bde stong gi ye shes lhang gi skyes/ slob dpon gyi thugs ka'i 'od zer gyis/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma khro bo dang khro mo thams cad ba spru'i bu ga nas sib sib thim par gyur/ o ā be sha ya ā be sha ya nga ya/ ra ra ra/ tsa la ya tsa la ya ha le ya/ hu ya ha hu dzhai swāhā/ zhes drag tu bzlas/ gu gul dang /tshil chen byi la nag po'i brun/ zla mtshan gyis bgos pa'i ras rnams ro sol gyi me la bsregs pa'i dud pas bdug /rol mo sna tshogs bya/ a kha/ yang dag pa yid dkyil 'khor 'dir/ /bdag gis slob ma gzhug par bgyi/ /lha yi rigs kyi rim pa dang / /dngos grub bsod nams de bzhin shog /ces bden pa'i stobs brjod do/ /sngon nas sgrub pa'i yi dam lha/ /gang yin de ring bdag gi ni/ /rigs dang mthun pa'i dngos grub dang / /lha dang ma nor mjal bar shog /lko pra titsā badz+ra ho/ zhes pas me tog ngor/ sangs rgyas kun gyis byin rlabs pa'i/ /me tog rnam par snang mdzad — 153—

'di/ /stobs chen khyod kyis rab bcings pas/ /rigs kyi bdag por dbang bskur ro/ /oṃ pra titsā grihā stu/ sa ma ya ma swāhā/ rdo rjes mig dbye ste/ he ru ka dpal deng khyod kyi/ /mig 'byed par ni brtson par mdzad/ /rdo rje'i mig ni bla na med/ /phye bas thams cad mthong bar shog /oṃ badz+ra ni tra a pa ha ra pa tra li hri a badz+ra tsak+ṣu pra be sha ya hu/ zhes brjod/ he badz+ra pa ju hri/ zhes pas gdong g.yogs bkrol nas/ lha ngo bstan pa ni/ dkyil 'khor bzang po 'di la ltos/ /mthong nas dad pa rab tu bskyed/ khyod ni rnal 'byor ma rigs skyes/ /sngags dang phyag rgya'i byin rlabs kyis/ /'gro don phun sum tshogs kun dang / /dngos grub thams cad mngon du 'gyur/ /dam tshig thams cad srung ba dang / /gsang sngags la yang brtson par bgyi/ /zhes brjod la/ dkyil 'khor gyi steng gi nam mkha' la brgyud pa'i bla ma thams cad dur khrod rnams su chos skyong ba'i bsrung ma dang bcas pa thams cad bzhugs par mos/ dgu pa ni / sbyang pa gnyis ni sngon 'gro yin/ /chu cod rdor dril ming dang lnga/ /dngos gzhi nyid de chu dbang la/ /bsangs sbyangs lhar bskyed byin gyis brlabs/ /ye shes dbang lha spyan 'dren mchod/ /dbang bskur bzlas pa mchod bstod bya/ /gsol btab shis brjod chu dbang bskur/ /slar yang mchod bstod dag pa brjod/ /dbang lha spyan 'dren ma gtogs pa/ /'og ma rnams kyang phal cher 'dra/ /zhes bya ste/ de yang rdo rje slob ma'i dbang bskur ba'i don du maṇ+ḍal phul/ he ru ka dpal dbang bskur ba/ /'gro ba skyob pa'i gzi brjid can/ /yon tan 'gyung gnas ji ltar stsol/ /de bzhin bdag la deng stsol cig /bdag gzhan ngan 'gro las sgrol zhing / /thar pa chen po'i grong mchog tu/ /gnas nas 'gro ba sgrol byed pa'i/ /ye shes dbang mchog bdag 'a — 154—

stsole4/ /zhes lan gsum/ oṃ sum+bha ni sum+bha hu hu phaṭa/ oṃ gro hā grihā hū hū phaṭa/ o grihā pā ya gro hā pā ya hu hu phaṭa/ oṃ ā na ya ho/ bha ga wā na/ bi du rwa dza hu hu phaṭa/rol mo drag tu bya/ oṃ badz+ra ḍā ka kha kha ji hi 'a hi sarba pā pa da ha na/ bhasmi ku ru swāhā/zhes pa'am/ oṃ sarba pā ba sarba bi da shin+ta ku ru swāhā/ de nas chu dbang bskur ba ni/bdag dang dbang rdzas gnyis ka /oṃ tsho tas bsangs/ swabha was sbyangs/ bdag dang dbang rdzas rnam rgyal bum chu/ stong pa'i ngang las/ pad+ma dang nyi ma'i gdan la/ hu las rdo rje hū gis mtshan pa las/ gnyis ka'ang mi bskyod pa sku mdog sngon po zhal gcig phyag gnyis g.yas rdo rje dang g.yon de'i yu ba byas pa'i dril bu 'dzin pa/zhabs rdo rje'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa/ stag lpags kyi sham thabs dang /thod pa'i phreng ba dang / rus pa'i rgyan drug gis brgyan pa/ yum mā ma ki sngon mo gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pa dang mnyam par sbyor ba/ dpral bar o/ mgrin par ā thugs kar hū/ slob dpon gyi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad mi bskyod pa yab yum gyi rnam par badz+ra sa mā dza o badz+ra a ku sha dza/ oṃ badz+ra pā sha hu/ oṃ badz+ra slo ṭa ba/ oṃ badz+ra ga rje ho dza : ba ho gnyis ka dang gnyis su med par thim/ slar yang slob dpon gyi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ dbang gi lha sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' rig pa'i lha mo khro bo'i tshogs dang bcas pa badz+ra sa mā dza o badz+ra pur+sha ā hu/ sogs nyer sbyong lnga phul la/ de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyis 'di la mngon par dbang bskur ba stsal du gsol/ zhes gsol ba bto pas/ o badzi bha wa a bhi khri lto hu/ zhes dbang rdzas la dbang bskur/ sku gang dri ma dag /chu'i —155—

lhag ma yar lud pa las mi bskyod pas dbu rgyan/ oṃ ā badz+ra dhika hu phaṭa swāhā/zhes mang du bzlas la me tog la sogs pas mchod/ mi bskyod pa ni ye she che sogs sho lo ka rnyag gis bstod/ nam mkhar bzhugs pa'i dbang gi lha dkyil 'khor dang bcas pa rnams la gsol ba btab par mos te/ byang chub rdo rje sangs rgyas la/ /mchod chen ji ltar stsal ba ltar/ /bdag kyang rab tu bsgral ba'i phyir/ /nam mkha'i rdo rje deng bdag stsole/ /zhes lan gsum gsol ba bto/ slob dpon gyis so so'i bum pa mang du yod na/ rang sngags kyi bum pa so so'i bum chu bum pa'am/ ka pā lar bsdus/ rnam rgyal bum pa stog kho na yin na/ de nyid thogs te/ o phun sum tshogs pa mnga' ba gser gyi ri bo 'dra/ /'jig rten gsum gyi mgon po dri ma gsum spangs pa/ /sangs rgyas pad+ma rgyas pa 'dab 'dra'i spyan mnga' ba/ /'di ni 'jig rten dge ba'i bkra shis dang po'o/ /de yi nye bar bstan pa'i mchog rab mi g.yo ba/ /'jig rten gsum na grags shing lha dang mis mchod pa/ /chos kyi dam pa skye rgu rnams la zhi byed pa/ /'di ni 'jig rten dge ba'i bkra shis gnyis pa'o/ /dge 'dun dam pa chos ldan thos pa'i bkra shis phyug /mi dang lha dang lha ma yin gyis chod pa'i gnas/ /tshogs kyi mchog rab ngo tsha shes dang dpal gyi gzhi/ /'di ni 'jig rten dge ba'i bkra shis gsum pa'o/ /bkra shis gang zhig sems can kun gyi snying la gnas/ /kun gyi bdag nyid rigs kun gyi ni bdag po mchog /sems can ma lus bskyed byed bde ba chen po ste/ /de yi deng khyod dbang bskur mchog la bkra shis shog /nyin mo bde legs mtshan bde legs sogs bya/ ji ltar bltams pa tsam gyis ni/ /lha rnams kyis ni khrus gsol — 156—

ltar/ /lha yi chu ni dag pa yis/ /de bzhin bdag gis sku khrus gsol/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shrī ye hu/ las bum gyis khrus bya/ de nas rnam rgyal bum pa thogs la/ kun gzhi rnam shes rnam dag cing / /me long ye shes ngo bo nyid/ /bcom ldan mi bskyod pa yis ni/ /ye shes chu rgyun dbang bskur ro/ /o sarba ta thā ga ta badz+ra a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma shrī ye hū/ dbang bskur rdo rje chen po ni/ khams sum kun gyis phyag byas pa/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi gsang gsum ni/ /gnas las byung ba sbyin par bya/ /gtso bo rnams kyi snying po brjod la/ o badzi bha wa a bhi khri ñtsa hū/ zhes re re la btags/ thams cad kyi mjug tu/ brtan par bya ba'i phyir/ lko sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shrī ye hū/ zhes brjod cing / dbang bskur sku gang dri ma thams cad dag /chu'i lhag ma yar lud pa las/ mi bskyod pas dbu rgyan/ nam mkha'i dbyings gang ba'i sangs rgyas rnams las/ rdo rje'i rigs kyi lha tshogs dpag tu med pa byung nas/ rang nyid la thim/ oṃ badz+ra pukhye ā hū/ sogs kyis nyer spyod lnga dang rol mo 'bul/ mi bskyod pa ni ye shes che sogs kyi slob ma la bstod par bya/de ltar khyed la chu'i dbang bskur bas/ rnam par shes pa'i phung po rgyal ba mi bskyod pa dang / chu'i khams mā ma ki'i ngo bor sangs rgyas shing / zhe sdang ma spangs par dag nas/ me long lta bu'i ye shes mngon du gyur/ 'di man ho la 'don pa bsgyur bar bya'o/ /cod pan gyi dbang ni/ bsangs sbyangs/ khyed rang dang dbang rdzas dbu rgyan/ stong pa'i ngang las/ pad+ma nyi ma'i gdan la a las rin po che'i a gis mtshan pa las/ gnyis ka'ang rin chen 'byung ldan sku mdog ser po zhal gcig phyag gnyis g.yas rin po che dang / g.yon des yu ba byas pa'i dril bu 'dzin pa/— 157—

zhabs rdo rje'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa/ stag lpags kyi sham thabs dang /thod pa'i phreng ba dang / rus pa'i rgyan drug gis brgyan pa/ yum rin chen sgrol ma ser mo gri gug dang thong/ pa 'dzin pa dang mnyam par sbyor ba/ dpral bar oṃ/mgrin par ā thugs kar hu/ slob dpon gyi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad rin chen 'byung ldan yab yum gyi rnam par badz+ra sa mā dza oṃ badz+ra a ku sha dza dza : ba ho'i bar gong bzhin/gnyis ka dang gnyis su med par thim/ de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyi 'di la mngon par dbang bskur ba stsal du gsol/ ces gsol ba btab pas/ oṃ badz+re bha wa a bhi khri3 hū/ zhes dbang rdzas la dbang bskur/ sku gang dri ma dag chu lhag ma yar lud pa las/ rin chen 'byung ldan gyis dbu rgyan/ oṃ ā rat+na dhika hū phaṭa swāhā/ zhes mang du bzlas la/ me tog la sogs pas mchod/ rin chen rgyal po rab tu zab/ /zhes sogs sho lo ka gcig gis bstod/ rin chen 'gyung ldan yab yum snyoms par zhugs te zhu ba las byung ba'i rin po che'i cod pan du gyur/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis/ bdag la mngon par dbang bskur du gsol/thor tshugs cod pan gyis brgyan cing / /sangs rgyas kun gyi rab bsngags pa'i/ /rin chen 'bar ba'i dbu rgyan dang / /dar dpyangs dbang bskur sbyin par bya/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta rat+na a bhi ṣe ka sa ma ya shrī ye hu/ zhes pa'i sngags 'di gtso bo rnams kyi snying po'i mthar btanas la/ mthar/ oṃ badz+ra rat+na a bhi ṣe ka ta hu su ra ta sta a ha/ oṃ la ma pa ta hu/ oṃ badz+ra tu rtsi ho/ zhes bcings te cod pan gyi dbang bskur ro/ /o sarba nas/ shrī ye hū gi bar gyi chu dbang bskur/ dbang bskur sku gang dri ma —158—

dag /chu lhag ma yar lud pa las/ rna ltag g.yas su rin chen 'byung ldan gyis dbu rgyan/ nam mkha'i dbyings thams cad gang ba'i sangs rgyas rnams las/rin po che'i rigs kyi lha tshogs dpag tu med pa byung nas slob ma la thim/ oX badz+ra pur+sha sogs dang rin chen rgyal po sogs kyis bstod/ de ltar khyed la cod pan gyis dbang bskur bas/ tshor ba'i phung po rgyal ba rin chen 'byung ldan dang /nam mkha'i khams rin chen sgrol ma'i ngo bor sangs rgyas shing / nga rgyal dang ser sna ma spangs rang sar dag nas/ mnyam pa nyid kyi ye shes mngon du gyur snyam du sgoms shig /ces brjod/rdo rje'i dbang ni/ bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las dbang rdzas rdo rje dzi las pad+ma dzī gyis gnyis ka'ang 'od dpag med dmar po/g.yas pad+ma dang g.yon/ yum gos dkar mo nga/mar mo/ 'od dpag med yab yum gyi rnam par/ 'od dpag med kyis dbu rgyan/ oX āX.a ro lika hūX phaṭa swāhā/rdo rje dpag med rgyal po che sogs/ 'od dpag med yab yum zhu/ rdo rje/ sangs rgyas kun gyi rdo rje'i dbang / /de ring khyod la bskur bar bya/ /sangs rgyas kun tu rab sgrub phyir/ /rdo rje'i dbang ni sbyin par bya/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta pad+ma a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shrī ye hūX/ oṃ badz+ra a dhi pa ti stuX/ a bhi 'a ṣañtsa hūX tiṣ+ṭha bi ra sa ma ya staX/zhes pas gtad/ gong bzhin las ltag par 'od dpag med kyis dbu rgyan/ pad+ma'i rigs kyi/ rdo rje 'od dpag med sogs kyis/ rdo rje'i dbang / 'du shes kyi phung po rgyal ba 'od dpag med dang / me khams 'od dpag med kyi gos dkar mo'i ngo bor sangs rgyas shing / 'dod chags/ so sor rtog pa'i ye shes/ dril bu'i dbang ni bsangs sbyangs/ dbang rdzas dril bu stong pa'i ngang las/ khaX las ral gri khaX gis:— 159—

gnyis ka'ang don yod grub pa ljang khu/ g.yas ral gri dang g.yon: yum dam tshig sgrol ma ljang khu /don yod grub pa yab yum gyi rnam par/ don yod grub pas dbu rgyan/ oX pradzñā dhika huX phaṭa swāhā/ don yod rgyal po rdzogs sangs rgyas/sogs/ don yod grub pa yab yum spyo dril bur sangs rgyas kun gyi dril bu'i dbang / /de ring khyod la bskur bar bya/ /sangs rgyas kun tu rab grub phyir/ /dril bu'i dbang ni spyin par bya/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta karma a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shrī ye huX/ oX badz+ra a dhi pa ti stuX a bhi ski nyu hūX tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra sa ma ya stuX/ zhes pas gtad/ oX sarba ta thā ga ta lha ṇ+ḍa a nga na a ṣi ka ta sa ma ya shrī ye hūX/ rna ltag g.yon par don yod grub pas dbu rgyan las kyi rigs kyi/ don yod grub pa sogs kyi/ dril bu'i dbang / 'du byed kyi phung po rgyal ba don yod grub pa dang /rlung gi khams dam tshig sgrol ma'i ngo bor sangs rgyas shing / phrag dog ma spangs:bya ba grub pa'i ye shes ming dbang ni: bsangs sbyangs/ dbang rdzas rdo rje dang dril bu stong pa'i ngang las/ bhuX las 'khor lo bhuXganyis ka'ang rnam snang dkar po g.yas 'khor lo dang / g.yon/ yum sangs rgyas spyan ma dkar mo/ rnam snang yab yum gyi rnam par rnam par snang mdzad kyis dbu rgyan/ oX āXdzi na dzika huX phaṭa swāhā/ rnam par snang mdzad dag pa che sogs/ rnam par snang mdzad yab yum zhu ba las byung ba'i rdo rje dang dril bur gyur/ rnam par snang mdzad ming gi dbang / /de ring khyod la bskur bar bya/ / sangs rgyas kun tu rab grub phyir/ming gi dbang mchog bskur bar bya/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta bud+dhā a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shrī ye hūX/ zhes bsgrags la/ oX badz+ra sa twa stuX a bhi khiñtsa huX badz+ra nā ma a bhi ṣe ka ta — 160—

————he shrī/ yang brtan byed du/ shrī ye hu gi cod pan gyi skabs bzhin/ dpral bar rnam snang gi dbu rgyan/ nam mkha' dbyings/ o badz+ra pu tharba rnam par snang mdzad dag pa che sogs/ de ltar khyod la ming gi dbang / bskur bas gzugs kyi phung po rgyal ba rnam par snang mdzad/ sa'i khams sangs rgyas spyan ma'i ngo bor sangs rgyas shing /gti mug ma spangs rang sar dag nas/ chos kyi dbyings kyi ye shes/ mngon du gyur/ snyam du bsgom shig /slar yang slob dpon gyis/ /'di ni sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ /rgyud sde lnga yi dkyil 'khor du/ /de ring slob dpon ming dbang sbyin/ /dkyil 'khor gtso byed ming dbang 'grub/ /lko ā badz+ra hū/ bcu pa la/gsol gdab phyag mtshan rdor dril spyin/ /dam tshig gsum dang chu dbang mchod/ /rjes gnang lung bstan dbugs dbyung zhing / /brtul zhugs dag pa brjod pa'o/ /dang po ni/ rdo rje slob dpon gyi dbang gi don du maṇ+ḍal phul/'khor lo phyir mi bzlog pa'i dbang / /dam pa bdag la stsal nas kyang / /mgon po 'khor lo lha dag gis/ /de nyid slob dpon 'phrin las gsung / /de ring bdag ni khyod drin las/ /rang dang gzhan don nus 'gyur phyir/ /rdo rje slob dpon dbang bskur bar/ /thugs rjes can khyod stsal du gsol/ /rtag tu rdo rje dril bu 'dzin/ /sems can bzung phyir rjes gnang sogs/ /bdag la de ring bka' drin mnos/ /mgon po thugs rje thugs dam dgongs/ /zhes lan gsum gnyis pa ni/ dbang stegs sogs legs par bshams thub na rab/ ma thub na yid kyis bsam pas chog ste/ dkyil 'khor gyi shar phyogs su seng khris btegs pa'i rin po che'i khri la rang nyid rdo rje 'chang chen po sku mdog sngon po rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pa/— 161 —

mes po'i shul ba theg las/ tā ra nā tha'i gsung 'bum/dar dang rin po che dang / rus pa la sogs pa rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/mtshan dang dpe byad thams cad yongs su rdzogs shing / rang snang gi shes rab dam pas 'phyud pa'i sku can du gyur/ steng du gdugs dkar po gser gyi yu ba can/ mtha' bskor du mchod pa'i sprin gyi phung pos yongs su bskor bar gyur/hu yig las byung ba'i phyag mtshan rnams su gyur/ he ru ka ni kha tā ga /rnal 'byor ma ni ḍā ma sa /rdo rje kha ṭā rdo rjer bcas/ /dril bu sil sil sgra sgrog cing / /tshangs pa'i skud thogs rnal 'byor bdag /gri gug dang ni ka pā la/ /dpa' bo chen pos blang bar gyis/ zhes brjod/ gsum pa ni/rdor dril gnyis ka bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las/ hū las rdo rje hū gis mtshan pa las/ rdo rje sems dpa' dkar po rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pas yum rdo rje snyem ma dkar mo gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pa dang mnyam par sbyor ba/ rgyan thams cad kyis rnam par brgyan pa'i sku can du gyur/ dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par ā thugs kar hū/sangs rgyas thams cad rdo rje sems dpa' yab yum gyi rnam par spyan drangs te thim/ de nyid zhu ba las byung ba'i rdo rje dang dril bur gyur/ rdo rje che dang dril bu che/ /zungs shig rdo rjer byin gyis bsas/ /de ring rdo rje slob dpon gyur/ /slob ma'i tshogs rnams bsdu bar gyis/ /mi shes pa'am rmongs pa yis/ /de nyid nges par bstan mi bya/ /rdo rje dril bu mi spang ste/ /slob dpon rnams ni smad mi bya/ /sngags dang sangs rgyas thams cad dang / /ma sdongs par mchod de 'bad pas gyis/ /zhes brjod/ rang snang gi shes rab dam pa la 'byud pas bde ba chen po nyams su myong bar gyur/ bzhi pa ni/ sangs rgyas kun gyi rdo —162—

rje nas dbang / /de ring khyod la bskur bar bya/ /sangs rgyas kun tu rab sgrub phyir/ /rdo rje'i dbang ni sbyin par bya/ /snying gar gar+sā/ thog mtha' med pa'i sems dpa' ni/ /rdo rje sems dpa' dga' ba che/ /kun tu bzang po kun bdag nyid/ /rdo rje bsnyems tshul bdag po'i bdag /bcom ldan dpal mchog dang po yi/ /skyes bu mchog tu 'di 'gyur ro/ /oṃ ā mahā badz+ra hū/ khyod kyis sems 'khor 'das dbyer med kyi don rtogs par bya'o/ /'di ni rnal 'byor ma kun gyi/ khres rab dbyangs kyi rjes 'gror bshad/ khyod kyis kyang ni rtag tu bcangs/ /byang chub mchog tu rgyal ba bzhed/ /dril bu lan brgyad dkrol/ a srid pa ngo bo nyid kyis dag /ngo bo nyid kyis srid bral byas/ /rang bzhi dag pa'i sems dpa' mchog /srid pa dam pa byed par 'gyur/ /oṃ badz+ra snyarnye a/ oṃ ā satwa stu/ sgra thams cad grag stong du shes par gyis shig /rdo rje dang dril bu gnyis ka zung du sbyar la/ shes rab bcu drug lon pa la/ /lag pa dag gis yang dag 'byud/ / bdag med yum mchog khyod la sbyin/ /rdo rje sku yi dngos grub thob/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a nu rā ga na badz+ra su bha wa ut+pa ko3ha/ yid kyi lus su brtan pa'i phyir/ /phyag rgya'i dam tshig rab tu brjod/ /gang gi lus ni thams cad brtan/ /des na phyag rgya rab tu bsgrags/ /gzugs su snang ba rnams lha skur shes par gyis shig /lnga pa ni/ oṃ phun sum tshogs nas/ bkra shis gsum pa'o/ /dbang bskur rdo rje nas shrī ye hū gi bar chu dbang bzhi/ de ltar dbang bskur ba'i chu rgyun gyis lus kyi nang thams cad gang / dbang rtags su rdo rje 'chang chen po'i dbu rgyan par gyur/ oṃ su pra tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra ye swāhā/ zhes me tog gtor cing brtan —163—

bzhugs bya/ drug pa ni/ bdag 'jug gi skabs 'dir/ ar+gha nas sha lta'i bar gyis mchod do/ /tshigs bcad rnams mi dgos/ dbang gi lugs 'dir slob ma la mchod pa 'bul ba yin te/ sgeg dang bcas pas phreng ba 'phang / /sangs rgyas kun mchod rnal 'byor ma/ / de ni 'bral bar mi 'gyur te/ /phreng ba de yi rgyan yin no/ /o badz+ra kā ru ṇi ka lak+ṣa hu ba stu/ rdo rje'i gdan 'di rdzogs sangs rgyas/ /sras dang bcas par rnam rol zhing / /rdo rje sgeg mo'i rab sbyor gyis/ /dga' ston byed pa'i mchod pa gyis/ /oṃ badz+ra a gha ā hu/ sangs rgyas rnams la me tog gtor/ /byang chub yan lag tshogs gyur pa/ /mtshan dang dpe byad ldan pa yi/ /bde gshegs sku ni thob par 'gyur/ /bhu rdzogs sangs rgyas la spos phul bas/ / brtul zhugs bzang po legs tshims kyis/ /lus can bde gshegs cha lugs su/ /ye shes kyis ni tshim par gyis/ /gha/ rgyal ba rnams la dri phul bas/ /tshul khrims ting 'dzin shes rab dang / /rnam grol ye shes mthong ba yi/ /byang chub lus can rnams la bgos/ /hi/ chos kyi me ni legs 'bar bas/ /pad+ma gar dbang rang nyid de/ /sems can ma rig ldong rnams la/ /chos kyi sgron me sbar bar gyis/ /gi /lus can kun la dam chos kyi/ /glu ni khyod kyis blang bar bya/ / des ni rnal 'byor ma rnams dang / /myur du bde ba myong bar 'gyur/ /oṃ/ deng nas brtsams te byang chub par/ /rnal 'byor ma dang dpa' tshogs kun/ khres rab thabs kyi sbyor ba yis/ /bde ba'i gar gyi rol par gyis/ /ho/ de nyid thal mo'i gar gyis ni/ /sangs rgyas thams cad chags par bya/ /sangs rgyas 'du ba'i 'phrin las kyis/ /gar mkhan tshul du bsgyur bar —164—

bya/ /bdun pa ni/ mig thur me long dril bu dang / /mda' gzhu 'khor lo dung po ti/ /sprul bshad dngos grub mchod pa dang / /lha sgom sngags kyi rjes gnang ngo / /de dag kyang rim pas/ ji ltar mig mkhan rgyal po yis/ /'jig rten rab rib bsal ba ltar/ /rgyal ba rnams kyis bu khyod kyi/ /mi shes pa yi rab rib bsal/ /oṃ badz+ra nai tra a pa ha ra pa ṭa la hritra/ zhes mig thur dang / cho che/ rnams gzugs bsnyan lta bu ste/ /gsal zhing dag la rnyog pa med/ /gzung du med cing brjod du med/ /rgyu dang las las kun tu 'byung / /ngo bo nyid med gnas med par/ /de ltar chos rnams shes kyis la/ /sems can don ni mnyam med byos/ /'on kyang skyob pa'i sras su skyes/ /wo brjod de me long dang / a las byung ba'i dril bu/ thams cad nam mkha'i mtshan nyid de/ /nam mkha' la yang mtshan nyid med/ /nam mkha' dang ni mnyam sbyor bas/ /thams cad mchog gi gnyis med gsal/ /zhes dril bu dang /ho las byung ba'i mda' gzhu/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad dang / rjes su chags par byos shig /zhes mda' gzhu dang / lko badz+ra he tu ma/ rkang pa gnyis kyi bar du 'khor lo bzhag /deng nas bsams te sems bskyed pa/ /brtsams te chos kyi 'khor lo bskor/ /de ring phan chad sems can la/ /skyob pa rnams kyis 'khor lo bskor/ /lko 'khor lo dang / o badz+ra bha ṣa ra/ lag pa g.yas su dung / khyod kyis the tshom dogs med par/ /yid gnyis med pa'i tshul gyis su/ /chos kyi dung ni bla med pa/ /dri med kun tu gang bar gyis/ /oṃ mahā dharma hū/ rgyud kyi po ti/ gsang sngags spyod tshul cho ga 'di/ /skye bo rnams la rtag tu shod/ /de ltar byas na sangs rgyas la/ /phan thog drin du gzo zhes bya/ /rdo rje —165—

'dzin pa de kun yang / khyod la rtag tu bsrung bar mdzad/ /zhes pu ti dang / rigs lnga'i phyag mtshan rnams rim pas gtad la/ 'jig rten khams ni thams cad du/ /sems can kun la phan pa'i phyir/ /ji ltar sna tshogs 'dul 'gyur ba'i/ /chos kyi 'khor lo rab tu bskor/ /de bzhi du/ chos kyi 'khor lo'i gnas su/ rdo rje dang / rin chen dang / pad+ma dang / sna tshogs zhes pa rnams bcug la/ rigs lnga'i sprul pa'i sgo nas sems can rnams kyi dug lnga sbyangs te/ ye shes lnga rgyud la bskyed par gyis shig /ces rigs lnga'i rjes gnang dang / zhi dang rgyas dang dbang dang dgug /sdang bar bya dang gnon sogs dang / /bsad dang bskrad pa la sogs pa/ /las de rnams ni sgrub par gyis/ /ral gri mig sman sa 'og dang / /mchil lham de bzhin ril bu ste/ /rnal 'byor pa yis dngos grub ni/ /de ni ci dgar sgrub par gyis/ /bdag nyid sangs rgyas thams cad dang / /rnal 'byor ma ni kun gyis dngos/ /de bas 'bad pa thams cad kyis/ /he ru ka dpal bdag mchod do/ /mchod pa'i rjes gnang ngo / /'dod chags bral ba lta bu yi/ khams gsum na ni sdig med des/ /de bas 'dod la chags bral bar/ khyod kyi nam yang ma byed cig /lha'i sku la sems yongs su chags shing / zhen par gyis shig /lha bsgom pa'i rje gnang ngo / /rigs lnga 'di la stsal lags kyis/ /'di la 'go bar mdzad du gsol/ /lan gsum/ rigs lnga bdag la stsel lags kyis/ /bdag la 'go bar mdzad du gsol/ /lan gsum/ sngags kyi dngos grub stsal du gsol/ /brtul zhugs brtan par mdzad du gsol/ / sngags bzlas pa'i rjes gnang ngo / /—166—

brgyad pa ni/ slob dpon bcom ldan 'das dpal rgyal ba shākya thub pa'i skur gyur pas bla na med pa'i byang chub tu lung ston par gyur/ rgyud sde lnga yi dkyil 'khor 'dir/ /rdo rje 'dzin pa bdag nyid dang / /phyogs dus sangs rgyas thams cad kyang / khyod la rtag tu lung ston 'gyur/ /bdag cag sangs rgyas mgrin gcig tu/ /bde bar gshegs par lung ston to/ /o 'di ltar ngas khyod lung bstan te/ /rdo rje sems dpa' de bzhin gshegs/ /srid pa shin tu rnam dag pas/ /srid pa'i ngan 'gro las khyod 'das/ /oṃ shrī he ru ka na ma sarba ta thā ga ta sirnyi sa ma ya stu snur bhu wa swadagu pa ni/ gsang chen mchog gi dkyil 'khor 'dir/ /bcug pa dang ni mthong bas kyang / /sdig pa kun las rnam grol nas/ /de ring khyed rnams bde bar gnas/ /bde chen theg pa 'di la ni/ /phyin chad 'chi ba yod ma yin/ /mi thub pa dang mi tshugs pa/ /cis kyang mi 'jigs dga' bar gyis/ /srid pa shin tu rnam dag pas/ /srid pa'i ngan 'gro rnams las bton/ /ya pa ni/ dbang rdzas rdo rje bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las/ hu las rdo rje hu gis mtshan pa yongs su gyur pa las/ rdo rje sems dpa' sku mdog dkar po rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pa/ yum rdo rje snyems ma dang mnyam par sbyor ba'i sku can du gyur/ dpral bar lko/ mgrin par ā thugs kar hu/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad rdo rje sems dpa'i rnam par badz+ra sa mā dzadza / ba ho/ de nyid zhu ba las byung ba'i dang po'i rdo rje rtse lnga par gyur/ de nyid spyi bo dang /mgrin pa dang / snying ga rnams su reg la/ 'di ste sangs rgyas thams cad de/ /—167—

rdo rje sems dpa' phyag na gnas/ khyod kyis kyang ni rtag tu bcang / /phyag na rdo rje'i brtul zhugs brtan/ /o sarba ta thā ga ta sirnyi badz+ra sa ma ya tiṣ+ṭha e ṣa bhā dha ra ya mi badz+ra sa twa hi hi hi hi hu/ deng phyin chad tha mal gyi spyod pa thams cad brtul nas sngags kyi spyod pa la zhugs par gyis shig /rang gi bdag nyid yongs spangs nas/ /dka' thub kyis kyang mi gdung zhing / /ci bde bar ni bde ba bzung / /'di ni ma byon rdzogs sangs rgyas/ /zhes brjod la don spyod/bcu gcig pa ni/ sems can don phyir sems bskyed pas/ /sems can bsgral ba'i don de la/ /gtso bos ji ltar bka' stsal pa/ /de dag thams cad bdag gis bgyid/ /chos thams cad mnyam pa nyid kyis phyir/ gzhal med khang gru bzhi pa/ dran pa nye bar bzhag pa bzhis shar sgo/ yang dag sbong pa bzhis lho sgo/ rdzu 'phrul gyis rkang pa bzhis nub sgo/ dbang po dang stobs ni byang sgo/tshangs pa'i gnas bzhis zur bzhi/ bsdu ba'i dngos po bzhis rta babs/ byang chub yan lag bdun gyis me tog gi 'phreng ba/ 'phags pa'i lam yan lag brgyad kyis ka ba/ bdud bzhi yongs su bcom pas bsrung ba'i 'khor lo/'khor ba rnam par dag pas dur khrod/ rdo rje theg pa'i chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba'i phyir rdo rje'i thig dang ldan pa/ nyes pas ma gos pas pad+ma/ ye shes chen pos nyi ma/ 'jig tshogs la lta ba yongs su 'joms pas rdo rje/ byang chub kyi sems zla ba'i dkyil 'khor rnams so/ /lha rnams ni phung po lnga dang / khams bzhi dang / dbang po drug dang / yul drug rnam par dag pa ye shes lnga dang / tshad med pa rnams dang / pha rol tu phyin pa drug la sogs pa'i bdag nyid do/ /—168—

gzhan yang deng nas khyod kyis dbang bskur ba dang / rab tu gnas pa dang /sbyin sreg dang dngos grub sgrub pa la sogs pa slob dpon gyi las 'di dag mtha' dag sgrubs shig /de nas bum dbang gi dag pa brjod pa ni/ de ltar na rdul tsho ni gyi dkyil 'khor du zhugs bum pa'i dbang bskur ba thob/ gtso bor lus kyi dri ma mtha' dag sbyangs/ dam tshig tu rtsa ba dang yan lag gi dam tshig nyi shu rtsa gnyis bsrung ba la dbang / lam bskyed pa'i rim pa bsgom pas/ 'bras bus sprul ba'i sku mngon du 'gyur ba'i rten 'brel legs par bsgrigs pa yin no/ /zhes brjod / de dag gis bum pa'i dbang 'khor dang bcas pa'o/ /bcu gnyis pa ni/ dbang gong ma gsum thun mong gi don du maṇ+ḍal phul/ bdag ni 'khor bar bying ba yis/ /'gro ba skyabs med 'phongs nas ni/ /de bsgral phyir ni khyod nyid dang / /rdo rje 'dzin bdag slob dpon la/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi ye shes mchog /gsang dbang bla na med pa zhu/ /brtse bas bdag la gnang bar mdzode/ /dam tshig ji bzhin bdag gis bgyid/ /lan gsum/ slob dpon bcom ldan 'das dgyes mdzad rdo rje zhal brgyad phyag bcu drug zhabs bzhi pa mtshon cha can gyi skur gsal ba'i spyi bor dpal gsang ba 'dus pa lha sum cu rtsa gnyis kyi dkyil 'khor/ mgrin par mahā mā ya lha lnga'i dkyil 'khor/ snying gar dgyes mdzad thod pa can lha dgu'i dkyil 'khor/ lte bar 'khor lo sdom pa lha drug cu rtsa gnyis kyi dkyil 'khor/ gsang bar rdo rje 'jigs byed lha bcu gsum thod pa bzhi dang bcas pa'i dkyil 'khor rnams skad cig gis grub par gyur/mdun bskyed kyi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros sangs rgyas byang chub sems —169—

dpa' thams cad rgyud sde lnga'i lha tshogs kyi rnam par spyan drangs/ lus kyi dkyil 'khor la thim/ dza / ba ho gnyis su med par thim/ rig ma skad cig gis rje btsun rdo rje bdag med mar gyur/ yab kyi gsang gnas hū nas/thugs kar rjes su chags pa'i mes byang chub kyi sems su zhu/ dkyil 'khor lnga'i lha tshogs thams cad kyi zhal du zhugs/ gsang ba'i lam nas byung ba rnams gcig tu bsdus te/ gzhi lus kyi rtsa a wa dhu ti'i lam nas brgyud/ rdo rje dang pad+ma'i lam nas byung ste/ ga bur dang sih+la gcig tu 'dres pa'i rgyun ye shes bdud rtsi lnga gcig tu 'dres pa'i ka pā lar babs par gyur/ o sarba ta thā ga ta pū dza badz+ra swa bha wa ut+pa ko3ha/ gsang dbang kho na'i don du mkha phul/ oṃ bcom ldan zhi ba chen po kye/ /rdo rje rnal 'byor cig bzhed pa/ /mi phyed phyag rgya sgrub pa po/ /rdo rje sbyor las yang dag byung / /bdag nyid chen po khyod ji bzhin/ /mnga' bdag bdag la'ang de ltar mdzod/ /'khor ba 'dam gyi tshogs nang du / /bying ba skyabs med bdag la skyobs/ /nyon mongs ye shes nyid gyur pas/ /byang chub sems chen bdag la stsole/ /lan gsum/ oṃ ā hū/ stong pa'i ngang las/ slob ma dgyes mdzad mtshon cha can zhal phyag yongs su rdzogs par gyur/ o de ba pi tsu badz+ra hū hū hū phaṭa swāhā/ ye shes pa badz+ra sa mā dza dza : ba ho a kha wi ra hu gis gdong bcings/ oṃ badz+ra yo ga tsit+ta u ta pa da ya mi/ zhes sems bskyed/ bdud rtsi lce thog tu bzhag /ji ltar bcom ldan dgyes rdor gyis/ /byang chub sras la dbang bskur ltar/ /bdag gis gsang ba'i dbang gis ni/ /sems kyi rgyun gyi dbang bskur ro/ /gtso bo lnga'i snying po'i mthar/ 'bru gsum btags pa brjod/ slob mas kyang a ho mahā su —170—

kha zhes bya/ de bzhin du shes rab rdo rje bdag med ma'i gzugs sa kyis kyang dbang bskur bar gyur/ ji ltar nas mahā su kha'i bar gong bzhi/ de nas 'bru gsum gyis gdong g.yogs bkrol/ de ltar na kun rdzob byang chub sems kyi dkyil 'khor du zhugs gsang ba'i dbang bskur ba thob/ ngag gi dri ma sbyangs/dam tshig tu sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga la sogs pa bza' ba'i dam tshig rnams sgrub pa la dbang / lam gtum mo dang skyu lus yan lag dang bcas pa bsgom/ 'bras bu longs sku mngon du 'gyur ba'i rten 'brel bsgrigs pa yin no/ /shes rab ye shes kyi don du phyag dang maṇ+ḍal phul/ dus gsum sangs rgyas thams kyi/ /sku gsung thugs kyi rdo rje rnams/ /gcig bsdus bde ba chen po ste/ /gsang ba'i ye shes bdag la stsole// /lan gsum/ gong bzhin mig dgab/ de nas mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa'i rig ma gtad/ dga' ster gnas ster lha mo ni/ /sna tshogs gzugs can yid 'ong ma/ /bzung zhig bzung zhig sems dpa' che/ /bzung la mchod pa rtag tu gyis/ /thabs gzhan gyis ni sangs rgyas min/ /'gro gsum 'di'ang dag pa yin/ /de phyir 'di dang bral bar ni/ khyod kyis nam yang ma byed cig /'di ni sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ /rig pa'i brtul zhugs bla na med/ /blun po gang zhig 'di spong ba/ de la mchog gi dngos grub med/ /lha mo des kyang / bdud rtsi bza' dang btung ba dang / khrag dang khu ba de bzhin te/ kha chen bsten par bu spro'am/ /bud med rnams la rtag gus dang / /bha ga'i pad+ma ra 'o byed par/ /bu khyod ji ltar bde byed smos/ /lha mo ci phyir bdag mi spro/ /bdud rtsi lnga po bza' ba dang / /bdag med ma la rtag tu gus/ /bha ga'i pad+ma ra —171—

'o byed pa/ /a ho nga yi pad+ma ni/ /bde ba kun dang yang dag ldan/ /ci ste cho ga bzhin bsten na/ /de yi mdun na nga 'dug ste/ /sangs rgyas bsnyen pa la sogs pa/ /bya ba pad+ma ra byed bzhin gyis/ /bde chen rgyal po rang nyin ni/ /'di nyid du ni rtag tu bzhugs/ /oṃ ā bhañdza mo k+ṣa ha/ zhes brjod/ de nas/ slob ma dgyes mdzad rdo rje mtshon cha can zhal phyag thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa dang / rig ma rdo rje bdag med mar gyur/ gnyis ka'i rtsa 'khor lo lnga rab tu gsal ba la rgyud sde lnga'i dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs yongs su rdzogs par gyur/ sgrub thabs bzhin mkha' gsang byin gyis wos/ slob dpon gyi thugs ka'i 'od zer gyis sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' thams cad spyan drang / slob ma dang / rig ma'i gnas lngar thim pas bde ba chen pos rgyud byin gyis brlabs/ yab yum snyom par zhugs/ rjes chags gtum mo rab tu 'bar bas spyi bo'i ha yig zhu/ mgrin par phyin pas dga' ba/ snying gar phyin pas mchog dga'/ lte bar phyin pas khyad dga'/ nor bus phyin pas lhan cig skyes dga' mngon du byas/ slar yang hū zhes bya bas gyen du gshegs par gyur te/ 'khor lo bzhir rim pas mas brtan pa'i dga' ba shar te/ spyi bor lhan cig skyes pa brtan par gyur/ snyu gsum gyis gdong g.yogs bkrol/ de ltar na bha ga'i dkyil 'khor du zhugs/ shes rab ye shes kyi dbang bskur thob/ yid kyi dri ma sbyangs/ dam tshig tu dngos dang ye shes kyi rig ma bsten pa la dbang / lam las dang ye shes kyi phyag rgya dang 'od gsal sgom/ 'bras bu chos sku mngon du 'gyur ba'i rten 'brel bsgrigs pa yin no/ /

bzhi pa chen po tshig dbang zhu bar maṇ+ḍal phul/ khyod zhab/sa pad+mo'i bka' drin gyis/ /gtso bo'i dbang bskur rnam gsum thob/ /de ring rin chen bzhi pa yang / /gtso bos bdag la bka' drin stso'i// /de nas bzhi pa tshig tsam gyis sbyin pa ni/ye shes 'di ni ches phra zhing / /rdo rje snying po mkha' dang mtshungs/ /rdul med mthar phyin zhi ba nyid/ khyod kyi pha ni khyod nyid rga /de nas bzhi pa'i ye shes de/ /man ngag sngon du sbyin pa ni/ /phyag rgya bzhi don gcig nyid du/ /brgyung pa yod pas de la bstan/ /phyag rgya bzhi don rim pa lnga/ /lam lnga skad cig de la bsgom/ khyod kyi srog chags bsad par bya/ /rdzun gyi tshig kyang smra bar bya/ /ma byin par yang khyod kyis long / /pha rol bud med bsten par bya/ kha lnga bdud rtsi lnga la rol/ /mi bza' ba ni gang yang med/ /rtsa ba'i ltung ba bcu bzhi bsrung / /des ni tha mal spangs nas 'grub/ /de ltar na don dam/ byang chub sems kyi dkyil 'khor du zhugs/ dbang bzhi pa thob sgo gsum gyi dri ma'i bag chags thams cad sbyangs/ dam tshig tu dgongs te gsungs pa'i dam tshig rnams kyang spyod pa la dbang / lam zung 'jug phyag rgya chen po bsgom/ 'bras bu ngo bo nyid sku mngon du 'gyur ba'i rten 'brel bsgrigs pa yin rgo /de nas/ gtso bos ji ltar sogs dang / gtang rag gi maṇ+ḍal 'bul ba dang / deng nas brtsams te sogs dang / dge ba bsngo ba rnams bya'o/ /bcu gsum pa ni/ mchod pa rgya cher bshams/ gong bzhin byin gyis rlabs/ smu/chod yon nas rol mo'i bar tshigs bcad dang bcas pa gong bzhin brjod/ de bzhin du nang mchod kyang sngar bzhin phul/ de nyid lnga pas bstod/ bcom ldan 'das dpal dgyes mdzad rdo rje'i lha — 173—

tshogs 'bor dang bcas pa rnams dang / bcom ldan 'das dpal gsang ba 'dus pa'i lha tshogs 'khor dang bcas pa rnams dang / bcom ldan 'das dpal snyen ra lo sdom pa'i lha tshogs 'khor dang bcas pa rnams dang / bcom ldan 'das dpal sgyu 'phrul chen po'i lha tshogs 'khor dang bcas pa rnams dang /bcom ldan 'das dpal gshin rje gshed rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi lha tshogs 'khor dang bcas pa rnams nga/nga / rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i bla ma dam pa rnams dang / sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' rnams dang / dpa' bo dang mkha' 'gro ma'i tshogs rnams dang / dpal myur mdzad ye shes kyi mgon po zhing skyong ba 'khor dang bcas pa rnams dang / dpal gtsang rigs kyi mgon po bdun cu rtsa lnga la sogs pa phyi nang gsang ba'i dam can gyi tshogs dang bcas pa rnams bdag la dgongs su gsol/ bdag dang sems can thams cad bla na med pa'i byang chub kyi gnas la 'god par mdzad du gsol/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan nga rin po che dar ba dang / sems can thams cad la bde skyid 'phel bar mdzad du gsol/ khyad par rig pa 'dzin pa'i theg pa lung dang rtogs pas bsdus pa mtha' dag byin rlabs mi nyams shing shin tu dar bar mdzad du gsol/ bdag dang slob mar bcas pa la mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub ma lus nga tshe 'di nyid la stsal du gsol/ rgyud kyi rgyal po rnams las ji skad bshad pa'i las thams cad thogs pa med par 'grub par mdzad du gsol/zhes dngos grub zhu/ yi ge brgya pa lan nyi shu rtsa gcig sogs 'don zhing / ma 'byor pa dang sogs dang / lhag pa dang ni sogs dang / gtso bor nus pa ma mchis pa sogs kyis — 174—

bzod par gsol/ de nas dkyil 'khor gyi shar sgo'i thad du gnas pas/ cho se thams cad mnyam/ pa nyid du mos pas/ o khyod kyis sems can don kun mdzad/ /rjes su mthun pa'i dngos grub stsole/ /sangs rgyas yul du gshegs nas kyang / /slar yang 'byon par mdzad du gsol/ /zhes lan gsum gyis mthar rol mo'i sgra dang bcas/ o a kā ro mu kha sarba dharmā ṇa u du nu tra sno twa ta o ā hu phaṭa mu zhes brjod cing thog rma ra dbang ldan gyi rtsig pa bzhag /de rjes su thig chen brgyad kyi sa nas dbyi'o/ mthar ci bder phyags shing lha mtshan rnams logs su bsdu'o/ /de byin rlabs kyi don du rang gi spyi bor cung zad blugs la/ don du gnyer ba rnams la'ang cung zad byin/ de nyid bum pa bzang por blug ste bkur sti dang bcas klu brgyad mchod pa'i cho gas chu bor sbyan drangs shing gtad do/ /slar 'ong ste thig rjes rnams mi mngon par byas la/ lha mo sangs rgyas spyan ma'i sngags kyis phur bu phyung zhing / sngags de nyid kyis phur khung kyang 'o mas bkang ngo / /sgrub mchod nyid zhag sbrel mar byed na yang gshegs gsol gyi nyin mo ma gtogs gshegs gsol gyi don du brtan bzhugs bya zhing / dngos gzhi nyin rting ma rnams la nam mkha'i lha 'bebs pa'i skor rnams mi dgos so/ /smon lam btab cing bkra shis kyang rgya cher brjod la shul de nyid du sbyin sreg dang tshogs kyi 'khor lo la sogs pa dga' ston rgya cher bya'o/ /de ltar bsha/da pa'i dge 'dis kyang / /dpag g.yas sems can ma lus rnams/ /yan lag bdun ldan sku bzhi'i dngos/ /rdo rje 'chang chen thob nga ra shog/ //dpal rgyud sde lnga'i bdag 'jug ngag 'don 'di yang nye mkhor mthong nas tā ra nā thas smras pa'o/ / bkra shis/ gcig zhus/ /

mngon rtogs bzhugs/oṃ khyu sti/ rgyal ba mchog rnams kun gyi dngos/ /lhan skyes dga' chen he ru ka /ye shes lnga ldan dkyil 'khor la/ /bcan nas de yi sgrub thabs bshad/ /skyabs 'gro sems bskyed sngon du bto / /mdun gyi nam mkhar skad cig gis/ /rigs lnga'i lha tshogs byon par gyur/ /bdag gi sdig sgrib ma lus pa sbyang du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/thugs ka nas lha mo bdud rtsis gang ba'i bum pa thogs pa spros/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shrī ye hūX/ zhes gsung zhing khrus byas pas/ dbang bzhi thob/ sdig sgrib thams cad dag /lus shel gong g.ya' dag pa ltar gyur/'og nas 'byung ba ltar nang mchod byin gyis brlab te/ oṃ ā huX zhes myang / oṃ ā phri ta bā tsa rak+ṣa rak+ṣa huX phaṭa/ rang gi sems nyid gzung 'dzin gnyis bral gyi ye shes spros pa mtha' dag gis dben pa'o/ /zhes mnyam par bzhag /rang skad cig gi 'khor lo sdom pa'i skur gyur pa'i thugs kar huX/ oṃ badz+ra rak+ṣa rak+ṣa hūX hūX hūX phaṭa lan gsum thugs ka'i hūX las raX 'og phyogs su ho/ nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor du gyur/ hūX spros pa las sna tshogs rdo rje'i rang bzhin gyis/ sa gzhi dang de las 'phros pa'i rwa gur du gyur/ huX las hūX dpag tu med pa phyogs bcur spros/ rdo rje rtse gcig pa nas dgu pa'i bar du gyur pas bar mtshams med par bltams pa/ nyi ma las 'bar ba'i mes rab tu bzhu ste rwa gur gyi phyi rol dum bu gcig tu 'dres — 176—

shing / phyi nang kun tu me lces gang bar gyur/ snying ga'i huX gi 'od zer gyis/ bla ma yi dam sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' thams cad mdun gyi nam mkhar badz+ra sa mā dzaX sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun ni/ /bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro dang / khro bo chos skyong bcas pa la/ /bdag ni gus pas skyabs su mchi/ / lan gsum/ tshad med bzhi spyi dang mthun pa lan gsum/ skyabs yul de rnams bdag gi mdun du byon te/ 'od zer rang gi lus la phog pas/ rang gi lus ngag yid gsum gyi dri ma mtha' dag sbyangs te/ me long dang gzugs brnyan ltar rang dang skyabs yul dbyer med du gyur/ slar yang snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros/ dpal he ru ka lha lnga'i dkyil 'khor bla ma dang sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs dang bcas pa mdun gyi nam mkhar byon par gyur/ oX na maXte hūX/ na mo me skyoX/ na mo na maXskyoX/ zhes phyag 'tshal/ ar+ghaX nas shak+ta'i bar gyis mchod/ oṃ āXhuX lan gnyis kyis nang mchod dang gsang mchod phul/ mchod bya mchod byed mchod pa rnams gnyis su med cing dmigs su med pa'o/ /zhes de bo/ na nyid kyi mchod pa bya/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi/ /sogs rgyun bshags lan gsum bya/ tshogs zhing 'od gsal gyi ngang du thim/ oX su bhā wa shudha sarba dharma su bha wa shurnyo3haX/ gzung ba rang bzhin med pa'i bdag nyid do/ /oX hūṃ n+ya ta dzñā na badz+ra swa bhā wa at+pa ko3haX/ 'dzin pa yang rang bzhin mi dmigs te/ chos thams cad stong pa nyid do/ /zhes mnyam par bzhag /stong pa'i ngang las/ skad cig gis phyi rol dur khrod brgyad dang bcas pa'i bsrung 'khor gyi dbus su/ yaX las rlung gi dkyil 'khor sngon po zla gam/ raX las me'i dkyil 'khor dmar po gru gsum/ baX las chu'i —177—

dkyil 'khor dkar po zlum po/ la las sa'i dkyil 'khor ser po gru bzhi/ su las ri rgyal lhun po shar shel/ byang ser/ nub pad+ma rā ga /lho be+e rje rlu las grub pa/ bang rim bzhi dang ldan zhing lcog brgyad kyis brgyan pa gru bzhi pa ste/ 'byung bzhi ri rab rnams steng nas steng du brtsegs pa'o/ /de'i steng du/ pa las sna tshogs pad+ma'i lte bar/ hu las byung ba'i sna tshogs rdo rje/ shar dkar byang ljang nub dmar lho ser/ lte ba mthing nag gru bzhi pa/ de'i steng du pa las sna tshogs pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa lte ba dang ge sar du bcas pa dang / pad+ma'i lte bar ra las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor 'jigs byed dus mtshan dang bcas pa'o/ /de'i steng du rang sems zla ba dmar skya la gnas pa'i hu/ de las 'od zer 'phros/'phags pa mchod sems can gyi don byas/ slar 'dus te thams cad ro gcig tu 'dres pa yongs su gyur pa las/ brten pa lha'i dkyil 'khor yongs su rdzogs pa ni/ dbus kyi gdan gyi steng du/ rang nyid dpal he ru ka 'khor lo bde mchog sku mdog mthing kha in+d+ra shī la ltar 'bar ba'i 'od zer 'phro ba/zhal gcig phyag gnyis dmar la zlum pa'i spyan gsum g.yo ba/ khro zhing sgeg la chags pa'i nyams can mche ba'i myu gu cung zad gtsigs pa/ bzhin shin tu 'gyur ba'i khro gnyer bsdus shing 'jigs su rung ba/ bung ba lhar gnag pa'i dbu skra ral pa'i thor tshugs spyi bor bcings pa/ rtse mo rus pa'i 'khor lo la gnas pa'i nor bu dang / ral pa'i ngos la sna tshogs rdo rje dang / g.yon ngos su zla ba phyed pas brgyan pa/ mi rus kyi rna cha dang mgul rgyan dang gdub bu'i tshogs dang ska rags dang mchod phyir sogs kyis brgyan pa/ thal ba chen pos nye —178—

bar byugs shing / mi mgo skam po lnga'i dbu rgyan dang / dpa' bo'i dar dpyangs dang bcas pa/ mi'i rgyu ma la rgyus pa'i khrag 'dzag mgo bo lnga bcu'i do shal can/stag gi pags pa'i sham thabs grol ba/ phyag g.yas rdo rje dang / g.yon dril bu 'dzin pas yum la 'khyud pa/ zhabs g.yon bskum pas 'jigs byed nag po dang / g.yas brkyang bas dus mtshan ma dmar mo mnan pa/ gar gyi nyams dgu dang ldan zhing / spo dang dpe byad yongs su rdzogs nga 'o/ /de la 'byud pa'i yum rdo rje phag mo sku mdog dmar mo/ /bskal ba'i me ltar gzi brjid 'bar ba/ phyag g.yas rdo rje gri gug dang bcas pa'i sdigs/ mdzub kyis phyogs thams cad gnon cing / g.yon thod pa khrag gis gang ba 'dzin pas yab la 'khyud pa/gcer bu skra grol zhing phyag rgya lngas brgyan pa/ thod skam gyi dbu rgyan dang do shal can/ 6khas g.yas bskum g.yon brkyangs pas yab la 'khyu/da pa/ yab yum gnyis ka yang lang tsho gsar du brngo ba me dpung 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'o/ khar gyi 'dab ma la mkha' 'gro ma mthing ga /byang du lā ma ljang khu/nub tu dum skyes ma dmar mo/ lhor gzugs can ma ser mo/ thams cad kyang zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan gsum ma/ g.yas gri gug 'phyar zhing / g.yon thod phrag thugs kar 'dzin pa/ mchan khung du rdo rjes mtshan pa'i kha ṭāX ga dang bcas shing / mi ro'i gdan la zhabs g.yas brkyang gi stabs kyis bzhugs pa/rdo rje phag mo dang mtshungs shing phag mo'i rigs las byung ba'o/ /mtshams bzhi bdud rtsi lngas gang ba'i bum pa thod pas kha brgyan pa dang bcas pa rnams 'khod par gyur/ rang gi snying ga'i huX las 'od zer 'phros/ 'khor lo bde mchog lha —179—

lnga'i dkyil 'khor h+pha/ badz+ra sa mā dzaX ar+ghaX nas shasta'i bar gyis ma rdzo/ dzaXhūX baX hoXganyis su med par thim/ oṃ yo ga shudha sarba dharma yo ga shu rdzo3haX/ rang gi dpral bar oX dkar po/ mgrin par āXdamar po/ thugs kar huX sngon po/ yang snying ga'i huX las 'od zer 'phros/ dbang gi lha sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' khro bo'i dbang po rnams btsun mor bcas pa thams cad spyan drangs/ phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod nga thams cad kyis mchod par gyur/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi khiñtsa tu maX/ gtso bo'i thugs ka nas yum lnga bdud rtsi'i bum pa thogs pa spros/ oṃ badzi bha ba a bhi 'khri ñtsa hūX/ zhes gsung zhing / bum pa'i chus spyi bo nas dbang bskur/ sku gang / dri ma dag /chu'i lhag ma yar lud pa las/ gtso bo dang / mkha' 'gro ma la mi bskyod pa/ rdo rje phag mo la rnam snang / lwa ma la don yod grub pa/ dum skyes ma la 'od dpag med/ gzugs can ma la rin chen 'byung ldan gyis dbu brgyan pa/ cung zad rgyas pa la spro na lha dbang bskur ba'i skabs 'dir/byang chub rdo rje sogs kyis gsol ba btab/ ji ltar bltams pa sogs dang / a bhi ṣe ka'i sngags kyis dbang bskur ba'i lugs kyang yod pa ltar spro na bya'o/ de nas bdud rtsi myang ba ni/gtor ma ltar byin gyis rlabs kyang rung mod kyi/ lag len la de lta bu gtso bor mi mdzad do/ /des na bsang sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las/ ka pā la yangs shing rgya che ba nang sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga dang myos byed kyis gang ba/ de'i steng du dpal 'khor lo bde mchog lha lnga skad cig gis bzhugs par gyur / oX hri ha ha huX phaṭa/ lan bdun sogs ci rigs bzla/ phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas thams cad spyan drangs/ thod pa'i steng gi he ru ka lha lnga'i sku la thim/ sbyor mtshams dang / gsang ba'i sgo nas bdud rtsi'i rgyun — /8()—
