babs/ gzhir gnas kyi dam rdzas dang 'dres te ye shes kyi bdud rtsis thod pa gang bar gyur pa la/ lha lnga po rnams kyang bdud rtsir zhu te thim/ so so'i snying po'i mthar 'bru gsum btags te bdud rtsi myangs pas/ lha thams cad bde bas mnyes par bsam/bar 'dir rdzogs rim rtsa 'khor lo bzhi pa'i gtum mo dang / rdo rje'i bzlas pa bya ste yig rnying las shes par bya'o/ /de bzhin du yig rnying las 'byung ba ltar bzlas pa'i dmigs pa yang gsal btab la/ o shrī badz+ra he he ru ru ka hu hu phaṭa/ ḍā ki nī dzā la sam+bha ra swāhā/ yab kyi snying po'o/ /o hri ha ha hu hu phaṭa/ nye snying ngo / /o sarba budha ḍā ki nī ye badz+ra brta nī ye hu hū ཾ phaṭa/ swāhā/ yum gyi snying po'o/ /o badz+ra be+e ro tsa ṇi ye hu hū phaṭa swāhā/ nye snying ngo / /oṃ ḍā ki nī ye hū hu phaṭa/ oṃ lā ma hū hū phaṭa/ o khaṇ+ḍa ro he hu hu phaṭa/ o ru pi nī ye hu hū phaṭa/ 'khor rnams kyi sngags so/ /ces ci nus su bzla/ gtor chog dang 'brel ba yin na skabs 'dir gtor ma gtong ba yin na'ang / sgrub thabs tsam sgom pa la/ skabs 'dir gtor ma nges par dgos pa ma yin pas/ dkyil 'khor nyer bsdu byas te/ thun mtsham sa la 'jug go /de yang / rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros/ khams gsum snod bcud thams cad 'khor lo sdom pa'i dkyil 'khor du gyur/ de rnams 'od du zhu/ bdag nyid kyi bsgoms pa'i dkyil 'khor la thim/ rten gyi dkyil 'khor 'od du zhu/ lha mo bzhi la thim/ lha mo bzhi rang la thim/ yum yang yab kyi thugs kar thim/dpal he ru ka yang 'od gsal gyi dbyings su thim par gyur/ cung zad mnyam par bzhag /'od gsal gyi ngang las slar yang he ru ka'i skur gyur/ dpral bar o/mgrin par ā thugs kar hū/ kun tu sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ /rdo rje 'chang chen go 'phang ldan/ /bdag gi dge ba 'dis thob te/ /'gro kun gyis kyang thob — 181 —

par shog /rdzogs pa'i byang chub phyir spyod gang / /rdzogs sangs rgyas nas gang spyod pa/ /byang chub rdo rjes sngags pa yi/ /spyod pa de gnyis bdag spyod shog /ces dge ba bsngo ba'o/ /gtor ma gtong bar 'dod na legs par bshams te/ su snas bsangs/swa bhā bas sbyangs/ yaX las rlud dang / raX las me'i steng du/ kaX las mi mgo'i skyed pu gsum la gnas pa'i a las ka pā la/ de'i nang du pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa'i dbus dang phyogs bzhir/ na go ku da ha las mi/ ba glang / khyi rta glang chen te sha lnga/ dbus dang mtshams bzhir mu bi ra shu ma las/ chu sman/ rdul/ khu ba/ klad pa ste bdud rtsi lnga/ sha lnga'i thad kyi steng rnams su/ hūX oṃ traX hriX.a ye shes lnga'i ngo bo/ de'i steng gi nam mkha' la zla ba la oṃ āXhūX/ de'i steng du huX las byung ba/bdud rtsis rang bzhin gyi kha ṭāX ga dkar po mgo bo thur du blta ba/ rlung g.yos me sbar rdzas bcu yi ge bco lnga dang bcas pa zhu/ oṃ āXhūX 'bru gsum gyi 'od kyis sbyangs rtogs sbar gsum du byas/ kha ṭāX ga'i rtse mor hanaX/ /de'i 'od kyis ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i bkug nas kha ṭāX ga la thim/ zla ba yi ge gsum kha ṭaX ga dang bcas thod pa'i nang du lhung / kha ṭāX gis dkrugs pas thams can zhu ste/ dam rdzas dang gnyis su med par gyur pas/ gtor ma ye shes bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ /ha ho hriXlan mang du brjod/ ga kho ma byin gyis bsas pa'o/ /rang gi mdun du 'khor lo bde mchog lha lnga'i dkyil 'khor la/ sangs rgyas byang sems mkha' 'gro'i tshogs dang bcas pa dang / rig drug gi sems can thams cad/he ru ka yab yum gyi rnam par gyur pas phyogs thams cad nas bskor ba grub par gyur/ 'bar ba'i phyag rgya bcas pas h+pha/ /oṃ badz+ra a ra zhi ho dzaXhūX baX hoX badz+ra ḍā —182—

ki ni sa ma ya stu/ dra lja ho/ phyogs bcu dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad ye shes 'khor lo'i rnam par byon pa rnams dam tshig 'khor lo dang ro gcig tu gyur/ mgron skyed pa'o/ /lha rnams kyi ljags rdo rje'i sbu gus gtor ma gsol bar gyur/ o badz+ra ḍi ki nī i da ba la gro hā gro hā hu hū phaṭa/ yi ge bdun pa dang / be+e ro tsa na dang /mkha' 'gro bzhi'i sngags rnams kyi mthar/ i da ba li ta kha kha sku hi ji hi/ zhes btags pa lan lngas 'bul he ye shes lha la mchod pa'o/ /o kha kha 'a hi 'a hi/ sarba yak+ṣa/ rak+ṣa sa bhu ta/ pre ta/ pi shā tsa/ ud man+ta/ a pa smar/ nā ka/ ḍā ki n+ya da ya/ i ma bā li/grit+na na tu/ sa ma ya rak+ta na tu/ ma ma sarba sirnyi sme pra ya:skyo/ ya thi ba/ ya the ṣ+ṭha bhañdza tha pi ba thā/ dzigh+ra thā/ ma ti kra ma thā/ ma ma sarba ka rta ya/ sad su kha/ bi shu khyu sdo/sa ha yi ka bhan+ta hū hū phaṭa phaṭa swāhā/ lan gsum gyi dur khrod na gnas pa dang 'byung po'i tshogs la 'bul/ ar+gha nas/ shaga'i gyis mchod/ 'khru gsum gyis nang mchod phul/ yab yum gyi rkang pa brgyad pa'i gsang sngags kyis bstod/ bcom ldan bde mchog 'khor dang bcas/ khyed la mchod cing bstod pa yis/ /rnal 'byor bdag cag 'khor bcas la/ /nad med tshe dang dbang phyug dang / /dpal dang grags dang skal pa bzang / /longs spyod rgya chen kun thob cing / /zhi dang rgyas la sogs pa yi/ /las kyi dngos grub bdag la stsol/ /dam tshig can gyis bdag la srungs/ /dngos grub kun gyis stongs grogs mdzod/ /dus min 'chi dang nad rnams dang / /gdon dang bgegs rnams med par mjodi/ /rmi lam ngan dang mtshan ma ngan/ /bya byed ngan pa med par mdzod/ /'jig rten bde zhing lo legs dang / /— 183—

'bru rnams 'phel zhing chos 'phel ba/ /bde legs thams cad 'byung ba dang / /yid la 'dod pa kun 'grub shog /ces pas lon las gzhol lo/ /gang yang bdag blo gti mug pas/ /legs byas 'di la nyes gyur gang / /gang phyir lus can skyabs gyur pa/ /de kun mgon khyod bzod par gsol/ /zhes pa bzod par gsol lo/ /oṃ khyed kyis sems can don kun mdzad/ /rjes su mthun pa'i dngos grub stsol/ /sangs rgyas yul du gshegs nas kyang / /slar yang 'byon par mdzad du gsol/ /o badz+ra mu zhes mgron gshegs su gsol/sems can thams cad bde gyur cig /sems can thams cad nad med pa/ /sangs rgyas nyid du 'gro ba yi/ /lam de nyid du grub gyur cig /ma bsgral pa rnams bdag gis bsgral/ /ma sgrol ba rnams bdag gis sgrol/ /rnal 'byor gtsug lag bstan bcos la/ /da lta nyid du gnas par shog /ces smon lam bto/legs pa'i yon tan rab rdzogs pa/ /bla ma yi dam bkra shis shog /'phrin las thams cad sgrub mdzad pa/ /mkha' 'gro chos skyong bkra shis shog /ces shis pa brjod/ dge ba'i tshogs rnams bsags pa kun/ /bdag gir yongs su bzung med par/ /sems can ma lus kun don du/ /chos dbyings bla na med par bsngo/ /wo dge ba byang chub tu bsngo/ ye shes mkha' 'gro'i dgongs don gang / /blo dman rnams la nyer mkho'i phyir/ /ngag 'don cung zad bsdebs pa yi/ /dge bas 'gro kun grol gyur cig/ // ces pa'ang rgyal khams pa tā ra nā thas smras pa'o/ /dge'o/ /ma ṅga la/ /—184—

oṃ snya sti/ dpal rtag brtan dam chos gling nges don dga' ba'i tshal gyi par khang du/ dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i bstod r+ṣa/ dus 'khor gyi dbang gong ma'i cho ga /spyor ba yan lag drug pa'i khrid yig /de'i gegs sel 'khrul 'khor/ dus 'khor chos 'byung /bde mchog bstod chen/ dges pa rdo rje'i sgrub thabs/ de'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga /gshed dmar lha lnga'i sgrub thabs/ de'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga /dpal gsang ba 'dus pa'i sgrub dkyil 'bar ba'i 'od gsal/ yang dpal gsang ba 'dus pa ye shes zhabs lugs kyi sgrub dkyil/ tshe dbang lha gcig bum gcig gi cho ga /'khor lo bde mchog lha lnga'i sgrub dkyil/ rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i bskyed rim gyi man ngag /bsngo ba yas gtam sogs/ par brkos kyi 'du byed/ mdo smad brag sna pa gzhon nu/ rdo rje lhun grub/ sa skya skyab pa/ lcags thang pa bstan pa yar 'phel bzhi'i bsam pa rnam par dag pa'i sgo nas/rta lo nas bya lo hor zla lnga pa yin la/ bslab cing brkos mthar phyin pa dang / gong gi chos tshan so so brkos pa'i dge bas skye ba 'di nas bzung byang chub ma thob bar rje btsun thams cad mkhyen pa kun dga' snying po'i bstan pa la phan cing bya ba byed nus pa gcig tu skye bar gyur cig/ // maṅgal//bdag gis skye ba 'di nas 'phos ma thag /sngags kyi zhing der ma 'gag bzhugs pa'i drung / /thugs sras mchog gi thu bor skyes nas kyang / /tshe gcig gsang chen lam bzang mthar phyin shog /ma tis smras/ /— 185—

dbang chog bzhugs/na mo gu dra/ sangs rgyas rdo rje bde ba che/ khrag 'thung dpal gyi dkyil 'khor ni/ /ye shes lnga ldan la btud nas/ /dkyil 'khor cho ga bri bar bya/ /'dir ye shes mkha' 'gro ni gu ma'i man ngag/lugs 'di'i khrid tshul kun gyi sngon du 'gro ba/ bde mchog lha lnga'i dbang gi cho ga ni/rnam pa gnyis te ras bris la brten pa dang / rdul tshon la brten pa'o/ /de la dang po'i dbang du byas nas/ lhag gnas dang dngos gzhi dang rjes kyi bya ba gsum las/ dang po la sngon 'gro gtor ma sdo/za bsangs/ swabha was sbyangs/ skye( āXhuX ha ho / hi zhes byin gyis brlabs/ h+pha badz+ra a ra l+li ho nas/ khru khyo ho'i bar gyi mgron rnams bkug slo kha khya man chad lan gsum gyis phul/ar+ghaX nas shabha'i bar gyis mchod/ lha chen brgyad po 'khor dang bcas/ /klu chen brgyad po 'khor dang bcas/ /'jig rten skyong ba brgyad po dang / /gnod sbyin tshogs rnams ma lus dang / /srin po'i 'byung po'i: sha za'i: spyo byed:brjed byed: ma mo'i: de la sogs te 'byung po'i tshogs/ /ma lus ji snyed yod pa rnams/ /'dir gshegs bdag la dgongs su gsol/ /rnal 'byor bdag cag 'khore bcas la/ /zhes pa nas/ yid la 'dod pa kun 'gru ba rbe(ga /dam can khyed rnams dkyil 'khor ra gyi/ /las la bsrung ba dam pa dang / /yul phyogs 'di dang sbyin bdag dang / /slob ma la yang shis par mdzod/ /gsang spyod lta bar mi dbang pa'i/ /'byung po'i tshogs rnams gang yin pa/ /gtor 3/'i — 186—

lhag ma 'di long la/ /da lta nyid du gzhan du dengs/ /ci te 'gro bar mi byed na/ /rdo rje 'dzin chen khros pa'i bkas/ /mtshon cha 'bar ba'i sprin spros nas/ /lus sems rdul du brlag ta re/ /zhes gtor ma phyir dor la mtshams bcad/ de nas mchod pa zhig bshams la/ gnas dang yo byad bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang du huX yig las byung ba'i srung 'khor gyi nang du chud pa'i/ bhuX las gnas khang gzhal med khang mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa'i nang du/ oṃ āXhuX rnams las byung zhing / lha rdzas las grub pa'i mchod yon/ zhabs bsil/ me tog bdug sbos / mar me/ dri chab/ zhal zas/ rol mo la sogs pa mchod pa'i yo byad bzang zhing gya nom pa/ yul dus chad pa med par yongs su khyab cing / rnam 'phrul bsam gyis mi khyab pa/ rang bzhin bde stong gi ye shes/ rnam pa mchod rdzas kyi sprin phung / byed las rang gzhan mtha' dag zag med kyi bde bas tshim par byed pas/ phyi nang thams cad du gang bar gyur/ lkoX badz+ra ar+ghaX swāhā/ de bzhin du/ pu duX/ oṃ badz+ra pur+sha āXskyoX/ de bzhin du/ dhape/ ā lo ke /ga rnye/ ni be t+ya/ shasta/oX sarba bid pū ra pū ra/ su ra su ra/ ā brta ya ā brta ya ho/ oṃ badz+ra snya ra ṇa khaX/ rol mos byin 'bebs zhing / oṃ badz+ra gaṇ+ḍi ra ṇi ta/ pra ra ṇi ta/ saX pra ra ṇi ta/sarba bzhi slo ta pra tsa li te/ pradzha pa ra mi ta/ na da sam+bha be ta badz+ra dharma hri da ya ni sa sto ṣa ni huX hruX huX ho ho ho a khaX swāhā/ zhes lan gsum brjod/ de nas bdag bskyed ni/skyabs 'gro nas/ dkyil 'khor nyer bsdu'i gnas gsum byin rlabs kyi bar yan chad/ sgrub thabs bzhin du bya/ de nas dkyil 'khor gyi sa gzhir mchod pa rgya cher bshams/ gtor ma gnyis kyang bshams te/ slar yang gong bzhin mchod pa byin gyis brlabs/ rol mo byin 'bebs mi —187—

dgos/ rang gi snying ga'i hū las 'od zer 'phros pas/ phyogs bcu dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas byang sems/ dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i tshogs thams cad/ gcig tu 'dus te/ mdun gyi nam mkhar dpal 'khor lo sdom pa'i dkyil 'khor du gyur pa ni/ skad cig gis phyi rol dur khrod brgyad dang bcas pa'i srung 'khor gyi dbus su/ 'byung bzhi ri rab dang bcas pa'i dbus su/ sna tshogs rdo rje la gnas pa'i gzhal med khang mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa/ dbus kyi gdan gyi steng du dpal he ru ka zhes pa nas/ 'khod par gyur/ dngos gzhi'i skabs su 'chad par 'gyur ba ltar/ mchod bstod gtor bsngo rnams bya/ bcom ldan 'das dpal 'khor lo sdom pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs/ phyogs bcu dus gsum na bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'/ dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma'i tshogs dang bcas pa rnams kyis/ sang nyin dkyil 'khor chen po byin gyis rlob pa dang / bdag dang slob mar bcas pa la dngos grub stsol pa'i 'phrin las mdzad du gsol/ zhes lan gsum gsol ba btab/ bsdu na de tsam gyis chog la/ rgyas pa la dga' na phyis kyi lag len ltar/ bcom ldan 'khor lo sdom pa mchog /rigs sngags rgyal po khyod la 'dud/ /slob ma rnams la brtse phyir dang / khyed rnams la yang mchod pa'i phyir/ /mgon po thugs rje'i bdag nyid can/ /dkyil 'khor bri bar bdag 'tshal lo/ /de phyir bcom ldan bdag gus la/ /bka' drin snang bar mdzad par rigs/ /sangs rgyas 'gro 'khor bya phyir stsole// /byang chub sems dpa' 'bras gnas dang / /gzhan yang gang dag gsang sngags lha/ /lha dang 'jig rten skyong ba dang / /'byung po byang chub bstan gnas — 188—

dang / /sems can bstan la mngon dga' ba/ /gang su rdo rje'i spyan mnga' rnams/ /bdag la yang dag dgongs su gsol/ /bdag ni rdo rje che ge can/ /bde mchog 'khor lo'i dkyil 'khor ni/ /ji ltar nus pa nyer sbyor bas/ /'gro ba sbyang phyir bri bar bya/ /de phyir bdag dang slob ma la/ /rjes su brtse bas nyer bzung nas/ /dkyil 'khor dang bcas thams cad ni/ /nye bar 'byon par mdzad par rigs/ /zhes kyang lan gsum gsol ba btab/ /yig brgya lan gsum/ gang yang bdag blo sogs bzod par gsol nas/ oṃ mu zhes dbyings su gshegs su gsol/ lha lhag par gnas pa'i don no/ /bum pa gnyis spyi dang mthun par bshams/ bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las pa las pad+ma dang a las zla ba'i steng du bhu las rin po che'i bum pa yangs shing rgya che ba/ lto ba ldir zhing / mgrin pa phra ba/ mchu 'phyang ba/ lha'i gos kyi mgul bcings dang / dpag bsam gyi shing gis kha brgyan pa/ nang chu dang bcud thams cad kyis yongs su gang ba'i dbus su/ pa las sna tshogs pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa/ zhes pa nas/ rin chen 'byung ldan gyis dbu brgyan gyi bar/bdag skyed dang 'dra ba las/ rang nyid ces sogs kyi tshig dor ro/ /de nas bum bzlas ni/ yab yum gyi nye snying dang / mkha' 'gro ma bzhi'i sngags rnams ci 'grub tu bzla/ a bhi ṣe ka ta'i sngags kyang nyer gcig la sogs pas byin gyis brlabs/ bum pa'i mchod pa sangs sbyangs byin rlabs byas la/ ar+gha nas shabha'i bar gyis mchod/ yab yum gyi rkang pa brgyad pas bstod/yig brgya dang bzod gsol byas la/ o ā hu zhes pas mchod yon phul/ bum nang gi lha rjes chags kyi mes yongs su zhu te byang chub kyi sems su gyur zhes brjod/ ci ste las bum logs su sgrub par 'dod na/ snga ma'i bzlas pa song mtshams su/ las bum gyi nang du khro — 189—

bo bdud rtsi 'khyil ba/ skad cig gis bskyed nas/ su lha'i sngags ci nus su bzlas/ mchod pa man chad phyogs gcig tu mdzad/ mchod yon dang gzungs thag phyogs so sor byed pa'am/ snga phyir spo ba'i srol kyang yod/ 'on kyang 'di la las bum gzhung las ma bshad cing nges par dgos pa ma yin no/ /bum pa lha gnas so/ /slob ma rnams la sngon 'gro'i bya ba rnams skabs 'dir byed pa/ slob ma lhag gnas kyi don yin cing / lhag por bya ba ni/ sgo gsum byin gyis brlabs nas mchod pa 'bul ba yin no/ /de yang 'di ltar sngon 'gro rnam pa bcu'i nang gi gsang ba bsgrags pa dang ye shes dbab pa dang nangs par dgos pas skabs 'dir mi mdzad bsam pa 'chos pa dang / skyabs sems dang / spro bskyed pa dang / maṇ+ḍal dang bcas pa'i gsol btab dang / gnang ba sbyin pa dang / rtog pa bsdu pa dang / yan lag lnga pa dang / sdom pa 'bogs pa rnams song ba'i rjes su/ nang mchod dang dri bzang bsres pa'i thig les slob ma'i gnas gsum du 'bru gsum brjod de byin gyis brlabs la/ slob dpon gyi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ sangs rgyas thams cad sku rdo rje rnam snang gi rnam par spyan drangs te khyed rang rnams kyi dpral bar thim/ gsung rdo rje 'od dpag med kyi rnam par sbyan drangs te mgrin par thim/ thugs rdo rje mi bskyod pa'i rnam par spyan drangs te snying gar thim par mos mdzod/ ces bya/ 'di ni sngon 'gro dgu par byed cing / bcu pa ni gzengs bstod pa ste/ 'jig rten du ni kun mkhyen rnams/ /zhes pa nas/ des kyang 'di la dga' bar gyis/ /zhes pa'i bar ro/ /de ltar na mdor len gyi dbang du byas pa'i sngon 'gro rnam pa bcu po de dag ni/ slob ma lhag gnas so/ /dgu pa dang bcu pa'i bar du/ so shing / 'khyor chu/ bsrung skud/ ku sha rnams ster ba'i lag len kyang 'ga' zhig la snang ba spyir mi 'gal yang / gzhung na med pas nges par dgos pa ma yin no/ /gnyis pa — 190—

dngos gzhi la/ dkyil 'khor sgrub pa mchod pa 'bul ba/ bdag nyid 'jug pa/ slob ma dbang bskur te bzhi las/ dang po ni/ sngon 'gro gtor ma gnas yo byin rlabs/ bdag bskyed nyer bsdu'i bar/ gong lhag gnas kyi skabs bzhin du bya/ de nas mdun skyed kyi dkyil 'khor bkram/ mchod pa bzang po dang / gtor ma zlum gtor gnyis sam/ thod gzugs dar mtshon sna lngas brgyan pa gang rung bya/ mdun bskyed kyi dkyil 'khor bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las e las byung ba'i chos kyi 'byung gnas kyi dbus su/ ya las rlung gi dkyil 'khor zhes pa nas/lte ba mthing nag gru bzhi pa hu gis mtshan pa/ de las 'od zer phyogs bcur 'phros/ bsrung 'khor rdo rje'i phyag gzhi rwa ba drwa ba gur bla re mda'i drwa ba me dpung 'bar ba dang bcas par gyur/ bsrung ba'i 'khor lo'i nang du bhu las gzhal med khang chen po/ gru bzhi pa sgo bzhi pa/ rta babs bzhis brgyan pa/'dod yon gyi snam bu dang / pha gu dang drwa phyed dang / rin po che dang mda' yab la sogs pa mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa/ gdugs dang rgyal mtshan dang ba dan dang rnga yab la sogs pa rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/ lha dang mi las khyad par du 'phags pa'i mchod pa'i sprin du mas gang ba/ nang ka ba brgyad dang ldan pa'i steng rdo rje'i gdung zlum po dang / de'i steng du rdo rje'i thal gdung gnyis mig mangs ris su bris shing mdzes par phub pa/ dbus phyur bur gyur pa'i rtse mor rdo rje rin po che'i tog gis nye bar brgyan pa/ gzhal yas khang gi phyi rol tu dur khrod chen po brgyad dang / de dag tu gnas pa'i phyogs skyong ba brgyad dang / zhing skyong ba brgyad dang / chu dang / me dang / rlung dang / sprin dang /ri dang / mchod rten rnams brgyad brgyad dang bcas pa/ 'byung po dang / srin po — 191—

dang / sha za dang / ro langs dang / mkha' 'gro ma'i tshogs rnams rgyu ba/ ro dang keng rus dang bya dang gcan gzan sna tshogs pas yongs su gang ba'o/ /gzhal yas khang gi nang gi lha snam/ shar dkar/ byang ljang / nub dmar/ lho ser/dbus sngo ba'i steng du/ pa las sna tshogs pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa/ lte ba dang zhes pa nas/ bcas pa'o/ /de'i steng du/ rang nyid gnas par gyur/ bdag nyid hū las rdo rje hū gis mtshan par gyur pa las/ rang nyid dpal he ru ka 'khor lo bde mchog nas/ dbus na bzhugs pa'o/ /thugs ka nas ma ta pa la rnams spros pa te/ phyogs bzhir 'khod/ bhu a dzi kha bzhi spro ste/ mtshams bzhir 'khod pa rnams yongs su gyur pa las/ shar gyi 'dab ma la nas/ rin chen 'byung ldan gyis dbu brgyan/ dbang gi lha thams cad kyang dkyil 'khor la gnyis su med par thim/ bar 'dir lha so so'i snying po ci 'grub tu bzlas pa'i mthar lha drug po re re'i sngags kyi mthar/ he ru ka'i yig brgya sbyar ba lan gsum gsum gyis brtan par bya'o/ /gnyis pa dkyil 'khor mchod pa ni/ mchod pa byin wos byas la/ bde mchog sgyu 'phrul 'khor lo'i rol pa las/ /yan lag brgyad ldan rdo rje a rta'i rgyun/ /kun bzang mchod sprin rgya mtsho rab spel bas/ /mkha' 'gro dra ba'i 'khor lo sdom gyur cig /o badz+ra ar+gha pra titsā hū swāhā/ de'i tshig rkang gnyis par/ zhabs kyi pad+ma'i gdung sel rdo rje'i chu/ /zhes dang / ar+gha gyi tshab tu pā bya sbyar te chu gnyis so/ /o bzang zhing dge ba'i me tog ni/ /gtsang zhing gtsang ma'i gnas las skyes/ /bdag gi dad pas 'bul lags kyi/ /bzhes nas bdag la dgyes par mdzod/ /yang dag dga' ba'i me tog gi /rdo rje nyi ma pad+ma ra phyung / /me tog —192—

bdag nyid la mchod pa/ /rdo rje gsum gyi bdag nyid mchog/oṃ badz+ra pukhre āXskyoX/ /dri yis rgyas pa lha yi rdzas/ /nags tshal bcud ni yid 'ong 'di/ /bdag gi sogs tshig rkang gnyis gong bzhin/ rnam rtog tshogs kyi yul min cing / /lte bar gtum mo 'bar ba yi/ /nges par bsregs pa de yi sogs/ /thugs kyi rdo rje la dbul bya/ /ga pe/ srin po 'joms shing gtsang byed la/ /mun pa sel byed dge ba 'di/ /bdeg gis sogs/ yi ge hūX las yang dag byung / /sngags kyi 'od zer shin tu gsal/ /mar me 'bar ba'i yang dag 'od/ /thugs kyi rdo rje la dbul bya/ /dī paX/ gtsang dag skye gnas las skyes pa/ /dge ba'i dri bzang dam pa 'di/ /bdag gi sogs/ bde ba chen po'i nam mkhar gnas/ /byang chub sems ni sad pa dang / /de nyid kyis kyang byug pa ni/ /thugs kyi rdo rje la dbul bya/ /ga rnye/ sman rnams bcud gtsang yi gar 'ong / /sngags kyi zhal zas mchog 'di dag/bdag gi sogs/ 'dir ni gang dang gang longs spyod/ /dbang po thams cad yang dag brten/ /de dag thams cad thugs rdo rje/ /bza' ba'i mchod pas mchod par bya/ /ni bi t+ya/ de las gzhan yang mchod pa'i tshogs / /rol mo dbyangs snyan yid 'ong ldan/ /sems can sdug bsngal tshim byed pa'i/ /sprin rnams so sor gnas gyur cig/rdo rje pad+ma yang dag sbyar/ /zhugs pa la sogs rim las byung / /rnal 'byor pa yi gzhom med sgra/ /thugs kyi rdo rje la dbul bya/ /oṃ badz+ra sha p+ta āXhūX/ /lha rnyer ṇi sogs dang rol chen bya/ nang mchod gtor ma byin gyis bsas/ khyab bdag dang po'i sangs rgyas rdo rje 'chang / /rdo rje btsun mo dpal gyi ni gu ma/ /mkhas grub chen po khyud po rnal 'byor la/ /rnam dag —193—

bdud rtsi mnyes mchod dam pa 'bul/ /oṃ ā hū/ rmog lcog mnyam med rin chen brtson 'grus dang / /dbon ston spyan ras gzigs dbang skyer sgang pa/ /thog rdugs grub chen gnyan ston ri gong bar/ /rnam dag 'gro ba'i bla ma sangs rgyas ston pa dang / /gtsang ma shangs ston tshul khrims 'bum pa'i zhabs/khyung po gsum par byon pa'i tshul mgon la/ /rnam dag: bya bral ri khrod dbang phyug ras chen dang / /mkhyen ldan shangs pa dkar po rin rgyal ba/ /mnyam med chen po sangs rgyas dpal bzang la/ /rnam dag: grub chen chos rje nam mkha'i rgyal mtshan dang / /rgya sgom sbas pa'i rnal 'byor legs rgyal ba/ /'jam mgon grub pa'i dpa' bo dam pa'i rjer/ rnam dag: 'chi med dbang po mchog gzigs lha dbang grags/ /mkhas mchog byang chub thugs mnga' rdo rings dbon/ /rgyud pa kun 'dus rtsa ba'i bla ma la/ rnam dag: 'khor lo bde mchog rdo rje rnal 'byor ma/ /mkha' 'gro lā ma khaṇ+ḍa ro hi dang / / gzugs can ma sogs dkyil 'khor lha tshogs la/ /rnam dag myur mdzad spyan ras gzigs mgon re ma tī/ /spyo tra pā la dzi na mi tra dang / /ṭak+ki rā dza bdud mgon ṭa ka da la/ rnam dag: phyogs bdag zhing skyong klu yi dbang po dang / /dpa' bo mkha' 'gro dur khrod gnas pa'i tshogs/ /gnyug mar gnas pa'i gzhi bdag ma lus la/ /rnam dag bdud rtsi'i mnyes mchod dam pa 'bul/ /oṃ ā hu/ oṃ hi ha ha hū hū phaṭa lan bdun/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a nu ra ga ṇa badz+ra swa bha ba ut+pa ko3ha/ 'dir ni thog ma dbus tha med/ /srid med mya ngan 'das pa med//bdag med gzhan yang med pa ste/ /'di ni mchog tu bde chen nyid/ /ces brjod —194—

cing mnyam par bzhag /de nas bstod pa ni/ oṃ bcom ldan dpa' bo'i dbang phyug chen po ni/ / bskal pa chen po'i me dang mnyam pa'i 'od/ /ral pa gyen du brdzes pa'i cod pan can/ /mche ba gtsigs pa drag po 'jigs pa'i zhal/ /gzi brjid ldan pa stong phrag phyag gis ni/ /dgra sta zhags gdengs mdung dang kha ṭāX ga/bsnams shing stag gi lpags pa'i na bza' 'dzin/ /dud kha mun nag chen po'i sku la 'dud/ /huX huX phaṭa/ ces dang / oṃ na mo bha ba te bī ri shā ya huX huX phaṭa/oṃ mahā kalpa asni sa ni pā ya hūX huX phaṭa/ de bzhin du/ tseX( dang hūX hūX phaṭa/ mtshungs par sbyar la/ dza ṭa mu ku ṭa sko ṭa ya/ daX ni ka ra lo gra bī ṣa ṇa mu ji ya/ sa ha sra bhu dza bha su rā ya/ pa ra shu pa sho du ta shā la kha ṭāX ga dha ri ṇi/ byā gh+ra dzi nā sba ra dha rā ya/mahā dhu grwan+ta ka ra ba pu khri ya/ zhes yab kyi rkang brgyad dang / oṃ bcom ldan 'das ma rdo rje phag mo 'phags mo ni/ /gzhan gyi mi thub 'jig rten gsum yum rig ma ni/ / dbang phyug 'byung po'i 'jigs pa kun sel rdo rje che/ /rdo rje'i gdan ma mi pham dbang mdzad gzhan mi rgyal/ /spyan 'phrul dug skem drag mo khro mo mche gtsigs ma/ /skrag byed gsod byed 'joms byed rnal rgyal gzhan las rgyal/ /rmugs byed rmongs byed rengs byed rdo rje phag mo ni/ /rnal 'byor chen mo 'dod pa'i dbang mo mkha' 'gror 'dud/ /huX huX phaṭa/ bha ga ba te badz+ra bā rā hi baX/ār+ya pā ra dzi te tri lo kya mā te mahā bi du shwa ri/ sa spru bhu ta bha ya bā he mahā badz+re badz+ra sa ne a dzi te a pa ra dzi te ba shuX ka rī ni tra bh+ra ma ṇi/ sho kha ṇi ro ṣa ṇi krodha ni ka ra li nī/ tra sa ni ma ra ṇi pra bhe da nī a pa ra dza ya/ bi dza ye dzam+bha ni stam bha ni mo hā ni/ badz+ra bā rā hi mahā yo ki nī kā me shwa rī kha ge zhes pa la rkang pa'i re re'i mgor/—195—

oṃ na mo dang tha mar hu hu phaṭa/ sbyar ba yum gyi rkang pa brgyad pas bstod/ gzhan yang / ye shes lnga ldan ngo bo nyid/ /rigs rnams kun gyi bdag po ste/ /sangs rgyas kun 'dus he ru ka /bde mchog dpa' bo la phyag 'tshal/ /sangs rgyas rigs kyi dkyil 'khor kun/ /mnyam nyid gcig tu bsdus pa'i sku/ /mkha' khams shes rab pha rol phyin/ /rdo rje phag mo la phyag 'tshal/ /rdo rje rigs kyi dkyil 'khor kun/ / gcig tu 'dus pa'i ngo bo nyid/ /chu khams rnam dag snying rje'i dngos/ /mkha' 'gro ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /las kyi rigs kyi: gcig tu/ rlung khams rnam dag btang snyoms dngos/ /lwa ma'i dbang phyug ma la 'dud/ /pad+ma'i rigs kyi gcig tu/ me khams rnam dag dga' ba'i dngos/ /dum skyes ma la phyag 'tshal 'dud/ /rdo rje rigs 'a kya gcig tu/ sa khams rnam dag byams pa'i dngos/ / gzugs can ma la phyag 'tshal 'dud/ /bde gshegs rnams kyi byin rlabs pa/ /gzungs ma rnams kyi ngo bo nyid/ /bdud rtsis gang ba'i bum pa dang / / pad+ma'i snod la phyag 'tshal 'dud/ /thar pa chen po'i gzhal med khang / /byang chub phyogs kyis rnam par brgyan/ /lha rnams bzhugs pa'i gdan dang bcas/ / rtag pa'i rang bzhin khyod la 'dud/ /rnam shes brgyad po rnam dag pa/ /mi gnas mya ngan 'das pa'i tshul/ /'jig rten skyong ba rnams kyi gnas/ /dur khrod brgyad la phyag 'tshal 'dud/ /stong nyid ye shes rdo rje yis/ /bdud tshogs ma lus zil gnon pa/ /mi phyed bsrung ba'i 'khor lo la/ /rtag tu gus pas phyag 'tshal 'dud/ /chos nyid shes rab gru gsum gnas/ /ye shes lha tshogs khams lngas brgyan/ /dkyil 'khor ma lus sprul —196—

pa'i gzhi/ /bde chen de la phyag 'tshal 'dud/ /de ltar bstod pa'i dge ba yis/ /rgyud lnga 'gro ba rnam dag nas/ /rnam lnga ye shes go 'phangs ni/ /rdo rje 'dzin pa'i mthus thob shog /ces pas kyang bstod/ mchod bstod de tsam ni nges par bya dgos la/ rgyas pa la spro na/ gos zung dang / rim bcu drug dang / rgyal srid sna bdun la sogs pa mchod pa'i rnam grangs ji snyed yod pa kun/ gzhan nas kha bskang de 'dir sbyar bas rung la/ 'dir ni yig rnying du gtogs pa'i mchod 'bul rgyas la/ nyog pa rnams kyi spros pa spangs te/ yid brtan thub nges pa rnams bsdus te bkod pa yin no/ /de nas gtor ma 'bul ba ni/ phal cher sgrub thabs su bshad pa dang 'dra ba las/ ye shes lha la gtor ma phul ba'i rjes thogs de nyid la/ gtor chog ltar myur mdzad ye shes kyi mgon po la gtor ma 'bul/ de rjes/ oṃ kha kha sogs kyis 'gyung po'i tshogs la gtor ma sbyin no/ /gsum pa ni sngon 'gro dkyil 'khor du 'jug pa'i don du mkha phul/ dga' chen khyod bdag ston pa ste/ /sogs lan gsum gyis gsol ba btab/ de nas rgyun bshags ni/bdag gis sdig pa bgyis pa dang / /bgyid du rtsal dang yi rang gang / /sangs rgyas spyan sngar mchis nas su/ /ma lus de dag bshags par bgyi/ /sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' dang / /rang rgyal dgra bcom 'gro rnams kyi/ /sgom dang bzlas brjod bsod nams kyi/ /tshogs la bdag ni yi rang ngo sems bskyed mngon par sangs rgyas nas/ /chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba dang / /byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs kyi mchog/de la bdag ni skyabs su mchi/ /sangs rgyas 'byung ba ji lta bar/ /skal ldan byang chub sems dpa' yis/ /byang chub sems ni bskyed pa ltar/ /de bzhin bdag gis sems bskyed do/ /bdag gi dge ba'i — 197—

las rnams 'di dag gis/ /'jig rten 'dir ni myur du sangs rgyas shog/'gro la phan phyir chos rnams ston bgyid cing / /sems can sdug bsngal mang po gzir las sgrol/ /zhes lan gsum/ de nas sdom bzung ni/ sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' kun/ /ji tsam dus nas bzung nas su/ /ma lus bdag la dgongs su gsol/ /bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi ba yis/ /dus 'di nyid nas bzung nas su/ /nam zhig byang chub snying po la/ /yongs su gnas kyi bar dag tu/ /bdag gi byang chub mchog gi sems/ /ma lus par ni bskyed par bgyi/ /ji ltar dus gsum mgon po rnams/ /byang chub tu ni nges mdzad pas/ /byang chub sems ni bla na med/ /dam pa bdag gis bskyed par bgyi/ /sangs rgyas rnal 'byor sdom pa la/ /tshul khrims kyi ni bslab pa dang / /dge ba'i chos ni sdud pa dang / /sems can don byed tshul khrims gsum/ /bdag gis brtan por gzung bar bgyi/ /sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun ste/ /bla na med pa'i dkon mchog gsum/ /deng nas brtsam ste gzung bar bgyi/ /nam du yang ni mi spang ngo / /rdo rje rigs mchog chen po la/ /rdo rje dril bu phyag rgya yang / /yang dag nyid du gzung bar bgyi/ /slob dpon dag kyang gzung bar bgyi/ /rin chen rigs mchog chen po yi/ /dam tshig yid du 'ong ba la/ /nyin re bzhin yang dus drug tu/ /spyin pa rnam bzhi rtag tu sbyin/ /byang chub chen po las byung ba'i/ /pad+ma'i rigs chen dag pa la/ /phyi nang gsang ba theg pa gsum/ /dam pa'i chos ni ma lus gzung / /las kyi rigs mchog chen pa la/ /sdom pa thams cad ldan par ni/ /yang dag nyid du gzung bar bgyi/ /mchod pa'i las kyang ci nus —198—

bgyid/ /byang chub sems ni bla na med/ /dam pa bdag gis bskyed bgyis nas/ /sems can mya ngan 'das la 'god/ /ces lan gsum/ ā kha bī ra hu/ lan gnyis kyis mig dar dang me tog blang / nyungs dkar gtor zhing su lha'i sngags kyi bgegs bskrad/bdud rtsi lce la bzhag te/ oṃ ā hu gis bsrung ba bya/ rang gi snying khar he nag po rgyu dang bral ba/ mgrin par ru dmar pa tshogs dang bral ba/ dpral bar ka dkar po gang du yang mi gnas pa/ lte bar shrī ser po gnyis su med pa'i ye shes su gyur/shrī he ru ko3ha/ zhes stong pa nyid du sems bskyed/ de nas/ ā kha bī ra hu/ zhes yol ba'i nang du bcug /o na ma te hū/ na mo me hū/ na mo na ma hu swāhā/ zhes phyag 'tshal du gzhug/de nas gsang ba bsgrags pa ni/ gnas gsum du dri bzang gi thig le byas la/dpral bar o/ mgrin par ā thugs kar skyo/ snying khar kun rdzob byang chub sems kyi ngo bo zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ don dam byang chub sems kyi ngo bo/ rdo rje dkar po rtse lnga pa/ oṃ sarba yo ga tsit+ta u pa da ya mi / snying gar rdo rje bzhag la/ oṃ su ra ta sa ma ya stu/ ho sirnyi badz+ra ya thā su kha/ de nas dam la bzhag pa ni/rdo rje mgo bor bzhag la/ 'di ni dam tshig rdo rje ste/ khyod kyi spyi bor gzhag pa yis/ /sangs rgyas sku ru khyod 'grub cing / /mi phyed ye shes thob par 'gyur/ /snying gar bzhag la/ rdo rje 'dzin pa deng khyod kyi/ /snying la yang dag zhugs par gyur/ /gal te tshul 'di smra na ni/ /de ma thag tu dral ste gshegs/ /bdud rtsi lnga'i nang mchod blud la/ /'di ni khyod kyi dmyal ba'i chu/ /dam tshig nyams na sreg par byed/ /dam tshig bsrungs na dngos grub ni/ /ye shes bdud rtsis chu 'dis 'grub/ /o badz+ra sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta u da ka hū/ yang rdo rje spyi bor bzhag la/— 199—

deng nas gzung ste bu khyod kyi/ /rdo rje 'dzin pa nga yin gyi/ /nga yi ji ltar bka' stsal pa/ /gus pa'i tshul gyis nyan par gyis/ /gal te nga la brnyas pa na/ /sangs rgyas thams cad brnyas pa yin/ /mi bde ma spangs dus byas nas/ /dmyal ba chen por gyur ta re/ /bcu pa ye shes dbab pa ni/ bde bar gshegs pa thams cad kyis/ /byin gyis brlabs pa'i ye shes mchog/sems can kun gyi don gyi phyir/ /gtso bos bdag la stsal du gsol/ /zhes lan gsum gyis gsol ba btab/ stong pa'i ngang las rang nyid 'khor lo bde mchog dpa' bo gcig pa'i skur gsal ba'i/ rkang mthil gnyis kyi 'og tu/ yi ge dzhaiXdamar po bskul bar byed pa po/ gsang bar aXdamar po gsung rdo rje/ snying gar hūX nag po thugs rdo rje/ spyi bor haX dkar po sku rdo rje/ snying gi nang du 'khor lo bde mchog yab yum mtshon gang ba rnams 'khod par gyur/ slob dpon nam mdun bskyed dkyil 'khor gyi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyi thugs gsung sku rdo rje rnams 'od zer mthing dmar dkar gsum gyi rnam par spyan drangs/ gnas gsum gyi byuX āXha rnams la thim/ dzhaiXyig las 'od zer 'phros pas/ rkang ba'i bu ga nas zhugs/ lus nang gi yi ge gsum bskul bas/ de rnams las 'od zer gyis lus kyi nang thams cad gang zhing / lus sems thams cad bde bas khyab/ yang slob dpon nam/ mdun bskyed dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo'i thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros te/ sangs rgyas tham cad 'khor lo sdom pa'i lha tshogs kyi rnam par spyan drangs/ rang gi snying gar sib sib thim par gyur/ spos dang rol mo'i sgra dang bcas te/—200—

yi ge bdun pa mang du bzlas shing / oṃ tiṣ+ṭha mahā krodha a be sha ya skyo/ zhes pa bzlas pas ye shes dbab/ spyi bor rdo rje rgya gram du bzhag ste/ tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra lan gnyis kyi brtan par byas la/ o pra titsā badz+ra ho zhes pas dkyil 'khor gyi lha la me tog dor/ stobs dang ldan pa'i sems can khyod/ /'di ni so sor bzung bar gyis/ /zhes me tog spyi bor bcings/ he ru ka dpal dang khyod kyi/ /mig 'byed par ni rtson par mdzad/ /phye bas thams cad mthong 'gyur pa/ /rdo rje'i mig ni bla na med/ /oṃ dzñā na tsak+ṣu hu a/ de ni phyi'i dkyil 'bor du 'jug pa yin la/ dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo'i thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/rang gi lus la phog/'od kyi gong bu gyur/ dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo'i zhal nas zhugs/ rdo rje'i lam nas yum gyi mkhar babs/ rang nyid he ru ka phyag gnyis pa yab rkyang gi rnam par gyur/ yang sangs rgyas thams cad spyan drangs/ zhal du zhugs byang chub kyi sems dang ro gcig tu 'dres te/ rdo rje'i lam nas byung ba'i thig le'i rgyun gyis dbang bskur bas rang gi phung khams skye mched thams cad rnam par dag pa'i ngo bo gdod nas grub pa'i rten dang brten par bcas pa'i dkyil 'khor du gyur/ hū zhes bya bas gsang ba nas phyir spros te/ phyi'i gzhal yas khang gi shar sgo'i nang du pad nyi la mkhod par gyur/ slob ma la dbang skur ba'i skabs yin na/ de nas skabs 'dir/ rten dang brten par bcas pa'i dkyil 'khor mtha' dag sgrub thabs dang mdun bskyed kyi skabs bzhin lha ngo bstan par bya la/ bdag 'jug gi skabs ni/phyi dkyil mthong bar mos pa tsam gyi chog go /de nas/ rang bzhin gyi ni dag pa'i bdag /lus ni rang bzhin dri ma med/ /dpa' bo dpa' mo dbang mo'i gnas/ /dkyil 'khor la ni bu khyod ltos/ /zhes nang gi dkyil ge sgor blta bar bskul/ slob dpon dang —201—

dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo dbyer med kyi sku la gnas pa'i rtsa rnams mkha' 'gro ma dang / khams rnams dpa' bo'i rang bzhin du nges par gyis shig /de ni nang gi dkyil 'khor du 'jug pa'i tha snyad mdzad do/ /dngos gzhi las/ rdo rje slob ma'i dbang gi don du maṇ+ḍal 'bul/ bsam gyis mi khyab chos kyi snod/ /bdag la dbang ni bskur du gsol/ /zhes lan gsum gyi gsol ba 'debs/ de la dang po chu dbang bskur ba'i cho ga ni/ dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo'i thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ bdag dang dbang rdzas rnam rgyal bum pa'i chu gnyis ka /slob dpon gyi zhal du bcug/thugs kar byang chub kyi sems dang ro gcig tu 'dres/ rdo rje'i lam nas yum gyi mkhar babs pa'i thig le cha gnyis su gyur pa'i cha gcig hū las rdo rje hu gis mtshan par gyur/ de yongs su gyur pa las/rang nyid mi bskyod pa/ sku mdog sngon po rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pa/ yum mā ma gī sngon mo gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pa dang mnyam par sbyor bas/ g.yas rkyang ba'i stabs kyis bzhugs shing rus pa'i rgyan gyis brgyan par gyur/ hu zhes bya bas mkha' nang nas phyir spros te/ phyi rol tu dbang stegs kyi gdan la 'khod/byang chub kyi sems kyi cha gcig ye shes kyi bdud rtsis gang ba'i bum par gyur/dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo'i thugs ka nas sprul pa'i dbang gi lha rnams kyis/ ye shes kyi bdud rtsis gang ba'i bum pa de nyid thogs te dbang bskur/ ji ltar bltams pa tsam gyis ni/ /lha rnams kyis ni khrus gsol ltar/ /lha yi chu ni dag pa yis/ /de bzhin bdag gi sku khrus gsol/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shrī ye skyo/ gtso bo yab yum gyi nye snying dang / lha mo bzhi'i sngags kyi mthar/ oṃ badzi —202—

bha ba a bhi khiñtsa skyoX/ zhes bum pa'i chus dbang bskur/ lus thams cad bde bas gang / snying ga'i 'khor lo brtan par byas/ chu'i lhag ma spyi bor lud pa las/ mi bskyod pa'i dbu brgyan/ de ltar chu dbang thob pas/ rnam par shes pa'i phung po rnam par dag te/ me long lta bu'i ye shes mngon du byas so/ /zhes so/ /'di man chad cod pan gyi dbang sogs ni/ dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo'i thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros zhes pa nas/ ye shes mngon du byas so zhes pa'i bar/ chu dbang gi skabs de nyid kyi rigs 'dres pa las/ khyad par ni/ cod pan gyi dbang la/ bdag dang dbang rdzas dbu rgyan gnyis ka zhes dang / gnyis su gyur pa'i cha gcig aX las rin po che aX gis mtshan pa zhes dang / rang nyid rin chen 'byung ldan ser po rin po che dang dril bu 'dzin pa/ yum rin chen sgrol ma ser mo gri gug dang zhes pa 'es/sems kyi cha gcig dbu rgyan du gyur lha rnams kyi dbu rgyan de nyid thogs te dbang bskur/ oṃ rat+na mu ku ṭa a bhi ti rdo ni huX/ su ra ta staX a haX zhes dbu rgyan bcings/oṃ rat+na sam+bha ba a sgyi khi ྅ mi skyoX/ zhes bum pa'i chus zhes dang / lte ba'i 'kho9ra lo brtan par zhes dang / rin chen 'byung ldan gyi dbu brgyan/ de ltar cod pan gyi dbang thob zhes dang / tshor ba'i phung po zhes dang / mnyam pa nyid kyi ye shes mngon du byas so/ /zhes 'don pa spo'o/ /de bzhin du sbyar te/ rdo rje'i dbang ni/ dbang rdzas rdo rje gnyis ka cha gnyis su gyur pa'i cha gcig dzi las pad+ma dzi gi mtshan pa/ 'od dpag me dmar po/ pad+ma dang dril bu 'dzin pa/ yum gos dkar mo dmar mo/ sems kyi cha gcig rdo rje 'gyur/ lha rnams kyis rdo rje de nyid thogs te dbang bskur bar gyur/ oṃ mahā —203—

badz+ra hūX/ sangs rgyas kun gyi rdo rje'i dbang / /de ring khyod la bskur bar bya/ /sangs rgyas kun tu rab sgrub phyir/ /rdo rje 'di ni khyod kyis long / /slar yang bum pa'i chus dbang bskur/ oX pad+ma dha ra a bhi tañtsa hūX/ mgrin pa'i 'khor lo/'od dpag med kyis dbu brgyan/ rdo rje'i dbang thob/ 'du shes kyi phung po/sor rtog ye shes zhes 'don pa sgro'o/ /de bzhin du dril bu'i dbang ni/ dbang rdzas dril bu/ cha gcig khaX las ral gri khaX gis mtshan pa/ don yod grub pa/sku mdog ljang khu ral gri dang / yum dam tshig sgrol ma ljang khu/ cha gcig dril bur gyur/ dril bu de nyid thogs te/ oṃ badz+ra a dhi pa ti stuX/ asni tiñtsa huX/ tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra sa ma ya/ zhes dril bu btang / oṃ karma bha ba a bhi ṣi3mi huX/ gsang ba'i 'khore lo/ /don yod grub pas dril bus dbang thob/ 'du byed kyi phung po/ bya ba grub pa'i ye shes zhal 'don pa spo/ de bzhin du ming gi dbang ni/ dbang rdzas rdo rje dang bcas pa'i dril bu gnyis ka /cha gcig bhuX las 'khor lo bhuX gyi mtshan pa /rnam par snang mdzad/ dkar po 'khor lo dang / yum sangs rgyas spyan ma dkar mo/ /cha gcig rdo rje dang bcas pa'i dril bur gyur/ dbang gi lha rnams kyis rdo rje dang bcas pa'i dril bu de nyid thogs te/ oX badz+ra satwa stuX/ a bhi khiñtsa hūX/ badz+ra nā ma asni ṣe ka ta/ kyai dpal/ gsang ba'i ming btags/ oṃ bzhi bha baX asni 'a ṣañtsa hūX/spyi bo'i 'khor lo/ rnam par snang mdzad kyis/ ming gi dbang thob pas/gzugs kyi phung po/ chos kyi dbyings kyi ye shes/ zhes 'don pa spo/ de ltar dbang rnam pa lnga po de thob pas phung po lnga rgyal ba rigs lnga/ khams lnga yum lnga/dbang po dang yul rnams sems dpa' dang sems ma/ rnam par dag pa'i lus —204—

kyi cha rnams khro bo dang / khro mo'i rang bzhin du byin gyis rlabs pa yin rno/ /de nas sngags kyi dbang ni/ bdag nyid 'khor lo bde mchog yab rkyang gi rnam pa tsan du gyur/ snying gar nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hū/ thugs ka nas sngags kyi 'phreng ba byung zhal nas 'thon/ rang gi kha sgo nas zhugs/ snying gar hu gi mtha' bskor du 'bo da/ o shrī badz+ra he he sogs dang / lko sarba bud+dhā sogs la myo gsum gsum/ de nas me tog 'bul/ ster byed bzhin par/ bcom ldan bdag la stsal/ lags kyi/ /bdag la 'go bar mdzad du gsol/ /lan gsum/ bcom ldan 'di la stsal lags kyi/ /'di la 'go bar mdzad du gsol/ /sngags kyi dngos grub stsal du gsol/ /brtul zhugs brtan par mjad du gsol/ /rdo rje'i brtul zhugs kyi dbang ni/ yang rdo rje'i dbang gi skabs bzhin du chu dbang gi skabs la 'don pa spos te/ dbang rdzas rdo rje gnyis ka cha gcig hu las rdo rje hū gis mtshan pa: rdo rje sems dang/'a dkar po: rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pa/ yum rdo rje snyems ma dkar mo: cha gcig rdo rjer gyur/ rdo rje de nyid thogs te/ 'di de sangs rgyas thams cad de/ /he ru ka dpal phyag na gnas/ khyod kyis kyang ni rtag tu bcang / /he ra kyi ka dpal rtul zhugs brtan/ /tse( sarba ta thā ga ta sirnyi badz+ra sa ma ya/ tiṣ+ṭha e ṣa stu/ dha ra ya mi/ badz+ra satwa hi hi hi hi skyo/ lko badz+ra bha ba a bhi ṣi3 ma/ gtsug tor gyi 'khor lo rdo rje sems dpas dbu brgyan/ rdo rje rtul zhugs kyi dbang thob/ ye shes kyi phung po/ lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes mngon du byas so/ /spyod pa'i rtul zhugs kyi dbang ni/ bdag nyid hu las byung ba'i he ru ka 'khor lo —205—

sdom par gyur/ /spa ṭāX ga ḍā ma ru thod pa tshangs skud rnams gtad/ he ru ka dpal phyag rgya 'di/ /phyi dang nang du yang dag gnas/ kha ṭāX cang te lhung bzed sbyin/ /dpa' bo chen pos blang par gyis/ kha ṭāX ga lha'i sku/ ḍā ma ru stong pa nyid kyi sgra/ thod pa bde ba chen po/ tshangs pa'i skud pa rnam par mi rtog pa'i ngo bo nyid do/ /lung bstan cing gzengs bstod pa ni/ dkyil 'khor gyi bdag po dang slob dpon dbyer ma mchis pa/ dpal rgyal ba shākya thub pa'i skur gyur pas lung bstan cing / gzengs bstod par gyur/ 'di ltar ngas khyod lung bstan yin/ /he ru ka dpal de bzhin gshegs/ /sred pa shin tu dag pas na/ /srid pa'i ngan 'gro las khyod bton/ /oX shrī he ru ka sirnyi sa ma ya stuX snur bhu ba swa/ gsang ba'i ming yid kyis dran par bya/ khams gsum gyi ni rgyal srid che/ /dpal ldan yon tan 'byung ba'i gnas/ /bdud tshogs kun las nges rgyal te/ /grong khyer mchog tu khyod zhugs so/ /de nas phyir mi ldog pa'i dbang bskur gyi don du maṇ+ḍal phul/ 'khor lo phyir mi ldog pa'i dbang / /dam pa bdag la stsa'/ du gsol/ /lan gsum/ yang gong bzhin phal cher chu dbang la 'don pa sgyur te/ bdag dang dbang rdzas dang po'i rdo rje dang po'i rdo rjes mtshan pa'i dril bu gnyis ka:gyur pa'i cha gcig huX las rdo rje hūX gis mtshan par: rdo rje 'chang chen he ru ka /sku mdog sngon po rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pa/yum rdo rje snyems ma sngon mo/ sems kyi cha gcig cha gnyis su gyur te/ dang po'i rdo rje dang / dang po'i rdo rjes mtshan pa'i dril bur gyur/ rdo rje de nyid thogs te/ 'di de sangs rgyas thams cad de/ /he ru ka dpal dbang bskur bas/ /de ring khyod —206—

—la dbang bskur te/ /rab tu sgrub phyir rdo rje long / /rdo rje gsor zhing snying gar gtad la/ thog mtha' med pa'i sems dpa' ni/ /rdo rje sems dpa' dga' ba che/ /kun tu bzang po kun bdag nyid/ /rdo rje snyems ma'i bdag po'i bdag/bcom ldan 'das dpal mchog dang po'i skyes bu la'o/ /slar yang dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo'i thugs ka nas/ dril bu de nyid thogs te/ 'di ni rnal 'byor ma kun gyi/ /shes rab dbyangs kyi rjes 'gror bshad/ khyod kyis kyang rni rtag tu bcangs/ /byang chub mchog tu rgyal ba bzhed/ /lan gsum du dkrol te/ g.yo na pa la brten nas/ a srid pa ngo bo nyid kyis dag/ngo bo nyid kyis srid bral byas/ /rang bzhin dag pa'i sems dpa' mchog/srid pa dam pa byed par 'gyur/ /rang nyid skad cig gis dpal he ru ka /phyag gnyis kyis rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pa la/yum rdo rje phag mo dmar mo gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pa/ lo bcu drug lon pa lta bus yang dag par 'khyud nga// yid kyi lus su brtan pa'i phyir/ /phyag rgya'i dam tshig rab tu brjod/ /gang gi lus ni thams cad brtan/ /des na phyag rgya rab tu bsgrags/ /shes rab bcu drug shwe1na pa la/ /lag pa dag gis yeng dag 'khyud/ /rdo rje dril bu mnyam sbyor ba/ /slob dpon gyi ni dbang du brjod/ /slar yang bum nga 'i chus dbang bskur/ ji ltar bltams pa nas/ badz+ra bha ba a bhi ski nyu skyo/ zhes gsungs shing dbang bskur/ lus thams cad gang / bde ba chen po myong / chu'i lhag ma spyi bor 'khyil ba las rdo rje sems dpas dbu brgyan par gyur / ar+gha nas shasta'i bar gyis mchod/ o su pra tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra ye swāhā/ rdo rje slob dpon gyi dbang ngo / /de nyid rig pa'i rnal 'byor pas/ /mi bya ba ni ci yang —207—

med/ /de nyid shes nas de nas ni/ /dpa' bo 'dod pa lnga spyad do/ /bdag nyid dpa' bo kun gyis dngos/ /bdag nyid lha mo kun gyi gnas/ /de phyir bdag gi thams cad bya/ /bdag nyid he ru ka dpal mchog/brten cing 'brel bar 'byung chos can/ /sems can sgyu ma'i rang bzhin te/ khams gsum de ltar shes nas ni/ /'gro ba'i don ni mnyam med byos/ /zhes pa ni rjes gnang ngo / /de ltar na phyi dbyibs kyi dkyil 'khor du zhugs/ bum pa'i dbang bskur thob/ lam bskyed pa'i rim pa sgom pa la dbang / sprul sku rang bzhin lhun grub mngon du byas/gsang dbang gi don du ma rdza phul/ byang chub rdo rje sangs rgyas la/ /mchod chen ji ltar stsal ba ltar/ /bdag kyang skyob pa'i don gyi phyir/ /nam mkha'i rdo rje deng bdag stsol/ /zhes lan gsum/ dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo yab yum rjes chags kyi snyom par zhugs pas/ bde bas sgras sangs rgyas thams cad spyan drangs te/zhal du zhugs/ thugs kar byang chub kyi sems su zhu/ dga' ba bzhi'i rim pas/ lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes brtan par byas pa'i/ bde ba'i rten kun+da lta bu dang rdul gyi dwangs ma rdo rje dang pad+ma las mthe bong dang ming med kyi yang dag par blangs te/ rang gi lce thog tu bzhag/'di de dpa' bo lha mo rnams/ /dam tshig rmad byung chen po ste/ khams lnga ldan pa'i ros rtogs byed/ /bde ba gang de myang bar byos/ /oṃ ā hū/ a ho mahā su kha/ 'das pa'i rdo rje 'chang sogs kyis/ /ji ltar sangs rgyas sras dbang bskur/ /byang chub sems ni bzang po yis/ /de ring bu khyod dbang bskur ro/ /oṃ ā hu/ de ltar byang chub kyi sems myangs pas/ mgrin pa'i 'khor lo gang / rang bzhin brgyad cu'i rnam rtog —208—

'gags/ bde ba'i ye shes brjod bral rgyud la skyes par gyur/ de ltar na kun rdzob byang chub sems kyi dkyil 'khor du zhugs/ gsang ba'i dbang thob/ ngag gi dri ma dag /lam gtum mo dang sgyu lus sgom pa la dbang / 'bras bu longs sku'i rang bzhin lhun grub mngon du byas/ shes rab ye shes kyi dbang gi don du mkha phul/ bcom ldan zhi ba chen po kye/ /rdo rje rnal 'byor gcig bzhed pas/ /mi phyed phyag rgya sgrub pa po/ /rdo rje sbyor las yang dag byung / /bdag nyid chen po khyod ji bzhin/ /mnga' bdag bdag la'ang de ltar mdzod/ /'khor ba 'dam gyi tshogs nang du/ /bying ba skyabs med bdag la skyobs/ /lan gsum/ phyag rgya lo bcu gnyis nang nyi shu'i bar gang yang rung ba/ lang tsho phun sum tshogs pa bdag la gtad/ lha mo 'di ni khyad par che/ /mtha' yas bde ba sbyin pa mo/ /rnam pa kun tu phyag rgya long / /bu yis bla med mchod par gyis/ /lha mo des kyang bshang gci dag ni bza' ba dang / khrag dang khu ba de bzhin te/ /sha chen brten pa la dga'am/ /bud med rnams la rtag gus dang / /bha ga'i gnas su 'a ni/ khyod ni spro ba yin nam ci/ /zhes dris/ de la sogs pa'i dam tshig kun/ /lha mo ci phyir bdag mi spro/ /zhes lan bto pas/ de dgyes nas phyogs kyi gos can gsang rtsa rgyas pa'i pad+ma mtsho ni bzhin du/ e ma bdag gi pad+ma ni/ /bde ba kun dang yang dag ldan/ /ci te cho ga bzhin brten na/ /sangs rgyas snyems pa la sogs pa/ /bya ba thams cad pad+ma ra byed/ /bde chen rgyal po rang nyid ni/ /'di nyid du ni rtag tu zhugs/ /pad+ma bhañtsa ho/ bdag dang rig ma dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo yab yum gyi skur rdzogs pa la/ hū las byung ba'i rdo rje oṃ las skyes pa'i nor bu/ bu —209—

gar phaṭa kyi yongs su bkag pa/ hri las byung ba'i pad+ma ā las skyes pa'i ze 'bru rtse mor as mtshan pa/ thabs shes snyoms 'jug rjes su chags pa'i rkyen gyis/ byang chub kyi sems spyi bo nas mgrin par byon pas dga' ba/ snying gar byon pas mchog dga'/ lte bar byon pa'i khyad dga'/ gsang bar byon pas g.yo med du brtan par byas pa ni/ lhan cig skyes pa'i dga' ba'o/ /slar yang gyen du gshegs par gyur te mas brtan gyi dga' ba bzhi'i rim pas/ don dam rang rig lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes bde stong zung 'jug mngon du byas/ de ltar na bha ga'i dkyil 'khor du zhugs shes rab ye shes kyi dbang bskur ba thob/lam gzhan lus shes rab sgom pa la dbang / 'bras bu chos kyi sku rang bzhin lhun grub mngon du byas/ dbang bzhi pa'i don du maṇ+ḍal phul/ khyod zhabs pad+ma'i bka' drin gyi/ /gtso bo'i dbang bskur rnam gsum thob/ /de ring rin chen bzhi pa yang / /bdag la bka' drin skyabs du gsol/ /lan gsum/ ye shes 'di ni ches phra zhing / /rdo rje snying po mkha' dang mtshungs/ /rdul bral mthar phyin zhi ba nyid/ khyod kyi pha ni khyod nyid do/ /sems nyid spros pa thams cad bral ba/dmigs pa med pa'i sgyu lus dang / lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes zung 'jug tu gdod ma nas rang shar ba ni/ dbang bzhi pa'i ye shes te/ de ltar na don dam byang chub sems kyi dkyil 'khor du zhugs/ dbang bzhi pa thob/ lam 'od gsal phyag rgya chen po sgom pa la dbang / 'bras bu ngo bo nyid sku rang bzhin lhun grub mngon du byas/ gtso bos ji lhar bka' stsal pa/ /de dag thams cad bdag gis bgyi/ /lan gsum dbang bzhi rdzogs par thob pa'i bka' drin btang rag gi don —210—

du maṇ+ḍal 'bul/ deng nas brtsams te bdag bran du/ khyod la bdag ni 'bul lags kyi/ khyod kyi slob mar bzung ba dang / /cha shas kyis kyang spyad du gse1la/ /lan gsum/ dge ba bsngo'o/ /bdag 'jug rkyang pa la ni de tsam gyis chog la/ slob ma la dbang bskur na/ slar yang dkyil 'khor gyi lha la mchod bstod bsdus pa zhig byas la/ shes rab thabs bdag dkyil 'khor gyi/ /bden pa'i byin rlabs gang yin pa/ /bden pa de yis mgon dag la/ khyod kyi 'dod pa rab rdzogs mdzod/ /chos rnams gzugs brnyan lta bu te/ /dag cing gsa' la rnyog pa med/ /bzung du med cing brjod du med/ /rgyu dang las las yang nga/ga byung / / de bzhin de nyid nges par 'byung / /bden pa de yi dkyil 'khor ni/ /gzugs brnyan gsal bar slob ma rnams/ /kun gyis sgrib med mthong bar shog /ces lan gsum gyis bden stobs brjod/ de bzhin gshegs pa kun gyi gnas/ /he ru ka dpal grong khyer mchog/snying po'i dkyil 'khor 'di ru ni/ /bdag gi slob ma gzhug par bgyi/ /zhes lan gsum du gsol ba btab/ dkyil 'khore gyi lha rnams kyis kyang gnang ba byin par bsam mo/ /bzhi pa ni/ gong du ji skad bshad pa'i bdag 'jug gi don de rnams/ slob ma la 'bog pa yin te/ bdag 'jug gi drig don legs par byed na/ lag len mthong ba tsam gyis shes par 'gyur bas logs su ma bris so/ /gsum pa rjes kyi bya ba ni/ tshogs kyi 'khor lo'i bya ba rnams rdzogs pa na/ slar yang mchod pa gsar du bshams pa'am kha gso/ /gong bzhin byin gyis brlabs/ ar+gha nas/ shabha'i bar gyi phyi mchod phul/ snying po drug pa'i mthar 'bru gsum sbyar bas nang mchod/ rkang brgyad gnyis kyi bstod pa rnams byas la/ bcom ldan 'das dpal 'khor lo sdom pa'i lha tshogs

rnams kyis bdag dang slob mar bcas pa la/ thugs brtse ba chen por mdzad de/ bar chad zhi ba dang dngos grub ma lus stsal du gsol/ zhes pa dang gas yang 4'dod don gsol ba ci rigs par btab/ yig brgya mang du bzla/ bzod gsol/ gshegs gsol smon lam/ bkra shis bsngo ba rnams sgrub thabs su bshad pa bzhin byed dgos pa las/mgron gshegs gsol gyi mthar/ dkyil 'khor la brtan bzhugs bya/ smon lam dang bkra shis sogs rgyas bsdus ji ltar 'dod pa bya'o/ /gnyis pa rdul tshon gyi phyogs la brten pa ni/ sa chog dang / thig tshon byin gyis brlabs nas/ thig gdab cing dkyil 'khor bri ba dang / rdul tshon gshegs su gsol ba la sogs pa dgos te/ rgyas pa la dga' na/ rgyu sde lnga'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga chen mor bshad zin pa las shes par bya zhing / da lta lag len byed pa nyung bas 'dir ni ma bris la/ snying po bsdus pa'i yig chung zhig 'bri bar yang 'gyur ro/ /dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga 'di la lha lhag gnas rgyas pa dang / ras bris kyi skabs sa'i lha mo'i cho ga ni mi dgos te/ 'di nyid kyi rang lugs gong du bshad pa kho na'i 'grub par 'gyur ro/ /ni gu'i lugs kyi bde mchog lha lnga 'di la/dkyil chog rgyas pa rgya gzhud ma gtogs bod yig dag gas la cha tshang ba zhig cher mi snang la/ cho ga'i yan lag 'ga' re bris 'dug na'ang / shin tu nyog par mngon cing / rje grol mchog gis mdzad pa 'di yang / zhu ba po'i blo ngo dang bstun pa'i rang lugs las phyir phyogs pa mang du snang bas/'dir dag cing gsal la gzhan dang ma 'dres par rang lugs ma tshang ba med cing bzung bde bar brkad pa yin no// //rnal 'byor can la nyer mkho bas/ /dkyil chog spros pa nyung ngu 'di/ /bshad las dge ba gang thob des/ /lhan cig skyes pa'i sa thob shog/ces pa'ang rgyal khams pa tā ra nā thas smras pa'o/ /dge legs 'phel//

mar brdal ba zhes bya ba bklags ce prog ma bzhu/gas/na mo gu sa /zab lam ni gu'i chos drug gi khrid yig zab don thang mar brdal ba zhes bya ba/ pha bla ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gsol ba 'debs so/ /skyabs su mchi'o/ /byin gyis rlobs shig/bla ma dang ni rdo rje 'chang / /tha nga ra/ nyid du ma dmigs pas/ /bla ma'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /thugs yid dbyer med ngang du gnas/ /sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun lha zhes jo bo dkon mchog gsum/ /grub mchog dbang po'i tshul 'dzin zhu bde'i ye shes phyogs brgyar 'bar/ /chos kyi sku las ma g.yos snyan pa'i grags pas sa gsum khyab/ /srid zhi kun dang mnyam nyid khyed la rtag par phyag bgyi'o/ /man ngag zab mo mtha' yas kyang / /yid ches mngon rtags nyams myong kun/ /dus mtha' 'dir yang 'byung 'gyur ba/ /mkha' 'gro ni gu'i zhal gdams 'di'o/ /de la 'dir ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ni gu'i chos skor 'di dag/spyir mdo rgyud thams cad kyi zab don dgongs 'dus yin la/ khyad par du yang / mthar thug ston pa rnam pa lnga'i rgyud ces bya ba/ gtum mo ston pa'i mthar thug dgyes mdzad dang / /las rgya ston pa'i mthar thug 'khor lo sdom/ /sgyu lus rmi lam mthar thug gsang 'dus dang / /'od gsal mthar thug mahā yā ya dang / /—213—

'phrin las mthar thug rdo rje 'jigs byed do/ /zhes pa ltar/ rgyud sde lnga'i don gyi bcud phyung ba'i rdzogs pa'i rim pa zab mo yin la/ /de yang rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rdo rje 'chang chen po nas/ da lta'i bar du brgyud pa las/ gdams ngag zab mo'i brlan drod ma yal/ byin rlabs chu bo'i bka' rgyun ma nub/ grub thob brgyud pa'i zam ma chad/ nyams dang rtogs pa'i 'char sgo ma 'gags/chos bdag mkha' 'gro'i bka' rgya ma nyams pa'i man ngag rtsod med grags pa kun khyab de yin/ de lta bu yang / dag pa'i sa la bzhugs pa/ sangs rgyas rdo rje sna chang chen po'i zhal mngon sum du gzigs shing / gsung gi snang ba la spyod pa/ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ni gu ma'i zhal nas/ chos 'di shes pa nga dang / slob dpon lwa ba pa min pa rgya gar na yang med/ de las kyang gnyid thun gcig la chos thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa ni/ khyod kho na las gzhan med do zhes dbugs 'byin par mdzad pa/ grub pa'i dbang phyug khyung po rnal 'byor pa/mtshan gzhan lo tsā ba tshul khrims mgon por grags ji/ de nyid sku gsang ba 'dus pa/ gsung ma hā mā ya/ thugs dgyes mdzad rdo rje/ yon tan 'khor lo sdom pa/ 'phrin las rdo rje 'jigs mdzad de/ ye shes dkyil 'khor lnga'i ngo bo dang gnyis su med par bzhugs la/ de ltar yin par grub thob a mo gha badz+ra chen pos kyang lung bstan pa/ gzhan yang mthar thug lnga ldan pa zhes/ mtshan yongs su grags pa de ni chos 'di sgyur ba po yin no/ /chos gzhan rnams kyi lo paṇa gyi dod longs sku ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma nyid dang / mkhas grub chen po sprul pa'i sku de yin cing / de yang rdo rje 'chang chen po nyid nas brtsams te —214—

brgyud pa bdun gyi bar du snyan brgyud dang chig brgyud kyi bka' rgyas btab/ de rjes nas chos 'dis sa steng thams cad khyab 'gro bar lung bstan pa ltar dngos su'ang de ltar byung ba yin/ 'dir bka' rgya 'grol ba po gro mgon sangs rgyas ston pa'i thugs kyi sras thu bo rnam pa gsum las/ mkhas grub gzhon nu grub dngos kyis khrid yig mdzad pa dang / mkhas grub shangs ston tshul khrims mgon gyi gsung rnams/ mkhas btsun rgyal mtshan 'bul gyis khrid yig tu mdzad nas bla ma nyid la sbyan lam du phab pa dang / slob dpon gnas rnying pa a'i seng ge dang / sprul sku rin chen blo gros kyi gsung las byon pa rnams/ gser gling pa bkra shis dpal gyis yig ris su mdzad pa rnams kyang / chos drug gi khrid yig sogs dmigs pa rnams zhus dag pher ba lta bur yod/ spyir chos tshul 'di skor la/ snyan brgyud yi ger 'god pa'i bka' drin che ba ni/ mkhas btsun rgyal mtshan 'bum nyid yin te/ 'di kho nas yi ger mdzad pa mang ngo / /de ltar na/lugs 'di la tshad mar gyur pa'i mkhas grub rnam pa gsum gyi gdams ngag gi rgyun thams cad rang re'i chos brgyud 'di la tshang bar bzhugs/ nang gses so so nas gyes pa'i brgyud lugs mi 'dra ba nyi shu rtsa bzhi yang 'dir tshang ba lags so/ /skabs 'dir bla ma'i rnam thar rgyas pa lung bklag dgos pa'i dbang du byas na/ rnam thar rgyas pa rang ngag na bshad mi dgos kyang / rin chen sna bdun gyi lo rgyus che ba ci rigs pa brjod na legs so/ /'dir mkhas grub chen po khyung po rnal 'byor pa des/ rgya gar mkhas pa brgya dang lnga bcu'i thugs bcud longs pa nyid kyi phyir/ mdo sngags bshad sgrub —215—

kyi chos mtha' yas pa zhig mnga' zhing / gzhan la'ang gsungs tshul rags rim tsam rnam thar na bzhugs pa der gda'/ de rnams kyi nang nas deng sang ma nub par bzhugs pa rnams gzhung bsrangs/ cha lag gzhan gyis kyang cung zad brgyan te/ shangs pa bka' brgyud kyi chos skor du yongs su grags pa ltar na/mkhas grub khyung po nyid las byung ba'i chos skor dang / phyis 'phel ba'i chos skor gnyis yod/ dang po la/ ni gu'i chos skor/ su kha'i chos skor/ rdo rje gdan pa'i chos skor/ mai tri pa'i chos skor/ rā hu la'i chos skor/ gas man ngag thor bu dang bcas pa rnams yod/ yang na smin byed dbang gi skor/ grol byed lam gyi skor/ rgyab rten lung gi skor/ bka' srung mgon po'i skor/ zhes dbye ba bzhir mdzad pa yod pa las/ ye shes mkha' 'gro ni gu nas brgyud pa'i grol byed lam gyi skor la/ rtsa ba ni gu chos drug/sdong po phyag rgya chen po/ yal ga la lam khyer rnam gsum/ me tog mkha' spyod dkar dmar/ 'bras bu 'chi med 'chug med de/ gser chos lnga'am/ khrid chen lngar grags pa dang / khrid chung bdun la sogs pa/ ji snyed cig yod pa las/ dang po chos drug la/ thog ma'i sngon 'gro/dal 'byor rnyed dka'/ 'chi ba mi rtag pa/ 'khor ba'i nyes dmigs/ las rgyu 'bras/ chos kyi phan yon/ 'bras bu'i bzhugs tshul sogs bstan pa la 'jug pa'i rim pa sogs dang / mthun par go bde bar bshad nas cung zad bsgom du gzhug go /khrid dngos la dbye na/ sngon 'gro dang / dngos gzhi'i khrid gnyis so/ /dang po la/ thun mong / thun mong ma yin pa gnyis so/ /dang po la skyabs su 'gro ba dang / sems bskyed pa gnyis so/ /de'i dang po skyabs 'gro ni/ slob —216—

dpon gyis spyir skyabs 'gro'i go babs rgyas bsdus 'tsham pa zugad cing /skabs 'dir dmigs pa la/ skyabs 'gro bzhi skor spyi dang mthun pa 'bog pa'i phyag len yang 'dug mod/ spros pa la dga' ba rnams kyi ngor/ de yang ma legs pa ma yin kyang / chos 'di nyid kyi khyad chos zab don skyabs 'gro chig 'grel ma 'di byin rlabs dang ldan pa'i zhal rgyun ma chad pa lags pas/ phyag bzhes rgyun gyi nyams len 'di la mdzad pa yin no/ /de yang dben pa'i gnas su stan bde ba la 'dug/lus gnad spyi dang mthun par bcas/ sems rnal du phab/ rang gzhan thams cad la gzhig 'grel zhig bcug /ga re bdag dang mkha' khyab kyi sems can thams cad 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal bzod blags med pa/ dus mtha' med par myong dgos pa 'di a tsam ci rang drag snyam du bsam/da ni 'di las nges par skyob thub pa'i skyabs zhig dgos par 'dug na/ skyabs gnas dkon mchog gsum gcig tu 'dus pa'i ngo bo mtshan ldan bla ma dam pa las gzhan mi 'dug pas/ rtsa ba'i bla ma kho na la cis kyang skyabs zhu dgos snyam pas/ rang nyid gang du gnas pa'i yul phyogs khang khyim kun yang dag pa'i zhing du mos/ rang gi mdun gyi nam mkhar seng khri pad+ma nyi zla'i gdan la drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma dam pa nyid sku dngos de ka la bkrag mdangs gzi brjid 'od du 'bar ba/ rang la dgyes pa'i zhal 'dzum bag can/ sangs rgyas kun 'dus/chos kun 'dus/ dge 'dun kun 'dus/ dngos dang brgyud pa'i bla ma kun 'dus/ yi dam zhi khro rab 'byams kun 'dus/ mkha' 'gro chos skyong srung ma kun 'dus pa'i bdag nyid can yin/ drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma mkhyen snyam pa bya/—217—

de nas rang gi tshe 'di'i dngos kyi pha ma dang / rang la gnod par byed pa'i dgra dang bgegs/ rang nyid gang du gnas pa'i yul phyogs de'i gzhi bdag rnams kyis gtso byas pa'i khams gsum sems can thams cad kyang / nye 'khor phyogs mtshams thams cad khyab par 'khod nas/ rang dang lhan cig tu skyabs 'gro byed par mos te/ ngag tu/ ma nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad skyabs kun 'dus kyi ngo bo bla ma rin po che la skyabs su mchi ba lags so/ /zhes ci nus su brjod cing / bdag dang sems can thams cad sngon chad 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal sna tshogs pas 'jigs pas/ da ni khyed la skyabs zhu/ skyabs bslu ba med pa khyed la blos ling gis bkal ba lags/ re sa mgon skyabs gzhan na med do/ /thugs rje chen pos bskyab tu gsol snyam pa'i 'dun pa drag po dung dung pa rgyun chags su bya/ thun 'jog khar skyabs yul bla ma de la mos gus dung ba byas pas/ de nyid 'od du stem ste zhu nas rang la thim/ bla ma dang rang sems dbyer med du mos/ de ka'i ngang du cung zad mnyam par bzhag/de ka la thun mtshams byed na/ dge ba byang chub tu bsngo/ dmigs skor gcig go /gnyis pa sems bskyed ni/ sngar ji skad bshad pa'i skyabs 'gro de sngon du btang nas// slar yang rang g.yin snod bcud/ nam mkhas gar khyab sems can gyi khyab pa rnams la blos gzhig 'grel bcug ste/ ga re nam mkha' 'dis gar khyab sems can gyis khyab par 'dug/'di thams cad re re nas pha dang ma dang mdza' bzhes su ma gyur pa cung zad kyang med/ de yang lan re tsam ma 'chi yam —218—

gyi/ skye ba dpag tu med par pha ma sogs su gyur pa yin/ 'di rnams 'dod ni bde ba 'dod kyang / myong ni sdug bsngal 'ba' zhig myong ba cis kyang snying re rje/de bas na 'di rnams sdug bsngal med cing bde ba dam pa la bdag gis 'god par bya na/ mthar thug pa na 'di rnams kyi sgrib gnyis bag chags dang bcas pa sbyangs nas/ rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang la 'god dgos par 'dugade yang thabs gzhan gyis mi nus pas bdag gis sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob par bya/sangs rgyas de yang dam pa'i chos kyi don bsgoms pa las 'byung ba'i phyir/ da res zab lam mthar thug chos drug zab mo 'di bsgom snyam du bsam/ngag nas 'di skad ces/ nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad kyi don du/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob par bya/ de'i phyir du zab lam ni gu'i chos drug nyams su blang bar bgyi'o/ /zhes brjod de/ don yid la bsam dgos pas/ tshig de yang dal bus brjod cing nan tan cher bya/ thun gyi dngos gzhi'i nyams len de kho na bskyar gyin bsgom pa yin/ thun gyi mjug tu dge ba byang chub tu bsngo ba re yang dgos pa lags/ dmigs skor gnyis pa'o/ /gnyis pa thun mong ma yin pa'i sngon 'gro la/ dag byed a'i stong ra/ stong ra nad gdon sel byed/ rtags gsum stong ra'i khyad par te/ rtsis 'go gsum du dbye ba yin/ dang po ni/ dmigs chen yin te/ de yang sngar bshad pa'i skyabs 'gro dang sems bskyed lan bdun bdun tsam re sngon du btang nas/ slar yang rang gi spyi bor gdan bzhi rdzogs sam/ ji ltar 'os pa'i gdan la/ bla ma sku dngos de ka gsal btab nas/—219—

mos gus kyi gdung shugs dang 'brel bas/ dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad 'dus pa'i ngo bo bla ma rin po che/ sems can thams cad kyi don du/ bdag gi nad gdon thams cad zhi bar mdzad du gsol/ sdig sgrib thams cad 'dag par mdzad du gsol/ ting nge 'dzin khyad par can rgyud la skye bar mdzad du gsol/ /zhes gsol ba bzlas drag la yun ring du btab/ mthar bla ma 'od du zhu nas rang la thim/ de yan chad 'di'i dgos kyi sngon 'gro bla ma'i rnal 'byor yin/ de yang spyi bo nas zhugs te thim pas/ klad pa gti mug gi rang bzhin can de yal ba'i tshul gyis sbyangs/ thod pa dung khang gi gzhal yas khang lta bur gyur gsung ste/ don dngos ni/ /rang tha mal du gsal ba'i lus po 'di/ da lta'i gdos bcas 'di ka yin pa'i mgrin pa yan chad gyi dbyibs rnam pa de ka yin kyang / nang sha khrag rus gsum spangs pa smos ci dgos/ phyi pags pa'i skya ri yang shin tu srab pa chu'i lha ba lta bu kha dog dkar ba zhag tu bsam/ mgo bo'i nang du chos 'byung dkar po gru gsum pa/ khong stong dwangs gsal shel gyi snod lta bu/ rtsa ba phra ba thur du bstan pa mgrin pa'i mtshams su slebs/gdengs ka che ba gyen du bstan pa la zur gsum yod pa'i zur gcig smin phrag gi thad dang / zur gzhan gnyis rna lcog g.yas g.yon gyi ltag tsam du nang nas pags pa la reg ge yod pa'o/ /chos 'byung de'i nang g.yas g.yon mdun rgyab gang la yang ma yo ba'i dbus drang thad du/ bla ma dang rang sems dbyer med spros bral skye med mtshon pa'i a yig dkar po dwangs gsal 'od kyi rang bzhin can 'od dkar po shin tu 'tsher ba 'phro ba/ chos 'byung gi kha mtshams dang a yig —22()—

gi mgrin pa'i nyeg mtshams mtho dman mnyam pa tsam bsgom gsung / gang ltar a yig gi mgo bo chos 'byung gi kha mtshams las mtho nges pa bsgom/ thog mar de lta bur bsgrims te 'bad pas gsal btab nas/ de rjes shes pa grims lhod ran po zhig gis/ a yig chos 'byung dang bcas par cung zad sems 'dzin/ de rjes a thung gi bzlas pa lan nyer gcig tsam shub shub por bzlas pas/ a las bdud rtsi'i rgyun sbom po dkar la dwangs pa 'od 'phro ba shugs dang ldan pa babs/ skad cig la chos 'byung mer gyis khengs nas chos 'byung gi kha'i phyogs thams cad nas zham zham byung / las kyi dbus thog thag tu shugs dang ldan par song / 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i sdig pa dang sgrib pa/ gnas skabs kyi 'gal rkyen nad gdon bar chad dkor sku glud dam tshig 'gal 'khrul la sogs pa thams cad phyir bdas par bsam dgos/ /sdig sgrib la dngos su kha dog med kyang dmigs pa gsal ba'i phyir dang / rten 'brel nus pa sna tshogs pa'i khyad par gyi phyir/ sdig sgrib sogs de dag rnams thams cad dud khu'am sol khu lta bu'i rnam pas/ rgyun sbom pa rnams bu ga dgu nas mi shong tshad par 'gro ba dang / 'bring po rnams rkang lag gi sen mo'i phrag dang / phra ba rnams skra'i rtse mo dang ba sbu'i khung bu tshun chad nas kyang nag nu ru ru thon 'gro bar bsam/ de yang bdud rtsi dwangs gsal gyi rgyun gang du slebs pa'i mtshams de nas/ nad gdon sdig sgrib rnams sdod dbang med par steng nas 'og tu bdas 'gro ba dang / dbus nas mtha' la bdas 'gro bar bsam/ lus kyi sha khrag rus pa sogs mi gtsang ba'i rdzas thams cad kyang zhu ba —221 —

ltar song nas/ sdig sgrib rnams dang lhan cig tu gar song med pa'i tshul gyis dag/de ltar lus kyi nad thams cad bkrus/ yang bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun skra dang ba spru'i rtsa ba nas phyir song ba rnams kyis lus kyi phyi nang kyang bkrus/ lus dwangs gsal dkar ba/ pags pa'i skya ri tsam la shel snod srab mo 'dra ba/ nang bdud rtsi dwangs gsal gyis gang ba'am/ yang na 'ja' 'od dkar po las grub pa lta bur song bar bsam/ phyi la bdas pa'i nad gdon sdig sgrib rnams nag bun nu nus ngogs thag ring por song zhing / de yang yal bar bsam la de dag dmigs pa 'jur po bar ma chad par bsgoms pa'i rjes la/ ngal gso ba'i tshul gyis shes pa dar cig glod la bzhag/de yan chad dmigs pa tshar gcig yin/ bla ma'i rnal 'byor thun mgo'i de kas chog pas thun de nang du slar bskyar mi dgos/ dmigs pa dngos gzhi de yang yang bskyar gyin bsgom/ de yang dper na thun re'i nang du dmigs pa lan brgya rtsa tsam/ thun yang bzhi lnga drug tsam bsgom thub na/ zhag bdun sogs la rtags myur bar 'ong / /des mtshon te rang gi rtsol ba rab 'bring tha gsum dang sbyor ba'i rtags myur bul gyi khyad par 'byung ba yin no/ /'di'i sdig sgrib dag par bsam pa'i skabs/ lus thogs med 'ja' tshon lta bur sgom na gsal nyams 'char rig pa dwangs/bdud rtsis gang bar bsgoms na lus zungs bzang / shel gong g.ya' dag pa lta bur bsgoms na/ rmi lam gsal snang skye ba yin gsung ngo / /dmigs skor gsum pa'o/ gnyis pa stong ra nad gdon sel byed la nad sel ba dang /gdon sel ba gnyis yod/ de re re la yadwa dbye ba du ma yod mod kyi so sor na —222—

dmigs phran yang yin/ spyir nas dag byed a'i stong ra'i las tshogs tsam yin pas/ yongs bsdoms nas dmigs chen gcig gi don du brtsi dgos/ de yang nad tshad pa lta bu la/ a las bdud rtsis rgyun kha dog dkar ba/ reg bya dang nus pa gnyis kar bsil ba'i rgyun babs te/ tsha ba'i gnas stod kyi yul lam/gang nas de ka nas bu ga har re byung sgo de ka nas nad tsha ba de yang dmar 'dur 'dur phyir bdas par bsam/ de bzhin du nad grang ba la/ bdud rtsi kha dog dmar po reg bya dang nus pa gnyis ka tsha ba babs te/ grang ba'i yul ro smad kyi cha'am/ gang na sa nas brdol te nad thams cad dkar 'dur 'dur 'dur thon par bsam/ rlung gi nad la bdud rtsi kha dog ser ba mar khu ltar bcud dang ldan pa babs/ lus kyi cha thams cad dam/ 'og sgo gnyis sam/ gang na sar bu ga byung ste/ nad rnams sngo 'dur ba'am nag 'dur gyis thon par bsam/yang na rlung 'tshub ma'am du ba lta bur bun bun thur du 'gro bar bsam/ snying rlung la snying gi thad ka nas bu ga byung ste/ de nas 'gro bar bsam/ des ma rdzo nas nad gzhan thams cad la yang rigs 'gre/ yang dmigs pa'i gzhi dag byed stong ra bzhin bsgoms nas/ a las khro bo so so'i sku'i rnam pa can gyi bdud rtsi ser ba drag po ltar 'bebs pa dang / khro chung gi tshogs dpag tu med pas lus kyi nang go mtshams med par gtams/ me lce yang spros te thur dang phyogs mtshams su 'bar ba dang / bdud rtsi khro chu bzhu ba'i rgyun lta bu yang 'bebs te/ sngags kyi sgras skrag pa dang / mtshon cha brdeg pa dang / me ris sreg pa sogs kyis gdon gyi ris srog chags sna tshogs pa'i gzugs can de —223—

rnams lus kyi nang du sdod dbang med par phyir bskrad de/ phyi rol de nyid du tshar bcad cing / lhag ma tsam yang ma lus par bsam mo/ gdon so so'i gnyen por khro bo gang dgos pa ni/ 'og gang 'dul gyi skabs dang 'dra'o/ khro bo dang me dang khro chu lta bu ste spro ba gsum po dus gcig tu mi yong bas rim can du bya'o/ /dmigs skor bzhi pa'o/ /gsum pa rtags gsum stong ra'i khyad par ni/ dag byed a'i stong ra bsgoms pas sdig sgrib dag pa'i rtags rab dngos su shar ba ni/ 'di bsgoms pa kho nas lus ldang ba yang ba dang / shes pa gsal ba dang / rgyud 'jam zhing blo khug 'ong / chags sdang sogs nyon mongs chung du 'gro ba dang / dad pa dang snying rje shes rab sogs rang shugs kyis cher song na'ang yin/ 'bring gnyid sad dus 'khrul snang nyams kyi tshul du 'char ba dang / tha ma rmi lam gsal bor 'char ba la khrus byas pa dang / nam mkha' la 'phur ba dang / gos dkar po gyon pa la sogs pa'o/ /stong ra nad sel byed bsgoms pas nad thon pa'i rtags rab ni/ nad dngos su sangs pa yin/ 'bring nyams dang tha ma rmi lam la 'khru skyugs dang / lus las rnag khrag thon pa sogs byung na yin/ stong ra gdon sel byed bsgoms pas/ gdon gyi gnod pa sel ba'i rtags rab/ dngos su nyer 'tshe zhing / lus sems dga' bde skye/ /bag bro'u re ba yong / 'bring nyams dang / tha ma rmi lam la/ srog chags gdug pa can bcom pa dang / rang nyid dgra las rgyal ba dang / lus las srog chags thon pa la sogs pa 'byung ngo / /de la rtags gsum ni sdig sgrib dag pa'i rtags/ nad sel ba'i rtags /—224—

gdon sel ba'i rtags te gsum po yin la/ de re re la yang dngos dang /nyams dang / rmi lam gyi dbye ba gsum gsum ste/ nad sel rtags kyi dbye ba dgur 'gyur ba yin no/ /de la dang por rtags yong du re ba mi bya/ rtsis btab med par 'jog dgos/ rtags byung na zhen pa dang / rloms sems dang /dga' mi dga' byed du mi rung / 'di lta bu rten 'brel snang ba ma 'gags pa'i 'char sgo cam yin gyi/ don gang du'ang ma grub pa sgyu ma lta bu'o/ /zhes re dogs spangs te bzhag pas/ slad kyi bar chad mi 'gyung zhing lam du 'gro ba yin no/ /dngos kyi rtags rnams byung na des khyab/ sad dus kyi nyams la gsal snang du shar ba yin / lan gcig shar ba kho nas rtags su byed/ rmi lam tsam la nges pa med pas/ shin tu gsal ba dang / lan mang du byung ba dang / sad nas kyang blo'i mdangs 'gyur tshabs che bar byung na rtags su byed pa lags so/ /rtags kyi rnam bzhag rgyas par yig rnying na gsal/ 'di la dmigs thun bcad pa'i dmigs pa med kyang / rtags shar ba lam du srol tshul de ka dmigs pa yin pas/ dmigs skor lnga pa'o/ /gnyis pa dngos gzhi la/ gtum mo/ sgyu lus/ rmi lam/ 'od gsal/'pho ba/ bar do ste drug yin la/ de dag kyang rang rang gi byed las che ba dang bcas pa brjod na/ thabs lam bde drod rang 'bar/ sgyu lus chags sdang rang grol/ rmi lam nying 'khrul rang dag 'od gsal gti mug rang sangs/ 'pho ba ma bsgoms sangs rgyas/ bar do rgyal ba longs sku'o/ /de la dang po thabs lam bde drod rang 'bar la/ ga tshu mo nyid kyi sngon 'gro dang / dngos gzhi dang /—225—

rjes gsum mo/ /dang po ni/ spyir khrid kyi dngos gzhi yin kyang / gtum mo rang gi dngos gzhi la ltos pa'i sngon 'gro 'gyur bas/ sngon 'gro lus gnad ma'i stong ra zhes bya/ drod shin tu myur bas gtum mo me rgod kyi dmigs pa zhes kyang bya ste/ de la yang skyabs sems sngon du btang nas/ thog ma'i sngon 'gro bla ma'i rnal 'byor cig dgos pas/ rang lha skur sgom pa'am/ re zhig tha mal pa'i nga rgyal gyis kyang rung ste/ spyi bor gdan bzhi rdzogs su bsgoms pa la/ gtum mo'i skabs 'ji/ra sna tshogs pad+ma mi byed/ pad+ma dkar por bsgom/ der bzhugs nga/'i bla ma yang sku dngos su sgom na yang sku mdog dkar ba/ 'od zer dkar po 'phro bar bsgom/ rdo rje 'chang du bsgom na yang / sku mdog ston zla ltar dkar bas bsgom mod/ chos drug gi skabs tham sa cad du/ bla ma sku dngos su bsgom pa nyid gtso che ba yin gsung nas phyag len 'debs par mdzad/lar sku dngos kyi rnam pa la mos sam/ rdo rje 'chang gi rnam pa la mos/ gang la mos pa de nyid sku bde ba'i nyams rgyas shing / zhal 'dzum bag dang ldan pa/rang la byin gyis rlob rlob 'dra ba zhig bsgom/ dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad 'dus pa'i ngo bo bla ma rin po che/ sems can thams cad kyi don du/ bdag gi lus la bde drod kyi ting nge 'dzin khyad par can skye bar mdzad du gsol/sems la bde stong gi ting nge 'dzin khyad par can skye bar mdzad du gsol/ ces gsol ba drag tu btab/ mthar bla ma bdud rtsi'i ngo bor zhu/ rang gi spyi bo nas zhugs te thim/ rang gi tha mal rnam smin gyi lus ngag yid gsum nam mkha' la 'ja' yal ba ltar sang ste dag /ye shes lha'i sku gsung thugs su gyur pa ni/ —226—

rang nyid bcom ldan 'das ma rdo rje phag mo sku mdog dmar mo/ phyag g.yas rdo rje thur du cung zad sdigs pa/ g.yon thod khrag thugs kar bsnams pa/ gcer bu rus pa'i rgyan lnga dang / mi mgo skam po lnga'i dbu rgyan/ rlon po lnga bcu'i do shal can pad nyi mi ro mgo bo g.yas su bstan pa'i steng na/ zhabs g.yas brkyang gi stabs kyis bzhugs pa/ me dpung 'bar ba'i dbus na gnas pa/spyan gsum dbu skra grol ba sogs cha byad spyi dang mthun/ gang ltar yang rang rdo rje phag mo ku mdog phyag mtshan rnam pa gang gsal gsal zhig ci nus su gsal btab ste cung zad sems bzung / de phyi'i dmigs pa yin/ de nas rang lha skur gsal ba'i lus nang la sems gtad pas/ lus kyi nang sha khrag rus gsum sogs gang yang med pa'i stong sang nge ba/ phyi pags pa'i rnam pa yang shin tu srab pa/ nang khong stong de yang 'od dmar po drod kyi rang bzhin gyis khyab pa/ dpe dar dmar gyi gur ram/ khru ma phus btab pa lta bu zer ba de yin/skra'i rtsa ba dang ba sbu'i rtsa ba tshun chad kyang sbubs stong du sbu gu sag ge bsgom dgos gsung / gang ltar na'ang rang lus rdo rje phag mo'i skur gsal ba de'i lus nang stong sang nge ba spyi bo nas zhabs mthil gyi bar dang / zhabs mthil nas spyi bo'i bar dang / phyag zhabs kyi sor mo'i rtse mo'i bar kun tu rim pas gsal btab cing nang stong sang nge ba la sems gtad/ nang gi dmigs pa'o/nyams khrid rang byed na/ phyi nang gnyis po 'di la'ang so sor zhag shas bskyangs na shin tu legs/ de nas me rgod kyi dmigs pa dngos ni/ skabs de nas lus gnad me thab drug chings bya ste/ rkang pa gnyis re mig ltar bsnol la tsog pu —227—

bya/ rkang ngar g.yas pa nang dang g.yon pa phyi la yod pa byed/ lag pa g.yas g.yon bar lhu g.yas g.yon la bsnol mar 'jus/ gru mo gnyis pus mo'i steng du yod par byas la sgal tshigs bsrang / lta stangs sogs lus gnad lhag ma spyi dang 'dra/ de nas thun gyi dang po la rlung ro dal la ring ba lan gsum bus/rlung sbyor dngos ni/ de rjes steng rlung ran par sas te nye 'og tu mnan/ 'og rlung rang gnas su bcing / yar 'then pa mi dgos/ dmigs pa ni rang gi lte ba'i thad dang / de'i thad kyi rgyab dang / mkhal khung g.yas g.yon gnyis te gnas bzhir me'i gong bu dbyibs zlum po/ kha dog dmar ba/ reg bya tsha ba/me lce lhab lhab 'bar ba rang ma yin pa la/ 'bar tshad tshad pa sol me dar ma bus pa'am/ lcags bsregs kyi gong bu dmar lhang ba lta bu bzhi bsgoms su gsal btab/ rlung 'jam rlung bzung ba'i ngos nas lto ba g.yas su bskor ba gcig dang / g.yon du bskor ba gcig byas pas/ me gong bzhi po de drag tu 'thab nas me lcags gtsubs pa lta bu'i me stag dmar skyas lus kyi nang thams cad 'od dmar chem chem khyab pas/ lus tsha 'u ru ru byung bar bsam/ de ltar mi bde ba med med du rlung bzung nas cung zad mi bde ba snyam byed na/ dang por shugs chung ba/ bar du shugs che ba mthar sang ste rlung bus/ rlung thengs gcig go /yang snga ma ltar bzung zhing dmigs pa yang snga ma ltar bsgom/ thun mjug tu dge ba bsngo'o/ /de ltar zhag shas rlung thengs re la dmigs pa dang g.yas g.yon du skor ba tshar re re kho nas sbyangs/ de nas rim pas zhag shas nas g.yas skor g.yon skor re re bsnan/ grangs kyi tha ma grangs la nges bzung rang —228—

med kyang / g.yas skor bcu gnyis dang g.yon skor bcu gnyis tsam du longs song tsa na me'i nus pa rnyed par 'gyur ro gsung / thun mtshams su yan lag lnga sbyongs re sngon du 'gro bas/ gtsubs shing dang gtsubs stan ma'i 'khrul 'khor ci nus su sbyang ngo / /dmigs skor drug pa'o/ /gnyis pa gtum mo'i dngos gzhi la/ gtum mo zas su za ba/ gos su gyon pa/ stan du 'ding ba/ rtar bzhon pa ste bzhi las/ dang po ni/ gtum mo zas su za ba ste/ chos 'di'i lugs kyi gtum mo'i dmigs pa'i gtso bo yin te/'di la yang shes rab dang / mos pa'i khyad par gyis dmigs pa rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum yod do/ /de la dang por rgyas pa ni/ sngar bzhin skyabs 'gro sems bskyed bla ma'i rnal 'byor rnams sngon du btang / rang lhar gsal ba dang lus nang stong ra bca' ba yang sngar bzhin byas te/ de rjes lus gnad rkang pa sems dpa'i skyil krung lhod kyis byas te rgya che bar bcas lag mthil pus mo'i steng du bkab ste lag ngar bsrang / lhag ma lus gnas spyi dang 'dra/ thun gyi mgo 'dir rlung ro dgu sprugs su 'bud de/ dang por dal la ring ba gsum/bar du drag la 'thung ba gsum/ tha mar ro stod gcus shing 'bud pa gsum/ de rnams lag len bltas pas gsal/ de nas rang gi lus la rtsa gsum 'kho(ra lo bzhi yi ge gnyis dang bcas pa gsal 'debs/ de yang lus kyi g.yas g.yon gang la yang yo ba'i dbus drang thad/ mdun rgyab kyi dbang du byas na rgyab phyogs la cung zad nye bar/ rtsa dbu ma a wa dhu dhi chos bzhi ldan du gsal 'debs de yang chu shing gi sdong po ltar drang ba ste/ ya yo khyar khyor khyag khyog med pa/ til —229—

gyi mar me ltar gsal ba ste rang 'od 'phro ba/ rgya skyegs kyi khu ba ltar dmar ba ste rgya tshos kyis bcos pa'i mdog lta bu/ pad+ma'i snal ma ltar phra ba ste shin tu srab pa'o/ /yongs kyi phyi dbyibs sbom phra ni/ mda' smyug 'bring po tsam ste/dbu ma de'i yas sna spyi bo tshangs bug la zug ces gsung ste/ de yang dngos su rus pa'i tshangs bug rang ta mi sgom ste/ 'on kyang tshangs bug gi thad spyi gtsug gi yas mtha' nas mar sor gnyis tsam gzhal ba'i sar sleb pa yin/ mas sna lte 'og sor bzhi'i thad du zug par bsgom/ dbu ma de khong stong yas snas sna gnyis ka bcad khar yod cing / de'i g.yas su ro ma dmar po dang / g.yon du rkyang ma dkar po ste gnyis po dbu ma bzhi bshags su btang ba tsam gyi tshad dam/yang na gro sog tsam yang gsung ste gang lta ra bsgoms kyang 'dra/ /de gnyis spyi bo nas lhe 'og sor bzhi'i bar dbu ma dang lhan cig tu gsum gshibs ltar yod pa/ yas mas kyi sne ni ro rkyang gnyis ring ba las/ 'og tu ro rkyang gnyis dbu ma las sor bzhi tsam gyi ring ba'i ro rkyang gi sne de gnyis yar slog ste/ dbu ma'i mas sna'i nang du chug tsam byas la/ yas sna gnyis po dbu ma'i yas sna'i rgyab phyogs mtheb sor tsam gyi thad du song / de mtshams nas gnyis gshibs su byas pa dbu ma'i yas sna'i steng nas bkab cing / de nas mdun du 'khyogs te/ro ma'i sne sna bug g.yas dang / rkyang ma'i sne bug g.yon du zug pa'o/ /de ltar ro rkyang dbu ma gsum po gsum gshibs su yod pa las/ lte ba'i thad dang /snying ga'i thad dang / mgrin pa'i sbom sa'i thad dang / spyi bo'i dbu ma'i yas sna nas mar rtse sor gnyis tsam gzhal ba'i thad de bzhi po de rnams rtsa 'khor gyi lte —230—

ba zlum po a long khong seng can lta bu/ ro rkyang dbu ma gsum dbus kyi srog shing 'dra ba la/ des sked dkris byas pa lta bu ste/ de lta bu'i lte ba las rtsa 'dab rnams rtsa sbubs can gyi rnam pa gdugs kyi rtsibs ma bzhin du skyes par gyur pa las/ lte ba sprul pa'i 'khor lo rtsa 'dab drug cu re bzhi gdugs rtsibs ma can gan rkyal du bzhag pa lta bu/ snying ga chos kyi 'khor lo rtsa 'dab brgyad gdugs rtsibs ma can nyid lta bu/ mgrin par longs spyod kyi 'khor lo rtsa 'dab bcu drug gdugs 'degs lta bu/ spyi bo bde ba chen po'i 'khor lo rtsa 'dab sum cu so gnyis/ gdugs kyi rtsibs ma lta bu/ 'khor lo bzhi kar phyi rim nang rim gyi dbye ba med/ grangs de rnams mu ded yin/ thams cad kyang kha dog dmar po/ lcags bsregs ltar 'od dmar lham me ba bsgom/ rtsa dbu ma'i nang gi yas sna'i phyogs su ha yig dkar po mgo bo thur du lta ba/ thig le'i rang bzhin nyams bde zhing bsil ba zhu la khad khad pa bsgom/ /dbu ma'i mas sno'i nang rtsa gsum 'dus mdor/ /ra yig dmar po mgo bo gyen du lta ba/ /me'i rang bzhin shin tu tsha ba/ dbu ma'i mas sna nas sor bzhi gzhal ba tsam gyi thad bshang sgo'i phyogs su rlung gi dkyil 'khor zla gam sngon po g.yo ba'i rang bzhin gdan thabs su yod pa/ bcad kha mdun la bstan pa rnams sgom mo/ /dmigs rdo pa'i gzhi de lta gsal thebs nas/ yang rlung ro zhig dal bus bsal/ de nas steng rlung shar te rngubs pa nye 'og tu bskyur stabs su mnan/ de dang mnyam du 'og rlung bskum ste/ lte bar kha sbyor du bzung / cung zad mi bde ba snyam/ byed na gzhil bar bya ste/ de yang sngar rlung bzung ba de nyid cung zad kyang —231 —
