phyir ma btang par slar yang rngubs chung gang nus bya ste/ lte ba'i gnas su g.yas g.yon dbus gsum du 'then gnon byas nas kyang gang thub bzung yang mi bde ba snyam byed na/ dang por shugs chung ba/ bar du shugs che ba/ mthar sang gis btang ba rnams la bslab/ de ma thag tu yang rngubs te sngar bzhin bsgom/ma goms gong du ngal na rlud thengs bzhi'i mtshams sam/ brgyad dang / bcu gnyis sam/ bcu drug gam/ nyi shu'am/ nyer bzhi'am/ nyer brgyad dam/ so gnyis kyi mtshams su ngal gso yi/ gang 'dod du bzhag tu mi rung ngo / /dmigs pa ni/ rlung rnams sna sgo nas zhugs/ ro rkyang gi lam brgyud de/lte 'og rtsa gsum 'dus mdor sleb/ 'og rlung bskums pas bshang sgo'i rlung gi dkyil 'khor las rlung po kha mdog sngon po shin tu phra ba zhig mdung tshugs su langs te dbu ma'i mas snar chud/ de ltar ro rkyang dang thur sel gyi rlung gsum po/ gcig tu 'dus pas ra yig la bus pas/ ra yig las gtum mo ye shes kyi me lhag ste 'bar/ mar me 'bar ba lta bu de'i rtse mo shin tu phra zhing rno ba sbu shad dmar po lta bu/ phra ba/ gsal ba/ 'tsher ba zhig je ring rje ring la 'bar/rlung thengs 'ga' re song ba na/ spyi bo'i ha las reg reg 'dug par bsam/ de nas rim pas ha zhu ba las byang chub kyi sems kyi rgyun dar dkar po'i snal ma brkyang ba tsam babs/ je ring je ring la lte ba'i ra la thim par bsam/ spyir gtum mo la/ me kho na la dmigs pa theg le la dmigs pa/ 'bar 'dzag la dmigs pa gsum yod pa las 'di phyi ma yin/ de la'ang 'bros 'ded dang /skra shad 'dzings pa lta bu dang / phye dmar khyab pa la sogs pa'i lugs sna tshogs —232—

yod kyang / 'di bar pa yin/ de yang dbu ma'i dbus su 'bar 'dzag gnyis ka rgyun mi 'chad pa la zer te/ de las kyang dbu ma'i dbus kyi nang gzhir bzhag pa las/ mdun gyi phyogs su me 'bar ba dang / rgyab kyi phyogs su byang chub kyi sems 'bab pa bsgom dgos gsung / gtum mo 'bar ba'i me 'od gang du slebs pa des lus nang du tsha 'ur gyis byung ba dang / byang chub kyi sems 'bab pa'i 'od skya ya byung ba na/ lus thams cad bde cham gyis byung bar mos pa gnyis re mos su yid la bya'o/ /thun mtshams su dge ba byang chub tu bsngo/ de ltar na dmigs pa rgyas pa ste/ dmigs skor bdun pa'o/ /dbang rtul la 'di spong sgom du byed na/ rtsa gsum dang 'khor lo bzhi dang yig 'bru dang rlung sbyor dang 'bar 'dzag rnams la thun re re byas na'ang 'ong ba lags/ gtum mo zas su za ba'i dmigs pa 'bring po ni/ rtsa 'khor lo bzhi lte ba sked dkris 'dra ba dang bcas pa'i skor de rnams bor nas/ lhag ma sngar ltar bsgom pa kho na'o/ /dmigs pa bsdus pa ni/de'i steng du ro rkyang gnyis kyang spangs pa ste/ 'di la mi 'dra ba'i khyad rlung sna sgo nas rngubs pa gnyis dbu ma'i g.yas g.yon nas mar mdung tshugs su song /lte 'og nas sor drug gam brgyad tsam du mar sleb pa de/ 'og rlung yar bskum pa'i rlung dang phrad pa na/ de la brdabs pa ltar yang thabs su yar log ste thams cad dbu ma'i mas snar zhugs/ ra la bskul bar bsam dgos/ gzhan 'dra/ de ltar na dmigs pa 'bring bsdus gnyis po/ dmigs pa rgyas pa'i nang du chud pa yin pas logs su mi 'dren/ dmigs skor bdun pa nyid du 'dus/—233—

de'i rgyu mtshan rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum kar bla ma las thob par byas nas/rang gi mos pa dang mthun par gang rung zhig kho na bsgom rgyu yin pa'i phyir ro/ /dmigs skor gcig yin kyang 'chad pa'i tshe chos thun so sor byed pa ni mi 'gal lo/ /'dir mkhas btsun rgyal mtshan 'bum gyis mdzad pa sogs khrid yig rnying pa rnams na/ sngon 'gro me'i stong ra la rkang pa skyil krung dang / dngos gzhi gtum mo zas za la me thab drug chings byed par bshad na'ang/ bla ma'i zhal la ltos pa'i phyir man ngag dkrugs te bshad nga/ yin/ lag len gong du bshad pa kho na byed dgos so/ /gtum mo zas su za ba 'di gtum mo'i dngos gzhi yin/gzhung las/ rang lus thabs ldan rtsa gsum 'khor lo bzhi/ a ha 'bar 'dzag skad cig dga' bzhis brgyan/ /zhes gsungs pa'i bstan don dngos yin no/ /ra yig bsgoms pa la lte ba'i a thung sgom pa'i don tshang ba dang / /dmigs pa 'bring bsdus gnyis la 'khor lo bzhi dngos su ma bsgoms kyang / rtsa dbu ma yongs rdzogs bsgoms pa'i phyir/ /dbu ma nyid 'khor lo bzhi khar gyi lte ba yin pas/ don 'khor lo bzhi char tshang ba yin no/ /gnyis pa gtum mo gos su gon pa ni/ dmigs pa'i rtsa ba gtum mo zas su za ba cung zad goms pa/ zhig gis bya ste/ 'di la phyi'i dmigs pa grang ba yid la mi byed/ gnas khang rdo rje'i rang bzhin nam/ lcags bsregs kyis sa gzhi dang / rwa gur la me 'ur 'ur 'bar bar bsgom/ rang lha sku dang / rgyan phyag rgya lnga/ na bza' stag lpags mi lpags/ thams cad kyang me lce yal la la —234—

'bar bar bsam/ nang gi dmigs par lte 'og sor bzhir ra las 'bar ba'i mes lus nang thams cad gang bar bsam/ lus gnad tsog pu/ lag gnyis pus mo'i phyi nas 'khyud dbugs sha dbrag la 'gro bar byed ces bshad na'ang /man ngag gab pa yin pas/ lag gnyis nang du bsnol te/ g.yas kyi lag mthil g.yon gyi mkhal khung dang / g.yon gyi lag mthil g.yas kyi mkhal khung la bkab/ phyi nang pus 'khyud kyis bsdoms pa yin/ rlung gi gnad/ gzhil ba lan gnyis re'am/ gsum re lus stobs dang bstun nas bya/ thun mtshams su gtsubs shing gtsubs stan gyi 'khrul 'khor la 'bad/ 'dis drod 'phral du skyed/ lus rngus na gos srab tu btang zhing / lus la dril phyis bya'o/ /de yang dngos gzhi zas su za ba ma bsgoms par me'i stong ra yun ring du bsgom pas kyang 'di bsgom du wo ngo / /dmigs skor brgyad pa'o/ /gnyis pa stan du 'ding ba ni phyi'i dmigs pa gos su gyon pa dang 'dra ba las/ lhag par gdan lcags bsregs kyi pad+ma dang nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor me lce 'u ru ru 'bar la rang nyid gnas pa lhag por bsgom/ nang gi dmigs pa lte ba'i thad du ra dmar po 'od lhag ge ba la sems gtad/ rlung gnad 'jam rlung rgyun chags su bzung / nyin par nam stod de ltar byas nas gnyid log khar/rab skyil krung / 'bring tsog pu/ tha ma sngas mtho ru bcug/glo g.yas pa 'og tu bcug/pus brang sbyar/ lus sum ltab tu nyal/ sems lte ba'i ra la gtad pa'i ngang nas gnyid du 'gro bar bya/ 'di'i dgos pa ni/ gtum mo bsgoms pas gnyid kyi 'od gsal zin pa dang / nyin par bsgoms pa'i drod kyi rgyun de mtshan —235—

mo mi yal ba'i phyir yin/ 'di yang me'i stong ra'am/ zas su za ba gang rung zhig cung zad 'byongs pas bsgom na don ston par the tshom med pa yin no/ /dmigs skor dgu pa'o/ /bzhi pa rlung ltar bzhon pa ni/ rtsa ba'i dmigs pa dang rlung 'byongs pa zhig gis yun ring du bsgoms na/ rta mchog dang mnyam pa'i 'gros 'byung ngo zhes pa lta bu rtags dang yon tan gyi tshul du 'byung ba yin/ da lta lag tu longs nges la zla ba gcig gnyis cam rlung sbyangs pa'i las dang po pas sgom na/ lam gyi 'gro 'dug gis rtsa rlung 'khrugs pa dang / khams rnyog par mi 'gyur zhing /'gro 'dug nyid lus sbyongs su 'gro ba'i phan yon yod do/ /de yang lam du 'jug pa'i sngon du khug pa nyer gcig tsam bzung / de skabs dngos gzhi'i dmigs pa'am/ yang na mi rtog pa rkyang pa bsgoms kyang btub/ dngos ni lam du 'gro ba'i tshe/ lag pa stod skyil bcas/ rlung 'jam rlung bzung / dmigs pa ni rlung gi lha mo dkar ljang gshog pa can gnyis kyis mchan khung nas btegs te/ gang 'dod pa'i gnas su phyin par bsam gsung / 'dir rlung khug pa zhes pa ni/ gong du bshad pa'i rlung thengs bzhi bzhi pa de la zer ba yin/ de nyer gcig la rlung thengs brgyad cu gya bzhi yod/ de yang las dang po bum can ma 'grub pa rnams kyi dbang du byas par 'dug/yun ring bzung nus pa rnams la grangs de tsam mi dgos/ khrid yig rnams na mi gsal yang skabs der bar lhu 'jus pa'i stod skyil tsam pos mi chog/khu tshur mchan khung du bcug pa'i stod skyil bcas nas/ rlung gi lha mos —236—

btegs pa sgom dgos zhes/ sangs rgyas kun 'dus rtsa ba'i bla ma gsung ngo / /dmigs skor bcu pa'o/ /gsum pa rjes kyi khrid la/ srid pa'i dbang zhu ba dang / gegs rang grol gnyis so/ /dang po ni/ man ngag 'di thob phyin chad nas/ gtum mo bsgoms pa'i mjug thun rma/tshams la 'jug khar 'di tshar gcig nges par bsgom dgos te/ de yang rang gi spyi bor seng khri pad dkar nyi zla'i gdan la/ rtsa ba'i bla ma sku dngos sam/ rdo rje 'chang gang du bsgoms kyang rung mod kyi/ rtsa ba'i bla ma nyid bsgom pa zab par bzhed/ gang ltar yang sku mdog dkar la 'od zer 'phro ba/de nyid skyabs gnas kun 'dus su shes/ mchod yon dang / me tog la sogs pa'i nyer spyod dang / khang bzang bzhugs khri/ na bza' rin po che'i gter dang /dpag bsam gyi shing dang / 'dod 'jo'i ba dang / rgyal srid sna bdun dang /bkra shis lha mo brgyad la sogs pa/ mdor na phyogs dus kun gyi mchod pa bzang dgu thams cad 'bul ba ni/ /phyi'i mchod pa'o/ /de nas sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga la sogs pa'i dam rdzas rnams ye shes kyi bdud rtsir byin gyis brlabs te 'bul ba ni nang gi mchod pa'o/ /bde ba skyed byed rigs kyi/ yum 'bul ba ni gsang ba'i mchod pa'o/ /de thams cad sgyu ma rmi lam ltar shes pa ni/ de kho na nyid kyi mchod pa'o/ /de ltar mchod pa bzhi rdzogs su phul nas/ 'di skad ces/dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad 'dus pa'i ngo bo bla ma rin po che la/ phyi me tog bdug spos/ nang sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga/ gsang ba bde stong gi ye shes/ yang gsang de kho na nyid kyi mchod pa dam pa rnams 'bul lo/ /bzhes nas bdag la —237—

dbang bzhi rdzogs par bskur du gsol/ ces gsol ba drag tu btab pas/ bla ma'i sku las ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i rgyun dkar la dwangs pa nyams bde ba dang ldan pa drag tu babs/ spyi bo nas zhugs/ smin mtshams yan chad gang / bum dbang thob/ sku'i dngos grub stsal/ yang bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun gyis mgrin pa yan chad gang / gsang dbang thob/ gsung gi dngos grub stsal/ yang snying ga yan cha gang / shes rab ye shes kyi dbang thob/ thugs kyi dngos grub stsal/ yang bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun nye ba sogs nas brgyud/ rkang mthil yan chad lus kyi nang thams cad gang / dbang bzhi pa thob/ sku gsung thugs kyi dngos grub thams cad stsal/bla ma nyid kyang 'od du nyem ste zhu nas rang la thim/ bla ma'i sku gsung thugs dang / rang gi lus ngag yid gsum dbyer med gcig tu gyur pa la mnyam par bzhag /de rjes dge ba bsngos nas thun mtshams la 'jug pa yin/ dmigs pa 'di bla ma la ma thob gong du der zad/ thob phyin chad gdams ngag 'di'i lugs kyi gtum mo'i dmigs pa'i rigs bsgom pa thams cad la/ thun gyi 'jug tu 'di tshar re nges pa bsgom dgos pas/ gtum mo'i dmigs pa'i rjes chog lta bur 'gyur ba'i phyir/ rjes kyi khrid du bsdus pa yin la/spyir 'di nyid dmigs pa gzhan dang ma sbrel bar logs su bsgom pa'i srol yang yod cing / bla ma'i sku las dbang bzhi len pa'i gnad don thams cad tshang zhing / spros pa'i bsre bslad med pas/ byin rlabs kyi tshan kha shin tu che'o/ /skabs 'gar zhag gsum mam/ lnga'am/ bdun sogs 'di kho na la dril te bsgoms na/ sgom gang la yang bogs bla na med par phyin par 'gyur —238—

ro/ /gtum mo'i mjug tu nges par bsgom dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan ni/ gtum mo dngos gzhi bsgoms pa'i bde drod kyi nyams myong brtan par byed pa dang / rlung stod du 'tshangs pa thur du 'bebs pa dang / rtsol ba drag pos lus zungs la gnod pa'i rigs la/ 'dis lus zungs gso ba ting nge 'dzin gyi bcud len du 'gyur ba dang / thun mtshams su grib sogs bar chad srung ba dang / gtso bor byin rlabs brtan pa'i sgo nas ye shes skyed pa'o/ /dmigs skor bcu gcig pa'o/ /gnyis pa gegs rang grol ni/ spyir gegs sel rgyas pa gzhan du shes dgos kyang / khrid kyi dkyus la 'di tsam 'byung ste/ gtum mo bsgom pa phal cher la rlung stod du 'tshang ba dang / 'og tu kun+da'i gegs 'byung ba yin/ de yang 'ga' zhig la gnyis kar 'byung ba'ang yod/ phal cher la gang rung re 'byung ba shas che/ gegs kyi rnam pa gzhan rnams ni re re tsam ma gtogs 'byung ba dkon no/ /de la stod gegs bsal ba ni/ thabs lam gtum mo bsgom pa'i skabs su ro stod na ba dang / mgo la zur gzer skye ba dang / shes pa 'phyo ba sogs byung na/ sngon 'gro nyams su blangs pa'i rjes su/ rang lus stong sang nge ba gsal btab ste/ rlung thengs gcig gnyis shig sngon du btang / gang na sar bu ga zlum po sum tshom nor bu mig gsum 'dra ba gsal btab/ lag gnyis khu tshur mdun du brkyangs te/ slar khu tshur gyi rgyab nu steng dang / lag ngar rtsibs logs la thebs par byed pa dang mnyam por kha nas ha thung drag tu 'don/ nad rnams bu ga nas dud pa'am rlung tshubs kyi rnam pas phyur phyur phyir rgyang ring du —239—

'gro ba dang / lus kyi nang stong sang sang song bar mos/ lus thams cad na na sus khrol tshags lta bur sgom pa khyad par yin/ lus kyi cha shas 'di rang na ba'i nges gzung med par shes pa 'phyo ba sogs byung na snying rlung gi byed las yin pas/ snying dkar nag gi mtshams su bu ga sgom na legs gsung ngo / /dmigs skor bcu gnyis pa'o/ /smad kun da'i gegs bsal ba ni/ rab dgag sgrub dang bral ba'i blos sel/ 'bring dbang bskur dang tshogs 'khor gyis sel/ tha ma dmigs pa dang 'khrul 'khor gyis sel gsung / yang chags sred dang bag chags kyi rgyu las byung ba yin na/ dgag sgrub dang bral bas sel/ grib dang dam sel yin na/dbang bskur dang tshogs kyi 'khor gyis sel/ gang 'dzag dang nad gzhi yin na/dmigs pa dang 'khrul 'khor gyis sel yang gsung ngo / /'dir 'dzag bsrung bka' rgya ma'i dmigs pa sbyor rgyu yin na'ang/ bka' rgya ma yin pa'i phyir mang po'i tshogs pa'i nang du mi 'chad pa'i zur tsam smos pa de kas chog/de la thun gcig byed dam mi byed blo dang sbyar ro/ /yang slob ma gal che nyung ngu la dmigs pa de 'bogs nas/ de nyid dmigs skor bcu gsum par 'gyur ba yang shes par bya'o/ /yang dkyus ltar na/ gtum mo la gzhung tshig gi zin pa'i dmigs pa bdun yod/ rtsa tshig gis dngos su ma zin kyang gtum mo'i thon chos sam/ bde drod kyi bogs 'don khyad par can byin rlabs bla ma'i gtum mo 'di yin/ ces mtshams sbyar nas/ byin rlabs bla ma'i gtum mo/ skabs 'dir ston te/ de'i —240—

dmigs pa yang logs su shes par bya'o/ / de ltar na de rnams kyis ni rang lus thabs ldan gyi gtum mo rgyas par bstan pa yin la/ 'di'i yan lag tu gtum mo'i gzhung khrid kyi man ngag 'khrul 'khor rnams kyang lag len du 'debs pa shin tu gal che'o/ /gzhan lus shes rab kyi gtum mo'i skor ni man ngag rno la zab pa yod kyang re zhig gleng brjod med par 'jog /mkhas grub gzhon nu grub kyi zhal na re/ dpal ldan shangs pa'i bka' brgyud 'di rgya gar gyi rdo rje gdan pa dang / bod yul gyi sangs rgyas glang ri pa'i rnam thar skyong dgos/ gtsang sgom gyi brgyud 'dzin yin/ 'jol nyog gi brgyud 'dzin min gsung ngo / /gnyis pa sgyu lus chags sdang rang grol gyi gdams ngag la/ dbang po rab bla ma dam pa grogs su bsten pa/ dbang po 'bring tshig gzhan gyis bar ma mchod par khrid pa/ dbang po tha ma mal gcig tu ting nge 'dzin bskyed pa'o/ /dang po la/ mos gus bla ma'i lam khyer dang / cir snang bden med lam khyer gnyis so/ /dang po mos gus bla ma'i lam khyer ni/ dbang po rab kyi skabs 'dir sgyu lus kyi dmigs pa'i rkang chen gcig tu yang byed la/ spyir sgyu lus la sogs pa chos lnga po thams cad kyi dmigs pa'i gzhi ma yang 'di yin no/ /de yang 'di ltar skyabs 'gro sems bskyed nges par sngon du btang / dag byed stong ra sgom mi sgom nyams dang sbyar/ de nas rang gzhan thams cad la gzhig 'grel zhig bcug ste/ ga re/ lar 'dus byas thams cad la rtag pa'i go skabs med/ sgos su 'gro ba rigs drug gi sems can thams cad 'chi ba las —241—

ma 'das/ de yang myur 'chi dang nam 'chi cha med/ 'chi ba la dam pa'i chos ma yin pa cis kyang mi phan/ de phyin chad da ni zas gos longs spyod kha drag dbang thang gtam snyan mi snyan dgra 'dul gnyen skyong sogs gang gis kyang dgos pa mi 'dug/cis kyang phan pa mi 'dug/da phyin chad gang dga' ci dgar thong snyam pa dang / nam 'chi cha med dang / cis kyang dgos med kyi 'dun pa dung dung ba sbyangs/ de ka la cung zad ngal gso/ de nas rang skad cig gis yi dam lha gsal 'debs te/ de yang ni gu'i chos drug 'di rgyud sde thams cad kyi dgongs pa yin pas lhag pa'i lha gong du bsgoms kyang rung ba yin/ de'i nang nas kyang rgyud sde lnga'i don gyis bcud bsdus pa yin pas rgyud sde lnga'i dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo gang blo la 'thad pa cig tu bsgoms kyang legs mod/ mnyam med rin chen brtson 'grus man chad brgyud pa nas brgyud pa'i phyag len du/ bde mchog lhan skyes nyid du bsgom par mdzad pa nyid byin rlabs kyi rgyun dang ldan pa'i rim pa yin pas/ rang nyid skad cig gis 'khor lo bde mchog lhan skyes sku mdog sngon po/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pas yum la 'byud pa/zhabs g.yon bskums pas 'jigs byed nag po dang / g.yas brkyangs pas dus mtshan dmar mo mnan pa/ stags lpags kyi smad dkris/ thod skam gyi dbu rgyan/ thod rlon gyi do shal/ rus pa'i rgyan drug/thor tshugs la zla ba phyed pa dang sna tshogs rdo rje la sogs pas brgyan pa/ yum rdo rje phag mo dmar mo gri gug thod pa 'dzin pa dang mnyam par sbyor ba/ me dpung 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs par bsgom/ de yang dang por bsgrims te gsal btab/ de nas lnga sku —242—

snang stong tsam sgyu ma lta bu de la cung zad sems gtad de rig pa khong ltod kyis bzhag/de ma thag tu bla ma bsgom ste/ de yang rang gi rigs bdag gi tshul du spyi bo nyid du bsgom pa thob thang yin/ 'on kyang rnam pa mi bde na rang gi spyi bo'i steng gi nam mkha' drang thad la bsgom/ de yang rnam pa mi dod na mdun gyi phyogs steng gi nam mkha' la zhal tshur bstan pa bsgoms kyang rung ste/ gang ltar na'ang seng khri sna tshogs pad+ma nyi zla rnams brtsegs pa'i gdan la/ rang gi rtsa ba'i bla ma sku bkrag mdangs gzi brjid phun sum tshogs pa dang ldan par bsgoms te/ sgyu lus la sogs pa'i chos phyi ma lnga po rnams kyi skabs/ rdo rje 'chang du sgom na/ sku mdog sngon por byed/ 'on kyang lag len bla ma sku dngos nyid sgom par mdzad pa de ka gtso che'o/ /de nas dmigs pa spros pa'i dbang du byas nas/ rtsa ba'i bla ma'i thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ brgyud pa'i bla ma thams cad spyan drangs te rtsa ba'i bla ma la thim/ bla ma kun 'dus su gyur/ de bzhin du yi dam zhi khro rab 'khyams thams cad spyan drangs thim yi dam kun 'dus su gyur/ phyogs bcu dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas thams cad spyan drangs thim sangs rgyas kun 'dus su gyur/ lung rtogs kyi dam chos rnams yi ge'i gzugs kyi rnam par spyan drangs thim chos kun 'dus su gyur/ theg pa che chung gi 'phags pa'i dge 'dun thams cad spyan drangs thim dge 'dun kun 'dus su gyur/ mkha' 'gro chos skyong srung ma thams cad spyan drangs te rtsa ba'i bla ma'i sku la bstim chos skyong kun 'dus su gyur/ de ltar na rtsa ba'i bla ma nyid bla ma kun 'dus/ yi dam/ sangs rgyas chos/ dge 'dun/ chos skyong kun 'dus —243—

mtshan thos pa tsam gyis 'khor ba ngan song thams cad las sgrol bar mdzad na/gsol ba btab na lta smos kyang ci dgos snyam pa dang / gzhan yang sgo du ma nas mos gus drag tu bsgom/ de nas gsol ba 'debs dgos te/ rang gi tshe 'di'i dngos kyi pha ma dang / rang la gnod par byed pa'i dgra dang gdon bgegs rang nyid gang du gnas pa'i gzhi bdag rnams gtso bor gyur pa'i 'gro ba rigs drug gi sems can thams cang kyang gnas 'di nyid du 'dus te/ drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma dam pa la lus gus pas phyag dang bskor ba byed/ ngag gus pas gsol ba 'debs/ yid gus pas mos gus rtse gcig tu byed par bsam/ de nas rang gis gsol 'debs ngag tu gyer ba na 'gro ba rigs drug gi sems can thams cad kyis kyang ram bu btegs pa'i tshul gyis ku di ri ri gsol ba 'debs par bsam zhing / ngag tu/ dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad 'dus pa'i ngo bo bla ma rin po che/ sems can thams cad kyi don du/ bdag gis bdag 'dzin blos thongs par mdzad du gsol/ dgos med rgyud la skye bar mdzad du gsol/ sgyu lus 'byongs par mdzad du gsol/ rmi lam 'byongs par mdzad du gsol/'od gsal phyag rgya chen po mchog gi dngos grub da lta nyid du myur ba nyid du 'dug sa 'di nyid du thob par byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ ces mos gus drag ngo/ phar la thim phod dang / tshur la sim phod kyi tshul gyis gsol ba 'debs/ngam/gas/ pa rgya chen 'byung / bzhi pa rdo ri brag rtsi shing nags tshal snod bcud thams cad las gsol 'debs kyi sgra 'u ru ru 'byung bar bsam mo gsung / de ltar na/ mos gus gsol 'debs kho nas thun gyi dngos gzhi bskyangs te/ thun —244—

'jog khar bla ma 'od du ldem ste zhu/ rang 'a gnyis su med par thim/ de ka'i ngang la sems dus gsum gyi rnam rtog spangs nas lhod de bzhag/thun mtshams su 'dun pa gsum dang / ldan par bya bar bshad pa ltar ram/ yang na dbang por rab kyi skabs 'dir/ thun mtshams su yang 'dun pa gzhan gnyis do gal chung / bla ma'i mos gus rang dgos pa yin ces zhal nas gsung ba ltar/ re zhig spros pa gzhan spangs te mos gus kho na bsgom par bya'o/ /dmigs skor bcu gsum pa'o/ /gnyis pa cir snang bden med lam khyer ni/ dmigs pa snga gru ri da bsgoms pas ji zhig nas/ snang ba thams cad bden med bkrag med du bun long ba/ da lta'i mtho dman bzang ngan nye ring bden bden po 'di thams cad g.yas med du shig gis 'gro ba zhig 'byung / de yang blos phar la bden med du bsgoms pa'i shugs tsam ma yin par mos gus kyi stobs kyis khong nas rang shar du 'byung ba yin/ de ltar byung na skabs der sgyu ma lta bu'i nyams shar ba zhes bya ba yin pas/ de nyid du rang gzhan snod bcud snang ba thams cad la sems gtad nas/ ga re 'di thams cad snang ni snang / bden ni mi bden/ sgyu ma lta bu yin/ rmi lam lta bu yin snyam pa'i 'dun pa shugs cher bskyed/ de rjes sgyu ma/ lta bu'o bden par med do snyam pa'i blo de ka'i rang ngo la che re bltas pas/gang yang gzung du med pa zhig yong / de la lhod de mnyam par bzhag/gang shar de la bcas bcos mi bya'o/ /'di la nyams len gyi ngo bor sngar gyi mos gus bla ma'i lam khyer de ka'i ngang nas/ sgyu ma'i 'dun pa zhig lhag por snon pa ka yin/—245—

res bla ma 'od du zhu rang la bstim nas/ sgyu ma'i 'dun pa bsgom/ res bla ma mdun nam spyi bor bzhugs bzhin pa'i ngang nas sgyu ma'i 'dun pa bsgom pa gnyis po gang 'os 'os su bya/ dmigs skor bcu bzhi pa'o/ /de lta bu nyams su blangs kyang 'phral du dge sbyor ma skyes na/ mos gus rab kyi tshad du phyin pa ma byung bas lan/ dbang po rab tu ma chung / da gnyis pa dbang po 'bring tshig gzhan gyis bar ma chod par khrid pa la rang lus snang stong lha sku sgom pa dang / cir snang sgyu ma'i lam khyer gnyis yod/ dang po ni/ skyabs 'apra nas bla ma la gsol ba 'debs pa'i bar du dbang po rab kyi skabs ltar nyams su blangs/ thun gyi phyed tsam sum gnyis/ tsam bla ma'i gsol 'debs bya/de nas bla ma 'od du zhu nas rang la bstim/ bla ma dang rang sems dbyer med la cung zad mnyam par bzhag/der rnam rtog cig thol gyis skye tshad pa na/ rang gi lus sems la cher gyi bltas nas/ rang nyid lha skur gsal btang/ de la gzhig 'grel zhig btang ste/ ga re/ lha skur snang ba 'di yang rang gi sems kyi snang ba las gzhan phyi rol tu grub pa cung zad tsam yang med/ lha sku 'di kho na sems yin/ sems kho na lha sku 'dir snang ba yin snyam du 'dun pa drag tu sbyong ba 'di gnad gcig yin/ yang sems kyi ngo bor yang bden dngos su ma grub snang ba tsam ma gtogs phyi nang bar gsum gang na yang mi 'dug/ngo ti 'di 'dra zhig yin bya ba gcig kyang mi gda'/ /snang ni snang / bden ni mi bden/ sgyu ma lta bu'o/ /zhes 'dun pa drag tu spyong ba 'di gnad gnyis pa yin/ de nas sgyu ma lta bu'o snyam mkhan khong gi ngo bo la bltas pas 'dun pa de yang rang sar zhi/—246—

gang shar ngos bzung med pa la che re 'jog pa 'di gnad gsum pa'o/ /de ltar na gnad gsum dang ldan pa'i 'dun pa de nyid yang yang bsgom dgos/dmigs skor bco lnga pa'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ gnad gsum po de dag snang ba gzhan thams cad la rim gyi spo zhing sbyong ba yin te/ de yang rang lus snang stong lha sku'i dmigs pa de thog mar bsgoms nas/ de ma yal ba'i ngang nas thog mar rang gi gnas khang dang rdzas longs spyod thams cad la/ sems kyi snang ba las gzhan du med pa dang /sems de yang sgyu ma lta bu dang / sgyu mar 'dzin pa yang dbyings su yal ba'i rig pa rang shar gyi rang 'gros skyong ba la bslab/ de la goms nas rang dbang ba'i zas nor 'khor g.yog yul zhing sogs yod na de dag dang / chags sdang skye ba'i yul dgra gnyen la nges par sbyang / de la goms nas rim gyis snang ba thams cad la gnad gsum po de sbyar ro/ /thun mtshams thams cad du 'chi ba mi rtag pa'i 'dun pa dang / bla ma'i mos gus dang / snang ba gang shar bden med sgyu ma lta bur bsgom pa ste/ gsum po gang rung gcig dang ma bral bar bya'o/ /'di la 'dun pa gsum sbrags zer ro/ /de ltar na dmigs skor bcu drug pa'o/ /gsum pa dbang po tha ma mal gcig tu ting nge 'dzin skyed pa la/ sad pa bzhi dang bral ba cig dgos/ bzhi ni 'gro 'dug mang po dge sbyor gyi sad/'pho bskyas mang po dge sbyor gyi sad/ blo sna mang po dge sbyor gyi sad/ long gtam mang po dge spyor gyi sad/ de rnams spangs te bsgom dgos/ de la dbye —247—

na/ 'gro drug sgyu mar 'char byed/ nad gdon sgyu ma lam khyer/ 'char byed yon tan tshogs drug/zhen med sgyu ma rang shar ro/ /dang po 'gro drug sgyu mar 'char byed ni/ skyabs 'gro nas brtsams te bla ma la gsol 'debs kyi bar gong dang 'dra ba las/ thun gyi sum cha tsam thub pa byed gsung / de yang thems yig gi dngos bstan ltar na/ sgyu lus dbang po rab 'bring gnyis la gsol 'debs lnga/ dbang po tha ma la gsol 'debs bzhi zhes gsungs te/ de'i don ni/ rab 'bring gnyis las sgyu lus 'byongs par mdzad du gsol/ /rmi lam 'byor par mdzad du gsol/ /zhes so sor dbye ba dang / tha ma'i skabs su/ sgyu lus rmi lam 'byongs par mdzad du gsol zhing gcig tu bsdoms pas gsol 'debs bzhir gyur ba'i don yin kyang phyag len dang zhal gyi rgyun la/ dbang po rab 'bring tha ma gsum la de lta bu'i dbye ba mi dgos te/ gsum kha la gsol 'debs lnga byed pa dang / bzhi byed pa la khyad med gsung / de nas bla ma rang la thim pa'i rjes su rang gi lus lha sku'i rnam pa nang stong sang nge ba'i smad kyi cha la sems gtad pas/ der chos 'byung gru gsum kha dog dkar zhing gsal ba/ rtsa ba phra ba thur bstan de bshang sgo'i thad tsam nas mar la zug pa/ gdengs ka che ba gyen du bstan pa'i zur mdun ma de nye ba'i thad dang / zur gzhan gnyis mkhal khung g.yas g.yon gyi phyogs su bstan pa/ /dwangs gsal 'od kyi rang bzhin can gcig bsam/ de la sems gtad pas de'i nang du 'gro ba rigs drug gi sems can rnam pa sna tshogs pa rnams lus longs spyod/ mdog /dbyibs cha lugs cha byad rnams spyi tshul tha dad pa/ rang rang gi bde sdug myong —248—

tshul sna tshogs dang bcas pa rnams kyi chos 'byung gi nang khrig mer gyis gang bar bsam/ de yang rab rgyud la 'gro ba tha dad du skye ba len pa'i rgyu las nyon gyi bag chags thams cad rigs drug so so'i gzugs su shar ba yin snyam pa dang / lte 'og na rigs drug gi snang ba 'char ba'i rtsa yig yod pa rnams gzugs brnyan de dang der shar ba yin snyam pa'i mos pa yang cung zad bya/ de rjes de rnams nyid rigs drug dngos yin pa'i tshul du mos pa las sems kyi rtsi kha lte ba'i rigs drug la gtad cing / /spyir mkha' khyab kyi sems can thams cad dmigs yul du byas nas ga re 'di rnams snang ni snang / bden ni mi bden/ zhes bden med kyi bden med kyi 'dun pa drag tu sbyang / yang 'di rnams bden med la bden par gzung bas 'khor bar 'khyam pa snying re rje snyam snying rje brtse lhag pa bsgom/yang 'di rnams 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal las bla mas bskyab tu gsol/pha bla ma mkhyen snyam pa/ bla ma'i mos gus kyi gdung shugs dang 'brel bar gsol ba zhig kyang btab bo/ /de nas de rnams la sems cher gtad pa na/rigs drug gi sems can de dag gcig yal gnyis yal/ re re nas rim pas yal te/ mthar chos 'byung gi nang stong sang song ba la sems gtad/ de rjes nas lus dang chos 'byung la yal ba sogs kyi dmigs pa'i spro pa'ang mi dgos te/ gtad so thams cad dang bral ba'i 'dzin med la shig gi bzhag /yang de la ma gnas na rang gzhan snod bcud thams cad la dmigs te sgyu ma lta bu'o/ /med bzhin du snang ba'o/ /—249—

snang bzhin du ma grub pa'o shes par bya/ des dmigs pa tshar gcig song / de nyid yang yang bsgom pa'o/ /'di la dmigs pa gtad so'i gnad brgyad yod de/ chos 'byung la dmigs pa/ rigs drug la dmigs pa/ 'gro drug bden med du sbyang ba/ snying rje bskyed pa bla ma'i gsol 'debs/ rigs drug stong par sbyong ba/ rang babs skyong ba/ snang srid sgyu ma'i 'dun pa'o/ /lar dmigs pa zhig la 'di bas zab pa med ces gsung / thun mtshams kyi nyams len ni 'di la'ang 'dun pa sum sbrags kho na ste/ de yang dang po nyid nas 'dun pa gsum po gang rung cig sleb par bya snyam pa tsam gyi gar yang mi rung bas/ thog mar gang yang rung ba zhig thun mtshams su sleb pa'i thabs la 'bad/ tshul des gsum kha la re re bzhin du bslabs nas/ mthar gsum po gang rung re dang ma bral bar bya snyam pa'i 'dun pa btang na/ gang rung re dang ma bral bar yong ba yin/ dper na/ thog mar thun mtshams su 'chi ba mi rtag pa'i 'dun pa rtag tu sleb par bya snyam pa'i go cha gyon nas/thun mtshams su mi rtag pa gang dran thub thub bya/ tshul de lta bus thun mtshams su dran pa'i bya ra bas gzhur na zla ba gcig gam gnyis tsam na thun mtshams phal cher du mi rtag pa'i 'dun pas sleb 'ong / de byung na re zhig de bor nas tshul de kas bla ma'i mos gus la bslab/ de yang byung ba na/ yang re zhig de gnyis ka bor nas sgyu ma'i 'dun pa la tshul de kas bslab/ de yang thun mtshams phal cher du byung na/ de rjes gsum po ga rung zhig dang ma bral ba'i —250—

'dun pa tsam btang bas/ gsum po gang rung re dang ma bral bar yong ba yin no/ /dmigs skor bcu bdun pa'o/ /gnyis pa nad gdon sgyu ma lam khyer la/ khrid yig gsum dang zur 'debs rnying pa rnams na/ don 'dra yang rnam grangs nges med la don tshang ma tshang yang ci rigs 'dug na'ang nges tig can 'di yin te/ nad lam du khyer na/na bar snang ba 'di yang / las ngan sdig sgrib sbyong ba dang / dge spyor gyi bskul ma yin pas mtshan ldan bla ma'i thugs rje'i 'jug pa yin/ sku drin re che snyam nga/ byas nas/ nad bla ma'i rang bzhin du mos/ gsol ba drag tu btang/ mthar bla ma dang nad dang / rang sems gsum dbyer med du che re mnyam par bzhag /lugs gcig go /yang na bar snang ba 'di 'khrul ba yin gnas chul lan pa dang na mkhan yod ma myong / med bzhin du na bar snang ba rmi lam du na ba dang 'dra snyam/ na ba'i thog de khar sgyu ma rmi lam gyi dran 'dun drag tu bya/ mthar na bar snang bar rang sems su shes/ de la'ang gtad so med pa sgyu ma lta bu la mnyam par bzhag/lugs gnyis pa yin yang na bar snang ba 'di sgyu ma lta bu med bzhin du snang ba yin/ snang ba 'di blos gang byas yin snyam pas steng rlung drag tu mnan/ lte ba'i chos 'byung gi nang nas mar nad rnams song / chos 'byung gi tshig ma je ring je ring la sa 'og thag ring por song zhing / nad kyang de'i nang nas mar song ba/ gnyis kar 'og tu 'ja' ltar yal bsam/ lugs gsum pa ste 'di sngon chad zhal shes yin/ de ltar nad lam khyer gsum mo/ /gdon lam khyer la yang gsum ste/ gdon gyi gnod pa dge sbyor gyi bskul mar shes —251—

nas/ bla ma'i thugs rje yin pa dang / bla ma la gsol ba 'debs pa dang / bla ma dang / gnod byed dang / rang sems gsum po rang bzhin gsal stong du ro mnyam pa'i ngang bskyang ngo / /yang na gnod par byed pa po'i 'dre gdod yang med bzhin du snang / snang bzhin du ma grub/ de bzhin du gnod pa'i bya ba nyer 'tshe sdug bsngal dang / gnod pa 'byung ba'i yul rang nyid lta bu sems can de yang med bzhin du snang / snang bzhin du ma grub/ sgyu ma lta bu yin/ rmi lam lta bu yin/ 'di la bden par 'dzin pa re 'khrul snyam du 'dun pa drag tu sbyangs pa'i mthar/ gnod byed du snang ba ngam ngam pa de ka'i ngo bo bltas te cher 'jog go /yang na chos 'byung dang 'gro ba drug sogs gong bzhin bsgoms la/gnod byed du snang ba de mdun du dmigs/ sgyu ma lta bu'i 'dun pa'i rtsis zin pa'i ngang nas/ rlung nang du 'jug pa dang lhan cig gdon de yang sna sgo nas bcug ste/ lte ba'i chos 'byung gi nang du sleb/ chos 'byung shin tu yangs por song / rlung bzung ste dkrugs 'khor byas pas/ chos 'byung gi kha 'ubs kyis 'dus pas 'bros sa med/ gnod byed de yang rigs drug gi gnas thams cad du 'khyams pas/ so so'i sdug bsngal mthong zhing myong / las 'bras la yid ches/ gnod sems zhi/ byang chub kyi sems dang ldan par bsam/ slar yang rlung phyir bsal ba na/ gnod byed de sna sgo nas rgyangs te thon/ thag rje ring rje ring la yal bar bsam pa'am/ yang na lan chags sel ba'i gtor ma byin te gshegs su gsol/ 'di la nang sel dmigs pa drug yod kyang / dmigs —252—

chen gcig tu brtsi ba'am gnyis su brtsi'ang yod/ 'dir gcig tu bsdoms te/dmigs skor bco brgyad pa'o/ /gsum pa 'char byed yod tan tshogs drug ni/ sgyu lus dbang po tha ma'i dmigs pa bsgoms pa'i gnas skabs kyi phan yon bshad nga/ ste/ 'di la dmigs pa logs pa med/ de yang drod skye ba dang gcig/thig le brtan pa dang gnyis/ rmi lam sbyong spel dang gsum/ 'gro drug gi yul snang dang bzhi sems can smin grol dang lnga/ sgyu ma rang shar dang drug go /dang po ni/ lte ba dang dbu ma'i mas sna gtum mo'i rtsa yig yod sa'i gnas la gnad du bsnun pa yin pas drod rang shugs la skye'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ dbu ma'i mas snar sems gtad pas song bas/ rlung yang der 'gag/des rtsa kha sdom/ thig le zin cing brtan par 'gyur ro/ /gsum pa ni/ /dbu ma'i mas sna rtsa mdud gru gsum gyi nang du rigs drug gi rtsa yig yod pas/ de la gnad du bsnun par song ba'i phyir/ rmi lam du yang rigs drug gi gzugs brnyan dang / yul phyogs sna tshogs pa'i rnam pa can gyi sbyong spel sprul bsgyur dus gcig tu 'byung ngo / /bzhi pa ni/rigs drug gi rtsa khams la rlung sems kyis gnad du bsnun pa yin pas/rigs drug go gnas lkog gyur rnams mthong ba'i yul snang gtan la 'bebs thub bo/ /lnga pa ni/ mkha' khyab kyi sems can thams cad la stong nyid snying rje bla ma'i mos gus gsum gyi sgo nas rang gzhan mnyam nyid du bsgoms pa yin pas sems can smin grol nus pa'o/ /drug pa ni/ lte ba sprul pa'i 'khor lo ni gnyid —253—

sad dus kyi 'khrul ba 'char ba'i gzhi yang yin/ de la gnad du bsnun nas sad dus kyi 'khrul ba dag byed sgyu lus kyi rtogs pa rang shar du 'byung ba'i nus pa yod pa'ang yin pa las de la gnad du bsnun pa yin pas/ sgyu lus kyi rtogs pa zhes bya ba rtog bral gyi lha sku snang ba rab 'byams sgyu ma lta bu rang shar du yong ba'o/ /bzhi pa zhen med sgyu ma rang shar ni/ dbang po tha ma kho na'i khyad chos ma yin te/ spyir sgyu lus kyi rtogs pa tshad du phyin pa'i rtags bshad pa'o/ /de yang sgyu lus bsgoms pas da lta nas chags sdang mtho dman gyi a 'thas 'di je chung du song nas/ mthar bde sdug chags sdang thams cad yul stongs te/ rang gi g.yas nas mi gcig gis bstod pa la dga' ba med/ g.yon nas gcig shos kyis smad pa la mi dga' ba med/ rang ngam rang phyogs la gtam snyan pa dang /nom pa sogs thob pa la dga' ba med/ gtam mi snyan pa dang yo byad shor ba la mi dga' ba med pa de'i tshe/ sgyu lus kyi nyams rtogs la brtan pa thob pa yin/ ji skad du/ tsan dan ste'u mtshungs pa la/ /chags bral zhes ni brjod pa yin/ /ces bshad pa lta bu'o/ /phyi ma 'di gnyis la dmigs skor brtsi rgyu med/chos thun ni gcig gam gnyis ji ltar 'os pa'o/ /gsum pa rmi lam nying 'khrul rang dag gi khrid la/ rmi lam bzung ba/ sbyang ba/ sprul pa bsgyur ba/ yul snang gtan la dbab pa ste drug go /dang po rmi lam bzung ba la/ rang zin thig le dbang bzhi'i gnad kyi gdams pa dang / de la ma zin na gnad 'chug med dgu la brten pa'o/ /dang po ni/ 'di rmi lam 'dzin pa'i dmigs pa'i rtsa ba gal che shos yin te/ de la bla ma'i rnal 'byor ni/ dmigs pa spyi khog thams cad sgyu —254—

lus kyi skabs dang mtshungs/ khyad par mi 'dra ba ni/ dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad 'dus pa'i ngo bo bla ma rin po che/ sems can thams cad kyi don du bdag gis bdag 'dzin blos thongs par mdzad du gsol/ dgos med rgyud la skye bar mdzad du gsol/ rmi lam zin par mdzad du gsol/ ces gsol 'debs kyi mtha' bsgyur ba kho na yin/ 'dir ma zad gzhan thams cad la yang 'dra ste/ gsol 'debs kyi tshig dang po gnyis thams cad mtshungs shing / tshig rkang gsum pa mtha' bsgyur ba kho na'o/ /de ltar thun gyi sum cha tsam bla ma'i rnal 'byor bsgoms nas/ bla ma 'od du zhu/ rang la thim/ rang lus lha sku gsal stong du shar ba'i lus kyi dbus su rtsa dbu ma kha dog dkar ba dwangs gsal shel gyi sbubs lta bu/ yar sna spyi bo dang / mar sna gsang bar zug pa/dbu ma'i nang gi yas snar ha dkar bo mgo bo thur du blta ba dang / mas snar hu dmar po mgo bo gyen du blta ba zhig gsal btab/ gang shar la spyir bden med dang / sgos su rmi lam du shes pa'i rtsis bzung nas bsgom pa zhig thams cad du gal che/ spyi bo'i ha las thig le dkar po sran ma tsam zhig hril gyis chad/ snying gar sleb/ nyon mongs pa gti mug dag/snying ga yan chad khog stod yang chod pa'am/ bde chod kyis song bar bsam/ gsang ba'i hu las thig le dmar po sran rdog tsam zhig yar chad snying gar sleb/ nyon mongs pa 'dod chags dag /sked man chad khog smad yang chod pa'am/ bde chos kyi song /dkar dmar gnyis po snying gar 'dzom/ zhe sdang ni rang dag la song / snying ga'i thad bde sang ba dang / yang chod kyis song bar bsam/ de nas dbu ma'i nang —255—

snying ga'i thad kyi khong stong der/ thig le gnyis po 'bros 'ded kyi tshul du 'khor ba la sems gtad/ 'khor tshul g.yas skor dang g.yon skor rang gi blo la gang bde yin/ de la sems gtad de/ rmi lam rang yin snyam pa'i 'dun pa'i gsum bzhi zhig bya/ de nas thig le gnyis po gcig rjes gcig gis zin pa'i tshul gyis reg tsam reg tsam 'dug kyang 'khor ba la sems gtad/ rmi lam yin snyam 'dun pa drag tu sbyang / de rjes yang sngar bzhin las/ reg pa la brten nas lus sems bde chil chil yong bar mos/ de la'ang sgyu ma'i 'dun pa sbyang / de nas dkar po dmar pa la thim dkar po yal ba'am/ de go ldog kyang rung ste/ gang ltar yang gcig la gcig shos thim/ de yang gtad yal du song bar bsam/ de ka'i ngang la ci yang mi bsam par cung zad bzhag/de nas rang gzhan snang ba thams cad la sems gtad de/ 'di thams cad snang ni snang /bden ni mi bden snyam pa dang / khyad par du yang nga gnyid du song 'dug/snang ba 'di thams cad rmi lam rang yin pa 'dug snyam pa'i 'dun pa drag tu sbyong ste/dmigs pa tshar gcig song / yang rtsa dbu ma gsal 'debs pa sogs yang nas yang du kho na bskyar gyin bsgom/ thun mtshams su yang sgyu ma'i 'dun pa'i dod du rmi lam gyi 'dun pa bcug nas/'dun pa gsum sbrags bya ste/ mi rtag pa dang / mos gus dang / rmi lam gyi 'dun pa ste gsum mo/ rmi lam 'dun pa'i gnad bya ba yin pas 'gro 'chag nyal 'dug zas za ba gtam smra ba mdor na spyod lam thams cad du nga gnyid du song 'dug rmi lam rmi bar 'dug/rmi lam rang yin ang snyam pa rgyun chags su —256—

byung na/ rmi lam zin pa la tshegs med pas 'di rang gal che'o/ /de ltar bsgoms pas myur du rmi lam zin par 'gyur ro/ /yang las 'brel chung ba 'ga' la nyin par bstar chags su bsgoms kyang 'phral du ma zin par 'gor na yang zla ba gcig gam/ zla ba phyed dang gnyis tsam gyi bar du zin du re ba dang / ma zin gyi dogs pa'i rtsis btab mi byed par ci dgar bsgyur/ 'dun pa drag tu byed pa gal che/ spyir sngon gyi nā ro chos drug pa rnams/ dbang po rab tu gyur pa la/ lo yis zin par dag kyang srid zer/ lo gcig tsam bsgoms na rmi lam zin pa la brtan pa thob/ /ces 'dod par 'dug/chos 'di'i lugs kyis dben pa'i gnas su grib kyis ma phog/long gtam dang ma 'dres/ nges 'byung skyo shas dang bcas par bsgoms na/ zhag bdun nam bcu tshun la 'go tho re ba zin yong / de nas ma 'byams ma dred zhud kyis 'byer bar bsgoms na/ zla ba gsum mam bzhi tshun chod la rmi lam zin cing brtan pa thob par 'ong ngo lar ma bsgoms pas kyang rmi lam na re zin pa 'ong ste/ de 'dra stes dbang tsam yin gtad pa cang med/ yang dang por bsgom ma thag rang du zin pa'ang yod de/rkyen gsar ngas kyis zin pa zer/ rjes la mi yong / de 'dras zin pa'i go mi chod/ rgyun 'thud mi thub/ 'dir dmigs pa'i stobs kyis zin pa dang / 'dun pa'i stobs kyis zin pa cig dgos/ de 'dras zin na 'di lan gcig zin pa'i rjes su nyams len ma bshol na gong 'phel du song nas bstar chags su zin yong ba la dka' las med pa yin no/ /dmigs skor bcu dgu pa'o/ /gnyis pa gnad 'chug med dgu la brten pa ni/ dmigs pa snga ma'i —257—

sbogs chog yin te/ spyir ni rang zin thig le dbang bzhi'i gnad nyid shin tu zab pas/ de kas rmi lam zin dgos kyang dgos 'ong yang 'ong / spogs chog 'di dag dgos pa cher mi 'ong / ci ste na/ dmigs pa snga ma 'bad pas bsgoms kyang zla shas ma zin na/ bogs 'don 'di rnams rim gyis bya ste/ de la gnad 'chug med dgu zhes bya ba/ dus kyi gnad gsum/ tho rangs/ nam langs/ nyi ma rtse shar ro lus kyi gnad gsum ni/ skyil krung/ tsog pu/ seng ge'i nyal stabs gsum mo/ /dmigs pa'i gnad gsum ni/ rtog med la bzung ba gnyis dang / rtog bcas lam du khyer ba'o/ /de ltar dgu las/skabs 'dir dmigs pa'i gnad gsum mo/ /de la dang po rtog med la bzung ba dmigs pa'i gnad rgya bskyed pa ni/ dbu ma yi ge gnyis dang bcas pa gsal 'debs pa sngar bzhin/ de rjes rlung ro bsal/ steng rlung nang du rngubs pa dang lhan cig ha las thig le dkar po chad te snying gar sleb/ 'og rlung yar 'then pas hu las thig le dmar po chad de snying gar sleb/ rlung kha sbyor du bzung skabs/ thig le gnyis po snying gar 'khor ba la sems gtad/ rmi lam gyi 'dun pa bya/ bum dbang ngo / /de rjes rlung phyir bsal ba'i dus thig le dkar po sna bug g.yas dang / dmar po g.yon nas thon te/ smin mtshams su 'khor ba la sems gtad de/ rmi lam gyi 'dun pa drag tu bya/ gsang dbang ngo / /thig le de gnyis rang gi mdun thad du babs te/ dkar po dpal 'khor lo sdom pa yab dang / dmar po rdo rje phag mor gyur/ kha sbyor lhan cig skyes pa'i skur gyur pa la sems gtad de rmi lam gyi 'dun pa drag tu bya/ shes rab ye —258—

shes kyi dbang ngo / /yum yab la thim/ de yang mkha' dbyings su yal kyi bar bsams te/ mi rtog pa la mnyam par bzhag/dbang bzhi pa'o/ /de las langs pa na rmi lam gyi 'dun pa drag tu sbyangs/ de nyid yang yang bskyar gyin bsgom/thun mtshams kyi spyod lam sngar dang 'dra/ tshan mo nyal khar mdun gyi lhan skyes yab yum dbyings su yal ba de ka'i ngang der rnam rtog gzhan gyis bar ma chod par gnyid du 'gro bar bya/ bar skabs su gnyid sad na/ dmigs pa de yongs rdog tshar re bsgom thub na legs/ ma thub na rmi lam gyi 'dun pa re bya'o/ /nam smad gnyid kyi lhag ma cung zad re yod pa'i skabs der gnyid sangs te/ lus gnad bcas/ sngar gyi dmigs pa de la 'dun pa drag po dang bcas nas bsgom/de rjes dus gnad gsum po gang rung gcig gi dus su slebs pa dag /lus gnad gsum po gang drag zhig bcas te/ dmigs pa sngar gyi de ka rim can du bsgoms nas/ mthar thams cad yal ba'i ngang la rnam rtog gzhan gyis bar ma chod pa'i ngang nas gnyid du 'gro bar la/ sngar nas dmigs pa gong ma'ang zin thig le de bsgoms pa'i goms shugs che bar yod/ lan gcig po de ka la zin 'ong / goms shugs ha cang che ba med kyang zhag 'ga' re bskyar na zin 'ong ngo / /dmigs skor nyi shu pa'o/ /yang na dmigs pa'i gzhi mdor bsdus pa la bslab te/ bla ma'i rnal 'byor sngar bzhin bsgom/ rang gi snying gar bla ma sku dngos sam/ rdo rje 'chang dkar po/ de'i thugs kar hūṃ yig dkar po 'od kyi rang bzhin can zhig bsgom/bla ma la mos gus dang rmi lam gyi 'dun pa gnyis ldan du bsgoms te yid kyis —259—

gsol ba btab/ hūṃ las 'od 'phros snang ba thams cad khyab/ rmi lam yin snyam pa bya/ snang ba thams cad 'od du zhu nas rang la thim/ bum dbang ngo / /rang yid dam du gsal ba la rmi lam gyi dran 'dun bya/ bla ma 'od du zhu nas hūṃ la thim/ sher dbang ngo / /de la'ang rmi lam gyi dran 'dun bya/ bla ma 'od du zhu nas hūṃ la thim/ sher dbang ngo / /de nas hūṃ yang 'ja' ltar yal bar bsams la/ de ka'i ngang bskyang / dbang bzhi pa'o/ /de las rmi lam gyi 'dun pa drag tu sbyangs/ yang de nyid bskyar gyin thun grangs dang thun tshad med par bsgom pa yin te/ lag len de ltar bsgom dgos so/ /'jag bsam gnyis kar gyi khrid yig las/ phyi snod bcud rang la bsdu ba mi gsal ba dang / nyin mo'i dmigs pa la 'od gsal du bsdu ba yang mi gsal ba ni/ lag len cung zad sbas pa yin la/ mkhas grub gzhon nu grub ni/ 'od gsal bzung ba'i skabs dmigs pa bzhin rim pas spro bar yang bzhed do/ /de gnyis la rtog med la bzung ba zhes tha snyad mdzad pa'i rgyu mtshan dngos su las la sbyor ba'i skabs/ dmigs pa bsdus nas gnyid du 'gro ba'i bar la/ rnam rtog gzhan gyi bar ma chod pa/ bsam med du gnas pa zhig dgos pa'i don yin no/ /dmigs skor nyer gcig pa'o/ /gnyis pa rtog bcas lam khyer ni/ sngon 'gro sngar dang 'dra ba las/rang gi mgrin pa'i rtsa 'dab bzhi/ pad+ma dmar po 'dab ma bzhi par gyur pa'i lte bar oṃ dmar po de'i 'od dmar pos mgrin pa'i phyogs thams cad khyab par bsgom/ rlung bum can nam 'jam rlung bzung ste/ nyin phyed yan lag cis kyang — —260—

do nub rmi lam zin par bya/ rmi lam la rmi lam du ngo shes par bya/ zhes 'dun pa drag po btang / nyin phyed man chad la nga gnyid du song 'dug/snang ba 'di rmi lam yin par 'dug snyam pa'i 'dun pa drag tu bya srod thun la da ni myur du rmi lam 'ong bas 'di nyid du ngo shes par byed dgos snyam pa'i 'dun pa gtong / de yang da lta'i sad dus kyi snang ba rags pa 'di nus gnyid 'thug po rang du ma song ba'i bar der/ gnyid dang snang ba'i bar gyi rnam rtog ces bya ba/ rna bar sgra tsi rong ba'am/ lus sdid pa snyam dang / thib thib non pa'am/ smin mtshams su sbring sbring pa dang dbugs thum thum pa lta bu'i nyams kyi rjes su/ mi khyi la sogs pa'i 'gro ba dang / khang khyim dang / lam kha la sogs pa'i rnam pa srib tsam srib tsam 'ong ba/ 'og 'gyu las ni gsal/ rmi lam dngos las cung mi gsal ba'i snang cha srab srib tsam 'byung ba de la gnyid dang snang ba'i bar gyi rnam rtog zer ba yin/ skabs 'dir de rmi lam du ngo shes par byed dgos snyam du 'dun pa drag tu sbyang / gnas skabs de gsum la 'dun pa bsgyur ba ma gtogs dmigs pa 'dra/ dus gnad gsum du lus gnad gsum bcas nas 'dzin tshul yang gong dang 'dra mod/ dmigs pa'i yul stong par bsdus nas 'jog pa de mi byed pas/ o yig la sems gtod cing / da lta rang gnyid dang snang ba'i bar gyi rnam rtog yong ba 'di ngos 'dzin dgos snyam pa'i 'dun pa'i shugs ha cang drag pa min tsam bsten pa'i sgo nas gnyid du 'gro bar bya/ der gnyid dang snang ba'i bar gyi rnam rtog byung na/ 'di ka rmi lam yin snyam pa'i 'dun pa bag tsam btang ste/—261—

thur sel cung zad bskum gsung / 'on kyang bcas bcom mang na gnyid dengs 'gro bas 'dun pa bag tsam gyi ngang nas gnyid du 'gro bar bya/ gnyid dang snang ba'i bar gyi rnam rtog ngos 'dzin cing / de yang 'dun pa rtog bcas kyis 'dzin pas rtog bcas la ma khyer ces bya'o/ /'di rmi lam mi zin pa mi srid pa'i gdams pa'o gsung / 'dir 'jag bsam gser gling pa gsum kar gyi khrid yig las/ mgrin pa'i oṃ gyi bshad pa zur tsam mdzad nas chams te bzhag/nyin par gyi dmigs pa sngar gyi dmigs pa de ka bsgom gsung rtog med gnyis la kha 'phangs tshul mdzad pa dang / 'jag chen gyis/ yang na dmigs pa gnyis kyi bogs 'don du/ de gnyis rang mi sgom par rmi lam gyi 'dun pa spyi ldog de sbyong bar gsungs pa rnams kyis man ngag zhal shes la ltos pa'i dbang du mdzad pa'o/ /dmigs skor nyer gnyis pa'o/ /gnyis pa rmi lam sbyong ba ni/ rmi lam zin pa la brten pa thob nas rmi lam sbyong ba dgos pa yin te/ de yang rmi lam 'dzin pas dmigs pa bor nas/sbyong ba kho na la bsgril ba'i dbang du byas pa yin/ 'dzin pa'i dmigs pa ma dor bar bstar chags su sgom gyin yod na/ nub re bzhin rmi lam lan re bzhin zin yong ba'i mtshams nas sbyong ba'i dmigs pa yang bsgoms te/'dzin sbyong phyogs gcig tu byas pas chog go /de la bzhi ste/ lus kyis sems sbyang ba/ sems kyis lus sbyang ba/ bdag med mas sbyang ba/ 'dun pas sbyang ba'o/ /de la dang po ni/ bla ma'i rnal 'byor yan chad rmi lam bzung ba'i skabs dang 'dra ba las/ rmi lam 'byongs par mdzad du gsol zhes 'don pa —262—

bsgyur/ de nas dmigs pa dngos ni/ rang nyid gnas pa'i 'og na/ brag phyams lta bu g.yang sa shin tu che bar zhig 'dug par bsam/ rang nyid kyang g.yang sa de'i kha mtshams mda' gang tsam gyi steng gi nam mkha' la 'dug par bsam/ de nas mar bltas pas yang ting gis 'byung / de tsa na nga gnyid du song 'dug/snang ba 'di rmi lam gyi snang bar 'dug/rmi lam gyi snang ba la skrag rgyu ci yod snyam ste/ chad kyis lhungs su bcug/sa la tob ter ma lhungs tsam la/ de nyid du yal bar bsam pa'am/ yang na yar la ye re re 'phur nas 'ongs te/ /g.yang gi khar sngar bzhin 'dug par mos/ tshul de lta bu yang yang sbyong /dmigs pa 'di la rang yi dam du gsal ba dang / tha mal gyi rnam pas sbyong ba gnyis kas rung bas nges med du bsgom/ yang g.yang sa'i rtser lus gcig bzhag nas/ de las 'od kyi thag pa dang 'bral ba'i lus gcig 'bab 'dzeg byed par yang bshad de/ zhal khrid la 'di mi gsung / dmigs skor nyer gsum pa'o/ /gnyis pa sems kyis lus sbyong ba ni/ sngon 'gro gong dang 'dra/ rang yi dam gyi sku gsal ba'i sgo dgu ru hu yig sngon po 'od kyi rang bzhin chen po re dang / ba sbu'i bu ga thams cad du hu sngon po 'od 'tsher ba phra mo dpag tu med pas go mtshams med par khyab/ hū thams cad mgo bo nang du lta ba'o/ /rmi lam gyi 'dun pa drag tu sbyang / hu thams cad las 'od zer sngon po dwangs gsal 'od kyi thag pa btang ba bzhin du sngo ta la la lus kyi nang du 'phros/ 'od rnams 'dus 'dus shing 'dus te gcig tu 'dres/ lus kyi phyi nang kyang g.yogs/—263—

lha'i rnam pa 'dal te thams cad 'od kyi gong bu gcig tu song / yang rmi lam gyi 'dun pa drag tu sbyang / 'od kyi gong bu de mtha' nas rim gyis yal/ je phra je phra la khu tshur tsam/ mthe bong tsam/ sran chung tsam/ yungs 'bru tsam/ mthar de yang mi dmigs par sbyangs te/ sems rtog med la mnyam par bzhag/yang rnam rtog skyes na rmi lam gyi 'dun pa drag tu sbyang ngo / /dmigs skor nyer bzhi pa'o/ /gsum pa bdag med mas sbyong ba ni/ gzhan sngar ltar las/ dngos gzhi ni rang 'khor lo sdom pa yab rkyang du gsal ba'i mdun du rdo rje bdag med ma/ sku mdog sngon mo gri gug thod khrag kha ṭu 'dzin pa/ lang tsho dang bde ba rgyas pa zhig bsgom/ sku de che na mda' gang khru gang tsam/ chung na sor bzhi'am mthe bong tsam/ de dag gi bar gang bde yin/ de'i gsang bar oṃ ā swāhā/ zhes bya ba'i sngags kyi yig 'bru gsal bar bsgom/ rmi lam gyi dran 'dun drag po'i ngang nas/ sngags de lan nyer gcig sogs ci rigs par bzlas pas/ de las 'od zer sngon po sngo tal gyis byung / rang he ru kar gsal ba'i sku la phog pas/ rang nyid lha sku sngar las kyang sngo zhing dwangs pa/ gsal ba zhig tu song /lus thams cad bde bas khyab par bsam/ yang rmi lam gyi 'dun pa dang bcas nas/ bdag med ma'i sku la sems gtad pas/ bdag med ma de nyid 'od zer sngon po nyams bde ba dang ldan pa zhig tu ltem gyis zhu/ rang nyid he ru ka'i skur gsal ba'i gsang ba'i sgo nas zhugs 'od des sku lus kyi nang thams cad khyab/sngar las kyang sngo zhing dwangs la gsal bar song / lus sems thams cad bde bas gang bar mos/ de nyid je dwangs je dwangs la nam mkha' la 'dres shing thim —264—

par bsam/ der cung zad bzhag ste/ yang rmi lam gyi 'dun pa drag tu sbyong ba sogs sngar bzhin dmigs pa 'di la mkhas grub rgyal mtshan 'bum ni rang gi dbang po'i rtse la hū bsgom gsung ba yod kyang / zhal khrid la de mi mdzad/ su kha'i 'dres shor ram gsung ngo / /dmigs skor nyer lnga pa'o/ /bzhi pa 'dun pas sbyang ba ni/ bla ma'i rnal 'byor yan chad sngon 'gro sngar bzhin/ 'di la ni dmigs pa'i gzhi gcig tu nges pa med de/ 'dun pa kho nas rtsal nges med du sbyong bas na 'dun pas sbyong ba'o/ /de yang nga'i lus na tsha sdug bsngal skyed par byed pa de mal na yod par 'dug/snang ba 'di rmi lam gyi snang ba yin/ lus 'di yang rmi lam gyi yid lus yin/ rmi lam gyi snang ba dang / yid kyi lus la ci sbyangs sbyangs su 'gro ba yin snyam pa'i 'dun pa drag po rgyun chags su byas nas/ rang gi mdun na 'dug pa'i ka ba gyang rtsig pa thog phub sogs la yar thal mar thal phar thal tshur thal thogs med du sbyang / gzhan yang dkar khung phra mo la 'dzul pa sogs dang /g.yang sa dang / chu dang / me dang / gcan gzan sogs la thog brdzis su byed pa dang / nam mkha' la 'phur ba dang / sa la 'dzul ba dang / chu'i steng nas 'chag pa sogs mdor na ci dran gyi tshul gyis sbyangs pas chog pa las/ khyad par du rnam rtog choms dka' ba'i rigs 'dzin chags kyi dngos po dang /'jigs skrag dang / ya nga dang / ngo tsha dang / skyug bro skye ba'i rigs rnams la/res 'ga' thug phrad thog brdzis bya/ res 'ga' sgyu ma rmi lam gyi 'dun pas bza' gtad med par bya/ res 'ga' nyam nga med par ldog sgom bya/ res —265—

'ga' skad cig gcig la thogs med du bcom mo/ /dmigs skor nyer drug pa'o/ /lus kyis sems sbyong ba rmi lam rtsal sbyong yin/ sems kyis lus sbyong ba 'od gsal dang bsre ba yin pas phrugs gcig tshar/ bdag med mas sbyong ba 'od gsal dang bsre ba yin/ 'dun pas sbyong ba rtsal sbyong yin pas rmi lam sbyong tshul gnad phrugs gcig de la tshang bas/ gang zag gcig gis de gnyis gang rung re bsgom par bya'o/ /gsum pa rmi lam spel pa la/ thug phrad du spel ba dang / gang 'dul du spel ba gnyis/ dang po la yang 'byung bzhi phra rags la spel ba dang / sems can phra rags la spel ba gnyis/ dang po ni/ sngon 'gro sngar dang 'dra ba las/ rmi lam spel nus par byin gyi rlobs zhes mtha' bsgyur la gsol ba btab/ de nad dper mtshon na/ rang gi mdun du sa'i gong bu zhig mthong gin 'dug na/ nga gnyid du song 'dug /'di rmi lam gyi sa yin par 'dug /ci spel bar der 'gro snyam nas/ gnyis su spel snyam tsa na gnyis su song / de bzhin du thog ma re zhig gsum nas bcu la sogs pa'i bar du spel/yang rim pas bsdus pas rtsa ba'i gcig pur song / mthar rim pas bslabs shing sbyangs pas/ gang 'dod 'dod du spel yang nus rtsa ba'i sa gcig pa la bsdu bar yang nus pa 'byung ngo / /de yang nyin par dmigs pa 'di yang yang bsgoms pas/ mtshan mo rmi lam zin/ spel ba'i dmigs pa 'di dran nas bsgoms kyang / kha cig la thog mar spel ba dang / bsdu ba mi 'byung ba yang yod de/ yang 'dun pa drag pos bsgoms na/ zhag shas nas cung zad spel thub par —266—

'ong / de nas rim pas je bzang du 'gro/ 'ga' zhig la thog ma nyid nas spel nus pa'ang yong / 'dir ma zad sprul bsgyur la de dang 'dra/ dang po sa'i gong bu lta bu zhig la goms par byas nas/ spro bsdu thub pa na/ de nas gzhan la'ang rim gyis bslab ste/ sa khams rags pa ri lta bu nas/ phra ba rde'u'am sa rdul gyi bar la bslab/ chu khams rags pa chu bo dang / mtsho la sogs pa nas phra ba chu thigs kyi bar la bslab/ me khams rags pa med dpung chen po nas phra ba me stag gi bar la bslab/ rlung khams rags pa rlung 'tshub chen po nas/ phra ba srog chags phra mo'i dbugs 'gyu ba tshun chad la'ang bslab/ 'dir 'byung bzhi zhes pa bem chos sems med thams cad la zer ba yin te/ phyi snod kyis bsdus pa thams cad la sbyong ba yin/ dmigs skor nyer bdun pa'o/ /gnyis pa sems can phra rags la sbyang ba ste/ sngon 'gro gong dang 'dra/rang gi mdun du thug phrad du mi lta bu zhig mthong na/ nga gnyid du song 'dug/'di rmi lam gyi snang ba'i mir 'dug /ci spel spel yin snyam pa dang / gcig gnyis gsum nas bcu'i bar du spel zhing / gong bzhin bsdu ba sogs bya/des mtshon pa'i rta glang sogs sems can dngos su mthong ba thams cad la bslab ste/ rags pa rta glang la sogs pa nas phra ba 'bu srin phra mo'i bar la bslab bo/ /dmigs skor nyer brgyad pa'o/ /gnyis pa gang 'dul la bslab pa la/ 'jig rten pa'i gang 'dul dang /'jig rten las 'das pa'i gang 'dul gnyis/ dang po 'jig rten pa'i gang 'dul du spel ba ni/ gtso bor srog chags kyi gzugs la sbyong ba yin/ me chu —267—

sogs sems med la yang sbyong ni sbyong ba yin te me'i gnyen por chu spel sprul byed pa lta bu'o/ /dper na/ mdun du byi ba lta bu zhig mthong na/ 'di rmi lam gyi byi ba yin/ 'di la 'dul byed cig spel dgos snyam pa byas te/ der byi la zhig byung / des byi ba de btul bar bsam/ de nas ci spel spel yin snyam pas/ byi la mang por spel nas 'dul ba'i dmigs pa byed pa'o/ /de bzhin du bye'u la khra lta bu dang / khyi la spyang ki /gcan gzan gzhan la stag dang / stag la seng ge dang / seng ge la me dpung / me la chu/ mi la srin po sogs la yang sbyar bar bya'o/ /dmigs skor nyer dgu pa'o/ /gnyis pa 'jig rten las 'das pa'i gang 'dul du spel ba ni/ rang ngam gzhan la gdon gyi gnod byed yod na/ rang gi mdun du khro ba'i rgyal bo gcig byung nas/ des gnod byed kyi gdon de zhags pas 'ching ba dang /zhabs kyi gnon pa dang / mtshon chas btub pa dang / me ris sreg pa dang /sngags kyis sgra drag po bsgrags pas skrag nas dran med du brgyal bar byed pa sogs thabs sna tshogs kyis slar ldang thes med par bcom par bsam yang khro bo de lta bu mang por spel bas kyang 'dul bar bsam/ de la ye shes khro bo gang gis kyang /gdon rigs thams cad 'dul bar nus mod de/ gtso che ba'i gang 'dul gyi dbang du byas na/ rgyal po dang btsan 'dul ba la rta mgrin/ steng gdon la phyag na rdo rje/ sa bdag klu gnyan spyi la bya khyung / klu srin la 'jam dpal nā rak+ṣa/ bdud kyi bar chad la mi g.yo ba/ rbod gtong la gtsug gtor —268—

—'khor los bsgyur ba/ gdon spyi la 'jam dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed bsngags zhes gsung ngo / /dmigs skor sum cu pa'o/ /bzhi pa rmi lam sprul pa'i gdams ngag la/ thug phrad du sprul pa dang /gang 'dul du sprul pa gnyis/ dang po thug phrad du sprul pa la dbye na/ 'byung bzhi phra rags su sprul pa dang / sems can phra rags su sprul pa gnyis so/ /dang po ni/ sngon 'gro'i skabs rmi lam sprul nus par byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ces mtha' bsgyur nas gzhan gong dang 'dra/ rang gi mdun du sa'i gong bu lta bu zhig mthong na/nga gnyid du song 'dug/sar snang ba 'di rmi lam gyi sar 'dug/ nga rang yang 'di dang 'dra bar sa'i gong bur sprul dgos snyam 'dun pa btang zhing / de ma thag tu rang nyid sa'i gong bu de 'dra ba zhig tu song / rmi lam rang yin snyam du cung zad bsgoms/ yang de 'phro bcad nas gzhan la mig gtad yengs su bcug ste/ rmi lam gyi 'dun pa drag po bya/ de lta bu yang yang bskyar zlos byed kyin bsgom mo/ /des mtshon nas 'byung bzhi phra rags gzhan thams cad la yang sbyar te/ dmigs skor so gcig pa'o/ /gnyis pa sems can phra rags su sprul pa yang snga ma rnams kyis rigs 'gre/ rang gi mdun du mi gcig mthong na/ e ma 'di rmi lam gyi mir 'dug/bdag kyang 'di lta bu gcig tu sprul dgos snyam pa bya/ de ma thag rang nyid kyang de 'dra bar song bar bsam/ rmi lam gyi 'dun pa bcas te cung zad sems bzung / yang 'phro bcad de rmi lam yin snyam pa byed/ de lta bu la bskor ldog —269—

bya'o/ /srog chags gzhan la sbyor tshul yang gong dang 'dra/ dmigs skor so gnyis pa'o/ /gnyis pa gang 'dul du sprul pa la/ 'jig rten pa dang 'jig rten las 'das pa gnyis yod/ dang po ni/ gzhan sngar dang 'dra ba las/ rang gi mdun du byi ba lta bu zhig mthong na/ 'di rmi lam gyi byi bar 'dug/'di 'dul dgos de la bdag byi lar sprul par bya snyam pas/ rang nyid de ma thag byi lar song byi ba de lhag med du bcom par bsam/ des gzhan rnams la yang rigs 'gre/dmigs skor so gsum pa'o/ /gnyis pa 'jig rten 'das pa'i gang 'dul ni/ rang ngam gzhan gyi don du bdag nyid rtog dpyad yod/ pa'i 'dre gdon de mdun du 'dug par bsam/'di rmi lam gyi 'dre gdon yin/ 'dul dgos snyam du rang skad cig gis khro bo chen por gyur nas/ zhags pas 'ching ba dang / bcom brdeg byed pa sogs gong bzhin 'dul thabs byas pas lhag ma tsam yang med par brlag par byas/rmi lam rang yin ang / dngos por grub pa ni cung zad kyang med snyam pa bya/ de ltar yang yang bskyar ro/ /gzhan gong spel ba'i skabs bzhin no/ /de la spel ba ni mdun du yod pa de spel ba yin / sprul pa ni rang nyid sprul pa yin te/ de yang phal cher la spel ba ni cung zad sla zhing de las sprul pa cung zad dka' bas/spel ba sngon dang / sprul pa rjes su bstan pa yin no/ /der ma zad 'jig rten 'das pa'i gang 'dul gyi skabs/ thog ma dmigs pa ma 'byongs pa'i dus na/rmi lam rang du rang nyid sprul thub kyang pha rol po de mi thul ba la/ khro bo zhig —270—

mdun du byon nas btul na thul ba zhig 'ong / de'i rgyu mtshan rang la mi tha mal dang gces 'dzin gyis bag yod pas/ rang pham dogs kyi nyam nga yod/ mdun gyi lha la de lta bu med pa'i rgyu mtshan gyis yin gsung / dmigs skor so bzhi pa'o/ /lnga pa rmi lam bsgyur ba'i gdams ngag la/ 'byung bzhi phra rags su bsgyur ba/ sems can phra rags su bsgyur ba/ lha sku sna tshogs su bsgyur ba/snang stong zhen bral du bsgyur ba ste bzhi las/ dang po ni/ rmi lam bsgyur nus par byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ ces mtha' bsgyur/ gzhan sngon 'gro la khyad med/ phyi ma gsum la'ang des rigs 'gre/ rang gi mdun du bum pa lta bu zhig 'dug na/ nga gnyid du song bar gda'/ bum par snang ba 'di yang rmi lam du gda'/ rmi lam gyi bum pa la gang byas byas yin ci bsgyur bsgyur yin snyam pa'i 'dun pa shugs drag pos bum pa 'di me thab tu bsgyur dgos snyam tsa na me thab tu song / de ka bar bsgyur snyam pa na ka bar song / de dag la sogs pa gang dran dran du ngo bo tshad dbyibs grangs kha dog nges med du bsgyur/ de ltar bum pa lta bu zhig sna tshogs su bsgyur thub na/ sa chu me rlung sa rdo ri brag rtsi shing nags tshal sogs phan tshun rnam pa sna tshogs su bsgyur tshul zad pa med pa la bslab bo/ /dmigs skor so lnga pa'o/ /gnyis pa sems can phra rags su bsgyur ba yang des rigs 'gre/ rang gi mdun du mi lta bu zhig mthong na/ 'di rmi lam gyi mi yin/ ci bsgyur bsgyur yin/ gang bsams bsams yin snyam pas de rta ru bsgyur snyam tsa na rta ru song /—271 —

de yang glang po cher bsgyur/ de yang ba glang rnga mong la sogs par bsgyur/ de yang mi dang dud 'gro srog chags nang phan tshun rnam pa sna tshogs par bsgyur ro/ /'byung bzhi dang sems can du bsgyur ba'i skabs 'di dag tu kha dog ma nges pa/dbyibs ma nges pa/ tshad ma nges pa/ grangs ma nges pa sna tshogs par bsgyur ba'ang dgos so/ /dmigs skor so drug pa'o/ /gsum pa lha sku sna tshogs su bsgyur ba ni/ g.yin rnams sngar dang 'dra ba las/ bden med dang rmi lam gyi 'dun pa drag po'i ngang nas/ rang nyid bde mchog lhan skyes kyi sku gsal por bsgom/ ga re nga gnyid du song 'dug/lha skur snang ba 'di yang rmi lam du 'dug/gang bsgyur ba der 'gro snyam pas/ rang nyid bde mchog de dgyes mdzad du bsgyur dgos snyam pa na/ dgyes mdzad su song /de yang gsang 'dus su/ de mahā mā ya sa /de rdo rje 'jigs byed du bsgyur ba sogs yi dam lha'i ngo bo sna tshogs su bsgyur/ de bzhin du lha gcig kyang sku mdog ma nges pa sna tshogs su bsgyur te/ dkar po sngon po dang / de dmar por bsgyur ba la sogs pa dang / de bzhin du zhal phyag ma nges pa sna tshogs su bsgyur te/ zhal phyag mang po khun ngur bsgyur ba dang / nyung ngu mang por bsgyur ba dang / /gdong brnyan sogs sna tshogs par bsgyur ba'o/ /dmigs skor so bdun pa'o/ /bzhi pa snang stong zhen bral du bsgyur ba ni/ lha sku sna tsho gos su bsgyur ba sngon du btang / de yang rtsa ba'i lha sku rgya cher spel/ spel ba thams cad sna tshogs su bsgyur/ de thams cad sgyu ma lta bu rmi lam lta bu'i 'dun pa drag tu sbyang / yang —272—

lha skur snang ba dang / snang mkhan gyi sems la char re bltas pas/ sgyu ma sgyu 'dzin dang bral/ de ka'i ngang der gang yang mi dmigs pa'i 'od gsal phyag rgya chen por rang shugs su 'byung/ yang de lta bu'i ngang nas rtsa ba'i lha skur skyed pa sogs gong bzhin yang yang sbyang / de ltar sbyangs pas mtshan mo rmi lam gyi dus su lha sku mang nyung ci rigs la de ltar bsgom pa 'byung / de nas je mang la 'gro/mthar rmi lam du lha sku nam mkha' khengs pa gcig gis gcig ma bsgribs pa/de thams cad kyang bde la zhen pa med pa/ gsal la rtog pa med pa/ snang la rang bzhin med pa ste/ mtshan nyid gsum ldan du 'char/ de'i tshe rmi lam nying 'khrul rang dag gi dge sbyor klungs su phebs pa yin no/ /de yang sgyu ma zhes pa ni/ sad dus dang rmi lam du bden med kyi 'dun pa sbyangs pa de'i shugs kyis a 'thas med par yul le/ mtho dman med par mnyam khad de shar ba de la zer/ sgyu mar 'dzin pa dang bral ba zhes pa ni/ 'di kun 'khrul snang du shar ba tsam las gtad pa rang ci yod snyam pa'i blo zhig yod pa de yang dbyibs su yal de dgag sgrub kyi 'dzin pa dang bral ba de yin/ skabs der gang yang mi rtog bzhin du nyams myong gi ro bde bar shar ba de 'od gsal yin/ de ka la phyag rgya chen po zer te/ sems kyi gnas lugs yin pas so/ /yang de ka'i ngang nas lha sku gsal stong rang du byung ba de la yang phyag rgya chen po zhes bya'o/ /bde la zhe pa med pa ni/ rmi lam du lha sku rang shar ba'i dus/ lus sems gnyis ka la bde nyams lam me shar yang nga rgyal rlom sems med cing / bde ba de la yang sred pa med pas/ bde ba byung ma byung la dga' mi dga' med pa zhig 'ong / gsal la —273—

rtog pa med pa ni/ lha sku'i rnam pa shin tu gsal bar snang yang de rang shar yin te/ rnam rtog gi rtsol ba med pa'o/ /snang ba rang bzhin med pa ni/ snang yang bden pas stong zer ba'i spyi skad de yang 'dir 'jug pa tsam yin mod de/ 'on kyang 'dir ni lus sems dang / gzugs sgra dri ro reg bya'i snang ba cig car shar ba de/ rig par rang gsal gcig po'i ngor mnyam khad de shar ba ma gtogs/ snang ba so so rnams la dngos po tha dad gang yang med par nyams su myong ba'o/ /dmigs skor so brgyad pa'o/ /rmi lam gyi skabs 'di dag tu/ 'byams gcod kyi man ngag dag kyang gal che ste/ 'byams gcod rgyas pa ni logs su bstan pa ltar yin pas khrid kyi dkyus la mi 'chad cing / 'byams gcod nyer mkho zhal shes mar grags pa ni gzhan du gsal lo/ /drug pa yul snang gtan la dbab pa la/ dbang po rab dmigs med gsal mkhyen/ 'bring gang bsams gsal mthong tha ma yid lus mkha' lding / dman pa dmigs pa'i yul snang ste bzhi yod pa las/ dang po dmigs med gsal mkhyen ni/ sbyor ba'i skabs su 'bad rtsol med kyang /lkog gyur gyi don thams cad nyin mo sad dus dang / mtshan mo rmi lam gyi skabs thams cad du mthong ba'o/ /'bring gang bsam gsal mthong ni/ nyin mo 'dun pa gang gtad pa de thams cad mtshan mo rtsol med rang shar du mthong ba'o/ /tha ma yid lus mkha' lding ni/ sngon 'gro gzhan 'dra ba la/ yul snang gtan la phebs par mdzad du gsol/ zhes mtha' bsgyur nas gsol ba btab/dmigs pa dngos ni/ bdag do nub sangs rgyas kyi zhing 'di lta bu lta ba 'am/—274—

lkog gyur 'di lta bu blta bar bya/ zhes 'dun pa drag tu btang / de nas rmi lam dngos yin snyam pas rang nyid yi dam gyi skur gsal ba de nyid dam/ lus kyi rnam pa gzhan du sprul kyang rung ste/ nam mkha' la yer gyis 'phur bas gnas der phyin ci dgos don rnams mthong bar bsam pas/ mtshan mo rmi lam du'ang de ltar 'byung ba'o/ /'dir yid lus mkha'i lding zhes pas mkha' lding ni/ nam mkha' la 'phur 'gro ba'i don tsam ka yin na'ang la la dag mkha' lding bya khyung lta bur sprul nas 'gro ba'i don du 'chad pa'ang yod do/ /dmigs skor so dgu pa'o/ /bzhi pa dman pa dmigs pa'i yul snang gi gdams ngag la gsum ste/bdag med ma yul snang gsal byed/ a yul snang gsal byed/ thig le yul snang gsal byed do/ /dang po ni/ sngon 'gro snga ma dang 'dra/ rang gi lte ba'i 'og tu 'od kyi rang bzhin gyi thod pa phyi dkar la nang dmar ba/ de'i nang du oṃ a swāhā/ kha dog sngon po 'od zer sna tshogs 'phro ba'o/ /de las 'od zer 'phros/chos 'byung dang rang lus gang / ba sbu'i bu ga nas 'phros/ phyi snod kyi 'jig rten gzhal yas khang / nang bcud kyi sems can yi dam du bsam/ 'od zer gyi rtse mo las mchod pa dang ga tu med pa sprul/ gdod nas bzhugs pa dang gsar du song ba'i yi dam lha tshogs thams cad mchod par bsam/ gzugs su snang tshad lha sku/ sgra grags tshad sngags/ dran rigs thams cad sgyu ma rmi lam du dran par bya/ yang 'od zer tshur 'dus te/ lte ba'i sngags kyi yig 'bru la thim/ de nyid rje btsun rdo rje bdag med ma'i skur gyur/ sngags kyi sgra di ri ri 'dug/mchod pa —275—

phul/ yul snang gtan la phebs par mdzad du gsol/ ces gsol ba btang/nyin par gyi dmigs pa zhal khrid nges can 'di yin/ gzhan 'jag lugs la sngags las 'od zer lan mang po spros pas/ bdag med mas dbu byas pa'i yi dam sna tshogs byung / gnyis pa spros pas mchod pa 'bul/ snga ma sna bug g.yas dang / rting ma g.yon nas spro bsam sdings pa/ lte bar thod pa'i nang du bdag med ma/ de'i lte bar thod pa'i nang du sngags bsgom/ 'od zer spro thengs gcig ka yin te/ sna bug g.yas nas byed/ lus gnyis kar la 'od zer tshur bsdu ba med do/ /'od zer sngags la bsdus te/ lhar bskyed pa 'di/ gser gling pa'i khrid yig la snang ngo / /mtshan mo nyal kha'i dmigs pa ni/ sngar gyi dmigs pa de tshar gcig bsgoms pa'i jis la/ mchod pa bzhi rdzogs su phul/ yi dam gyi lha khyed kyis do nub kyi gnas skabs su bdag gis/ sangs rgyas kyi zhing dpag tu med pa mthong ba dang / mchod pa rgya chen po 'grub par mdzad du gsol/ ces pa dang / 'dod don dmigs bsal phra mo yod na/ de dang de mthong bar mdzad du gsol/ ces kyang bya/ de nas bdag med ma zhal tshur bstan te/ thugs ka'i thad —ka shin tu dwangs pa la gang ltar bar 'dod pa'i yul de me long la gzugs brnyan shar ba ltar khra sal le mthong bar bsam/ des rmi lam gyi dus su yul snang gtan la phabs so/ /thod pa'i tshab tu chos 'byung bsgom kyang rung gsung ngo / /dmigs skor bzhi bcu pa'o/ /gnyis pa thig le yul snang gsal byed ni/ sngon 'gro sngar ltar la/ rang lhar gsal ba'i lus kyi dbus su/ rtsa dbu ma kha dog dkar po dwangs gsal —276—

'od kyi rang bzhin sbom phra sba lcag tsam pa/ yas snar ha dkar po mgo bo thur bstan/ mas snar hu dmar sngo mgo gyen bstan/ lte bar a thung dmar po yang gyen bstan no/ /rlung ro bsal steng rlung rngubs pas ho las thig le dkar po sran rdog tsam chad nas snying gar sleb/ 'og rlung bskum pas hu las thig le dmar sngo sran 'bru tsam yang chad/ lto ba zhom slog gis byas pas/ a las thig le shin tu dmar pa sran ma phyed tsam pa zhig yar chad/ de gnyis kyang snying gar sleb/ thig le gsum po gcig ru 'dres/ dkar la dmar pa yid tsam sngo ba'i mdangs chags pa gcig tu song / de 'od mer re 'dug nga la cung zad sem sa gtad/ yul snang blta bar bya snyam pa'i 'dun pa dang lhan cig rlung phyir bsal bas snying ga'i thig le la 'od zer dkar dmar thag pa'am sbrul 'dra rung zhig rgyangs te byung nas sna bug g.yon nas thon/ gang blta bar 'dod pa'i gnas der song / 'od des mun khung du sgron me btegs pa ltar yul de khra gsal gyis mthong ba'am/ yang na 'od zer de sbubs stong lta bur byas/ de'i nang nas bltas pas mthong bar bsgom kyang rung gsungs/ dmigs pa 'di'i rlung gnad dang thig le dmar sngo de zhal shes yin/ dmigs skor zhe gcig pa'o/ /gsum pa a yig yul snang gsal byed ni/ sngon 'gro dang rtsa dbu ma sngar bzhin bsgom/ dbu ma'i nang lte bar a dkar po dwangs gsal 'od kyi rang bzhin can bsgom/ rmi lam gyi 'dun pa dang bcas bum can 'jam rlung cung zad bsgom/ de mtshams nas a las 'od zer dkar po'i thag pa rgyangs te spros/ rtsa dbu ma la thogs med du song sna bug nas thon te gang blta 'dod pa'i —277—

phyogs der song nas mun khung du sgron me bteg pa ltar khra gsal gyi mthong ba'am/ 'od kyi skru gu nas lta ba gang rung bya'o/ /dmigs skor zhe gnyis pa'o/ /dman pa yul snang gi dmigs pa gsum po 'di/ gang zag gcig gis gsum gang bsgoms dgos par rang ma yin/ gang rung re res kyang chog pas don la snga phyi'i go rim med/ tshogs su 'chad pa'i skabs/ bshad pa'i go rim la/ khrid yig rnying pa gsum na thog mar bdag med ma/ de nas a yul snang gsal byed dang / de rjes thig le yul snang gsal byed bshad yod kyang /'ang/ra phyi ma gnyis go rim bsnor ma ni/ dmigs pa rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum gyi rim pa'i dbang du byas pa'o/ /gsang 'dus rim lnga'i gdams ngag sogs su/ spel sprul bsgyur gsum/ sbyong ba'i nang tshan du byas kyang / chos 'dir sbyong ba las logs su byed pa mi 'gal te/ sbyong ba zhes pa'i ngos 'dzin la mi 'dra ba'i khyad yod pa'i rgyu mtshan gyis yin no/ /de yang gzhan de dag tu ni/ rmi lam gyi rtsal spyod thams cad la sbyong ba zer bar 'dug/'dir ni rmi lam zin pa'i rjes su sna tshogs su bsgyur ba'i rtsal ma skyes pa skyed par byed pa'i thabs kyi nang sel gcig la sbyong ba dang / de nyid gong nas gong du spel ba la/ 'byongs nas spel sprul bsgyur gsum byed ces pa'o/ /yul snang lta ba ni/ rmi lam gyi rnam thar du grags pa/ yon tan skyes pa'i rtags ston pa tsam yin no/ /yang man ngag gzhan las bzung ba sbyong ba gcig tu byed pa zhes 'gyung ba'i phyi ma ni/rmi lam 'od gsal sogs su bsre ba la zer/ 'dir sems kyis lus sbyang ba dang / bdag med mas sbyang ba dang / bsgyur ba phyi ma gnyis la sogs —278—

pa'o/ /des na rmi lam gyi gdams ngag la/ dang por rmi lam la rmi lam du ngo ma shes na/ chos tshan 'di'i dge sbyor gyi rtsa ba stongs pas/ thog mar rmi lam rmi tshad zin pa zhig dgos/ don de la 'dzin pa'i gdams ngag ston/ de nas rtsal phyogs med du 'byongs pa zhig dgos pa la/ rmi lam nyid kyi snang ba la dbang 'byor pa'i phyir/ sbyong ba snga phyi gnyis dang / spel ba dang / sprul pa dang /bsgyur ba dang po gnyis dang / yul snang rnams byung ba yin/ rmi lam nyid du mchog gi dge sbyor dngos gzhi skyes pa la/ rmi lam 'od gsal du 'jug pa dang /rmi lam lha sku rang shar du 'jug pa gnyis yod pa las/ dang po ni sbyang ba bar pa gnyis yin/ phyi ma ni lha sku sna tshogs dang snang stong zhen bral du bsgyur ba'o/ /de ltar shes na mkhas rlom kha cig ni gu'i chos drug rmi lam gyi gdams ngag ma yang gnad chung zer ba'i bab bcol gyi smra ba de dag 'brel med byung rgyal gyi tshig tu go bar 'gyur ro/ /chos drug 'di'i dbu zhabs kyi gdams ngag thams cad las dang po pa nyid la mchog tu phan pa 'phral du rtags thon thon pa kho na yin gyi/ las dang po pa la phan pa ci yang med pa'i bshad pa mtho mtho mo la gdams ngag tu rlom pa de 'dra gtan ma yin cing / yang blun po rang bzo'i chos gzhung la brten pa'i legs bshad kyang med/ man ngag la brten pa'i lag len yang med pa'i 'ad lud shab shob rnams dang ni ye mi 'dra bar yang nges shes 'drongs so/ /bzhi pa 'od gsal gti mug rang sangs kyi khrid la/ sngon 'gro/ dngos gzhi/ rjes kyi khrid gsum bdog/dang po la rtsa ba mi rtag skyo shas/ yal ga spyod —279—

lam dam rdzas/ lo 'dab thabs lam rang mdangs/ gsol 'debs me tog 'char byed de bzhi las/ dang po rtsa ba mi rtag skyo shas ni/ nges par 'chi ba dang /nam 'chi cha med pa dang / 'gro drug khams gsum 'khor ba thams cad sdug bsngal du shes pas cis kyang / dgos med kyi blo drag tu bsgom/ snga nas mi rtag pa'i khrid ma bskyangs na smos ci dgos/ bskyangs pa tsho yang skabs 'dir mi rtag pa'i khrid bskyar nas bsgom dgos/ spyir chos kyi bskul ma 'chi ba mi rtag skyo shas shas cher bsgoms pas shes pa dwangs shing grung ba zhig 'byung / des shugs brtas te gnyid kyi dus na'ang / rig pa dwangs pa zhig 'byung / des kyang 'od gsal zin bla/ yang skyo shas can de rig pa la lcag chug gzeg thon pas gnyid 'thug po'i skabs kyang dran pa 'byung sla ste/ dper na/ nyin mo rig pa la sgrin chug pa'i dogs pa yod na mtshan mo gnyid chung bar 'gro bas mtshon no/ /de ltar na/ ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro mas kyang / /'chi ba rgyud skyes 'od gsal 'char/ /zhes gsung /gnyis pa yal ga spyod lam dam rdzas la/ spyod lam ni/ ji skad du/spyod lam dal la kha zas snum/ /rngul thon las rnams spang bar bya/ /zhes 'byung ba ltar/ nad pa'i spyod lam bzhin du bya ba byed dgos rnams bus byed/ kha zas snum pa ste/ lus la 'phrod pa mang nyung ran par bsten/ mchong rgyug dang rtsal 'gran dang 'dzing kha dang gzhu 'gengs sogs rtsa rlung 'khrugs par 'gyur pa dang rdzus thon pa'i spyod lam spang gsung / dam rdzas ni spyir tshogs dang gtor ma bzang du bshams te 'bul/ mkha' 'gro sde lnga la gtor ma phul/ myur mdzad —280—

ye shes kyi mgon po la yang gtor ma phul nas gsol ba 'debs/ gtor ma 'bul ba'i skabs/ gu gul dang / mahā ma sa'i 'dug spos gtong zhes gsung /gsum pa lo 'dab thabs lam rang mdangs ni/ sngar gtum mo'i rnal 'byor la goms pa yin na/ rgyun gyi rnal 'byor la bsgoms pa de kas go chod pa yin pas logs pa mi dgos/ de man 'jam rlung bum pa can zla re tsam sbyong ba sngon du 'gro bar byed/ 'od gsal dngos gzhi'i dmigs pa bsgom skabs kyang snga dro'am/ phyi dro gang 'thad re la ngal dub du mi 'gyur ba tsam gyi rlung thun re bsgom par bya'o/ /rlung gi rnal 'byor gyis khams dwangs snyigs phyed/ dwangs ma'i mdangs las 'od gsal 'char ba yin pas/ rtsa rlung bsgom pa gnad du che/ spyir chos drug gi ya gyal 'od gsal ni/ gnyid kyi 'od gsal gtso bor 'chad pa'i skabs yin pas/ gtum mo dang 'od gsal zhes so sor bgrangs pa yin gyi/ gzhan du na nyin mo'i 'od gsal skyed pa'i thabs kyi mchog cig gtum mo 'di yin/ ril 'dzin rjes zhig sad sud dang / phra thig than thun ga las kyang 'di stobs che'o/ /bzhi pa gsol 'debs me tog 'char byed ni ji skad du/ /'od gsal 'char byed bla ma'i mos gus dang / /zhes gsungs pa ltar 'od gsal 'char ba la bla ma'i mos gus gal che/ 'o na bla ma'i mos gus ni sgom thams cad la gal che yi/ 'od gsal kho na gal che bar smos pa ci yin snyam na/ spyir bla ma'i mos gus kyi rten 'brel 'grig pa zhig kun la dgos kyang / nyin bar gyi dge sbyor rngams rang gi rtsol bas kyang bsgom du btub la/ rmi lam gyi skabs yin na yang —281—

rmi lam nyid kyi snang ba sna tshogs dang / dran rtog gi blo rags pa 'di yod cing /de yod pas nyin mo'i bag chags rmi lam du khrid pa'i phyir/ rang gi rtsol ba dang 'dun pas sleb rgyu zhig kyang yod pa'i phyir byin rlabs kho na la ltos pa rang yang min/ gnyid 'thug po'i dus na dran rtsol med pa'i phyir/ gnyid kyi 'od gsal 'di ni/ skabs de nyid du rang shar du byung na ma gtogs/ gzhan bsgom thes med pa'i phyir/ lus la gnad du bsnun pa'i rten 'brel dang / bla ma dang lhag pa'i lha'i byin rlabs 'jom pa la re ba yin no/ /de ltar sngon 'gro bzhi po de la sngar ma bstan pa'i dmigs pa gsar ba rkang tshugs med pas/ dmigs skor logs su mi 'dren/ chos thun gcig la rdzogs pa'am/ gnyis sam gsum sogs gang ltar byas kyang 'dra'o/ /gnyis pa dngos gzhi la/ 'od gsal gzung ba dang / lam khyer dang /bsre ba dang / mthar thug ste sa bcad bzhi'o/ /dang po la/ bdag med ma la brten te 'od gsal 'dzin pa/ a yig la brten te 'od gsal 'dzin pa/ bla ma la brten te 'od gsal 'dzin pa ste gsum mo/ /dang po ni/ thun gyi sngon 'gro byings de sgyu lus kyi skabs su bshad pa dang 'dra ba las/ khyad par ni rtsa ba'i bla ma sku dngos su bsgom na yang / cha byad ral pa'i thor tshugs dang / rus pa'i rgyan drug dang / stag lpags kyi smad dkris sogs dur khrod kyi chas dang ldan pa zhig bsgom/ ci ste rdo rje 'chang du sgom na yang / rdo rje 'chang he ru ka zhi ma khro spyan gsum pa/ sku la dur khrod kyi chas brgyad rdzogs pa zhig bsgom/ gsol 'debs kyi skabs su/ /'od gsal zin par mdzod du gsol/ ces mtha' —282—

bsgyur ba'o/ /de rjes su re zhig rang tha mal du gsal ba lta ba'i klad rgya'i steng thod pa'i 'og/spyi bo'i thad der pad+ma dang nyi ma'i gdan sran ma phyed bkas tsam/de'i steng du gdan de ka dang 'tshams pa'i rdo rje bdag med ma sku mdog sngon mo gri gug thod pa kha ṭāX bsnams pa/ zhabs g.yon brkyang ba'i gar stabs can sku chung la yan lag dod pa gsal btang/ de'i thugs kar yang a dkar po spu shad kyis bris pa ltar phra ba gsal la 'tsher ba zhig bsgom de las 'od zer 'phros/ thog mar klad pa gti mug gi rang bzhin can de sbyangs/ de nas lus kyi nang gang bas sha khrag rus gsum yang dag ste/ lus 'od lus su gyur par bsam/ de yang yi dam gyi skur bsgoms na ka bzang gsung pas dpal sdom pa lhan skyes su ka bsgom/ der bdag med ma'i thugs ka'i a yig la sems gtad te cung zad bsgom/ de nas a de las 'od zer 'phros/ bdag med ma'i sku gang / de las 'od zer 'phros/ rang lus kyi nang thams cad mun khung du sgron me btegs pa ltar khra gsal gyis song yang rang gi ba sbu'i khung bu nas phar 'phros/ snang ba thams cad khra gsal gyis gsal bar bsam/ tshul de kho nas yang thog mar thugs ka'i a la sems gtod pa dang / yang 'od zer spro ba sogs spel gyin bsgom pa las/ thugs ka'i a la sems gtod pa yun ring du bya/ de 'dra lan 'ga' re song ba'i mtshams su/ shes pa rang babs su ltod kyis glod nas gang gnas re bzhag/de lta bu bskyar gyin rtag tu bsgom/ thog ma zhag mang por rtsol ba skyed de de ltar bsgoms pas/ skabs 'gar bde sal le ba rnam rtog med par rang shugs su gnas pa yang dum re 'ong steng re dogs su —283—

ma song ba byed/ de 'dra byung na de ka la gang gnas su bzhag pas chog/yang de sangs pa na sngar bzhin 'dun pa drag pos bsgom/ mtshan mo nyal ba'i skabs bdag med ma'i thugs ka'i a la sems gtad de gnyid du 'gro bar bya'o/ /dmigs skor bzhi bcu zhe gsum pa'o/ /gnyis pa a yig la brten pa ni/ sngon 'gro snga ma dang 'dra/ rang yi dam du gsal ba'i lus kyi dbus su rtsa dbu ma dkar po sba lcag tsam gsal btab/de'i nang lte ba'i thad dam lte 'og sor bzhi gang rung du a yig dkar po dwangs gsal 'od kyi rang bzhin can zhig gsal btab/ a yig de la dar gcig sems bzung / a las 'od zer 'phros/ dbu ma'i nang khengs/ de las 'od zer 'phros/ rang lus kyi nang shin tu gsal bar byas/ rang gi ba sbu'i bu ga nas 'od zer 'phros/ snang ba thams cad khra gsal gyis khyab/ nyal ba'i tshe lte 'og gi a la sems gtod/ gzhan ji ltar nyams su len lugs rnams snga ma dang 'dra/ dmigs skor zhe bzhi pa'o/ /gsum pa bla ma la brten te bzung ba ni/ yang sngon 'gro snga ma ltar btang la/ rang lhag pa'i lhar gsal ba'i snying gar pad+ma dang zla ba'i gdan la/ rang gi rtsa ba'i bla ma rdo rje 'chang du sgom na rdo rje 'chang sku mdog dkar po spyi dang 'dra ba dang / sku dngos su bsgom na yang / sku sha mdangs dkar zhing 'od zer dkar po 'phro ba/ zhal 'dzum mul le/ spyan sim me bzhugs pa zhig bsgom/ sku che chung gi tshad kyang che na sor bzhi tsam/ chung na mthe bong gi tshad tsam/ de'i bar ji ltar 'os pa bsgom/ de'i thugs kar thig le dkar la dmar ba'i mdangs —284—

chags pa'am/ shin tu dkar ba gang bsgoms kyang rung / tshad kyang bla ma'i sku la cha dpags nas bya ste/ sku gzugs sor bzhi tsam bsgom na de rgya sran tsam/ sku mthe bong tsam bsgom na/ de sran chung tsam bsgom/ des bar ma rnams la'ang mtshon/ gang ltar na yang bla ma'i thugs ka'i thig le 'od 'phro ba de la sems gtad de cung zad mnyam par bzhag/thugs ka'i thig le las 'od 'phros/ sku khra gsal te khyab/ thugs rgyud bde bas gang / sku'i cha thams cad nas 'od zer byung / rang lus kyi nang shin tu gsal bar khyab/ rang gi ba sbu'i khung bu nas 'od zer 'phros/ snang ba thams cad khra gsal gyis pa bar bsam bla ma'i thugs ka'i thig le la 'khyang tsam sems gtad/ de nas 'od zer spro pa'i dmigs pa re byed pa slar nas slar du goms par bya'o/ /nyal ba'i tshe bla ma'i thugs ka'i hu la sems gtad de nyal/ bsgom lugs gzhan rnams snga ma bzhin no/ /dmigs skor zhe lnga pa'o/ /'di 'od gsal 'dzin pa'i dmigs pa'i dngos gzhi gtso bo de yin no/ /rgyu mtshan ni/ /snying ga chos kyi 'khor lo ni/ gnyid 'thug po'i 'khrul ba 'byung ba'i gnas kyi gtso bo yang yin/ de la gnad du bsnun pas lam bsgoms ni/ 'khrul ba de'i gnyen po 'od gsal 'char ba'i gnas kyi yang gtso bo yin pas so/ /'o na gzhan gnyis la'ang gnad de yong 'thad pa la snyam na/'di 'dra'i rigs la nges pa med de/ spyir gnyid 'thug po'i 'od gsal 'char ba'i gnas drag shos de snying ga yin kyang / thog mar gnas der rlung 'jug dka' ba'i skabs shig/rtsa dbu ma'i gnas gzhan du gnad du bsnun na/ der —285—
