rlung 'dus pa'i 'od gsal gyi nyams myong zhig 'phral du skye bar 'gyur/ de yang yang goms pa na/ des sna drangs te 'dun pa cung zad bsgyur ba kho nas 'bad rtsol med par snying gar rlung sems 'dus pa'i 'od gsal 'char ba nyid la yang tshegs med do/ /thabs 'di rmi lam sogs gzhan la'ang rigs 'gre'o/ /des na 'od gsal 'dzin pa'i dmigs pa gsum po 'di/ gang blo la bde ba zhig 'bad pas bsgoms nas nus pa thon par bya dgos mod/ gang zag gcig gis gsum khar sgom ma dgos pa rang yang ma yin no/ /gnyis pa 'od gsal lam khyer la/ nyin mo sku gsum lam khyer dang / mtshan mo sku gsum rang shar ba/zhes sa bcad gnyis su byed kyang nyams len dmigs pa gcig kho na ste/ nyin mo sku gsum lam khyer nyid do/ /de yang dang por 'di thun mtshams kyi nyams len gal che ste/ skyu lus skabs su/ 'dun pa gsum sbrags bshad pa'i dod yin/ de yang rtsa ba mi rtag skyo shas dang / gsal bdebs me tog 'char byed du bshad pa bzhin/ 'od gsal gyi thun mtshams su yang / mi rtag pa dang / bla ma'i mos gus sngar sgyu lus su bshad pa bzhin dgos la/ sgyu lus dang rmi lam la/ sgyu ma dang rmi lam gyi 'dun pa dgos pa'i don/ 'dir sku gsum lam khyer gyi 'jog stangs de dgos pa'i don yin no/ /bsam sdings pa'i khrid yig ni/thun thun mtshams kyi gsal kha med/ 'jag chen a la sems gtod pa bzhin du grims lhod ran par bya/ zhes gsung ste/ de'i go ba ni a yig gi skabs na rig pa yengs kyang ma yengs bcur bcur du yang ma song ba mnyam rjes thams cad du bsgom gsungs pa de yin pas/ thun thun mtshams gnyis kar du bsgom —286—

pa'i don yin/ de la spyir thun gyi skabs su yang 'jog tshul de ka dang mthun pa yin mod kyi/ thun gyi nyams len byed tshul logs su bshad zin pas/ 'dir ni thun mtshams kho na'i dbang du byas pa'o/ /de yang bdag zas za 'gro 'chag/nyal 'dug spyod lam kun tu sku gsum lam khyer 'di dran pa zhig byed dgos snyam pa'i 'dun pa yang yang btang gin 'gro 'dug sogs bya byed gang byed pa'i skabs der/ gang shar de ka la sems gtad de/ shes pa khong glod/ rang zhal lta shes tsam bya/ de'i tshe mig gi lta stangs kyang ha re bzhag/de yang thog ma thun mtshams yin yang sos dal du 'dug pa'i skabs/ dran pa bsten pa tsam gyis 'phral 'phral du sleb 'ong / de nas bya byed brel po kun la'ang rim pas bsre bar bya'o/ /de yang snang ba sna tshogs gang shar ba de'i steng gi gsal cha de gsal ba sprul sku/ rang zhal la cher re bltas pas cir yang ma yin pa de stong pa chos sku/ snang ba sna tshogs pa shar ba la bzo bcos ma byas pa de dang / ngos bzung ci yang med pa de sems gsal rig tsam gyi steng de na/ ngo bo dbyer med cig car ro gcig tu shar ba de/ rang rig rang gsal long spyod rdzogs sku lam khyer ro/ /de ltar na thog mar thun mtshams kyi dge sbyor 'di la legs par bslab/ de rjes phal cher la 'di lam du khyer thub pa nas/ skabs 'di'i 'dun pa gsum po gang rung re dran par bya'o/ /mtshan mo sku gsum rang shar ni/ thun gyi skabs su dmigs pa la drag tu bcur ba dang / thun mtshams su sku gsum lam khyer bsgoms pa de'i mthu las/ mtshan mo gnyid 'thug po dus su 'od gsal zin pa na/ gsal stong zung 'jug gi sku gsum rang shar du 'byung —287—

ngo / /gnyid dus kyi gsal ba ni/ snang ba rags pa sna tshogs pa 'di dag de dus mi 'char bas/ rig pa nyid kyi gsal cha dang / /'char sgo rtags kyi snang ba sna tshogs pa'o/ /dmigs skor zhe drug pa'o/ /gsum pa bsre ba la/ gsal stong bsre ba dang mnyam rjes bsre ba/ nyin mtshan bsre ba/ bde stong bsre ba ste bzhi las/ dang po ni/ sgom mnyam bzhag gi dus/ sems cir yang ma grub pa 'dra ba de bsgoms pas rkyen byas nas stong sang sang ba ci yang med pa 'dra ba zhig 'char/ thun mtshams su yang gdong gtan kyi dngos po 'di dag gang yang mi 'dug snyam pa 'byung ste/ stong nyams rkyang pa shar ba yin/ skabs der thun dang thun mtshams thams cad du mig nam mkha' la gtad/ rig pa hur phyung / stong sang nge ba'i gzhi de la bltas pas/stong pa de la gsal cha rim gyis rnyed de gsal stong du 'gyur/ yang thun gyi skabs su rnam rtog med pa la rig pa gsal seng nge dga' bde dang bcas pa 'byung ba/ thun mtshams su'ang de la sred pa che/ rang rtsis skye bar 'dug na/gsal ba rkyang pa'i nyams skyes pa yin pas/ thun thun mtshams thams cad du sems dwangs sang nge ba/ gsal rjen ne ba/ de'i ngo bo la lta gzhigs drag tu bcug pas thogs pa'i dngos po zhig pa ltar chems se song nas ngos bzung du med pa zhig 'ong / de'i ngang la bzo bcos med par bzhag/sems la bltas nas kyang sgyu ma lta bu'o zhes yang yang dran pa gsal stong du 'char te/ de ltar na gsal ba stong pa la bsre ba'o/ /dmigs skor zhe bdun pa'o/ /gnyis pa mnyam rjes bsre ba ni/ spyir rjes thob mtshan nyid dang ldan pa —288—

zhig yin na/ mnyam bzhag dang ched du bsre mi dgos kyang / 'dir thun la mnyam bzhag dang / thun mtshams tsam po la rjes thob ces btags pa'o/ /de yang thun gyi skabs su rtsol bas bcos pa ma yin par sems gsal stong du dum re gnas pa yang yang byung kyang / thun mtshams su dang po'i tha mal pa zang ma de ka ma gtogs/ gsal stong gi nyams ye mi sleb pa 'dug na/ thun gyi skabs su nyams cung zad shar ba'i dus der/ spyod lam gang yang rung ba zhig la bsre ba'i 'dun pa gtong ste/ dper na/ da ltar bdag skor ba byed pa'i skabs su/nyams 'di bskyang bar bya snyam pa'i 'dun pa yang yang btang / thun las langs pa'i skabs su yang de ka'i rgyun dran pas bzung / lag tu 'chang rgyu lta bur dran 'dzin gyi rtags shig kyang bzhag/de nas skor ba byed pa'i skabs su/ sku gsum lam khyer du bshad pa bzhin dang de bskyangs pas/ thun gyi skabs su bshad pa lta bu'i gsal stong gi nyams de sleb 'ong / de ltar zhag 'ga' re song na rtsol ba chen po mi dgos par 'ong ste/ de la goms nas spyod lam gzhan thams cad la'ang rim pas sbyang / 'di ni mnyam bzhag gi nyams myong rjes thob la bsre ba yin/ rjes thob mnyam bzhag la tshur bsre ba ni mi dgos/ 'ga' zhig la rjes thob kyi nyams myong bzang po shar nas/ des mnyam bzhag la bogs 'thon pa zhig 'ong ste/ de shugs 'byung la 'og gi bcos pas mi phan no/ /dmigs skor zhe brgyad pa'o/ /gsum pa nyin mtshan bsre ba ni/ nyin mo thun gyi skabs la gsal stong gi nyams shar yang / mtshan mo gnyid 'thug po'i skabs su ye ma slebs na/—289—

thun gyi skabs su dmigs pa gsum po gang rung zhig la brten nas/ rlung bum pa can bsgom zhing rig pa drag tu bzhur/ gsal stong gi nyams shar ba'i dus/do nub gnyid kyi dus su'ang 'di kho na ltar bsgom rgyu yin snyam pa bag tsam re 'dun pa btang gin/ thun mtshams su yang snga dro 'dun pa cung zad bya/ dgongs mo dang srod kyi thun mtshams la/ 'dun pa drag tu sbyong ba gal che/ nyal khar yang 'jam rlung khug pa kha re bzung zhing dmigs pa bsgom/ mthar rang gi lus dang sems la sems gtad de cher re bzhag pa'i ngang nas gnyid du 'gro bar bya/ des nges par gnyid kyi dge sbyor zin 'ong ngo / /yang 'ga' zhig la mtshan mo'i dge sbyor bzang po thog mar skyes nas/ nyin par nyams myong de dran pa tsam gyis nyin par gyi dge sbyor la bogs 'byin par byed pa zhig kyang yod de/ 'di yang rang shugs la 'byung ba ka yin no/ /'od gsal la ni de lta bu dgos pa ci rigs pa 'byung la/ rmi lam rtsal sbyong la ni/ mtshan mo'i nyin mo la ched gtad bogs 'byin dgos pa yang shin tu mang ngo / /dmigs skor zhe dgu pa'o/ /bzhi pa bde stong dbyer med du bsre ba ni/ sems gsal ba dang / stong pa dang / mi rtog pa'i nyams kyis drangs pa'i dga' ba de la nyams bde ba chen po 'byung yang / ched du gnyer nas stong par bsre ba mi dgos/ gsal ba nyid sgyu ma lta bur shes pas rang chod la 'gro/ /zhu bde'i nyams rnams stong par bsre dgos pa yin te/ gzhan lus shes rab kyi bde ba'am/ rang lus thabs ldan gtum mo'ang / sgyu lus dbang po tha ma lta bu'am/ thig le dbang bzhi'i gnad dam/ 'od gsal 'dzin pa'i dmigs pa gsum lta bu bsgoms pas/ rlung dbu —290—

zab lam ni gu chos drug gi khrid yig zab don thang mar brdal ba bzhugs/mar thim pa'i bde drod skyes pa lta bu la bsre dgos pa yin te/ de yang bde nyams lan re tsam byung 'phral la bsre ba skad byas na/ nyams de sangs 'gro bas mi bya la/ de yang yang 'ong zhing brtan po yod na bsre dgos/ /nga rgyal dang sred zhen mngon gyur pa med na/ de'i rang zhal brtas pa tsam gyis bde bar snang ba ma 'gags bzhin du/ ngos bzung med par lhod de shigs se song ba de ka bskyangs pas chog/sred zhen dang rlom sems skye na/ bde ba de nyid la sgyu ma lta bur 'dun pa sbyangs shing / mthar sgyu 'dzin dang bral ba'i phyag rgya chen po la bzhag na/ bde stong dbyer med du 'gyur ro/ /bsre ba bzhi po de dag thams cad kyi gnas skabs su/ thun mtshams spyod lam gang byed kyang / yang nas yang du gang shar de la glang po che'i lta stangs kyis had de chad de 'jog pa kho na dgos/ mnyam bzhag gi dus su yang rtog med kyi nyams bde gsal gang shar dang / rtog bcas dmigs pa la gnad du bsnun pa'i dus thams cad du yang de ka ltar 'jog pa gnad du che/ lar thun thun mtshams su bde sdug mtho dman 'jig rten chos brgyad thams cad la sgyu ma lta bur shes pas/ da lta 'jig rten pa'i bzang ngan mtho dman nye ring gi rnam bzhag skad skad po 'di'i a 'thas zhig pa rang gal che'o/ /dmigs skor lnga bcu pa'o/ /bzhi pa mthar thug ni/ dang por nyin mo dang mtshan mo'i 'od gsal gang la'ang / 'od gsal gyi rtogs pa skye ba'i dang por gsal stong dbyer med kyi 'od gsal 'byung / tshogs lam gyi thad yin/ de nas bde stong dbyer med kyi 'od gsal 'byung / sbyor lam gyi thad yin/ de nas zab zhi spros bral gyi 'od —29/—

gsal 'byung / ma dag sa bdun gyi thad sor sleb/ de nas dbyer med mthar thug gi 'od gsal 'byung / dag pa sa gsum gyi skabs yin/ de rjes dag pa gnyis ldan gyi 'od gsal te/ rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi sa ye shes chos sku'o/ /'di dag gi don rgyas par pond na mang mod kyi 'dir ma spros so/ /'di ni spyir 'od gsal zhes bya ba gnas lugs kyi don rtogs tshul la sa mtshams phye ba yin/ gnyid kyi 'od gsal gcig po'i dbye ba ma yin no/ /'di la dmigs pa logs pa med pas dmigs skor du mi bgrang / chos thun gcig lta bu ji lhar 'os pa'o/ /gsum pa rjes kyi khrid la/ dam tshig spyi dang bye brag/gegs sel nyes skyon rang dag bogs 'don the tshom gcod byed/ khyad 'phags 'char sgo ngos 'dzin/ nyams rtogs nyin mtshan khyad par te/ lnga las/ dang po ni/ spyir sdom gsum las rang gis gang blangs pa'i bslab bya rnams ma nyams pa gal che/nyes ltung can la sgom rnam par dag pa mi skye zhing / sngar skyes rnams kyang nyes ltung byung na nyams 'gro bas so/ /de'i nang nas kyang gsang sngags kyi dam tshig ma nyams pa rtsa ba yan lag gi lhung bas ma gos pa dgos te/ dam tshig de dag nyams na sgom gyi re ba lta zhog/'di dang phyi mar mtho ris kyi bde ba tsam yang med te/ ngan song gsum la zang thal du 'gro bas so/ /de dag spyi'i dam tshig yin la/ gzhan mnyam rjes kyi dam tshig mtha' dag sgrub nus na der yang 'dus/ 'on kyang dam bca' 'chag med yin yin po'i bya spyod kyi rim pa mang pos sems 'khrug par yang mi byed de/ nyams len dang 'bral med kyi ngang —292—

nas/ bla ma'i mos gus dang ma bral ba/ rten kun de byang sems ma nyams pa/tha mal chags sdang gi yul snang thams cad sgyu ma lta bur bsgoms nas/ chags sdang gi dbang du mi gtong ba rnams 'od gsal sgos kyi dam tshig go /'dir 'od gsal ces bya ba yang / chos drug gi nang tshan mtshan mo'i 'od gsal kho nar ma zad/ nyin mtshan gyi 'od gsal thams cad yin pas/ bsre ba sgyu lus spyi khyab la go bar bya la/ 'pho ba bar do'ang bsre ba'i yan lag yin pa'i phyir/dam tshig 'di ni dam tshig spyi 'gro yin no/ /gnyis pa gegs sel nyes skyon rang dag ni/ spyir thabs lam dang 'brel ba gegs sel gyi yi ge sna tshogs pa ni gzhan du gsal la/ 'dir gsal stong 'dzin med/ snang stong rang shar/ bde stong zhen bral rnams nyams myong gi ye shes yin pa la/ de rnams kyi mi mthun phyogs kyi bdud ni/ 'dzin pa rnam rtog rang ga mar shor ba 'di yin pas/ rnam rtog gi rang zhal bltas nas rang grol rang dag rang stong du ngo 'phrod par bsgom/ de yang rnam rtog sems yin/ sems skye med mtha' dang bral ba'i gnad kas gang shar la bzo bcos med par bltas pas 'char sgo'i rang tshugs zhig/snang ba dang stong pa ris su ma chad pa'i rang 'gros la 'jog pa dang / yang skabs 'gar 'char sgo sna tshogs pa'i snang ba dang rig pa thams cad sgyu ma lta bus shes pa'i 'dun pa drag pos ar la gtad te bzhag go /de gnyid kho nas gegs dang gol sa sdug bsngal thams cad las grol bar 'gyur ro/ /gsum pa bogs 'don the tshom gcod byed ni/ kha cig rang gi nyams myong la the tshoms med par nges shes thag chod kyi sgo —293—

bogs 'don yang gsung / 'ga' zhig tshad med gnyis kyis bogs 'don yang gsung / de las kyang 'di ltar bya ste/ khyad par du snang ba sna tshogs dang / bde sdug chags sdang gi yul rnams kyi steng du/ sgyu lus rmi lam gyi 'dun pa'i rtsal sbyong dang / mi rtog pa rnams hur thon pa sbyong ba dang / gnas nges med/ 'dug stangs nges med/ 'gro sdod spyod lam nges pa med pa la yang 'dun pa gang rung re shugs bskyed de yang yang bsgom pa rnams phyi'i bogs 'don yin/ rlung sems 'jur la 'debs pa'i thabs rtsa rlung gi sbyor ba drag po shi med ko med du gzir ba skabs skabs su bsgom pa nang gi bogs 'don yin/ bogs 'don gnyis po de 'dra re'i mthar rig pa'i rtsal chen po re 'ong bas/ de la thag chod kyi nges shes bskyed/ de bla ma'i bka' drin du shes nas gsol ba 'debs/ de ltar ma rtogs pa'i sems can la snying rje re bsgom pa lags/ bogs 'don dgos na de la mdzod/bzhi pa khyad 'phags 'char sgo ngos 'dzin ni/ rgyas par logs su ston pa'i phyir skabs 'dir rgyas bshad mi dgos mod/ 'on kyang 'di skad ces gsal ba'i 'char sgo/ mi rtog pa'i 'char sgo/ bde ba'i 'char sgo/ zung 'jug gi 'char sgo ste bzhi yod lags/ dang po ni/ 'od gsal nyams kyi gsal cha la gnyid dus su rtags snang dang / lus nyams/ sems nyams sna tshogs su 'char ba zhig yin/ gnyis pa ni/ rna bar tsi rong ba dang / thibs thibs pa dang /'jig 'jir gnon pa'o/ /rlung sems dbu mar chud pa yin/ yang 'dar ba dang / 'phar ba dang / brgyal ba dang / yan lag phral song ba'ang / rtsa mdud —294—

grol ba yin/ gzhan yang rnam shes nam mkha' la yal pa 'dra ba 'ong / mi rtog pa gsal snang chen po la 'dar yer pa 'dra ba'ang 'ong / de dag la dga' spro dang / rlom sems byung na dge sbyor la bogs mi thon/ nad gdod kyi rnam 'gyur yin par bzung na gegs su 'gro bas/ dga' mi dga' med par byung rgyal du bskyang / gsum pa ni/ lus sems bde gsal du 'char ba yin/bzhi pa ni nyid mtshan thams cad du 'bad rtsol med par 'od gsal 'char ba la zer ro/ /rtsa ba'i lnga pa nyams rtogs nyin mtshan khyad par ni/ de yang lha sku dang thig le sogs blos bcos shing gsar du bsgom pa'i skabs der/gsal mi gsal ji ltar byung yang 'od gsal yang min la lha sku rang shar yang min no/ /rig pa bsgribs te bzhag pa'i skabs der rtsol ba'i 'dun rtog dang bcas pa bzhin du/ sems bag re gnas pa dang / bde gsal gyi nyams yod pa snyam byed pa zhig 'byung ste/ de tsam zhig gnyid sad kyi gnas skabs gang la byung kyang 'od gsal dngos ni ma yin/ 'od gsal gyi rgyur 'gro ba tsam ni yin no/ /des na thun thun mtshams gang la yin kyang / kho rang gi skabs der ched gtad rtsol ba ma byas par rang shar ba'i sems gsal stong bde ba mi rtog pa shar ba de la 'od gsal zer/ nyin mtshan gang la byung kyang khyad med do/ /yang kho ra'i dus de na bskyed 'dod kyi blo drag po mngon gyur med kyang / rang dang phyi rol du lha sku lam lam shar yod na/ sgyu lus lha sku rang shar zhes bya ba yin/sad dus dang rmi lam la khyad med/ nged sgom chen pa'i glen sa tam mam/ ri la sdug khur 'dra byas pa'i sdug yus tsam lags mod/ rgyud sde mkhan po dang —295—

mkhas pa rnams bkyon te mchi/ rang sa na blo gtad thub pa re myong thog na bdog/bka' bkyon kyang skrag rgyu tsam mi gda'/ bsgom nus na rang re las dang po pa mkhas rmongs kun la yang dka' tshegs chen po rang yang mi dgos/yun ring dgug sdod rang yang mi dgos par 'ong / rkyen 'byung dus su'ang cung zad sleb 'ong / sems la'ang phan pas 'phral bde zhing skyid par yang 'ong sa lam mthon po'i sgyu lus dang / 'od gsal zung 'jug gi rnam bzhag tsam de rang re las dang po pas lag len du khel ba min/ da lta lag len du khel ba 'di rnams ka mthar de dag gi rgyu grung por 'gro ba yin/ myu gu chung ngu nas legs par bskyangs pas mthar ston thog 'ong ba dang 'dra'o/ /de lta bu'i 'od gsal la/ nyams kyi 'od gsal dang / rtogs pa'i 'od gsal gnyis yod/ de gnyis ka la nyin mo sad dus kyi 'od gsal dang / mtshan mo gnyid dus kyi 'od gsal gnyis su dbye bas bzhi ru song / bzhi ga la snang bcas dang / snang med gnyis gnyis su phye bas brgyad du 'gyur/ snang bcas bzhi la phyi dang 'brel ba bzhi dang / ma 'brel ba bzhi ste brgyad/ snang med bzhi la'ang / srab mo'i 'od gsal dang / 'thug po'i 'od gsal gnyis gnyis te brgyad/ de thams cad bsdoms pa bcu drug go /slob ma nyams myong shar ba yin na/ de dag gi ngos 'dzin zhib par bshad la/ khong rang la shar ba'i 'od gsal gang yin pa de ngo sprad do/ /slob ma nyams myong ma shar ba dang / sna tshogs 'dus pa'i tshogs pa la/ /bcu drug dbye ba'i ming tsam ka bshad pa de kas chog go /de ltar na bsre ba dang /mthar thug dang / rjes kyi chos lnga po 'di dag chos drug nang sel gyi 'od gsal —296—

gyi sa bcad du sdud yod kyang / don la gtum mo/ sgyu lus/ rmi lam/ 'od gsal bzhi char gyi khrid bskyangs zin pa'i rjes skyong ba'i khrid yin par shes so/ /rjes kyi chos 'di rnams la nyams len dmigs pa'i gnad gal che ba mang po 'dug kyang / phyis rim pas bsgom rgyu'i gdams ngag yin pas/ da lta 'phral khyer gyi dmigs skor du bcad pa ni mi mdzad pas/ chos mthun mang nyung ji tsam byed skabs dang sbyar ro/ /de ltar na de dag ni rtsa ba'i chos bzhi zhes kyang bya/ bsre ba sgyu lus zhes kyang bya ste/ bsre ba dang 'pho ba zhes pa la/ rje mar pa lo tsu'i gdams ngag so so rnams na/ bsre ba'i rnam bzhag mi 'dra ba mang po yod kyang 'dir mi 'chad/ gdams ngag 'di nyid kyi lugs la/ gong du bshad pa gsal stong bsre ba sogs bsre ba bzhi dang / gzhan yang bsre 'pho shes rab rnam bzhi'am rnam gsum zhes grags pa yin/ de la shes rab gsum ni/ log par shes pa'i shes rab/ kun rdzob shes pa'i shes rab/ don dam shes pa'i shes rab bo/ /de yang thabs khyad par can gyis bsgrubs pa'i bde ba chen po'i dbang du byas na/ dang por bde bar shar tsam na zag bcas chags pa'i blo zhig kyang 'dug pa de phyin ci log shes pa yin/ de rang du sems sgyu ma lta bu'i bde bar shar ba de kun rdzob shes pa yin pas/ log pa de kun rdzob shes pa'i shes rab la bsre ba yin/ de yang bzo med dbyings su shar ba de don dam shes pa yin te/ kun rdzob de don dam shes pa'i shes rab la bsre ba yin/ gang shar thams cad kyi steng du dbyings shar de ngos bzung de ye shes dang cir snang ba bsre ba yin/ de mtshon nas sad dus kyi snang ba bun long shar ba tsam 'di log —297—

pa'i shes pa/ de sgyu mar shar ba kun rdzob shes pa/ sgyu mar 'dzin pa dang bral ba'i rang 'gros de don dam shes pa/ de gang shar gyi steng du khyer ba de ye shes dang cir snang bsre ba'o/ /yang rmi lam shar tsam de log pa/ de rmi lam dang sgyu mar shes pa kun rdzob/ rgyu 'dzin bral ba don dam/ de gnyid sad sogs kun tu khyer ba de ye —shes dang cir snang bsre ba'o/ /gnyid 'thug po dran med du med du thibs song ba de log pa/ de la bde gsal du dran pa sleb pa de kun rdzob/ de rang bzhin bzo med du 'dug pa don dam/ des sad dus dang rmi lam rgyas thebs pa de ye shes dang cir snang dbyer med do/ khres rab bzhir byed pa ltar na ye shes cir snang dbyer med la/ zung 'jug shes pa'i shes rab bcas ming 'dogs/ sgyu lus rmi lam skabs kyi rang shar lha sku ni kun rdzob don dam zung 'jug gsum kha'i cha ru yod gsung / yang thabs lam gyi bde ba sgyu lus dang bsre/ 'od gsal gyi bde stong rmi lam dang bsre/ sgyu lus dang rmi lam phan tshun du bsre zhes kyang gsung ste/ bsre ba'i don dbyer med du lam du khyer ba'i don lags pas so/ /gzhan yang bsre ba'i gzhi gnas thabs bshad na/ skabs 'dir 'di dag go dgos te/ 'khor ba pa rnams kyi 'khrul ba thams cad bsdu na bzhi ste/gnyid sad dus dang / gnyid 'thug po dang / rmi lam dang / gnyis sbyor gyi chags rtog ste bzhi po der 'dus/ bzhi po de gzhi chos dbyings kyi sku gsung thugs bde ba chen po bzhi la sgrib pa yin/ lam gyi ye shes snang stong dang /rig stong dang / gsal stong dang / bde stong bzhi pos rim gyis sgrib pa de —298—

rnams sel ba yin/ 'di'i skabs kyi rig stong ni mi rtog pa la zer/ de dag gi gtso bo yang rim pas sgyu lus dang / 'od gsal dang / rmi lam dang / gtum mo rnams yin/ de rnams bsgoms pa las 'bras bu mthar thug ni/ sprul sku/ chos sku/ longs sku/ bde chen gyi sku ste/ sku bzhi mngon du 'gyur ro/ /yang ye shes lnga dang spyor na/ sgyu lus me long lta bu/ 'od gsal mnyam pa nyid/ rmi lam so sor rtog pa/ gtum mo chos kyi dbyings kyi ye shes sgrub pa'i lam yin bsrung bar thams cad 'dra la/ bya grub ni chos bzhi char gyi 'bras bu spyi la sbyor gsung ba dang / sor rtog bya grub gnyis kar rmi lam la sbyor gsung ba'ang 'dug ste man ngag gsung rgyun las/ las rgya bya grub kyi lam du 'chad/ 'on kyang thams cad la mi 'gal 'e1/ /lnga pa 'pho ba ma bsgoms sangs rgyas la/ gzhung gi 'pho ba dang / lhan thabs kyi man ngag gnyis yod pa las/ dang po la/ gzhung las/ chos sku de bzhin nyid kyi 'pho ba/ zung 'jug yi dam gyi 'pho ba/ byin rlabs bla ma'i 'pho ba/ 'chug med mkha' spyod kyi 'pho ba'o/ /dang po ni/ 'chi ba 'od gsal ma bu ngo 'phrod na/ gzhan rnams la 'chi srid 'byung rgyu de/ rnal 'byor pa la 'od gsal bde stong du rang shar bas gong du 'pho ba'i gdams ngag la ma ltos te/dus de nyid du rang grol ba'o/ /'di la dmigs pa logs pa med pas dmigs skor la mi bgrang ngo / /gnyis pa zung 'jug yi dam gyi 'pho ba ni/ sngon 'gro rnams sngar sgyu lus skabs dang 'dra ba las/ bar dor sangs rgyas pa mdzad du gsol/ /zhes gsol 'debs kyi mtha' bsgyur ba tsam gyi khyad par ro/ /rang —299—

lhar gsal ba'i spyi bo'i steng gi nam mkha' la rang gang mos pa'i yi dam de bsgom gsung / spyir de ltar yin yang des khrigs ma byas na/ mi blun po'i yi dam la tshad gzung mi yong bas/ skabs 'dir 'khor lo sdom pa'am/ dgyes mdzad gang rung zhig rang gi spyi bo'i mda' gang tsam gyi steng gi nam mkha' la bsgom/ rang gi lus kyi dbus su dbu ma kha dog dkar ba sngar bshad pa rnams dang 'dra ba la/ mar sna gsang bar zug pa kha zum pa/ yar sna spyi bo tshangs bug la reg pa/ spyi bo tshangs bug te/ dbu ma'i kha dang rgya khyon mnyam pa/ rgya mthongs kha bye ba bzhin du skya thal le yod pa zhig bsgom/ dbu ma'i nang lte bar rang sems a dkar po dang / mas snar yi dam gyi sa bon hū sngon po rlung gi rang bzhin zhig gsal btab / de mtshams rlung ro bsal nas 'jam rlung bag tsam bzung / lte ba'i a dang gsang ba'i hu la sems drag tu gtad/ yang rlung phyir bsal ba'i dus/ kha nas 'bud na hig ring po dang / sna nas 'bud na hū ring byed dam sgra med kyi tshul gyis rlung shugs bkyed de bsal/ der skabs mas sna'i hu shugs dang ldan pa des lte ba'i a yar khyer te/ yi ge nyis brtsegs de dbu ma'i lam nas brgyud/ spyi gtsug tshangs pa'i bu ga nas rgyangs te thon te yi dam gyi thugs kar sleb/ der gang yang mi bsam par dran med thabs su cung zad bzhag /skabs der rlung yang rang babs so/ /de lta bu bskyar gyin lan bdun tsam bsgom/ de rjes yi dam gyi thugs ka nas yi ge nyis brtsegs thur la rgyang gis byung / spyi bo nas zhugs dbu ma'i lam nas brgyud de song / a yig lte bar bsdad/ hu yig gsang bar song ste ljid dang ldan par bsam/ dmigs pa —300—

thun chung gcig go /de ltar yang yang bsgom/ thun 'jog khar yig 'bru gnyis po sngar bzhin ma phab pa'i rjes la/ yi dam 'od du zhu nas rang la thim/hūṃ sngon po las 'phros pa'i 'od kyi kha gcod lta bus spyi bo'i tshangs bug 'grig por bkag par bsam/ de nyid 'pho ba'i rtags byung byung gi bar du bsgom/ de nas kyang nyin rer dmigs pa lan re tsam bsgom mo/ /dmigs skor nga gcig pa'o/ /gsum pa byin rlabs bla ma'i 'pho ba ni/ sngon 'gro snga ma dang 'dra/dngos gzhi'i skabs su yang rtsa dbu ma sngar bzhin bsgom/ dbu ma'i nang lte bar thig le dkar po gsung ba dang / ser po gsung ba sogs ci rigs yod kyang /lag len du dkar la ser ba'i mdangs chags pa 'od 'phro ba/ nor bu ke ke ru dang 'dra ba/ zlum zhing 'gril ba bongs tshod sran rdog tsam zhig gsal 'debs/rlung sbyor yang snga ma dang 'dra/ thig le dkar ser de spyi gtsug nas yar rgyang thon te/ bla ma'i thugs kar thim de ltar dmigs pa bskyar gyin lan bdun song ba na/ mar 'bebs pa'i dmigs pa byed de/ lte bar thig le ljid dang ldan pa nyams bde ba zhig bsgom/ de lta bu thun chung gcig ste de nyid bskyar gyin bsgom/ thun 'jog khar rlung sems lte bar phab pa'i rjes su/ bla ma la mos gus dung ba byas pas bla ma 'od du zhu/ spyi gtsug tshangs pa'i bu ga nas zhugs te thim pas lus sems bde bas khyab/ spyi bo tshangs pa'i bu ga de yang thig le dkar po gcig gi bkag par bsam/ tshul de lta bur rtags byung byung bsgom/de ltar 'pho ba de gnyis ka la yang las la sbyor ba'i skabs/ yar 'pho ba 'ba' —301—

zhig bsgom gyi mar 'bebs pa mi dgos la/ thun mtshams su sgo bkag pa yang mi dgos so/ /dmigs skor nga gnyis pa'o/ /bzhi pa 'byug med mkha' spyod kyi 'pho ba ni/ spyir dkyus kyi man ngag gi bsdebs yin kyang shin tu bka' gnyan ces gsung nas bka' rgya can du mdzad de tshogs su mi gsung / de bas na logs su shes par bya'o/ /dkyus kyi sa bcad kyis bsdus pa ma yin kyang / ye shes mkha' 'gro ma nyid kyi gsung 'pho ba bsdus pa gzhan yang rigs lnga tsam yod do/ /gnyis pa lhan thabs kyi man ngag ni/ skabs 'dir/ gzhung nas 'pho ba mang po bshad kyang / lag len ye shes skar khung ma la byed gsung / gzhung 'pho rnams la'ang lag len ye mi mdzad pa yin mod/ 'di la phyag len gtso cher mang du 'debs pa la dgongs pa'o/ /'di la sbyang ba dang las la sbyar ba gnyis yod/ dang po sbyang ba ni/ sngon 'gro sngar dang 'dra/ bla ma 'od du zhu nas rang la thim pa'i rjes su/ rang lus lha sku khong stong du bsam/ rtsa dbu ma yang yid dam gyi 'pho ba'i skabs su bshad pa bzhin bsgom/ dbu ma'i nang lte ba'i thad du chos 'byung gru gsum dkar po/ rtsa ba phra ba thur bstan/ gdengs ka gyen bstan/ zur gcig mdun la bstan pa/rgyab gzhung gi ngos la logs gcig bstan par bsgom/ de'i dbus su rten gang la yang ma reg pa'i a yig dkar go/ sran chung ngam/ yungs 'bru'i tshad gsal 'debs/ tshad che chung ma gtogs chos 'byung dang a yig gi bzhugs tshul stong ra'i skabs dang 'dra/ de rjes rlung ro bsal/ rlung bum can shugs drag po yun —thung tsam cig bzung / lte ba'i a la sems drag tu gtad/ rlung bzung ba'i ngang —302—

de ka nas lto ba tshigs pa'i phyogs la cung zad gcer tsam dang / a dkar po de 'phar tsam byung nas yang sngar shul du bsdad/ de bas cung shugs che bas gcer ba na/ yang sngar las mtho tsam 'phar ba las sngar gyi sar bsdad/ yang de 'phral skad cig la drag tu gcer te thub tshad du bsdad pas/ rlung stong du khong gis 'gril yong / dmigs pa chos 'byung gi kha thag gis brdabs pas/ de rlung gis bdas pa bzhin du rang sems a dkar po de mda' 'phangs pa bzhin du dbu ma'i lam brgyud spyi bo tshangs bug nas thon/ /nam mkha' la ye re re song /dbyings mthon po mthon por slebs nas nam mkha' la yal bar bsams te/dbyings dang nam mkha' rig pa gsum dbyer med du 'dres pa la hud de bzhag /dmigs pa de lta bu bskyar gyin lan bdun tsam bsgom/ yang 'bebs pa ni nam mkha'i dbus su a dkar po zhig lam te grub/ de mar bab pa spyi bo tshangs bug nas zhugs/ dbu ma'i nang nas mar lam lam lam dal bus babs/ lte ba'i chos 'byung gi dbus su brtan cing brjid dang ldan pa'i tshul gyis sgring nge 'dug par bsam de thun chung gcig yin/ de ltar yang yang bsgom/thun chen re'i nang du thun chung nge 'dra nyer gcig gam/ bcu gcig gam bdun tsam re byed/ de lta bu'i thun bzhi'am drug sogs byas na rtags myur du 'ong ste/rtsol ba che chung gi rim pas zhag bdun nam/ zla phyed dam/ zla gcig tsam la rtags rab 'bring tha ma gsum gang rung zhig 'byung bar the tshom med do/ /de yang rtags rab spyi bo 'bur ba brdol te chu ser sogs byung na'ang yin/dmigs pa btang res kyi ltag pa'i rtsa gnyis rengs shing / mig sprid chil ba —303—

dang / dran med du 'gro tshad pa byung na yin/ 'bring ni spyi bo 'bur ba tsam dang /mdun rtse chung gi rtsa rgyangs pa lta bu'o/ /tha ma spyi bo za zhing 'gul la 'khrigs pa 'ong / des mi yong gong ma gnyis gang rung gcig rang dgos/ gsung /dmigs pa gsal shos gcig la 'di bsgom tsam na yun ring du dran med du brgyal ba 'byung ste/ de la rin po che'i snod byang mas spyi gtsug bkab na/ thal ba'i nyes pa mi 'byung gsung / 'on kyang de 'dra'i rigs la tshigs pa brdung ba dang 'bebs kyis phab na legs so/ /de ltar rtags byung nas nyin re bzhin dmigs pa tshar re bsgom dgos/ spyir da lta 'pho bas rtsa lam 'byongs na/ nam zhig 'chi tshe 'pho ba'i gsal 'debs med kyang / sngar rtsa sgo bye zhing rtsa lam byang ba de nyid nas phal cher 'gro yang re re tsam ma nges pa las gsal 'debs byung na 'chug pa med/ sgom 'phro bzhag nas yun ring lon na/ dgos dus gsal mi thebs pa yang srid pas/ da lta sbyangs pa'i rgyun mi nyams pa'i phyir thun re bsgom pa yin/ lhag ma sgyu lus sogs bsgom pa khe che'o/ /las la sbyar ba ni sngar bshad pa dang 'dra ste/ myur du 'chi ba'i rtags nges pa can byung na/ yo byad la ma chags par bya/ rang gang mos pa la mchod 'bul dang / sbyan gtong byed/khon dang sel yod pa rnams la dngos dang brgyud pa'i sgo nas bshags sbyang bya/nye du sogs la chags pa'i blo spangs te/ 'brel thag bcad nas bsgom dgos so/ /'dir rdzas kyi 'pho ba'ang pa zhad pa 'grub na ni legs/ med ka med ni min no/ /dmigs skor nga gsum pa'o/ /de yang chad la gtum mo'i skabs su rtsa dbu ma dmar por bsgom/—304—

gzhan rnams la'ang phyi dkar nang dmar sogs khrid yig rnams su mi 'dra ba ci rigs bshad kyang lag len du dkar po kho na mdzad/ ye shes skar khung ma la chos 'byung gi stabs dbu ma cung zad sbom par bsgom dgos/ thig le dbang bzhi'i gnad la'ang de dang 'dra/ chos 'byung yang phyi dkar nang dmar sogs ci rigs bshad mod de/ bar do'i skabs ma gtogs/ chos drug gzhung gi dmigs pa'i chos 'byung thams cad dkar po kho nar mdzad pa zhal rgyun yin/thabs lam dang 'od gsal gyi skabs na lus thams cad dbu mas khyab par bsgom lus re yig rnying kun na bshad mod kyang / las dang po pa'i skabs na de rang phan chung mi dgos gsung ste khrid kyi dkyus la mi mdzad do/ /drug pa bar do rgyal ba longs sku ni rnam pa bzhi ste/ rab bar do dang po'i 'od gsal chos sku rang shar/ 'bring rgyal ba longs sku rang shar/ tha ma sprul sku 'gag med rang shar/ spyir gnad 'chug med kyi gdams ngag ste/ sa bcad bzhi yod la/ de'i dang po ni/ gong 'pho bya 'pho byed dang bral ba dang don gcig ste/ de yang bar do dang po zhes pa ni/ 'od gsal ma bu 'dres pa'i ye shes 'chi sems bde stong 'od gsal du gnas gyur pa de yin te/ bar do'i dang por byung bas so/ /de la 'chi ba chos sku zhes bya/ de las langs pa na tha mal pa rnams la bar do 'byung ba'i dod la lha sku sgyu ma lta bu rang shar du 'byung ba de la 'od gsal rang shar zer/ 'od gsal las rang shar ba'i go ba yin no/ /de yang sad dus su bde stong dang lha sku rgyun mi 'chad/ gnyid 'thug po thams cad 'od gsal du chug rmi lam gyi rtsal spyong zad pa yang med la dag snang lha skur rang shar —305—

ba'i gang zag de la bar do dang po'i 'od gsal rang shar chos sku 'di 'byung ba yin no/ /'di la dmigs pa logs pa med/ skabs 'dir de dag gi rnam bzhag rgyas par 'chad 'dod na chos thun gcig gnyis sogs ji ltar 'os pa byed/ gnyis pa 'bring rgyal ba longs sku rang shar ni/ sngon 'gro babs sgyu lus dang 'dra ba las/ bar do longs sku thob par mdzad du gsol ces mtha' bsgyur/bla ma rang la thim pa'i rjes su/ rang dang snang ba thams cad la bltas te/ srid pa bar do dngos yin snyam pa'i 'dun pa yang drag po sbyangs/ 'gro drug 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal dang / chags sdang nyon mongs kyi nyes dmigs dran pa'i skyo shas drag po yang bya/ bar do'i skabs 'dir/ 'khrul na 'khrul tshabs che ste chags sdang gi rnam rtog re res kyang skad cig la dmyal bar yang bskyur rung /lam bsgoms na grol tshabs kyang che ste/ da lta sad dus su lo zlar bsgoms pa las kyang / 'dir dar cig re bsgoms pa yang bogs dang chod che ba yin/ da nyon mongs kyi dbang du mi gtong bar ma 'khrul ba zhig byed dgos/ bla mas gnang ba'i rgyal ba longs sku bsgom par bya snyam du bsam/ stong pa'i ngang las rang gi mdun du chos 'byung sngon po rtsa ba phra zhing gdengs kha gyen du bstan pa zhig bsgom/ 'dir rang bzhin ma rtogs pa rnams la ma'i mngal du 'dug /rtogs pa rnams la 'og min chos kyi pho brang rang yin ang snyam du bsam par bya/de nas rang nyid de'i dbus su phyin/ rang sems hu yig sngon po che zhing 'od 'bar ba zhig tu gyur/ de las 'od 'phros chos 'byung la phog/'das pa'i mngal skyes kyi lan chags dang bag chags thams cad sbyangs/ da ltar ba'i mngal skyes —306—

kyi las thams cad kyang dag /ma 'ongs pa skye bar 'gyur ba'i sgo bkag /skye gnas gzhan gsum gyi bag chags rnams zhor la rang dag par bsam/ bar do yin ang snyam hū de yongs su gyur pa las rang skad cig gis 'khor lo bde mchog lhan skyes su bsgom/ bar do yin ang snyam spyi bor gdan bzhi rdzogs kyi steng du bla ma bsgom/ bar do'i skabs 'dir longs sku thob par mdzad du gsol/ zhes rtse gcig tu gsol ba btab/ de ltar dmigs pa sgom pa'i skabs thams cad du bar do rang yin snyam pa'i 'dun pa rgyun chags gal che/dmigs skor nga bzhi pa'o/ /gsum pa tha ma sprul sku 'gag med rang shar ni/ dmigs pa snga ma de rdzogs par bsgoms nas/ de'i steng du 'di bsnan te/ 'di thams cad bar do yin snang ba 'di bsgyur bar bya'o snyam pas/ gzugs su snang tshad 'khor lo sdom pa'i skur bsgyur dgos snyam pa byas tsa na/ thams cad he ru ka yab yum du khrong khrong song / sgra grags tshad sngags yi ge bdun pa lta bu gcig tu bsgyur snyam pa byas tsa na/ sngags de nyid du 'ur 'ur byung / bde sdug chags sdang sogs yid dran rtog yul dang bcas pa thams cad sgyu ma lta bu rmi lam lta bu zhes nyin par drag tu bsgom/ rmi lam shar ba na de nyid du sgyur ba gsum po dran par byas pa tsam gyis nyon mongs sdug bsngal thams cad las rang grol bar 'gyur ro/ /bzhi pa spyi gnad 'chug med ni/ skabs 'dir bla ma phal cher 'di skad gsung ste/ 'dir dbang po tha ma'i yang tha ma zhes spyi gnad 'chug med dbang po dman pa'i nyams len gyi dbang du byas nas/ bshad ma thag pa sprul sku 'gag med kyi —307—

dmigs pa yongs rdzogs kho na bsgom pa'i steng du/ 'di snon par mdzad pa 'ga' zhig 'dug ste/ lar bar do'i dmigs pa phyi ma gsum po rkang tshugs pa gsum ma yin/ snga ma la phyi ma phyi ma bsnan pa'o/ /zhes gsung ngo / /phyogs gcig nas de ltar yin mod kyang / de kho nar byas na spyi gnad 'chug med ces pa'i spyi sgra nus med du 'gro bas/ dmigs pa 'di dbang po 'bring gi nyams len la yang snon dgos pa srid/ tha ma'i nyams len la yang snon dgos zhes pa'i don du snang zhing / de ltar na bar do rang dbang po rab 'bring gsum gyi nyams len du 'dus pas/ dbang po bzhi pa'i rnam bzhag mi dgos par mngon la/ them yig gi mchan bu dang / tshig gsal du'ang / spyi gnad 'chug med gsung ba ma gtogs dbang po'i rim pa dang sbyar ba med do/ /des na 'bring dang tha ma'i dmigs pa gang ltar yang rung ste/ dmigs pa 'di bsnan te bsgoms na 'drug pa med ces pa'i don yin par snang ngo / /ji skad du/ bla ma yi dam sgyu lus gsum/ /'bral ba med par lam du khyer/ /bar do'i 'jigs pa chen po la/ /'chug pa med pa'i man ngag gces/ /zhes pa ltar/ /bar do'i 'dun pa drag po dang bcas pas/ spyir 'gro ba rigs drug gi nang nas skye 'gro pho thams cad dang / khyad par du zhe sdang skye ba'i yul thams cad rang nyid gnas pa'i chos 'byung gi g.yas zur phyogs su 'khod par bsgom/ mchod pa bzhi rdzogs su phul nas/ bar dor longs sku thob par mdzad du gsol/ zhes bya/ yang 'gro ba rigs drug tu gtogs pa'i sems can mo thams cad dang / khyad par 'dod chags skye ba'i yul thams cad chos 'byung gi g.yon zur du 'khod par bsgom/—308—

zab lam ni gu chos drug gi khrid yig zab don thang mar brdal ba bzhugs/ma rtsod pa bzhi rdzogs su phul nas/ bar dor longs sku thob par mdzad du gsol/ /ces gsol ba btab/ slar yang bla ma'i mos gus dang / rang gzhan lha skur gsal ba dang / bden med kyi 'dun pa shugs bskyed pas rgyab brten no/ /de ltar yang yang bsgom/ rten bud med kyis bsgom pa'i dbang du byas na/chags sdang skye ba'i yul go brje bar bya'o/ /yang rang gang du gnas pa'i chos 'byung sngon po de shin tu yangs par bsgoms pa'i g.yas g.yon gyi nang zur du de dag bsgom dgos pa yin na'ang / der bsgom mi bde dmigs pa mi gsal na/de'i thad kyi bar snang nam mkha' thams cad dang phyi rol du'ang bsgom du wo gsung / yang bla ma'i zhal nas thog mar rang yi dam de/ chos 'byung gi mdun gyi zur la zhal bstan pa yin kyang / skabs 'dir chos 'byung gi rgyab phyogs la zhal bsgyur bas/ rigs drug lha skur bsgyur ba la mdun gyis phyogs par 'ong /mchod pa dang gsol 'debs byed dgos pas de ltar bya gsung / dmigs skor nga drug pa'o/ /de ltar na dmigs skor lnga bcu nga drug gi steng du stong ra nad gdon sel byed dang / sgyu lus dbang po tha ma'i sa bcad phyi ma gnyis dang / 'od gsal gyi mthar thug dang / rjes kyi sa bcad lnga dang / 'pho ba bar do'i dang po re re rnams bsnan pas chos thun drug cu re bdun yin la/ da lta tshig khrid tsam thob chos su byed pa la thun gyi nges pa med do/ /dmigs thun dngos su yod med la ma rag par thun re la dmigs pa re'i tha snyad sbyar nas/ dmigs pa drug cu rtsa bdun ces kyang bya'o/ /—309—

na mo gu sa zab lam ni gu'i chos drug 'di la/ yan lag mtha' rgyas su ston pa'i rgyas pa dang / spyi nye bar bsdus pa'i 'bring por dang / don ma tshang med pa'i bsdus pa dang / gnad mthil du bsgril ba'i shin tu bsdus pa ste bzhi yod/ dang po ni/ chos drug bka' bcur grags pa'i dbang rnams kyang rdzogs par bskul/ rmi lam gyi khrid rdzogs mtshams su sgyu lus stan thog gcig ma dang / 'dzin pa rang grol/ sbyong ba rnam gnyis/ dmigs pa lnga skor sogs dang 'byams gcod rgyas pa nas len gyin 'chad pa yin/ 'od gsal rdzogs rma cha gru/sa su 'od gsal 'char sgo ngos 'dzen dang lhan thabs su 'bri bar 'gyur ba'i 'dam kha tsho yang ston pa yin ste/ 'on kyang phyis kyi phyag len la dmigs pa kha skong de rnams mi byed par gda' dbang rnams rdzogs par bskur ro/ /de la bka' bcu po so so'i dus mtshams skabs su bab pa der bskur bar 'dod na/dang por bde mchog lha lnga'i dbang bzhi rdzogs par bskur/ sngon 'gro spyi dang /skyabs 'gro sems bskyed song mtshams su/ yid dam 'bogs pa'i tshul yin pas/ bde mchog lha lnga'i ting nge 'dzin gyi dbang de bskur/ chos drug bka' bcu dngos la mi the yang / rgyud sde lnga'i ting nge 'dzin gyi dbang de yang stong ra'i khrid kyi skabs gang 'os re ru mdzad kyin ni 'dug/sngon 'gro'i khrid tshar gtum mo'i khrid ma tshugs pa'i mtshams der gtum mo'i sgos bka' bskur/ gtum mo dang / sgyu lus kyi bar skabs su/ sgyu lus kyi sgos bka' byed/ de dang rmi lam gyi khrid kyi bar du rmi lam gyi sgos bka' byed/ de dang 'od gsal gyi khrid kyi bar du/ 'od gsal gyi sgos bka' byed pa rnams la mi 'dra ba med/ rgyas pa'i —310—

skabs 'dir sgyu lus dbang mo che ni/ kha cig bsre ba sgyu lus gyi dkyil gyi thad rang yin gsung nas/ rmi lam sbyong spel gyi skabs gang 'thad du byed/ la la bsre ba'i mjug yin pas gsung 'od gsal gyi dngos gzhi song mtshams su mdzad de khyad chen po rang med na'ang / phyi ma 'thad par sems/ de bzhin du 'pho ba dang / bar do'i sgos bka' yang so so'i khrid kyi 'gor mdzad pa la mi 'dra ba med/ 'pho ba bar do spyi'i bka' de/ skabs sna tshogs gcig tu byed kyang bar do'i khrid kyi mjug tu byed nga/ nyid legs so/ bdag gi rnam rtog ltar na/lha lnga'i ting nge 'dzin gyi dbang bskur dang / rgyud sde lnga'i ting nge 'dzin gyi dbang bskur gnyis las/ gang rigs gcig kun gyi tha mar byas na legs par 'ong ngo sems so /de la chos drug gi bka' bcu ni/ byin rlabs sgo 'byed kyi bka' gnyis/byin rlabs khog phubs kyi bka' gnyis/ byin rlabs gzhung shing gi bka' drug go /de la bar pa gnyis ni spyi'i bka' gnyis la zer ba dang / phyi ma drug ni sgos bka' drug la ngos 'dzin pa la rtsod pa med/ dang po gnyis kyi ngos 'dzin la/ kha cig bde mchog lha lnga dang / rgyud sde lnga'i dbang bsdus pa gnyis la 'dod pa yang yod do/ /de ltar 'dod mkhan gyi nang tshan la la ni/ bde mchog lha lnga'i dbang rgyas pa yod pa ma tshor ba yang yin la/ kha cig ni dkyil chog gi gzhung don ma khrol bar dbang bskur byed ma shes par snang / gzhan 'ga' ni lha lnga'i dbang bskur che ba ni/ ni gu'i lugs kyi smin byed yin kyang chos drug sgos kyi min pas/ bka' bcu la mi bgrang zer te/ mdor na 'di la phyis byung —311—

lag len byed pa nyung bar byung ngo / /de'i rgyu ni 'di ltar yin te/ 'gro mgon rin po che'i rjes su/ mkhas grub rnam gsum dngos slob dang bcas pa'i skabs su/ 'di lag len du dar ba yod cing mchod phreng la sogs pa'i lhan thabs 'ga' re mdzad mod/ cho ga dngos zor yang zhing gzhung gzhan la kha 'phangs pa dang lag len khyer bde ba'i stabs/ yi ge gsal po cher ma mdzad par snang /de la yang spyir mkhas grub gzhon nu grub ni/ phyi dkyil gcig tu dbang bskur rgyas pa ma song ba la phyag chen chos drug sogs yi mi gnang ba yin par 'dug/dam bsgrags kyang cher mdzad par gda'/ mkhas grub gzhan gnyis kyis dam sbrags rang ma mdzad kyang phyag len de dang 'dra/ de ltar yin yang phyis kyi rnams sgom chen pa spyi 'di'i mig dkyus shor/ rgyud sde lnga'i dbang chen po 'di lo dang zla ba mang por grabs byas nas lkog bshams pa'i lan re tsam bskur ba ma gtogs/ dbang bzhi rdzogs kyi rigs 'phral 'phral mdzad pa ma lcogs nas/rang ngam gzhan la dbang rgyas pa gang rung de snga rol nas thob na rab byed/ de min smin byed rgyas pa gzhan ye ma thon cing lha lnga'i smin byed tsam yang ma byas par khrid 'debs pa'i srol cig byung / de phyin chad bla chos kyi dbang gis lha lnga rgyas pa la don gnyer cher ma byung ba'i skyon du 'dug/de ni byed ma shes chos drug gi bka' bcu po bgrang dgos byung bas/ lha lnga'i dbang rgyas pa'i tshab la cig shos de bcug pa tsam mo/ /gzhan yang ye shes mkha' 'gro'i lugs 'di la chos drug nyid lam gyi rkang dang rtsa ba yin pas spyi'i smin byed yin nam/ chos drug gi rkang dang 'gal snyam pa'i log rtog mi bya'o/ /des na byin rlabs sgo —312—

'byed kyi bka' gnyis ni/ bde mchog lha lnga'i dbang che chung gnyis yin/ rgyud sde lnga gtso bsdus kyi dbang ni/ yi dam gtad pa yin pas spyi khyab tu gser chos thams cad dang 'brel ba'ang yin mod/ gzhung bka' nyer lnga rang la mi 'brang ngo / /de ltar na chos drug nyid la yan lag mtha' rgyas su byed tshul de ltar yin la/ gnyis pa spyi nye bar bsdus pa 'bring ni/ byin rlabs sgo 'byed kyi dbang sgyu lus dbang mo che kho na la bsdu/ de yang deng sang phal cher rjes su byed kyin 'dug na'ang / bka' gzhan rnams mi byed pa'i stabs khrid kyi thog mar byas na legs/ sbyong ba rnam gnyis sogs cha lag rnams mi dgos/ khrid dmigs gzhung rkyang de yongs su rdzogs par byed pa'o/ /gsum pa don ma tshang ba med par bsdus pa ni/ sgyu lus dbang mo che de bskur dgos/ khrid tshul 'di la sngon 'gro dang / dngos gzhi gnyis zhes/ dang po ni dag byed a'i stong ra ste dmigs skor cig /skyabs sems sngon du byed dgos kyang dmigs skor logs su mi 'dren no/ /dngos gzhi la chos drug las/gtum mo la sngon 'gro lus gnad me'i stong ra/ dngos gzhi gtum mo zas su za ba/ rjes srid pa'i dbang zhu ba ste dmigs skor gsum mo/ /sgyu lus la/ rang lus snang stong lha sku/ cir snang sgyu ma'i lam khyer/ 'gro drug sgyu mar 'char byed de gsum mo/ /rmi lam bzung ba la/ rang zin thig le dbang bzhi'i gnad dang /rtog bcas lam khyer gnyis/ sbyong ba la zung du bsdebs pa gang rung / gcig go gsungs yang / sems kyi lus sbyong ba dang / 'dun pas sbyong ba gnyis sdeb/yul snang gi nang nas thig le yul snang gsal byed de/ rmi lam kyi khrid la rtsa —313—

ba'i sa bcad/ bzung ba/ sbyong ba/ yul snang gsum la dmigs skor lnga'o/ /'od gsal gyi skabs su/ mi rtag skyo shas dang / bla ma'i mos gus thun gyi sngon 'gro btang / thabs lam rang mdangs dang // spyod lam dam rdzas dang / lam mkhyer rnams thun mtshams kyi spyod pa la btang / bzung ba'i dmigs pa gsum po gang rung zhig bsgom gsungs kyang / bla ma la bzung ba kho na lag len gyi mthil du mdzad/ de ltar na 'od gsal gyi khrid la bzung ba dang / bsre ba'o/ /bsre ba la gsal stong bsre ba dang / nyin mtshan bsre ba'o/ /zhes bsdus don byed de/ gsal stong bsre ba/ nyin mtshan bsre ba ste/ 'od gsal la dmigs pa gsum mo/ /'pho ba la ye shes skar khung ma ste dmigs pa gcig go /bar do la rgyal ba longs sku lam khyer dang / gnad 'chug med gnyis bsdoms nas dmigs chen gcig ste/ de ltar na/ chos drug bsdus pa dmigs chen bcu bdun no/ /gnad mthil du dril ba ni stan thog gcig ma ste/ logs su 'chad par 'gyur ro/ /de ltar mkha' 'gro'i gsung gi bcud/ /zab don bla ma'i zhal bum 'di/ /yig bris mang du yod na yang / /de dag rnams la ma ltos so/ /zhal rgyun dmar khrid ma chad pa/ /blo la 'thems par byas nas ni/ /yig rnying khungs ma'i sbas skungs rnams/ /mdzub btsugs byed na mkhas pa yin/ /lar ni nyams myong rgyun med na/ khrigs bkod tsam gyis ga la phan/ /bla ma'i byin rlabs nyams myong rgyun/ /sems la thebs pa gal re che/ /zhes pa zab lam ni gu chos drug gi dmigs rim rgyas bsdus gab 'khrugs med par bkod pa 'di yang tā ra nā thas so// //sarba ma ṅga lam//—314—

mkha' 'gro bye ba'i thugs kyi bcud/ /chos drug snying po'i gdams pa ste/ /grol lam zab mo bla na med/ /thun mong min gang bri bar bya/ / 'dir rgyud sde lnga'i yang snying ni gu chos drug bsdus pa nyams len gnad du 'gra ( pa ba 'di la sngon 'gro dang / dngos gzhi gnyis las/ dang po la thun mong gi sngon 'gro dang /thun mong ma yin pa'i sngon 'gro gnyis thun mong gi sngon 'gro skyabs 'gro sems bskyed/ thun mong ma yin pa'i sngon 'gro dag byed a'i stong ra'o/ / dang po ni/mdun gyi nam mkha'i dbyings su seng ge chen po brgyad kyis btegs pa'i rin po che'i khri yangs shing rgya che ba'i steng du/ sna tshogs pad+ma nyi ma zla ba'i gdan gyi steng du ngo bo drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma rnam pa rdo rje 'chang sku mdog sngon po zhal cig /phyag gnyis rdo rje dang dril bu thugs kar bsnol te 'dzin pa/ zhabs rdo rje'i skyil krung / sku la mtshan dang dpe byed kyi spras shing / dar gyi na bza' dang rin po ches brgyan pa/ bdag la dgyes pa'i zhal 'dzum bag dang ldan par bsam/ de la bdag rigs drug gi sems can thams cad skyabs zhu bar mos shing / blos ling bkal te skyid sdug ci byung rung bla ma rang mkhyen snyam pas/'gro ba nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad skyabs kun 'dus bla ma rin po che la skyabs su mchi ba lags so/ /zhes lan bdun sogs ci rigs bya/ mdun gyi bla ma rdo rje 'chang de 'od du ltem gyis bzhu ste rang la thim pas bla —315—

ma'i thugs dang rang gi sems dbyer med chu la chu bzhag pa lta bur gyur par bsam pa'i ngang de ka la had de mnyam par bzhag /sems bskyed ni/ nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad bdag gi drin can gyi pha mar ma gyur pa med/ 'di rnams zung 'jug rdo rje 'chang chen po'i go 'phang la 'god par bya snyam pas/ ngag nas sems can thams cad kyi don du zung 'jug rdo rje'i 'chang chen po'i go 'phang thob par bya/ de'i phyir du bdag gis zab lam ni gu chos drug nyams su blang bar bya'o/ /zhes lan gsum tsam bya/ /gnyis pa thun mong ma yin pa'i sngon 'gro ni/ rang gi spyi bor drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma sku gzi mdangs dang ldan pa/ bdag la da dgyes pa'i zhal 'dzus bag dang ldan pa zhig bsgoms la/ ngag tu dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad 'dus pa'i ngo bo bla ma rin po che/ sems can thams cad kyi don du bdag gi nad gdon thams cad zhi bar mdzad du gsol/ sdig sgrib thams cad 'dag par mdzad du gsol/ ting nge 'dzin khyad par can rgyud la skye bar mdzad du gsol/zhes gsol ba btab pas/ bla ma 'od du zhu rang la thim/ klad pa gti mug gi rang bzhin can sbyangs te/ thod pa 'ja' 'od dkar po'i gur khyim lta bu/ de'i dbus su chos 'byung dkar po gru gsum pa rtsa ba phra ba mgrin par zug pa/gdengs ka che ba gyen du bstan pa zur gcig mdzode pu dang / gnyis rna ltag g.yas g.yon du bstan pa/ de'i dbus su a dkar po 'od 'phro ba/ phyed chos 'byung gi steng du 'thon cing / phyed nang du chud pa'i tshad tsam rten med du lding ba la sems gtad de ci nus bsgom/ de nas a dkar po de las bdud rtsi dkar —316—

po'i rgyun byung / chos 'byung gang de lud nas lus kyi phyi nang thams cad gang /sdig sgrib thams cad phyir bdas te sgo dgu dang ba sbu'i phug nas ded pa'i tshul gyis dud khu'am sol khu'i rnam par nag nur ru ru thon par bsam/ yang bdud rtsis lus kyi phyi na mar zhal zhal byung nas bkrus nas sa 'og thag ring por song bar bsam/ rang lus dkar la dwangs pa 'ja' dkar po lta bur bsam pa cung zad mnyam par gzhag /bde chen 'khor lo zla ba'i cha/ /skye med yig 'bru dam pa las/ /ye shes bdud rtsi rtag babs pas/ /sgrib pa'i dri ma kun bkrus so/ /༈ dngos gzhi la drug ste/ thabs lam bde drod rang 'bar/ sgyu lus chags sdang rang grol/ rmi lam nying 'khrul rang dag /'od gsal gti mug rang sangs/ 'pho ba ma sgom sangs rgyas/ bar do rgyal ba longs sku'o/ /dang po thabs lam la sngon 'gro dngos gzhi rjes gsum las/ sngon 'gro lus gnad me'i stong ra ni/ rang gi spyi bor rtsa ba'i bla ma rdo rje 'chang sku mdog dkar po zhig bsgoms la/ dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad 'dus pa'i ngo bo bla ma rin po che/ sems can thams cad kyi don du bdag gi lus la bde drod kyi ting nge 'dzin khyad par can skye bar mdzad du gsol/ sems la bde stong gi ting nge 'dzin khyad par can skye bar mdzad du gsol/ bla ma 'od du zhu rang la thim rang rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma sku mdog dmar mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis g.yas gri gug dang / g.yon thod khrag thugs kar 'dzin pa/ zhabs g.yas brkyang g.yon cung zad bskum pas/ mi ro dkar po mgo g.yas su bstan pa'i snying ga mnan pa/ mi mgo skam po lnga'i dbu brgyan/ rlon pa lnga bcu do shal can/ rus —317—

pa'i rgyan lnga dang ldan pa/ sku lus kyi nang thams cad khong stong du bsam/ me'i gong bu dmar zhing tsha ba bya sgong tsam bzhi lte ba'i thad kyi rgyab mdun mkhal ma'i thad gnyis te bzhir bsgom/ de la dmigs bzhin du rlung ro lan gsum 'bud/rlung dal bus nang du rngubs la/ lte ba'i 'og tu tshir gyis mnan/ lte ba cung zad bskor bas me gong rnams gcig la gcig 'thabs te/ /me stag dmar skyas lus kyi nang thams cad dmar chil ba dang tsha 'ur gyis gang bar bsam/gnyis pa dngos gzhi gtum mo zas su za ba ni/ rang rdo rje rnal 'byor mar gsal ba'i lus kyi dbus na mar rtsa dbu ma sbom phra mda' snyug 'bring po tsam mas sna lte 'og sor bzhir zug pa/ yas sna tshang bug tu zug pa/ mtshan nyid bzhi ldan te/ drang ba/ srab pa/dwangs pa/ dmar ba ste mtshan nyid bzhi'o/ /de yang khong stod du gnas pa/ de'i g.yas su ro ma dmar po/ g.yon du rkyang ma dkar mo/ de gnyis dbu ma las bun 'gros kyi phra ba mas sna gnyis dbu ma'i nang du cung zad chud cing / yas sna gnyis tshangs bug gi 'og thad du dbu ma la bkab pa'i tshul gyi mdun du gug nas cung zad gyes pa sna bug gnyis su zug pa dbu ma'i nang gi yas snar haX dkar po mgo bo thur bstan/ mas snar ram dmar po mgo gyen bstan/ 4nang sgor rma gi dkyil 'khor zla gam sngo skya rab tu g.yo ba rnams bsam/ /rlud ro dgu phrugs su bus/ /dal bus nang du rngubs la lte 'og tu mnan/ 'og rlung zad 'then la kha sbyor bzung bas lte ba'i raX las me phra zhing rno ba rim gyis 'bar ba spyi bo'i haX la phog pas thig le dkar po'i rgyun babs/ lte bar 'bar 'dzag skra shad 'dzings pa lta bu la sems gtad/—318—

gsum pa rjes srid pa'i dbang zhu ba ni/ bla ma rdo rje 'chang bskyed pa'i bar gong bzhin/ phyi nang gsang ba de kho na nyid kyi mchod pa dpag tu med pa yid kyis sprul la phul bar bsam zhing / dus gsum sangs rgyas 'dus pa'i ngo bo bla ma rin po che la/ phyi me tog bdug spos/ nang sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga/ gsal ba bde stong gi ye shes/ yang gsang de kho na nyid kyi mchod pa dam pa rnams 'bul lo/ /bzhes nas bdag la dbang bzhi rdzogs par bskur du gsol/zhes gsol ba btab pas/ bla ma'i sku las bdud rtsi'i rgyun dkar po dpag tu med pa byung/ rang gi spyi bo nas zhugs smin mtshams yan chad gang / lus kyi dri ma dag bum pa'i dbang thob/ mgrin pa yan chad gang / ngag gi dri ma dag /gsang ba'i dbang thob/ snying ga yan chad gang / yid kyi dri ma dag khres rab ye shes kyi dbang thob/ lus thams gang / bla ma yang 'od du zhu rang la thim/ lus ngag yid gsum gyi dri ma mtha' dag dag /dbang bzhi pa thob par bsams la cung zad mnyam par bzhag go /thig le 'bar 'dzag dga' bzhi'i 'gros/ /bde stong ye shes rmad byung che/ /bsod nams ye shes dbyer med pas/ /sangs rgyas lag rtser skad cig la'o/ /༈ gnyis pa sgyu lus ni/ pad+ma dang nyi ma'i gdan gyi steng du/ rang nyid dpal 'khor lo bde mchog sku mdog sngon po zhal gcig phyag gnyis rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pas yum la 'khyud pa/ mi mgo skam po lnga'i dbu brgyan dang /rlon pa lnga bcu'i do shal 'phyang zhing rus pa'i rgyan drug dang ldan pa/ stag gi lpags pa'i sham thabs can/ zhabs g.yon cung zad bskums pas 'jigs —319—

byed sngon po dang / g.yas brkyangs pas dus mtshan ma dmar mo mnan pa/ de'i pang du yum rdo rje rnal 'byor ma sku mdog dmar mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma g.yas gri gug dang / g.yon thod khrag 'dzin pas yab la 'khyud pa/ rang gi spyi bor seng ge chen po brgyad kyi btegs pa'i khri sna tshogs pad+ma nyi ma zla ba brtsegs pa'i gdan la bla ma rdo rje 'chang sku mdog sngon po de'i thugs ka nas 'od zer dpag tu med pa 'phros pas/ phyogs bcu'i bla ma yi dam sangs rgyas dge 'dun mkha' 'gro chos skyong thams cad spyan drangs te bla ma la bstim/ de nas rigs drug sems can rnams yid mos gus gdung shugs drag pos gsol 'debs kyi sgra 'ur dir bar byed par bsam zhing / dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad 'dus pa'i ngo bo bla ma rin po che/ sems can thams cad kyi don du bdag 'dzin blos thongs par mdzad du gsol/ dgos med rgyud la skye bar mdzad du gsol/ sgyu lus 'byongs par mdzad du gsol/ rmi lam 'byongs par mdzad du gsol/ 'od gsal phyag rgya chen po mchog gi dngos grub da lta nyid du/myur ba nyid du/ 'dug sa 'di nyid du thob par mdzad du gsol/ zhes gsol ba drag tu btab pas/ bla ma 'od du zhu rang la thim/ rang gi lte ba'i thad kyi lus nang du chos 'byung dkar po gru gsum pa/ rtsa ba phra ba gsang gnas su zug pa/gdengs ka che ba gyen du bstan pa/ zur gcig lte ba dang / gnyis mkhal khung gnyis kyi thad du zug pa/ de la sems cung zad gtad pas chos 'byung gi nang du 'gro drug sems can dpag tu med nga/ra byung bar bsam/ 'di rnams snang ni snang / bden ni mi bden/ bden med sgyu ma lta bu yin/ rmi lam lta bu yin/—320—

bden med la bden par bzung nas/ 'khor bar 'khyams pa snying re rje/ 'di rnams 'khor ba las thar par bla ma mkhyen snyam pa bya/ rim gyi de rnams yal nas chos 'byung stong sang nge ba dang / de yang yal ba dang / ci yang mi bsam par mnyam par bzhag /snang stong sgyu ma'i rtsis zin pas/ gang shar thams cad lha sku yin/ /sgyu mar shes na sangs rgyas dang / /dmyal ba la yang khyad ci yod/ /༈ gsum pa rmi lam nying 'khrul rang dag la drug ste/ rmi lam bzung ba/sbyang ba/ spel ba/ sprul pa/ yul snang ba gtan la dbab pa'o/ /dang po bzung ba ni/ bla ma rdo rje 'chang du bskyed pa yan chad sgyu lus kyi skabs bzhin las/ dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ngo bo bla ma rin po che/ sems can thams cad kyi don du bdag gi bdag 'dzin blos thongs par mdzad du gsol/ dgos med rgyud la skye bar mdzad du gsol/ rmi lam zin par mdzad du gsol/ zhes gso ba btab pas/ bla ma 'od du zhu rang la thim/ rang gi lus kyi nang du rtsa dbu ma kha dog dkar po sbom na lag ngar tsam/ phra na sba snyug tsam/ mas sna gsang gnas su zug cing / yas sna myongs bug tu zug pa/ shel gyi ka ba btsugs pa lta bu/de'i yas sna'i nang du ha dkar po mgo bo thur du lta ba/ mas sna'i nang du hū dmar po mgo bo gyen du lta ba bsam/ spyi bo'i ha las thig le dkar po sran ma tsam cig chad snying gar babs/ gti mug dag /mas sna'i hū las thig le dmar po sran ma tsam zhig chad/ snying gar sleb/ 'dod chags dag /de gnyis snying gar 'dzoms pas zhe sdang rang dag la song bar bsam/ rmi lam 'dun pa drag po'i ngang nas snying ga'i thad kyi dbu ma'i nang du thig le gnyis 'bros 'ded kyi —321—

tshul du g.yas skor du 'khor zhing / ji zhig na reg tsam reg tsam dang / de nas reg pas lus sems bde chil chil ba dang / mthar thig le gnyis gcig la gcig thim nas gtad med du yal ba la dmigs med du bzhag /'di rmi lam rang yin snyam 'dun pa drag po bya'o/ /thig le 'khor ba bum dbang / reg pa gsang dbang lus sems bde chil ba shes rab ye shes kyi dbang / mtha' yal ba dbang bzhi pa'i gnad dang 'brel ba yin/ gnyis pa rmi lam sbyang ba ni/gsol 'debs skabs zin pa zhes pa'i tshab tu 'byongs par mdzad du gsol/zer dgos la gzhan 'dra'o/ /rmi lam gyi 'dun pa drag pos gdong du dngos po ci yod la phar thal tshur thal du 'gro ba dang / gzhan yang nam mkha' la 'phur ba dang / sa 'og la 'dzul ba sogs ci dran dran gyis sbyong / 'jigs pa dang /skyug bro ba dang / ngo tsha ba dang / ya nga ba thams cad la thog brdzis kyi dmigs pa bya/ spel ba sogs lhag ma chos tshan bzhi po re zhig bzhag go /thabs kyi gsang ba'i 'khrul chen po/ /'dun pas skad cig nyid la yang / cho 'phrul dpag med a 'thas bral/ /'khor ba'i rgya mdud yud kyis grol/ /༈ bzhi pa 'od gsal gti mug rang sangs la/ 'od gsal bzung ba ni/rang yi dam du gsal ba'i spyi bor gdan bzhi rdzogs kyi steng du/ bla ma rdo rje 'chang rus rgyan stag lpags sogs dur khrod kyi chas brgyad kyis brgyan pa la/dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad 'dus pa'i ngo bo bla ma rin po che/ sems can thams cad kyi don du bdag 'dzin: /dgos med: /'od gsal zin par mdzad du gsol/ zhes gsol ba 'debs/ lhag ma sngon 'gro sgyu lus dang 'dra/—322—

rang lus kyi dbus su rtsa dbu ma dkar po de'i snying ga'i thad du pad+ma dkar po 'dab ma bzhi pa/ de'i steng du rang gi rtsa ba'i bla ma rdo rje 'chang sku mdog dkar po tshon gang ba/ thugs kar thig le sran ma tsam dngul chu'i mdog lta bu 'od 'phro ba/ hu gi 'od kyis bla ma gsal bar byas/ bla ma'i 'od kyis rang lus thams cad gsal bar byas shing / hūṃ la sems gtad la mnyam par bzhag go /gti mug na bun tshogs de rnams/ /'od gsal nam mkha'i dbyings su zhi/khams gsum khyab pa'i nyi 'od 'dis/ /smra rgyu med pa'i don cig mthong / /༈ lnga pa 'pho ba ni/ rang yi dam du gsal ba'i spyi bor bla ma sgom pa'i bar sgyu lus kyi skabs bzhin/ gsol 'debs ni/ bar dor sangs rgya bar mdzad du gsol/ zhes 'don pa spos la gzhan gong ltar gsol ba btab/ lus kyi nang du rtsa dbu ma dkar zhing dwangs pa sbom phra sba lcag tsam/ mas sna gsang gnas zug cing kha zum pa/ yas sna spyi bo'i tshangs bug rgya mthong kha phye ba ltar skya thal le ba yod pa la zug cing 'brel ba/ nye ba'i thad kyi dbu ma'i nang du chos 'byung dkar po shin tu gsal ba rtsa ba thur du zug pa/ gdengs ka gyen du bstan pa'i zur gcig lte ba dang / gnyis g.yas g.yon du bstan/ de'i dbus su a dkar po 'dar zhing g.yo ba 'phir la khad pa zhig bsam/ rlung ro lan gsum 'bud/ de nas nang du rngubs de nas lte 'og tu cung zad mnan/ 'og rlung drag tu 'then/ rang gi lto ba sgal tshigs la lan gsum gdab pas/ rlung gi shugs dag gis a de mda' 'phangs pa bzhin du dbu ma'i nang tshangs bug nas skya rgyang thon/ nam mkha' la yal gyis song bar bsam/ de ltar yang bdun tsam

bya/ de rjes a de nam mkha' nas skya lam de spyi bor babs/ tshangs bug nas zhugs/ dbu ma'i nang gi chos 'byung du sleb/ lus bde chil byung zhing / a de brjid dang ldan par gyur/ de 'pho ba'i dmigs thun cig yin/ de nyid yang yang bsgom/ thun 'jog na tshangs bug kha zum par bsam/ btsan thabs 'pho ba'i gdams ngag 'dis/ /mtshams med byas pa'ang grol bar 'gyur/ /dbyings su 'pho ba 'di yis chog /'gro ba drug tu 'khor bas ci/ /༈ drug pa bar do ni/ gsol 'debs kyi sham bur longs sku thob par mdzad du gsol/ zhes 'don/ rang gi mdun du chos 'byung sngon po/ chos 'byung de'i dbus su rang nyid phyin pas yi ge hūṃX sngon por gyur/ de las 'od zer 'phros/ chos 'byung la phog pas/ rigs drug tu sngar skyes pa dang / da lta skyes pa'i lan chags sbyangs/ ma 'ongs pa'i skye sgo bkag /hūṃX yongs su gyur pa las rang nyid 'khor lo bde mchog tu gsal ba'i spyi bor bla ma bsgom/ bar do longs sku thob par mdzad du gsol/ /zhes gsol ba btab/ gzugs su snang ba thams cad yi dam 'khor lo bde mchog tu bsgom/ sgra grags pa thams cad oṃ hriXha ha hūṃX hūṃX phaṭa la sogs pa yi dam gyi sngags su bsgom/ dran rig gi yul yid la shar ba thams cad rmi lam sgyu ma lta bur bden par grub pa cig kyang med par thag bcad nas/ chos 'byung gi nang gi g.yas zur du pho thams cad 'khor lo sdom par bsgom/ mo thams cad chos 'byung gi g.yon zur du rdo rje rnal 'byor mar bsgom/ de thams cad bar dor shes pa gal che'o/ /bar dor 'dun pas 'dzin pa ni/ /las dang po pa la ngo mtshar che/ /dag pa rab 'byams —324—

kho na la/ /srid pa'i las snang yod ma yin/ /gtum mo'i dmigs pa sgom na/skyabs 'gro sems bskyed stong ra rnams sngon du 'gro byas te bsgom/ sgyu lus rmi lam/ 'od gsal/ 'pho ba rnams la stong ra'i rjes su 'chi ba mi rtag pa'i skyo shas dung ba re bsgom pa yang gal che zhing / de mtshams dngos gzhi so so la 'jug /bar do la de'i tshab tu/ bar do dngos yin par 'dug ci rang drag /da ni ma 'khrul ba zhig byed dgos/ bar do rgyal ba longs sku'i gdams ngag bla mas gnang ba de sgom dgos snyam pas dngos gzhi 'jug /spyi babs chos drug kar mnyam len ma lcogs na/ rang gang mos pa re bsgoms pas chog /dper na gtum mo kho na la mos na skyabs sems stong ra sngon du 'gro bas/ lus gnad me'i stong ra rlung thengs gsum bzhi tsam bsgoms/ gtum mo zas su za ba ci nus nus bsgoms nas/ thun 'jog khar srid pa'i dbang zhu ba tshar cig byed pa yin/ de nyid thun bzhi la sogs par bya'o/ /g.yin rnams la'ang rigs 'gre'o/chos gnyis gnyis gsum gsum tsam bsgoms na yang de yis rigs 'gre'o/yongs rdzogs su sgom pa ni/ snga dro ga tshu mo/ nyin gung skyu lus/ /dgong mo rmi lam/ /mtshan mo 'od gsal rnams bsgom/ 'pho ba bar do skabs su gang bab cig tu bsgom par bya'o/ /'di smras pa/ shin tu zab pa'i lam gyi mchog /kun las mchog kyang dga' ba'i tog /snying po mdo tsam sbyar ba 'dis/ /'gro kun byang chub mchog thob shog /ni gu chos drug gi snying po don mthil du bstan pa'i 'khrid tshul 'di ni/ rigs rus phun sum tshogs pa'i sa gzhir/ dad sogs dge ba'i sdong po rgyas pa'i skal bzang can ngag dbang blo ldan bzang mo'i gsung —325—

lhan thabs kha skong bzhugs/na mo gu sa ye shes mkha' 'gro ni gu ma'i zhal gdams so/ /chos drug stan thog gcig ma dang / /gzhung khrid rgyas pa'i zhal gdams yod/ /rin chen 'od kyi phreng ba dang / /dri med 'od kyi phreng ba dang / /nyams myong yon to rgya ma/tsho dang / /sgyu lus stan thog gcig ma ste/ /bsre ba'i zab khrid rnam bzhi yod/ /de ltar sde tshan drug po 'di/ /chos drug mkhan la dgos nges yin/ /ces so/ /zab lam chos drug stan thog gcig tu dril ba ni 'di yin te/ de yang sngon 'gro dang dngos gzhi gnyis las/ dang po la/ thun mong dang thun mong ma yin pa gnyis/dang po thun mong ba ni/ skyabs 'gro sems bskyed gnyis yin la/ gnyis pa la/dag byed a'i stong ra dang / bla ma'i rnal 'byor ro/ /de ltar na/ skyabs sems dag byed stong ra gsum/ spyir khrid yig rgyas pa dang 'dra ba las/ skyabs yul gyi bla ma ma bsdus par bzhag pa la sems bskyed kyi rjes su/ stong ra'i gsol 'debs byas nas rang la bstim/ de rjes stong ra sgom pa yin/ gnyis pa bla ma'i rnal 'byor ni/ rang gi mdun gyi nam mkha' la gdan bzhi rdzogs kyi steng du/ bla ma sku dngos kho na bsgom/ skyabs gnas kun 'dus su ye nas grub par sgom pa las tshur bstim pa sogs dmigs pa'i spros pa mi dgos/ mos gus kyi gdung shugs drag pos/ dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad 'dus pa'i ngo bo bla

ma rin po che/ sems can thams cad kyi don du bdag gis bdag 'dzin blos thongs par mdzad du gsol/ dgos med rgyud la skye bar mdzad du gsol/ sgyu lus rmi lam 'byongs par mdzad du gsol/ 'od gsal phyag rgya chen po mchog gi dngos grub da lta nyid du myur ba nyid du 'dug sa 'di nyid du thob par mdzad du gsol/ ces pa kho nas gsol ba drag tu btab/ 'di la sems can thams cad snying khongs su bcug pas chog /'gro drug gi dngos su gsol ba 'debs pa'i dmigs pa mi dgos/ mthar bla ma 'od du zhu nas rang la bstim pa'i ngang du cung zad mnyam par bzhug go /dngos gzhi la gtum mo sgom par 'dod na/lus gnad rnam snang chos bdun spyi dang 'dra bar bya ba las/ mig thad ka blta/lag mthil gyis pus mo mnan no/ /rang nyid rdo rje phag mo rang lus dang bzhugs tshul mthun pa cig bsgom/ /rang gi lus kyi nang stongs sang sang ba/lus kyi dbus su rtsa dbu ma chos bzhi ldan ring thung sogs dkyus dang 'dra/ de'i nang lte 'og sor bzhi na ra dmar nag nas 'bru tsam/ lte bar nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor sran chung tsam gyi steng du/ a shad dmar ser ring thung sor gang tsam phra mo zhig bsgom/ de rang gi rtsa ba'i bla ma'i ngo bo yin snyam mos gus dung ba bya/ de nas spyi bor ha dkar po mgo bo thur du blta ba dang / steng gi nam mkha' la rang gi rtsa ba'i bla ma sku mdog dkar zhing zhal 'dzum pa/ gzi brjid 'bar ba zhig bsam/ thun gyi mgor rlung ro dgu phrugs su 'bud/ de nas rlung sbyor ba bzhi ldan drag tu bsgom/ dmigs pa ni/ rlud nyid dbu ma'i mas sna nas zhugs/ ra la bus/ de las me lce dmar nag sor bzhir 'bar/ bla ma'i ngo bo lte ba'i a —328—

shad la bskul/ a shad las me dmar ser 'ur gyi 'bar/ spyi bo'i haX cung zad zhu/ me lce tshangs bug nas thon te rgya cher 'bar/ me lce'i rtse mo las mchod pa sna tshogs sprul/ bla ma mchod pa bzhi rdzogs kyi mnyes par bsam/ me lce'i 'od las bde drod kyi mchod pa phul/ sangs rgyas kun 'dus kyi ngo bo bla ma de yang byang chub kyi sems kyi bdud rtsir zhu/ me lce dang lhan cig tshur byon/ tshangs bug nas zhugs/ bdud rtsi spyi bo'i haX yig la 'dres/ thig le'i rgyun nar gyis babs/ mgrin par slebs pas dga' ba bum dbang / snying gar slebs pas mchog dga' gsang dbang / lte ba'i a shad la thim pas khyad dga'/ sher dbang / de las kyang bdud rtsi babs pa raX la thim pas/ lhan skyes dang dbang bzhi pa'o/ /zhes dran par bya/ de nas kyang 'bar 'dzag skra shad 'dzings pa dkyus dang 'dra ba bsgoms pa las/ khyad par ni raX gyi me dang a shad kyi me gcig tu 'dres pa 'bar ba dang / haX gi thig le yang a shad brgyud de raX la thim par bsgom pa ni khyad par ro/ /'di ni gtum mo zas su za ba/ byin rlabs bla ma'i gtum mo/ srid pa'i dbang zhu ba ste gsum gar dmigs pa gcig la dril ba yin pas/ gnad shin tu che'o/ /yang 'di la gtum mo 'bar ba la sems gtad de/ rlung drag tu bus pa'i phyi 'dzin khong 'dren drag po dang / thig le 'bab pa la sems gtad nas drag tu rngubs nas thur sel gyi sgo gnyis la gzir ba dang / de thams cad la sems nam mkha' la yal du bcug /lto ba phyir bkyed nas lus gcu zhing rtsal sprugs drag po byed pa dang / hal zhes brjod pa ni/ thabs lam gnyis pa'i man ngag rlung sbyor gcig la lam rdzogs —329—

pa ste/ 'di nye brgyud bka' gsar pa zhig yin no/ /gtum mo stan gcig stong tshad rang la 'di 'chad pa min/ shin tu gsang ba'o/ /spyir 'di la chos drug ste thog gcig ma zer/ gtum mo'i rnal 'byor 'di la yang sgos su gtum mo stan thog gcig mar ming 'dogs mdzad/ gzhan sgyu lus sogs re re nas phral ba la de dang de stan thog gcig ma'i tha snyad mi byed do/ /gnyis pa sgyu lus ni/ rtsa ba'i bla ma nyid mdun nam spyi bo'am snying gar bsgoms kyang rung / gang na bzhugs pa'i phyogs sam mkha' khyab tu bzhugs pa la gsol ba btab kyang rung ste/ pha bla ma pha bla ma/ bla ma rang mkhyen/ drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma khyed la gsol ba 'debs so/ /zhes mos gdung drag po snying la 'brab pa zhig bsgoms nas de'i ngang la lhod kyis bzhag /rang lha skur lam tsam gsal btab ste/ rang gzhan snang ba thams cad la dmigs nas/ 'di thams cad med bzhin du snang ba 'khrul ba'i snang ba yin pa la bzang ngan bde sdug chags sdang mtho dman nyes ring 'byor rgud dga' mi dga' gtam snyan mi snyan sogs la a 'thas kyi zhen pas spang blang dgag sgrub byed pa 'dir a re 'khrul/ gtad pa rang ci yod/ rmi lam lta bu rang yin ang zhes sbyangs nas/g.yas med du chal song ba de ka la bzo bcos med par bzhag /dbang po rab 'bring gi nyams len thams cad de la 'dus/ de ma thag rang lhar gsal ba'ang / tha mal gyi rnam pa gang yin yang rung ste/ nang stong sang nge ba'i lte 'og tu chos 'byung dang rigs drug sgom pa sogs 'gro drug sgyu mar 'char byed dkyus dang mthun par bsgom mo/ /'di la dbang po rab 'bring gsum gyi gnad so —330—

sor tshang ba yin kyang gcig tu dril nas bsgom pa yin pas dmigs skor gcig kho na'o/ /gsum pa rmi lam la bzung ba dang / sbyang ba dang / yul snang lta ba'o/dang po ni/ rang zin thig le dbang bzhi'i gnad kho na ste/ de yang dmigs pa de tshar gsum tsam re bsdus nas 'jur bar bsgoms pa'i rjes su rang gzhan snod bcud dgra gnyen longs spyod thams cad la bden med kyi 'dun pa drag tu sbyangs shing / de ka'i ngang la gang shar bzo med du 'jog /tshul de lta bu yang yang goms par byed pa yin/ gnyis pa sbyang ba ni/ 'dun pa sbyong ba kho na yin te dkyus bzhin yin/ 'on kyang sgyu ma lta bu'i 'dun pa dang / rang bzhin dbyings kyi ngang skyong ba de gal che'o/ /gsum pa yul snang ni rang gi snying gar hūṃ yig dkar po dwangs gsal 'od kyi rang bzhin zhig bsgom/ rmi lam sgyu ma'i 'dun pa dang / yul snang lta 'dod drag tu bya/ hūṃ las 'od kyi thag pa lta bu zhig rgyang ste 'phros/ gang lta 'dod pa'i dngos po de zhags pas drangs pa ltar tshur byung nas snying ga'i hūṃ la thim/ hūṃ gi 'od kyis snang ba thams cad khra gsal le gsal ba la sems gtad de bsgom skabs 'dir bum can bsgom pa gal che/ lar ma zin 'khyams dang gol sa gsum/ /bsod nams tshogs kyis bcad par bya/ /zhes 'u byung la/ rmi lam sgyu lus kyi skabs su gal che bar bzhed/ bzhi pa 'od gsal la/ 'od gsal 'dzin pa dmigs pa'i gtso bo yin pas/ bla ma la brten nas 'dzin pa de nges par bsgom/ de kas zin na legs/ ma zin na rno khyad du a yig la rten —331—

nas 'dzin pa yin te/ rang gi dbu ma'i mas snar a dkar po bsgom/ steng rlung nan nan/ 'og rlung then then byas pas/ a de gsang ba'i rtsa bar lhan lhan song / gsang ba'i rtsa lam nas kyang gcus kyog kyog pa'i ngang nas rdo rje nor bu'i dbus su kha dog sngon po 'od 'tsher ba zhig tu gyur/ mgo nang bstan du log shugs drag pos phyi la 'gro 'dod kyang bu ga dog po la ma shong bas 'gro mi thub par lhan lhan 'dug pa la yud cig sems drag tu gtad/ yang de ka'i snang ba ma 'gags tsam la had de chad de bzhag /de ltar yang yang bsgom/ 'od gsal 'dzin lugs spyi dang 'dra/ 'dzin pa la lhag par bsngags so/ /'di kho nas gnyid kyi 'od gsal zin 'ong / stan thog gcig ma rang gi 'od gsal gyi dmigs pa de phyi ma 'di kho na yin bla ma la brten pa'i dmigs pa de/ spyi'i khog phub rgyab rten yin gyi/ stan thog gcig ma'i skabs kyi/ dmigs pa rang min no/ /a la brten pa 'di rten bud med kyis sgom na/ lte 'og sor brgyad tsam du dbu ma'i mas snas sleb pa'i mas sna de kar bsgom/ rlung gi gnad sogs gzhan 'dra'o/ /de ltar rtsa ba'i chos bzhi po de thams cad cha tshang sgom na thog mar re re bzhin zla ba gnyis gsum sbyangs pas nyams myong sna re rnyed 'ong / de rjes nyin zhag phrugs gcig nang du bzhi myong sgom na/ tho rangs nas snga thun la gtum mo/ gung thung la sgyu lus dgong thun la rmi lam/ srod thun la 'od gsal bsgom zhes khrigs ka 'di bzhin yang mdzad/ 'on kyang mtha' gcig tu ma nges so/ /de bzhin du bzhi char bsgom par mi nus na/ gsum sdeb bam/ gnyis sdeb bam/ re re bsgoms pas kyang don khyad par can 'grub par 'gyur —332—

ro/ /stan thog gcig ma zhes pa yang rtsa ba'i chos bzhi po la brtsi ba yin te/'pho ba bar do kha skong bas rgyas bsdus gang bstan kyang 'dra'o gsungs nas go babs lhod yangs su mdzad kyang / lag len du 'di ltar mdzad de/ /'pho ba ni/spyi bo tshangs bug rgya mthongs kha phye ba bzhin du yod par bsgom/ a la brten pa'i 'od gsal 'dzin pa de kho na bzhin las/ lte 'og sor bzhi'i a de rlung phyir 'bud pa dang lhan cig dbu ma'i lam brgyud/ nam mkha'i dbus su mda' 'phangs pa bzhin du song nas nam mkha' dbyings mthon por yal bar bsgom/yang a de nam mkhar grub mar babs tshangs bug nas zhugs te dbu ma'i mas snar phyin par bsam/ 'di la 'gro 'ong spel ma rang bsgoms pas chog /sgo dgag pa'ang mi dgos gsung ngo / /drug pa bar do ni/ rang gi mdun du chos ཿnga bsgom pa nas/ spyi bor bla ma bsgom pa'i bar gzhung khrid kyi dbang po 'bring dang 'dra/ gnad 'drug med kyi dod la/ 'gro ba rigs drug gi gnas dang / gzugs sgra dri ro reg bya bzang ngan thams cad la sgyu ma dang / bar do'i 'dun pa sbyangs/ mngal sgong gi gnyis sbyor sogs gsal btab nas bar dor zhes pas yi dam yab yum du bsgyur/ de la'ang mngon zhen med par sgyu ma lta ba'o/ /zhes dran par byed pa yin/ yan lag gi chos 'di gnyis kyang nye brgyud kyi cha shas cung zad yin/ de ltar na stan thog gcig mar sdud tshul 'di sngon chad yi ger 'khod pa cher med pa'i zhal rgyun yin/ gtum mo'i rlung sbyor gnyis pa dang / yul snang dang / a yi 'od gsal dang / yan lag gi chos 'di gnyis la dmigs pa'i sde bsgyur ba —333—

cung zad re yod pa 'di nye brgyud yin yang gsungs te/ yul snang dang 'od gsal yang yig rnying gis zin pa lags/ g.yin rnams ni man ngag rnying pa kho na'o/ /da ni khrid rgyas 'bring gnyis la dgos pa'i dmigs pa bka' rgya ma rnams bshad par bya'o/ /de la gtum mo'i thon chos byin rlabs bla ma'i gtum mo dkyus ni/ ga tshu tsho nyid kyi bla ma'i rnal 'byor sngon du song bas/ rang rje btsun ma bzhugs tshul rang lus dang mthun pa'am/ rang lus tha mal du 'jog pa gang yin yang 'dra/ nang stong sang nge ba'i stong ra bca'/ lus/ gnad tsog pu'am skyil krung gang gis kyang rung / rang gi lus kyi dbus su rtsa dbu ma kha dog dmar po sbom phra spos dong tsam pa gsungs/ mas sna lte 'og sor bzhi dang /yas sna spyi bor zug pa/ spyi bo tshangs bug shin tu yangs pa 'phang lo tsam zer te/ dbu ma'i sbom phra dang bstun dbu ma'i kha dang tshangs bug mnyam pa thal le bsgom/ dbu ma'i nang lte ba'i thad du nyi ma'i gdan rang gi rtsa ba'i bla ma/ ral ba'i thor tshugs dang / rus rgyan dang / stag lpags can skyil krung gis bzhugs pa/ me'i rang bzhin gang la reg kyang thogs med du/ tshigs 'gro ba zhig bsgom/ yig rnying 'ga' zhig na spyi bor ha bsgom pa bshad kyang phyag len du mi mdzad/ de nas rlung ro bsal te sbyor ba bzhi ldan drag tu bsgom/ dmigs pa ni/rlung kha sbyor du bzung bas bla ma'i sku las me lce 'ur gyi 'bar/ /me lce rtsa dbu ma'i nang du mi shong ba tsam du yar lud par te/ spyi bo tshangs bug nas thon pa na/me lces nam mkha' khengs/ bla ma yi dam sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' —334—

mkha' dbyings gang ba thams cad la mchod pa sna tshogs sprul te phul/ me 'od nyid bde ba'i mchod par gyur/ de thams cad bdud rtsi byang chub kyi sems su zhu/me lce dang lhan cig tshur byon/ bdud rtsi spyi bo tshangs bug nas zhugs/ dbu ma'i lam nas brgyud de/ bla ma'i sku la babs pas lcags sreg la snum blug pa bzhin du sor sgra dang / tsheg sgra dang / 'ur rgyang dang bcas te/ lus kyi nang thams cad me lce drag pos 'ur 'ur shig shig tu khengs par bsam/ rlung thengs bdun sogs ji ltar 'os pa bsgom/ 'dis drod la bogs thon/ rtsa zug rlung zug sel ba la bsngags/ spyir bla ma'i byin rlabs bskul ba yin pas gegs thams cad sel zhing yon tan thams cad skye ba la bsngags so/ /nang rtsa'i stong ra bca' ba zhes bya ba ni/ dang por dbu ma gro sog tsam bsgom/ de nas je sbom je sbom la mda' smyug 'bring po tsam/ rta lcag tsam/ je phra je phra la gro sogs tsam 'gro bar bsgom zhing / 'jam rlung bzung ba de ka la zhag shas bsgom/ yang dbu ma sbom phra lag ngar tsam du bskyed cing / sba lcag tsam du bsdu ba zhag shas bsgom/ de nas mda' dong tsam du bkyed cing / lag ngar tsam du bsdu ba zhag shas bsgom/ de nas lus dang mnyam par bkyed cing /mda' dong tsam du bsdu ba bzhag shas bsgom/ de rnams la 'jam rlung bsgom/de nas dbu ma blos 'byud tshad du rgya dpangs bkyed cing / lus dang mnyam par bsdu ba la bslab/ 'di la bum can drag rlud 'dzin no/ /de nas dbu ma phar bkyed tsa na nam mkha' la yas/ nang du bsdus pa'i skabs rta rnga tsam du song ba la sems gtad/ 'di la rlung sbyor zhi drag nges med du sbyang ngo / /'di thog mar —335—

sgom na/ rtsa rlung gi gegs mi 'byung ba yin/ bar du sgom na dmigs pa gang la gtad kyang rlung sems dbu mar 'jug pa'i thabs yin/ mthar sgom na 'od gsal mtha' dbus med pa nam mkha' lta bu 'char/ rtsa bsgoms pas stong nyid rtogs bya ba de yong ba yin gsungs/ 'on kyang re zhig stong pa'i nyams tsam 'char ba'o/ /gegs rang grol gyi skabs/ smad kun da'i gegs bsal ba'i skabs/tha ma dmigs pa dang 'khrul 'khor gyis bsal ces pa la/ thog mar rlung khug pa'i kha re bzung / de nas rang gi gsang gnas bde skyong gi snyen ra lo'i thad du hūṃ dmar po mgo bo nang du bstan pa/ zhabs kyu phyi'i phyogs la bstan pa zhig bsgom/ yang pad+ma dmar po 'dab ma brgyad pa yu ba rdo rje'i rtsa nang na yod cing /me tog 'dab ma rgyas pa nor bu'i bu ga'i phyi na yod pa/ rtsa ba ba thag lcags kyu lta bu de hūṃ gi zhabs kyu la sbrel bar bsgom/ lus kyi dbus su rtsa dbu ma yang khrol le ba bsgom/ lus nywa bzhi bsgrim lto ba tshigs pa la gcer/ lce phugs su ldog /mig spyi bor gtad/ lag pa gtsug tor gyi phyag rgya spyi bor mgo gzhug ldog /'og nas hūṃ 'dren drag la ring ba bya/ dmigs pa ni gsang ba'i hūṃ shugs chen pos gyen la 'ongs pa na/ de'i zhabs kyus pad+ma'i rtsa ba nas then pas me tog rdo rje'i bug la ma shong ste/ rdo rje'i rgyu ma phyi nang slog pa bzhin du song nas/hūṃ gis yar then dbu ma'i lam brgyud/ spyi bo'i steng du hūṃ dang / nor bu phyi nang log pa rgyang nge 'dug par bsam/ de'i ring la rlung phyir bzung ngo / /'di yang yang bsgoms pas/ gang bas 'dzag pa dang / chags pas 'dzag pa dang / nad —336—

gzhis 'dzag pa dang / rmi lam du 'dzag pa ste/ de rnams la shin tu bsngags/lar 'dzag pa drug kar chod de/ 'on kyang dam sel gyis 'dzag pa la bshags bsdams dang / grib kyi 'dzag pa la khrus chog dang / gnyis ka'i thun mong du tshogs gtor gal che gsungs/ rmi lam sbyong ba'i skabs/ bdag med ma la brten nas sbyong ba dang / yul snang gi skabs bdag med ma la brten pa dang /'od gsal bdag med ma la brten nas 'dzin pa rnams la bdag med ma nyid la yi dam byed na des chog /ma yin na rang skad cig la bdag med mar bskyed la/ oṃ a swāhā/ zhag bdun phrag gcig gam gnyis sam gsum 'bad de bzla/gtor chung zan ril sha chang gis brgyan pa/ yi ge 'bru gsum gyis byin gyis rlabs/ oṃ a a i yī ṛ grwa '-i lī o a a swāhā/ lan bdun bzlas pas phul/gtor chung de dus med du gtong / de lta bu sngon du song nas dmigs pa dngos gzhi bsgom pa'i skabs kyang / lha bsgom pa dang / gtor ma 'bul ba de ma chag pa dgos/ bum chu gcig la sngags stong tsam bzlas/ des nyin mo yang khrus byed cing nyal khar yang 'khrud/ khyad par yig brgya bzla zhing kha lag 'khru ba yang gal che'o/ /de ltar byas na mkha' 'gro'i byin rlabs kyi stobs yin pas/dmigs pa 'di rnams rno zhing shin tu myur gsungs/ 'od gsal gyi skabs/'jag chen gyis bdag med ma dkar mor bshad/ lar khar sngon gang byas kyang 'dra gsungs/ nyams len gyi rgyun sngon ma nyid ka mdzad do/ /'byams gcod kyi snying po ni/ rmi lam skabs su 'byams la/ mgrin pa dang snying gar rtsa 'khor 'dab ma bzhi pa re bsgom/ kha dog spyi dang mthun/ snying —337—

gar hūṃ dmar po/ mgrin par oṃ dmar po/ oṃ las 'od kyi skud pa dmar po zhig byung / snying ga'i hūṃ la lan gsum du dkris te/ thang nge spring nge bskor te lhag ma yar log /sne mgrin pa'i ā nyid la 'byar bar bsam hūṃ la sems gtad de gnyid log pas sel/ 'khrul 'byams la mgrin par sngar bzhin dang / spyi bor rtsa 'dab bzhi pa'i lte bar ha dkar po mgo bo thur bstan gsal btab/ yang oṃ las 'od zer gyi skud pa byung/ spyi bo'i ha la lan gsum du dkris nas slar log skud pa'i sne mgrin pa'i oṃ nyid la 'byar bar bsams nas spyi bo'i ha las sems gtad pas 'khrul 'byams sel gsungs te/ 'di zin ma thag 'khrul 'gro ba la bsngags/ ye nas rang mi zin pa'i 'khrul 'byams la/ rtog bcas lam khyer gyi skabs der/ mgrin par rtsa 'dab bzhi pa'i lte bar oṃ dmar po/ 'dab ma bzhi la/ a nu ta ra/ rlung bum can dang / rmi lam 'dzin pa'i 'dun pa drag tu sbyangs/ nyal khar rmi lam gyi 'dun pa drag po'i ngang nas/ a yig nu la thim/ de ta la de ra la/ de o la thim/ lko la rig pa gtad pa'i ngang nas gnyid du 'gro bar bya'o/ /des 'khrul 'byams sel lo/ /'od gsal gyi skabs su 'khrul 'byams sel ba la spyir 'od gsal 'dzin tshul spyi dang 'dra ste/ dang por dmigs pa gang yang rung ba la brten nas/rang shugs la 'od gsal zin na legs/ rmi lam las 'od gsal zin pa sna rnyed pa dka' bas/ dmigs pa'i stobs kyis zin pa yin na/ dbang po'i rim pa dang bstun te/ zla ba gcig gam/ gnyis sam/ gsum tshun la 'byung / stes dbang gis lan re tsam zin pa la ni nges pa med/ gal te de tsam du 'bad kyang —338—

bstar chags su zin pa ma byung na/ spogs chog la brten nas btsan thabs su 'dzin dgos/ de yang dmigs pa gtad res kyis gnyid bde chod chod yang sang sang ba byung na myur du zin no/ /yang gnyid 'thug po la nyams ma bde log log pa dang / 'dre gdon bzhin du jir jir gnon pa byung na yang myur du zin yong ba'i rtags yin no/ /'dir zla ba gcig nas gsum gyi bar du dmigs pa gra snam pa la ni rtsol pa cher bya/ do nub zin nam sang nub zin nam mi zin pa e yin snyam pa'i re dogs kyi tsab tsub mi bya bar rtsis btab med par bskyur na/ yang snyam med pa cig la la zin yong ba shas che/ ye ma zin na btsan thabs kyi sbyor ba ni/ da ni zhag 'dun sogs myur du 'dzin par bya snyam pa'i skabs/bla ma'am mched grogs la tshogs 'khor gyi mchod pa phul/ bshags bsdam bya/'od gsal zin par smon lam btab/ de nas bzung nub re bzhin mkha' 'gro sde lnga dang / myur mdzad mgon po'i gtor ma bya zhing / 'od gsal zin par 'phrin las gzhol/ zhag bdun tsam gyi sngon nas/ khrus dang gtsang sbra la 'bad cing / spyod lam dam rdzas la gzab pa gal che/ de rjes zhag gsum tsam gyi sngon nas nyin mo gnyid ye ma shor bar bya/ mtshan dus kyi gnyid kyang sum cha bzhi cha tsam bri/ dmigs pa dang 'dun pa drag tu bya/ man ngag g.yin gyi lugs kyis rlung bzung na rmi lam yong bas 'od gsal gyi skabs su rlung mi 'dzin gsung yang / man ngag 'di'i lugs kyis rmi lam byung yang a'u tsi/ rmi lam 'od gsal du 'gyur 'gro ba la tshegs med/ 'od gsal gyi gzhug la rmi lam byung na grogs yin/ lha skur rang shar bya ba de de nas 'ong gsung / /spogs chog gi —339—
