skabs 'dir rlung bsgom pa gnad du che bar bzhed/ dmigs pa dngos ni snying gar rtsa pad+ma sngon po 'dab bzhi'i rnam pa can gyi lte ba la hūṃ sngon po/ 'dab ma bzhi la a nu ta ra bzhi gsal 'debs/ thams cad kyang sngon po'o/ /hūṃ la sems gtad/ shes pa rig stong ngos bzung / yang hu las 'od 'phros yi ge bzhi la phog /'od du ltem ltem/ de las 'od 'phros rang lus 'od du ltem ltem pa/ de las 'od 'phros snang ba thams cad 'od du ltem ltem par song yang hūṃ la sems gtad nas rig stong skyong ba sogs de ka 'dra ba lan kha re song ba na/snang ba thams cad 'od du zhu nas rang la thim/ yang hūṃ la sems gtad/ rang lus 'od du zhu nas yi ge lnga la thim/ yang hūm̐ la sems gtad/ pad+ma dang yi ge bzhi po yang hūṃ la thim/ de la sems gtad/ hūṃ yang 'ja' yal ba ltar song ba'i ngang la rig ge bar mnyam par bzhag /mtshan mo nyal ba'i tshe/ hūṃ la sems gtad pa'i ngang nas ka gnyid du 'gro bar bya'o/ /de dag tu ka zin yong ba shas che/ gal te ma zin na zhag bdun pa'i nub mo gtor bsngo spyad sngar bzhin byas la/ thod pa mtshan ldan dum bu gcig pa lngas 'og tu sba gsung yang /man ngag gab pa yin/ spyir de yang mi 'gal mod/ don ni thod pa mtshan ldan gnyis rnyed na rab/ ma brnyes na gcig /de yang ma brnyes na/ rin po che'i snod gas chag med pa gnyis su kha zas bzang dgu la gtor ma re bcos/ 'byor na sha chen cung zad kyis brgyan/ gnyis kar byin gyis brlabs nas/ mgron spyan drangs te gcig 'od gsal zin pa na gtang rag tu 'bul lo byas dar gyis bkab ste sbas la bzhag /cig shos gtor ma bsngos te/ sgrub khang gi phyi rol du —340—

mi btang bar de nyid du bzhag /gtor ma gta' mar bzung ba de rang gi sngas mgo'i phyogs su bshams dgos/ gtor bsnge'i skabs su gu gul dang /tshil chen gyi dud pa btang ngo / /rang nyal ba la grogs dam tshig can nyams myong yod pa de 'dras 'od gsal zin ma zin lta bar 'jug pa sogs go yul spyi dang 'dra mod kyang / rgyu mtshan du mas 'grub dka' ba'i phyir lag len du mi mdzad de/ de phyin gtor ma dam rdzas sogs sus kyang ma mthong bar rang gcig pur byed pa gnad che gsung / nam 'od gsal zin byung ba na/ gta' mar bzhag pa'i gtor ma de yang nangs par gtang rag gi tshul du bsngo/ 'on kyang de ma thag phyir mi gtong bar zhag gsum nas bdun gyi bar nub re bzhin gtor ma de ka gsos nas bsngos/ mthar skya rengs shar ba'i dus shig khang steng ngam/ dur khrod dam ri rtser btang ngo / /'od gsal lan gcig zin pa'i mtshams nas/sngar gyis 'phros las mtshams dam du bcad nas dmigs pa dang / 'dun pa drag pos gzhur te bsgoms na bstar chags su zin 'ong / de ka la zhud bsrungs nas zla ba gcig gnyis song na/ cung zad brtan pa thob yong de nas 'byung ba lus 'khrugs byung ba dang / grib sogs rkyen gyis bsgyur ba'i skabs ma gtogs/ nub re la lan re tsam re nges par zin 'ong / bde gsal gyi nyams rang cher med pa la dran pas zin tsam de yang yang yong zhing yun yang ring rab skyong thub pa 'ong ba lags/ gnyid 'thug po thams cad la 'od gsal rtag tu zin 'ong ba la ni/ shin tu yun ring goms shing rtse gcig tu sgom dgos pa yin no/ /de yang gsal stong gi 'od gsal tsam dge sbyor thun mong ba yin la/ bde —341—

stong dbyer med kyi 'od gsal ni dngos gzhi'o/ /rmi lam 'od gsal gnyis kar kyi thun mong du dmigs pa gtad res kyi gnyid mi phebs na/ rang gi snying gar mu smug gnag las 'od zer na bun 'dra ba 'phros te/ lus kyi phyi nang thams cad khyab pa yang yang bsgom/ kha zas bcud can bsten/ dal brel ran par bcags pas sel/ rmi lam dang 'od gsal zin ma thag chu nang nas theg pa ltar yer gyis byung nas sad 'ong ste/ de la lus kyi smad kyi cha'i dbus su sems gtad pas sel/ de yang nyin mo dmigs pa de ka yang yang bsgom zhing /'di lta bu gnyid dus kyang yang yang bsgom rgyu yin snyam pa byas/ blo tsab tsob mi bya bar lhod de bzhag /mtshan mo rmi lam 'od gsal zin par rang gi dus kyang sad dogs chen po byas na sad 'ong bas lhod kyis byed pa gal che/ de ltar na sad 'byams ni/ rmi lam zin ma thag dang / 'od gsal zin ma thag pa la rtag tu sad 'ong ba'i ming yin/ de lta bu byung na thabs de kas sel/ dmigs pa dang 'dun pa rgyun du sbyangs kyang rmi lam dang 'od gsal zin dus med/ bsgoms ma bsgoms med pa 'dra ba de la 'dir 'khrul 'byams zer/ rim lnga gdan rdzogs sogs man ngag gzhan la lan brtul 'byams su grags/ rmi lam zin ma thag 'khrul 'gro na/ man ngag 'di'i lugs kyi 'khrul 'byams stobs chung ba zer/ /nā phra'i gdams par grags pa rnams na dred 'byams zer/ gnyid kyi 'od gsal la dred 'byams 'di cher mi 'ong / rmi lam 'di rang mang bas sel thabs gal che/ nyal khar 'dun pa btang res kyi/ rmi lam 'dzin pa'i skabs yin na/ gnyid 'thug por song nas rmi lam mi 'ong / 'od gsal gyi skabs —342—

yin na gnyid mi phebs/ de la stod 'byams zer/ rmi lam ma byung ba la nyin mo rlung sbyor mang du byas pas ka phan/ gnyid 'thug po ngang rmi lam gyi skabs su 'dzag gegs 'byung ba la bde 'byams zer/ de yang rmi lam du ni chags pa'i rkyen dang / bag chags dang / gdon rkyen sogs sna tshogs yin/ dngos dang rmi lam gang la'ang de byung tsa na/ rmi lam rtsal yang phal cher nyams 'gro/ skabs 'gar lan re lan gnyis khyad med pa 'dra byung na'ang rim pas nyams 'gro zhing / khyad par rmi lam gyi dge sbyor gsal stong bde ba'i lha sku bkrag can de rtsa ba nas 'jig /'od gsal gyi skabs la byung na ni lan re kho nas 'od gsal nyams 'gro/ dam sel dang / gdon rkyen dang / gang 'dzag gis yin na/slar bsgoms kyang rgyang tsam sor chud pa dka' bar yod/ gang ltar de thams cad la sel thabs gegs rang grol gyi skabs bzhin no/ /'byams pa zhes nga lan re lan gnyis la mi zer gyi/ yang yang byung bas lang shor chen por sor ba'i ming ngo / /'on kyang ma 'byams gong thog ma nas ka gcod pa gal che gsung / de dag kyang ngang thung zhing 'dod thag nye ba'i dbang du byas kyi/ rtsis btab med par rtag tu nyams su len pa la nam zhig na 'byams pa thams cad rang shugs kyis chod par 'gyur ro/ /'pho ba'i skabs su 'jug med mkha' spyod kyi 'pho ba la sngon 'gro gzhung 'pho gzhan dang 'dra/ rang gi spyi bo'i steng gi nam mkha' la chos 'byung gru gsum nyis rtseg phyi dkar la nang dmar ba/ bde bar rgyu zhing bde bar 'char ba/ de'i dbus su rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma sku mdog dmar mo/ g.yas rdo rje phyar ba/ g.yon thod khrag thugs kar gtod pa/ ma rman —343—

khung du kha ṭaX ga sku g.yas 'gyi byeng zhabs bgrad pa'i stabs kyis bzhugs pa/rgyan dang cha byad yongs su rdzogs pa/ pad nyi dang mi ro mgo g.yon du bstan snapa'i gdan la bzhugs pa/ 'khor tshogs dpag tu med pa dang bcas pa bsgom/rang lus tha mal du ka gsal ba'i rkang mthil gnyis dang / bshang lam du raX yig me'i rang bzhin can gsal btang/ de las me lce 'ur gyis 'bar nas lus thams cad zhu zhing khol/ ye shes bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin du gyur/ rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i phyag gi thod par yang song zhing / gtso 'khor thams cad kyi zhal rang du'ang gsol bas thugs rgyud bde bas tshim par gyur/ de lta bu lan gsum bsgom/ de nas rang nyid he ru ka yab rkyang du gyur/ lus kyi dbus su rtsa dbu ma spyi dang 'dra/ lte bar rnam shes kyi ngo bo a dkar po dang / gsang gnas su rlung gi ngo bo hūṃX sngon po 'od 'phro ba zhig gsal btab/ 'jam rlung cung zad bzung / rma phyir bsal ba'i tshe hi ka ring po brjod/ de'i tshe gsang ba'i hūṃX gi rlung shugs kyis nye ba'i a khyer te/ dbu ma'i lam brgyud spyi bo nas thon bcom ldan 'das ma rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i gsang ba'i sgo nas zhugs/ thugs ka tsam du sleb par mos/ de nas man ngag gi yig rnying rang nas/ de lta bu'i dmigs pa lan gsum bskyar/ de rjes rdo rje rnal 'byor ma mkha' dbyings mthon por gshegs pa dang / yang mar phebs pa sogs bsgom par bshad kyang / lag len la de ltar mi mdzad de/ sngags kyi dmigs pa de lta bu lan bdun sbyor/ re re bzhin rang sems dang / rdo rje rnal 'byor ma dang / stong pa gsum dbyer med du bsres pa la mnyam par 'jog mthar rang sems dang rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i —344—

byin rlabs dbyer med pa bdud rtsi dkar la dmar ba'i mdangs chags pa'i rnam par la song gsang ba'i sgo nas byon/ bdud rtsi'i rgyun rang nyid yi dam gyi skur gsal ba'i spyi gtsug nas zhugs/ spyi bo'i 'khor lo gang bum dbang / mgrin pa gang gsang dbang / snying ga gang shes rab ye shes/ lte ba gang dbang bzhi pa thob/ rtsa thams cad byang chub kyi sems kyis gang / nyams bde bas khyab pa la cung zad mnyam par bzhag /de lta bu yang yang bsgom pa yin/ thun 'jog khar rdo rje rnal 'byor ma chos 'byung dang bcas pa 'od du zhu/ spyi bo nas zhugs te rang nyid la thim/ spyi bo tshangs bug gi sgo yang ba yig dmar po mgo bo thur du blta ba/ 'od zer 'phro bas bkag par bsam/ 'chug med mkha' spyod kyi 'pho ba 'di la yig chung gcig yod/ mkha' 'gro ma ni gu las byung ba bdag khyung po rnal 'byor pa'i lugs so zer ba de yin no/ /gzhan 'pho ba bar do spyi bka' rang gi dmigs pa de ka 'chug med mkha' spyod kyi 'pho ba yin gsung ba grags che/ yang rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i phyag mtshan gyi 'pho ba la ngos 'dzin pa'ang yod de 'di dang mthun shas che/ mkha' spyod dmar mo'i 'pho ba la 'chug med 'pho ba'i mtshan byang / btab pa gcig kyang yod pas 'dzug tshugs ma byung na 'di ngos zin pa dkon par 'ong / 'chug med mkha' spyod gsar ba tsho re zhig pha ri la zhog ang / yang sgrub bo gang zhig chos 'di la brten pa'i gzhan lus sgom pa yin na/ bla ma'i rnal 'byor thams cad la bla ma nyid shes rab dang bcas pa'am/ rdo rje 'chang chen po yum can du bsgom par bya'o/ /zhes pa yang gsung rgyun gcig go /—345—

'dir smras pa/ dpa' bo dang bcas rnal 'byor ma dpal bye ba'i gtsug rgyan ni gu ma/ /gang gi zhal bum bdud rtsi'i rgyun de srid 'di'i nyes kun dag byed de/ /skal ldan yongs kyi snying gi gsos gyur 'di 'dra thob pa'ang skal pa bzang / /gang phyir 'di la gzhan dring mi 'jog cung zad goms pa'i snang ba'ang thob/ /ces bya'o/ /༈ na mo gu sa rin po che 'od kyi phreng ba zhes pa'i man ngag gi gzhung mnyam med rin chen brtson 'grus kyis mdzad pa de'i nyams len gyi snying po ni/man ngag thams cad lus gsum la gnad du bsnun par 'dus pa yin/ de la rnam smin gyi lus ni/ rtsa ba dug gsum gyi bskyed/ rgyu las kyis 'phangs/ rkyen 'byung ba lngas bsgyur ba'o/ /rgyu mtshan des na dngos por 'dzin pa'i nyon mongs rtag tu ldang / rgyu'i rjes su 'gro bas rang dbang med/ 'byung ba lnga'i gnod pa phyi snod la brten nas kyang 'byung / nang nad dang dgra dang gdon gsum du ldang /de yang las dang nyon mongs de dang po yid kyis bskyed/ bar du bag chags kyi tshul gyis bsags/ mthar bde sdug tu rnam par smin pa yin/ sad dus 'di la 'khrul bas rmi lam bag chags kyi lus la yang 'khrul te/ nyon mongs las dang bde sdug ldang / de gnyis las 'khrul bas yid lus la yang 'khrul te/ nyon mongs las dang sdug bsngal gyi snang ba shar/ yid lus kyi skabs der sngar gyi nyon mongs pa sogs kyis rgyu byas/ de dus kyi gsum pos rkyen byas nas/ yang rnam smin gyi lus bskyed pa sogs 'khor lo 'khor ba ltar 'khyams pa yin/ de la rnam smin gyi lus kyi 'khrul ba dag byed kyi thabs la/ sems 'khrul ba'i —346—

dngos kyi gnyen po sgyu ma lta bur shes pa dang / 'khrul ba de la brten lus kyi rgyu byas pas lus la gnad du bsnun pa zhig dgos so/ /de la 'dun pa rgyun chags dang / man ngag btsan thabs gnyis so/ /des na dang po ni/ brgyud pa'i bla ma sogs skyabs gnas thams cad rtsa ba'i bla ma la bstim ste/ gsol ba rgyun chad med par btab/ rang lus dang snang ba thams cad bde med sgyu ma lta bu'i 'dun pa drag tu sbyang / /thun mtshams thams cad du yang sgyu ma'i 'dun pa khar phog snar phog tu sbyang / de ltar bsgo mes kyang nyin par sgyu ma lta bu dang mi rtog pa yang bogs ma thon/ mtshan mo rmi lam yang mi zin na/ gnyis pa man ngag btsan thabs kyis 'dzin pa ni/ nyin mo lung stong du gcer bur mchongs rgyug byed pa la sogs pa nyams nga med pa spyod pa mang po dang / bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro rnams la gnad bor ba'i gsol ba btab/ mtshan mo nam smad skyil krung ltag snyes dang / tsog pu dang / seng ge'i nyal stabs gsum po gang rung byas nas/ rmi lam bsgyur ba'i 'dun pa drag po'i ngang nas gnyid du 'gro bar bya/ der rmi lam dam dum zin 'ong / gnyid sad pa'i dus na/ shar dang snang dang don byed nus/ /shes nas grol bar byed pa yin/ /rmi lam dang da lta'i snang ba gnyis/ dang por shar tsam gyi gnas skabs dang / de'i ngang la gnas nas rnam 'gyur sna tshogs su snang ba dang / rang dus nyid nas don byed nus pa ste gsum po'i sgo nas khyad par med/ gnas tshul la cung zad kyang ma grub par yang khyad par med/ sgyu ma lta bu'o snyam 'dun pa drag tu sbyong / de ltar nan tan tu bsgoms pas rmi lam zin ni 'ong / sbyong ba la ya bag tsha byung na/ da lta'i bden zhen gyi 'gab 'dre —347—

'brangs pa yin pas/ de la 'di snyam du na tsha sdug bsngal bskyed pa'i lus de mal na yod/ 'di ni yid kyi lus yin na 'jigs rgyu sogs ci yod snyam pas gang zin du sbyang / cung zad 'byongs nas 'byung bzhi sprul bsgyur la bslab/rig pa dang rlung dpangs gar+sā de nyi zla'i steng du 'gro ba dang / gting du smad nas rgya mtsho'i gting du 'gro ba dang / lha'i gnas sogs nyul/ bde ba can sogs zhing khams blta/ po ṭa la dang ri bo rtse lnga dang lcang lo can du rigs gsum mgon po'i zhal blta gdams ngag zhu/ dgyes rdor bde mchog sogs kyi dkyil 'khor la mchod cing dbang dang gdams ngag zhu/ rang g.yin rigs drug snod bcud thams cad yi dam lha'i dkyil 'khor du bsgom/ snang stong sgyu ma lta bur shes par bya/ yang thog ma lha skur shar ba de tha mal ba'i lus su log 'gro na/ 'khrul ba'i bag chags kyi shugs rjes su 'brang ba yin pas gnyid sad ma thag tu dmigs pa dang sgyu ma'i 'dun pa drag tu bsgom/ dpe'i sgyu ma ni me long gi gzugs brnyan la bstod smad dga' ba med pa bsgom/ don gyi skyu ma ni shar tsam nyid nas bden med la bzhag /gnyis med sgyu ma lha sku snang stong du shar bar bya/ snang stong bde ba dpe dang bsre/ /de don dang bsre/ de zung 'jug tu bsre ba'o/ /gzhan yang sgyu ma'i dpe gsum gyis mtshon pa dang / 'dod chags dang bral ba dang / shes rab rnam gsum dang / rnam thar gsum dang / phyi dang nang gi phar phyin drug dang / phyag rgya bzhi dang / dga' ba bzhi dang / ting 'dzin gsum sogs thams cad de ka la tshang / rmi lam sogs su gdon gyi cho 'phrul thams cad rang dag la 'gro/ 'gro drug lha skur shar bas bar do dag par the —348—

tshom med do/ /gnyis pa ni de ltar nyams su blangs kyang / dang por skye dka'/bar du 'byongs dka'/ tha mar brtan pa thob pa dka' na/ mos gus dang /'dun pa'i gnas sngar gyi de ka'i steng du lus la gnad du bsnun pa'i man ngag dgos te/ de yang lus gnad seng ge'i nyal stabs bya/ mgrin par pad+ma'i dbus su oṃ dmar po 'dab ma bzhi la a nu ta ra bsgom te/ rmi lam 'dzin pa'am sbyong ba'i 'dun pa drag po sbyang / des rmi lam gyi bogs thon par the tshom med/ sad dus kyi snang ba nas rmi lam la 'jug kha ma dang / gnyid phri phri ba dang / gnyid la hrum gyis song ba dang / rmi lam 'char kha ma ste/ dus ba'i po der rlung sems 'du ba'i gnad mgrin pa na yod pa'o/ /de klu sgrub kyi gdams pa yin no/ /yang snying ga'i rtsa 'khor gyi dbus su mar me lta bu 'od dkar la rtse mo dmar ba sor bzhi pa zhig bsgoms la/ de la rig pa bcug cing rlung yang cung zad bsdams/ nyin mtshan du de ltar bsgoms na/ nyin mtshan kyi 'od gsal gnyis kar 'char/ 'od gsal gyi man ngag bsgom bde zhing / dmigs pa gsal 'dus zab pa 'di lta bu gzhan la med/ grub thob lwa ba pa'i gdams ngag yin gsung / yang smin phrag gnad kyi sgor/ thig le dkar la 'tsher ba/snum la 'dril ba/ che ste mthe bong tsam/ chung na rgya sran tsam nyams bde ba zhig gsal btab/ de la rlud sems drag tu bcug /'di 'od gsal gyi 'dun pa dang sbyar na 'od gsal zin/ rmi lam gyi 'dun pa sbyar na rmi lam yang zin pa yin na'ang / gtso bor sad dus sgyu lus kyi gdams ngag yin/ gnyid sad dus kyi snang ba/ dpral ba'i 'khor lo dang sbyor ba'i lung khungs yod pa bzhin —349—

no/ /'di rnal 'byor ma skal pa bzang mo'i bzhed pa yin no gsung / rje btsun rmog lcog pa nyid kyi rnam thar na/ gdams pa 'di gsum bur sgom las brgyud par bshad pas/ de ltar yang yin mod kyi/ mgrin pa'i yi ge la sems gtod pa 'di/ 'od gsal dang rmi lam gyi spogs chog gi skabs na yod pa dang / smin mtshams kyi thig le rmi lam gyi dbang gi skabs na yod pas/ mkha' 'gro ni gu ma nyid kyi gdams pa dang 'brel zhing / snying ga'i mar me yang thig le la 'od gsal 'dzin pa dang gnad gcig cing / lwa ba pa dang ni gu ma gnyis kyang sa/nga/mas ngag byin rlabs kyi rkang gcig par bshad pas/ ni gu'i chos drug dang ma 'brel ba ma yin no/ /'di yang gtum mo ma gtogs bsre ba sgyu lus kyi gnad kun rdzob pa man ngag gi rkang yongs su tshang ba zhig go /rin chen 'od phreng gi man ngag go /༈ lam dri med 'od phreng las chos drug gi snying po 'di tsam gsungs so//sngon 'gro'i skabs gsum la skyabs 'gro logs su ma gsungs kyang kha 'gengs dgos/ sems bskyed spyi dang mtshungs/ bla ma'i rnal 'byor logs su byed de/sgyu lus kyi skabs dang mtshungs pa las/ byang chub kyi sems rtogs pa dang / stong nyid rtogs pa rgyud la skye bar gsol ba 'debs/ mjug tu bla ma'i skyabs 'gro nam nam ma re mdzad/ dngos gzhi thabs lam la byin rlabs bla ma'i gtum mo bsgom/ rlung rtar bzhon pa yang 'di ka yin gsung / de nas srid pa'i dbang zhu ba yang bsgom te dmigs pa gnyis yod/ sgyu lus la rang lus snang stong lha sku dang / 'gro drug sgyu mar 'char byed gnyis sbrags te bsgom/ spyir dben pa la —350—

bsten/ bla ma/'i mos gus kyis rgyab phul/ chos 'di bas skyabs kyi mi dang mi 'grogs spyod lam thams cad rang bzhin med rtogs kyis zin par bya/ chos drug rgyas pa'i skabs/ deng sang sgyu lus sgos kyi dbang bkar grags shing gab bsgyur dgos rgyu de ting nge 'dzin gyi tshul gyis len/ gdams ngag 'di'i dbang du byas na/ bsre ba sgyu lus spyi'i tshar gsum khug pa yin gsung / lar gtum mo'i dbang yin/ khrid 'di 'bogs na/ ga tshu mo'i dbang 'di ka sgo 'byed kyi dbang du bskur ba yin par bshad do/ /rmi lam 'dzin pa'i dmigs pa gsum yod/ dmigs pa dang po ni/ spyi bor ha dkar po/ /gsang bar phaṭa dmar skya/ha las thig le chad bde mchog dkar po 'gyur/ phaṭa las thig le chad pas rje btsun mar gyur te/ kha sbyor du zhugs pas lus sems bde bas khyab/ mdun du'ang de lta bu bsgom/ rmi lam gyi 'dun pa sbyangs/ mtshan mo gnyid du 'gro khar mdun gyi de rang nyid kyi snying ga'i lhan skyes la thim/ de yang 'od du lam pa la mtha' nas yal mi dmigs bar bzhag /dmigs pa gnyis pa rang zin thig le dbang bzhi'i gnad rang yin/ dmigs pa gsum pa rtog med la bzung ba gnyis kyi bla ma la brten pa de yin/ sbyangs pa ni/ 'dun pas sbyang ba la mdzad de/ spel sprul sgyur gsum yang de ka'i ngang nas byed/ yul snang gi dmigs pa yang stan thog gcig ma'i skabs su bshad pa de bsgom/ gnyis kyi 'od gsal 'dzin pa'i man ngag bla ma la brten nas 'od gsal 'dzin pa de kho na len par mdzad/ des rtsa ba'i chos bzhi'i don gyi snying po tshang / 'pho ba bar do'i dmigs pa logs su mi dgos/ 'dod na khrid rgyas par 'byung ba bzhin —351 —

no/ /nyams len gyi tshul 'di la brten pa'i sgom chen pa la dgos pa'i go don mang po yod pa rnams ni/ 'gro mgon sangs rgyas ston pa nyid kyi bka' las shes par bya'o/ /༈ yang nyams myong yon tan rgya mtsho las 'byung ba'i man ngag ni/ gang zag 'ga' zhig lus ngag gi rtsol pa zhan pas/ thabs lam sgom par mi nus pa'am blo rigs kyis bsgom par mi spro na'ang / gsang sngags kyi rdzogs rim nyams len la kha 'chad pa med de/ sgyu lus rmi lam 'od gsal gsum gyis lam thams cad cha tshang la ma nor ba yin gsung / de yang dal 'byor rnyed dka'/ 'chi ba mi rtag pa/ 'khor ba'i nyes dmigs rnams shes pas nyams len la 'dun pa bskyed/ gzhi lam 'bras bu thams cad zab pa dang rgya che ba zung 'jug tu go /de ltar ma rtog pa'i sems can la sems bskyed tshad med bzhi dang 'brel ba byed/ dngos gzhi la dang po sgyu lus dbang po rab 'bring gsum gyi/ rab ni mos gus bla ma'i lam khyer nyid yin pa las/ bla ma'i bzhugs gdan pad zla kho na dang / bla ma sku dngos yin pa mtshan dpes brgyan pa bskyed/ gsol 'debs kyi skabs sgyu ma la sgyu mar ngo shes pa dang / rmi lam la rmi lam du ngo shes par mdzad du gsol/ zhes pa gsung ba yod kyang mtha' gcig tu ma nges pas don gcig pa'i phyir/ gzhung khrid ltar byas pas chog gsung / dbang po 'bring ni rang lus snang stong lha sku nyid yin pa las/ snang ba thams cad kyi steng du 'dun pa zhar byung du sbyong / snang cha bskyed rim/ stong cha rdzogs rim/ dbyer med bde ba chen por ngo sprad/ tha ma ni 'gro drug sgyu mar —352—

'char byed yin/ chos 'byung phyi dkar la nang dmar ba dang / skabs 'dir sgyu ma'i 'dun pa kho na las 'dun pa gzhan gyi spros pa mi byed do/ /rmi lam la nyin par sgyu ma rmi lam gyi 'dun pa nyid dang / mtshan mo rang zin thig le dbang bzhi'i gnas dang / rtog bcas la bzung ba gnyis sbrags te bsgom/ de la cung zad brtan pa thob na/ 'dun pas sbyong ba nyid bsnan te/ gang zin dpag tu med par sprul pa la sogs pa zin sbyong sprul bsgyur thams cad cha mnyam rang shugs su 'byung / yul snang ni thig le la brten pa de bsgom te/ thig le'i 'od kyis gang lta ba'i yul tshur drangs rang gi snying gar thim par bsgom pa de khyad par ro/ /yang mtshan mo nyal khar blta ba'i yul dang / snying ga'i thig le gnyis 'od kyi thag pas sbrel/ yang sogs kun la sgyu ma ltar bsgom/ skabs 'dir bsre 'pho shes rab rnam bzhi'i sgo nas cung zad tsam ngo sprod bya/ de nas gnyid kyi 'od gsal 'dzin pa ni/ a yig la brten pa yin te/ 'di'i khrid yig gi dkyus la/rang gi lte 'og sor bzhi bcal bar zhes pa yod kyang de'i ma rman bu rang mchan na/ dbang po'i rtse mo'am gsung ba yod de/ rgyud sde dang mthun pa'i gnad dam pa yin/ stan thog gcig ma'i de ka la dgongs par mngon/ dngos bstan a dkar po gcig nor bur bsgom pa'o/ /'od gsal bde stong las snang ba sna tshogs 'char ba ni/ 'od gsal las lha sku rang shar 'byung ba'i gnad yin par bshad do/ /rgyas par 'gro mgon sangs rgyas nyid kyi gsung du blta'o/ /de dag las rin chen 'od phreng gzhung gi tshul du mdzad pas gleng brjod gang yang med/lam dri med 'od phreng dang 'di gnyis la khrid logs pa mi byed de/ chos drug —353—

las gzhan du med pas so zhes gsungs pa dang / ngag sgros la sngon chos drug khrigs chags 'di/ ye ge 'god pa bka' rgya ma grol pa'i skabs/ brjed tho ltar bur khrid yig bsdus pa 'dra min mdzad pa yin gsung pa sogs yod kyang /chos drug rang spyir snyan brgyud kyi bka' rgya ma grol pa'i skabs yin na ni/ dam dum yi ge bris kyang bka' rgya la gnod pa dang / 'dra min bris na brjed thor shin tu mi rung ste/ dkyus de brjes pa'i rgyur ngos 'gyur bas de 'dra ni ma yin no/ /des na 'di gnyis 'gro mgon sangs rgyas kyi gsung yin pas bka' rgya grol pa yin/ dmigs pa 'dra min phran bu yod pa rnams 'dam kha yin par shes par bya dgos/ des na 'di gnyis ye shes mkha' 'gro ni gu ma'i snyan brgyud kyi gdams pa'i snod du gyur pa la/ gdams skor yongs rdzogs rang mi dgos pa'i slob ma 'ga' zhig gis don du gnang / de rnams la yang nyams rtogs khyad par can mthar phyin skyes pa yin 'dug /khrid chen mo'i nang du don 'dus su chug kyang logs su byed pa mi 'gal te/ sgyu lus stan thog gcig ma bzhin no/ /des na mkhas grub chen po khyung po pa sgyu lus stan thog gcig ma logs su phral nas mdzad pa bzhin du/ /'gro mgon ston pas kyang 'di gnyis mdzad pa yin te/ skabs 'dir mdzad pa po bzang ngan la khyad med par go dgos so/ /rin chen 'od phreng dang 'di gnyis la tshig bcad lhug gi khyad la rtog dbyod zhugs ma zhugs kyi stabs cig byung 'dug pa ma gtogs dgos don de dag la khyad med do/ /de ltar na su khrid tshul rgyas pa'i nang nas dmigs pa'i gtso bo ji ltar 'os pa gud du phyung ba yin du chug kyang / skyes mchog de dag gis —354—

khrid kyi rnam grangs so sor byin gyis rlob par mdzad pa yin pas/ da ltar yang gdul bya so so'i blo rigs dang bstun nas khrid tshul 'di dag gis slob ma bkri ba yang shin tu legs shing 'os pa nyid do/ /spyir yang tshig khrid la gsung gi rgyun rgyas pa nyid tshig gi bslad ma zhugs shing / lhag chad nor 'khrul med pa zhig bla ma las thos shing blo la zin pa zhig dgos mod/ don nyams myong gi khrid la khrid yig rgyas pa'i gral bsgrigs de ka mu ded rang du dgos pa ma yin te/dmigs pa re re'am gnyis gsum la brten nas nyams myong tshad du phebs pa byung na/ des thams cad kyi rkang zin par 'gyur ba'i phyir ro/ /yang ci ste na/chos drug gi gzhung khrid rgyas bsdus rnams ni bsgom par mi spro la/ ni gu'i chos drug gi ming dang ldan pa mos na/ 'di gnyis kyi snga ma la 'pho ba bar do tsam bsnan pa dang / rin chen 'od phreng dang / phyi ma 'di la de'i steng du gtum mo yang ji ltar 'os pa bsnan cing / snon tshul yang dkyus la bcug na grub thob gsung la bsre bslad du 'gyur nyen srid pas/ logs su bsnan na legs par 'gyur ro/ /de las gzhan du ni gu chos drug gi khrid yig yin zer ba/ rje dge 'dun rgya mtshos nye bar sbyar ba lta bu/ ni gu mas ma gsungs/ khyung pos ma thos/brgyud pa'i bla ma sus kyang ma dgongs pa'i bcos ma ni gu'i chos zhes pa'i ming tsam la rgyug cing chos rgyus med pa'i blun po 'brid byed tsam du zad do/ /ci ste chos tshul g.yin las bshad pa'i dmigs rim rnam dag yin no zhe na/ de la ni gu'i chos kyi ming btags pas ci zhig bya/ shangs pa'i bka' brgyud kyi lugs kyi dmigs pa sna cig tsam yang med pa la shangs chos kyi ming btags pa de —355—

'dras cir yang mi rung ngo / /sgyu lus stan thog gcig ma zhes bya ba ni/ mkhas grub chen po khyung po'i gsung them yig las/ sgyu lus stan thog gcig ma la/gsol 'debs bzhi la 'dun pa brgyad/ gsol 'debs bzhi ni dbang po tha ma'i skabs bzhin yin/ 'dun pa brgyad ni 'chi ba mi rtag pa/ bla ma'i mos gus/ gnyid du song bar shes pa/ sgyu ma rmi lam du shes pa/ sbyong spel sbrul bsgyur rnams yin par gsungs/ nyams len gyi rim pa ni/ skyabs 'gro sems bskyed/ dag byed stong ra rnams sngon du btang / 'chi ba mi rtag pa'i skyo shas drag tu bskyed pa la dkyus las nan tan che tsam bya/ bla ma'i rnal 'byor ni sgyu lus dkyus dang 'dra/ bla ma rang la bstim pa'i rjes su rang lha skur gsal ba dang /phyi snang ba thams cad la yang sems gtad de/ gang gsal thebs thebs su lha skur gsal btab thams cad la cig car dmigs nas/ 'di thams cad rang gi sems snang yin la/ sems de yang bden med sgyu ma lta bu yin/ de las kyang khyad par du nga gnyid du song 'dug /snang ba 'di thams cad rmi lam rang yin ang snyam bden med kyi 'dun pa dang / rmi lam gyi 'dun pa gnyis spel gyin drag tu sbyangs/ thun mtshams su'ang 'dun pa gsum sbrags g.yel med du bsgom zhing / lhag par yang rmi lam gyi 'dun pa bsnan/ nyal khar yang rmi lam gyi 'dun pa dang / bden med kyi 'dun pa drag tu sbyangs nas/ de ka'i ngang nas gnyid du 'gro bar bya/ rmi lam 'dzin pa'i gdams ngag gzhan mi 'tshal 'di kho nas chog par bzhed/ de rjes sbyang ba spel ba sprul ba bsgyur ba rnams chos drug rgyas pa bzhin bstan no/ /rgyas par na 'di la mkhas grub rgyal mtshan —356—

'bum gyi khrid yig kyang logs su yod pa blta bar bya la/ gzhung khrid la nges po yod phyin/ yi ge 'di tsam gyis kyang don mthong bar 'gyur ro/ /de ltar na/chos drug gzhung khrid kyi skabs su dgos pa'i dmigs pa bka' rgya ma'i rigs dang / gdams ngag nyer mkho rgyas bsdus sna tshogs pa'i sde rnams bshad zin to/ /'dir smras pa/ zab don 'khrul med 'di yin zhes/ /nges tig smra ba shin tu dkon/ /mi gra gshog phyir thob chos tsam/ /'ol gcod byed pas rgyal khams gang / /mi phal blun po phyogs mos kyis/ /chos 'dir 'jug pa phal che ba/ /ja ngo nya ma shas che bas/ /zab don go ba dkon mod kyi/ khog ngan blo skyon chags pa'ang nyung / /che 'dod chos brgyad phyogs 'dzin gsum/ /gcig las gcig che 'gran pa bzhin/ /dang po go rtogs snying rje gsum/ /gcig las gcig chung 'gran pa bzhin/ /de ltar khyad chos drug ldan pa'i/ /dge bshes ming can zam zom 'ga'/ /rang gis bslabs pa'i kha bshad tsho/ /skye bo phal la ma brin pas/ /nyag nyog 'khor du 'du re nas/ /chos rgyus med pa'i tshogs pa la/ /lung skyog rnams su chos 'di 'chad/ /chos tshul 'di la sbyangs pa yi/ khres ldan rnams la ston nyan med/ /a po cang gi klog dar gyi/ /dpe de thugs su chud par mdzod/ /he rang re skal ldan yin par nges/ /zab chos nges tig yod sar sleb/ /bla ma sbed kyang mi dgos par/ /chos la spyod pa e ma ho/ /zab lam ni gu chos drug gzhung khrid ma mo'i lhan thabs 'di yang rgyal khams pa tā ra nā thas smras ba'o// //ma ṅga lam//—357—

oṃ snyu sti/ /na mo gu sa /rtsa mdud dgrol dang rtsa srong dang / /dbu mar sdud dang rtsa 'grems bzhi'o/ /langs 'dren bsgyur dang stod gnon gsum/ /rkang gcig rkang gnyis gcu ba dang / /bu chung tshul dang 'phar ba lnga/ kha 'byed gnyis ni snor dang bgrad/ /dbu mar 'jug dang dbu mar 'dren/ /dbu mar sdud pa gsum du bzhed/ /rnam snang ltag gcu don yod grub/ /gzir dang mnyam gzhag rkang g.yab dang / /kog langs gsum sprugs zhes bya brgyad/ /rtsa la bzhi dang thig le gsum/ /zug sel lnga dang kha 'byed gnyis/ /rdo rje gar la gsum yin te/ /nyon mongs sel la brgyad yod kyang / /gcig tu bsdus na bco brgyad yin/ /dang po skyil krung ro stod lan bdun gcu/ /gnyis pa langs la sked gzir rting 'khrab bdun/ /gsum pa lag gnyis mchan khung brla zur brkyang / /bzhi pa sar bsdad lus kun 'phur mnye bya/ /lnga pa spyi bor thal sbyar rting ba brdab/ /drug pa khu tshur g.yas g.yon re mos brkyang / /bdun pa mchan khung bsdams la ro stod gcu/ /brgyad dgu gnyis la dbyug mchongs byed par bshad/ /'on kyang da lta lag len de mi byed/ /brgyad pa pus mthil sbyar langs lag brkyang 'khrab/ /dgu pa rkang lag rdeg stabs rting 'khrab gsum/ /bcu pa sor bsnol brang 'gebs la na gsum gcu/ /bcu gcig langs sdod mgo bo bskor lcog sprug /bcu gnyis rting 'khrab gsum mthar sa la 'bebs/—358—

bcu gsum khu tshur brang gnon gcig shos 'phul/ /bcu bzhi kha mig bgrad mtha' brkyang bskum sprug/bco lnga nu rdeg rgod lding sprug dang skor/ /bcu drug snol nas 'then gnon dgyed dgu bya/ /bcu bdun dpung bkab rked pa lan gsum skyog/bco brgyad pa ni nyon mongs sel ba yin/ /byang chub phyag rgya g.yas g.yon steng 'og gcu/ /srin 'dud ltag mnan ro stod g.yas g.yon gcu/ /don grub phyag rgya gzhag sha brdebs pa yin/ /gzir ba 'bar rgya bskor zhing mig bskor bltas/ /mchan khung bsdams shing gcus nas slar yang blta/ /mnyam bzhag rdor skyil pho ba bsdams pa dang / /rkang g.yab gan rkyal tsog pu zan spru'i tshul/ /kog langs sdigs mdzub phyogs bcu rnams su bskor/ /gsum sprugs bsdams brkyang 'dud cing sprugs pa yin/ /ye shes mkha' 'gro ni gu'i chos drug gi /gtum mo'i gzhung khrid 'khrul 'khor bco brgyad yin/ /phyi ma brgyad du phye na nyi shu lnga/ /zhes so/ /de yang rlung sbyong ba zla gcig tsam song ba na/ gtum mo'i stong ra zhag bdun/ gong bu 'thabs pa zhag bdun/ dngos gzhi zhag bdun/ bla ma'i gtum mo zhag bdun/ gos su gyon pa zhag bdun bya/ de nas 'khrul 'khor de rnams bslab ste yang yang sbyangs pas ngal dub med cing sgrib mi dgos par song ba na/ so so'i dmigs pa rnams la thun re re byed kyin sbyangs/mthar 'khrul 'khor tshar re la dmigs pa thams cad tshar re 'gro bar byed/thun bzhi'am drug tu tshar re ma chag cing gtum mo la 'bad na yon tan dpag tu med pa 'phral du 'gyung nges pa yin no/ /de la sdom tshig gi don rnams bshad par bya ste/ dang po rtsa mdud dgrol ba ni/ skyil krung lus gnad bcas la/—359—

lag pa gnyis pus mo nas drangs te/ brla'i rtsa bar btsugs/ ro stod g.yas dang g.yon du gcu ba lan bdun bdun bya/ gnyis pa rtsa drang por bsrang ba ni/lus gnad bca' gzhi gong ltar bcas/ lag pa brla'i rtsa bar sleb pa dang /kag gi langs la rlung 'phar byas/ lag pa sked gzer gyi ngang nas/ lto ba g.yas bskor g.yon bskor bshang sgor sdig pa re dang / ro stod bag tsam g.yas g.yon du gcu ba lhan cig tu bya zhing / de rjes rting khrab re dang spel ba lan bdun bya/ 'di rtsa 'khrugs pa sel ba/ skra shad kyis skra gang byed pa dang 'dra'o/ /gsum pa dbu mar sdud pa ni/ snga ma'i 'phros la yin na/ rlung 'drab cig byas pas chog/logs su byed na/ bca' gzhi gnyis pa dang 'dra bar bya/lag pa khu tshur bcangs pa brla'i phyi 'phongs tshos phyogs la brkyang zhing shed bcug la rting 'drab gnyis gnyis kyi mtshams su/ 'phar rdeb re bya/ de 'dra lan bdun no/ /bzhi pa rtsa 'grems ni/ rlung bskyur zhig byas nas dang por mgo dang /de nas ro stod/ de rjes lag pa/ rjes su smad dang / rkang pa brkyang ba la/'phur mnye bya/ khyad par du lag pa dang rkang pa'i nywa bzhi rnams la/ phan tshun du bshud pa dang / rdung ba byed/ bzhi po de rnams rtsa dag par byed pa'o/ /lnga pa langs te 'grems pa ni/ bca' gzhi gnyis dang 'dra ba las/lag pa rim pas rtsibs logs brgyud yar brkyang / spyi bor thal mo sbyar/ sked pa nyag gis btang / thur sel thur du bsdigs pa dang / srog steng du drangs/—360—

lkog mas ol mdud drag tu mnan cing / 'phar rdeb byed pa las/ rting pa rdeb pa shugs che bar bya/ 'di yang lan bdun bya'o/ /drug pa bsgyur ba ni/ bca' gzhi gong bzhin byas la/ lag gnyis khu tshur brla'i zur la brkyang / lus g.yon du gcus nas/ rkang lag g.yas pa drag tu brkyang bskum bya/ lan lag dang lhan cig sor mo yang brkyang bskum bya/ de bzhin du g.yon pa la'ang sbyar/ bdun pa stong gnon ni/ bca' gzhi sngar bzhin las/ lag gnyis sor mo rnams bsnol te brang la bkab/ mthe bos mchan khung logs nas bsdams/ ro stod g.yas g.yon du lan bdun gcu/ de gsum thig le dag byed do/ /brgyad pa rkang gcig pa ni/ bca' gzhi gnyis pa dang 'dra ba las/ rkang pa g.yon pa'i pus mo'i gong la/ g.yas pa'i mthil sbyar/ pus mo g.yas pa g.yas la skyed/ lag pa gnyis kar brkyang ste/ 'phar rdeb lan gsum byed/ de nyid g.yas g.yon go ldog pa'ang lan gsum/ dgu pa rkang gnyis ni bca' gzhi gnyis pa bzhin las/ rkang lag g.yas pa gnyis mdun du g.yon bskor byas nas/ gyen du cung zad bteg ste/ slar g.yas kyi rgyab zur du/ lag pa sor mo dang bcas pa shad kyi brkyang ba dang / rting ba'ang de phyogs su sa la brdabs/g.yon la'ang de bzhin byed/ 'di'i gzhung las/ brgyad pa dang dgu pa 'di gnyis la thog ma lag pa gcig gis 'khar ba la 'ju ba dang mjug tu gnyis kas 'jus nas ring du 'phar zhing dbyug mchong byed par bshad kyang / deng sang lag len mi byed par 'dug/bcu pa gcu ba ni/ sor mo bsnol bas brang dang —361—

mchan khung btsir ba bdun pa dang 'dra rung ba las langs pa'i skabs/ mgo dang ltag pa dgye ba'i ngang nas g.yas g.yon lan gsum gcus/ de rjes rlung bskyur byas sa la bsdad nas/ mgo dang ro stod lan gsum gcus/ de nas pus mo btsugs pa'i phyed langs la/ lag pa g.yas pa sngar bzhin/ g.yon pa rgyab nas bskor te dpyi g.yas pa la 'jus nas/ ro stod g.yon du gcus/ de bzhin du go ldog pa'ang bya'o/ /bcu gcig pa bu chung tshul ni/ bsdad la mgo bo bskor zhing mgo lcogs sprug pa lan gsum dang / langs nas kyang mgo bo bskor zhing mgo lcogs sprug pa lan gsum rnams bya'o/ /bcu gnyis pa 'phar ba ni/ rting 'khrab lan gsum gyi mthar/ lag pa khur tshur brkyang ste/ /'phongs sa la brdab/ de 'dra lan gsum mo/ /de lnga rlung dang thig le thun mong du dag par byed pa'o/ /bcu gsum pa rtsa dbu ma kha 'byed pa dang po ni/ skyil krung bcas/ lus bsrangs/ lag pa khu tshur gnyis thad kar brkyang ba las/ g.yon khu tshur nu khar rdeg cing mnan/g.yas 'phongs tshos g.yas kyi phyogs thad ka la bskum khru gang tsam du brkyang /de 'dra ba lan gsum byed/ de nyid go ldog pa'ang lan gsum/ 'di la g.yas g.yon snor ba zer/ dbu ma kha 'byed gnyis pa ni/ rlung 'khrab byas nas langs/lag pa brkyang ste pho ba sa la btsugs/ kha mig gdangs/ yan lag bzhi brkyang bskum bya zhing drag tu sprug pa'o/ /'di la bgrad pa'i mtha' zer/ bco lnga pa dbu mar 'jug pa ni/ bca' gzhi dang bstun nas langs/ rlung thur la sdig cing / lag pa brkyang ste nu khar rdeg pa lan gsum bya/ yang lag gnyis khu tshur —362—

brla'i zur du brkyang la/ thur sel drag tu 'then pa gsum bya/ yang lag pa rgod gsho/ga bzhin brkyang la rting 'khrab gsum byas nas/ lus drag tu sprug/yang rlung phyir bsal nas kyang drag tu sprug go /bcu drug pa dbu mar 'dren pa ni/langs te lag pa gnyis bsnol/ khu tshur g.yas g.yon gyi mchan khung dang /lag ngar gyis nu ma btsir/ rtsibs logs g.yas dgang / mgo g.yon du 'byog pa dang lhan cig rlung g.yas gyen 'then dang / de nyid go ldog pas g.yas thur mnon bya/ g.yon la'ang des rigs 'gre/ de bzhin du ltag pa dgyed la mdun du/ 'then gnon dang sgur la rgyab la'ang 'then gnon bya/ bcu bdun la dbu mar sdud pa ni/ sngar bzhin langs la/ lag pa bsnol/ lag mthil dpung pa g.yas g.yon la bkab/ pho ba g.yas bskor g.yon bskor gsum/ ro stod g.yas g.yon du gcu/ sked pa g.yas g.yon dbus gsum du phar kyog tshur kyog bya zhing 'a tun btsal lo/ kha 'byed gnyis/ gar gsum zhes so sor bgrod yang chabs gcig tu yong bas kha 'byed gnyis dang / 'jug 'dren sdud gsum ste lnga la rdo rje gar gyi 'khrul 'khor zhes so/ /bco brgyad pa ni nyon mongs sel ba'i 'khrul 'khor zhes bya ste/ de la nang tshan du phye na brgyad yod/ dang po gti mug sel ba rnam snang gi phyag rgya ni/ byang chub mchog gi phyag rgya snying gar bcas nas/ mdun du brkyang la/ g.yas g.yon steng 'og rnams su gcu zhing / nu ma dang pho bar rdeg/rgod pa sel ba ni/ skyil krung ngang nas srin rmolag gnyis 'dud pa'i sor mor gzhan rnams kyis ltag pa'i chu ba nas mnan te ltag pa dgug/ro stod g.yas g.yon du lan gsum gsum du drag gcu/ lag —363—

pa steng du brkyang ste/ spyi bor thal lcag rgyag /lan gsum khro chig sel ba ni/lag gnyis pus mo nas blangs te/ gzhag sha brdab cing mdun du brkyang nas/don yod grub pa'i phyag rgya bcas pa snying ga dang lte 'og tu brdab/ g.yon pa'i lag ngar bsrangs nas gcud do/ /gnod byed gzir ba ni/ skyil krung ngang nas/lag pa 'bar ba'i phyag rgya bcas g.yas dang g.yon dang dbus dang steng dang 'og phyogs nas cung zad rgyab la dgyed de/ g.yas g.yon du lan gsum gsum skor ba dang lhan cig mig gdangs shing shugs bskyed pa'i lta stangs kyis mig kyang bskor ro/ /zhe sdang sel ba mi bskyod pa'i phyag rgya ni/ /skyil krung byas nas dpyad phrag brdab/ sor bcu bsnol bas brang gi dbus nas bsdams shing / gru mo phyir bkyed la g.yas g.yon du lan gsum gsum gcu ba dang /lag gnyis sa gnon byas te/ g.yas g.yon dbus gsum du khro bo'i lta stangs kyis blta'o/ /nga rgyal sel ba 'od dpag med kyi phyag rgya ni/ rdo rje'i skyil krung gi ngang nas lag ngar bsrangs pa'i mnyam bzhag shugs bskyed/ mnyam bzhag btegs nas pho bar rdeg cing bsdams/ yang lag ngar bsrangs pa sogs lan gsum/ de rjes rlung phyir 'bud pa dang lhan cig ha drag po lan gsum brjod/'dod chags sel ba ni/ bca' gzhi'i ngang nas rkang pa g.yas g.yon re mos su lan gsum bskor zhing g.yab/ de nas gan rkyal du 'dug ste/ rkang pa g.yas brkyang g.yon bskum dang / g.yon brkyang g.yas bskum byed/ lag pa nam mkhar brkyang nas zan snol ba'i phyag rgya bya/ bde chen 'bebs pa che ba ser sna sel ba ni/ skyil krung bcas pa las/ kag gis langs te 'dom 'jal —3ཿ—

brkyang / rlung 'drab bya/ sdigs mdzub byas te g.yas g.yon dang / steng 'og dang / mdun rgyab tu bskor/ rlung skyar zhig byas la mchog spyin brkyang lus dgyed par bya/ 'di la kog langs zer ro/ /bde ba 'bebs pa chung ba pa ni/gsum sprugs zhes bya ba lag pa g.yas g.yon gnyis steng nas 'og tu sprug pa dang / ro stod drag tu sprug pa la zer/ de yang sems pa'i skyil mo krung bcas nas/ gsum sprugs bya/ de nas lag pa g.yas steng dang g.yon 'og tu byas la bsnol/ lag mthil gyen du bstan/ lag mgo g.yon gyi 'og tu g.yas bcug ste/ g.yas pa'i srin lag gis g.yon pa'i srin lag bsdams/ mdun du brkyangs pas/ lag ngar gcus la bor ba dang / lag stabs de nyid go ldog pas kyang gcus la bor/ re re bzhin shugs 'jug thengs gsum gsum byed/de nas g.yon khu tshur dpung pa'i thad ka nas mdun gyi g.yon zur la brkyang /g.yas kyi khu tshur gyi bshud thengs gsum bya/ /g.yas pa la yang de bzhin du bya/yang gsum sprugs mthar 'bebs bya'o/ /phyi ma 'di la gsum sprugs zer te 'gyod pa dang / yid mi bde ba dang / rnam rtog sel ba yin/ 'khrul 'khor 'di rnams la/ so sor dmigs pa'i gnad re phal cher la yod de/ rtsa ba'i gzhung tshig las shes par bya'o/ /de ltar na 'di rnams ye shes mkha' 'gro ni gu'i zhal gyi gdams pa/ rlung sems dbu mar thim pa dang / rtsa mdud grol ba'i man ngag rang lus thabs ldan gtso bor gyur pa/ grol lam mchog sgrub kyi man ngag/lus sbyong bco brgyad pa zhes bya ba yin te/ 'di'i rtsa ba'i gzhung ni/ zhal shes cung zad gab pa dang / tshig mang po'i gseb tu 'thor bas sdud mi shes pa rī —365—

dag mang du yod la/ mi mkhas pas sbyar ba'i sdoms than thun yod srid na'ang lag len gsal po thon pa med par mngon pas/ 'di'i lag len nub tu nye bar mthong ba'i phyir/ mi nub cing rgyas par bya ba'i don du/ dpal ldan shangs pa'i bka' brgyud la mos pa cung zad thob pa/ tā ra nā thas ma sbas shing gsal bar bkod pa'o// //ma ṅga la//oṃ snyu sti/ chos sku kun khyab bde stong zung 'jug dbyings/ /brtan g.yo kun gyi srog tu rtag bzhugs kyang / /ma rtogs 'gro kun sgrib gnyis legs gsal phyir/ /tā ra nā thas zab chos thang mar brdal/ /rgyud rgyal chu gter dngos grub rlabs phreng 'khrigs/ /zab don nor bu'i phung po 'bum brdal las/rmad byung gsung 'bum rgya mtsho 'dir 'ongs pa/ /dus gsum sangs rgyas sras bcas bskyed pa'i yum/ /gang gi bka' 'bum rnam par dag pa 'di/ /skal ldan 'gro la dar zhing rgyas pa'i phyir/ /grangs med glegs bam snang brnyan 'bad med du/ /spel phyir rje btsun yon to bzang po yis/ /spyi lo1996lol ni/ /'dzam thang gtsang ba'i chos grwa chen po sa /spar gyi phyi mo gsar du bskrun pa'i skabs/ /tā ra nā tha'i gsung gi na pod kyi/ /ka nas a yi bar gyi chos rdzas rnams/ /spar du bsgrub pa'i rgyu yon ji song de/ /gtsang skor zhol ma'i sku skyes lnga pa mchog/ngag dbang 'jigs med phyogs las rnam rgyal gyis/ /sbyar ba'i dge ba chu shel bu mo yis/ /bstan 'gro'i phyi nang bar chad zhi ba dang / /mthun pa'i dge mtshan zla ba yar ngos bzhin/ /gong nas gong du 'phel ba'i dge legs stsol/ /'di las rgya cher bsod nams gang 'grub pa/ /srid zhi'i legs —366—

byas kun dang lhan cig tu/ /yongs su zhugs pas mtha' yas 'gro ba kun/ /bla med rgyal ba'i sa la 'khod par shog /drin can bla ma ngag dbang rdor bzang gi /thugs kyi dgongs pa yongs su rdzogs pa dang / /ma rgan nga zhe pha rgan bso rab dang / /a pho stong nyid la sogs 'brel thogs kyi/ /shi gson gang dang gang yod thams cad dang / /srid par gnas pa'i 'gro ba ma lus dang / /dge tshogs 'di la 'bad pa gang byas rnams/ /sku bzhi mchog gi rgyal sar bsgrod par shog/ji srid byang chub snying po'i bar du yang / /tshe ring nad med longs spyod rgyas pa dang / /bdud kyi las dang mi mthun phyogs kun zhi/ /bsam don thams cad yid bzhin 'grub par shog/spar 'di bzhugs pa'i yul phyogs thams cad du/ /dus bzhi snyoms shing lo phyug rtag tu legs/ /'thab rtsod 'khrugs pa'i ming tsam med pa dang / /bkra shis dpal 'bar 'dzam gling brgyan du shog/ces rje btsun tā ra nā tha'i gsung 'bum nang gi na pod kyi par gtsang skor zhol ma'i sku skyes lnga pa ngag dbang 'jigs med phyogs las rnam rgyal gyis/ spyi lo1998lo dang / rnam dkar byed po mchog sprul dgung grangs don gcig bzhes skabs par bskrun byas pa yin/ skabs der yul gru chen po sde dge nas spyan drangs pa'i yig bzo ba a rnam sogs mi nyer gnyis dang par gyi 'gan khur ba blo gros 'phel dang rdor bzang bcas yin/ rje btsun ngag dbang yon tan bzang pos par byang brtsams yod pa la phran pu rje shis kha skong cung tsam bgyis pas 'gro ba rnams la phan pa dang bde ba 'byung bar smon zhu/ par 'di da lta 'dzam thang gtsang ba'i chos grwar bzhugs// //—367—

nged dpal brtsegs bod yig dpe rnying zhib 'jug khang gi las sgrub mi snar lo bstud mar 'tsho ba'i yon spyor gnang mkhan mchog sprul pad+ma dbang rgyal rin po che la snying thag pa nas thugs rje zhu ba dang /krung rga'i bod rig pa dpe skrun khang nas rje btsun tā ra nā tha'i gsung 'bum dpe bsdur ma par skrun thad la rgyab skyor dang mnyam las gnang bar snying thag pa nas thugs rje che zhu ba yin/dpar yon zhal 'debs gnang mkhan/rang re'i spun zla rnams kyi mtshan tho/ ka mad kyi go rim ltar lags/gdung sras phrin las nor bu rin po che/ bla ma mthar phyin rin po che/ bla ma yon tan/sman pa rig 'dzin lags/ las rab gling pa rin po che/ bsod nams bde skyid/
